# Loan on card beyond credit limit  
Get a loan beyond your card’s credit limit if you are the primary credit cardholder  
[How to apply](#topic-how-to-apply "How to apply
")  
[How to cancel](#topic-how-to-cancel "How to cancel
")

[FAQs](#article-faq "Loan on card beyond credit limit")  
With the Loan on card beyond credit limit feature you can apply for a loan on your Emirates NBD credit card even beyond your card’s credit limit. This benefit is provided to primary credit card holders and is easy to apply for.  
**Features**  
* Easy installment payments over 12 to 48 months
* No impact on your existing credit card limit
* Loan amount transferred to your account or issued as a Manager’s Cheque  
**Eligibility**  
Your eligibility depends on the usage of your credit card, card limit, and your credit history. To avail this benefit, you must:  
* Be the primary card holder
* Apply for a minimum loan amount of 1,000

## FAQs  
[Do I need to submit any documentation immediately for Loan on card beyond credit limit?](#faqs-do-i-need-to-submit-any-documentation-immediately-for-loan-on-card-beyond-credit-limit "Do I need to submit any documentation immediately for Loan on card beyond credit limit")  
No, once you raise request, our sales team will get in touch with you and share all the details within 2 working days.  
[What happens if I fail to pay my installment on time?](#faqs-what-happens-if-i-fail-to-pay-my-installment-on-time "What happens if I fail to pay my installment on time")  
If you fail to pay your installments for two consecutive months, your plan will be foreclosed. Your entire outstanding loan amount will immediately be due for payment. Any remaining outstanding balance will attract our regular finance charges. For more details, have a look at our [credit card installment terms and conditions.](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/-/media/enbd/files/others/fees-and-charges/cards/emiratesnbd_credit_card_fees_charges.pdf)

[What if I plan to cancel my credit card?](#faqs-what-if-i-plan-to-cancel-my-credit-card "What if I plan to cancel my credit card")  
If you cancel your credit card, all your plans will also be closed. The entire outstanding amount will be due for payment in full, with applicable charges as per our[terms and](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/File/EmiratesNBD_Credit_Card_Fees_Charges.pdf) [conditions](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/File/EmiratesNBD_Credit_Card_Fees_Charges.pdf).  
[Will this reduce my credit card limit or benefits?](#faqs-will-this-reduce-my-credit-card-limit-or-benefits "Will this reduce my credit card limit or benefits")  
No, you can continue to enjoy the benefits of your credit card.  
[How will I know about my billing cycle and payment method?](#faqs-how-will-i-know-about-my-billing-cycle-and-payment-method "How will I know about my billing cycle and payment method")  
Once your Loan on card beyond credit limit has been approved, our sales team will provide you with all the information related to amount, billing cycle, payment method or any other relevant questions you may have within 2 working days.

text:
Increase your Credit Card limit instantly | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

## What are people asking?  
[How do I request a credit limit increase on the ENBD X App?](#accordion-14978b77-b612-43ee-8f7f-86bdaa0b4bee "How do I request a credit limit increase on the ENBD X App")  
Simply log in to the ENBD X App, select ‘Cards’ on the home screen, choose your credit card, and tap on ‘Limit Increase’. Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the request.  
[Is the credit limit increase approved instantly?](#accordion-e289ebe8-e1a0-4e0c-aabd-83d214e576a0 "Is the credit limit increase approved instantly")  
Yes, if you are eligible, your new credit limit will be updated instantly after you confirm and authenticate the request using your Smart Pass PIN to 100% of approved limit.  
[Will I be notified if I am not eligible for an increase?](#accordion-e155393b-97ff-4e27-858a-3cf9ca2a2263 "Will I be notified if I am not eligible for an increase")  
Yes, if you are not currently eligible, the app will display a message indicating that a credit limit increase is not available at this time  
[Can I choose a lower limit than the one approved by the system?](#accordion-74a5aefc-a925-414c-9f31-444b776ee246 "Can I choose a lower limit than the one approved by the system")  
Yes, you have the option to accept the full approved limit or reduce it to a level you are more comfortable by calling **[600 54 00 00](tel:600540000)**.

text:
Increase your Credit Card limit instantly | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

Yes, you have the option to accept the full approved limit or reduce it to a level you are more comfortable by calling **[600 54 00 00](tel:600540000)**.  
[Is there a fee for increasing my credit limit?](#accordion-ebeca2a7-d82d-43ab-9e62-53160619ea77 "Is there a fee for increasing my credit limit")  
No, there are no fees or charges for requesting or approving a credit limit increase through the ENBD X App.  
[What factors determine my eligibility for a credit limit increase?](#accordion-93e6d43d-447d-45c8-8174-0271d01bad0a "What factors determine my eligibility for a credit limit increase")  
Eligibility is based on several factors including your credit history, repayment behavior, income, and internal bank policies.  
[How often can I request a credit limit increase?](#accordion-9e48c661-105b-4be7-a028-e6b463083566 "How often can I request a credit limit increase")  
You may check your eligibility and request a limit increase at any time via the app. However, approval is subject to the bank’s review and policy.  
[Will increasing my credit limit affect my credit score?](#accordion-a433670a-3fc6-4162-930c-8eb1c5d5ac4e "Will increasing my credit limit affect my credit score")  
A higher credit limit may improve your credit utilization ratio, which may positively impact your credit score-provided you maintain responsible usage and payments.
title: Increase your Credit Card limit instantly | Emirates NBD

text:
Increase your Credit Card limit instantly | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[What should I do if my request is declined?](#accordion-96aabe58-872b-4e27-b705-e4d79b7764e8 "What should I do if my request is declined")  
You can try again after some time. Meanwhile, ensure timely payments and maintain a healthy credit profile to improve your chances in the future.  
[What happens to my supplementary card limit?](#accordion-93b09cb9-0950-4362-a26d-ff2302b8ef68 "What happens to my supplementary card limit")  
The supplementary limit will also reflect the revised limit based on the limit % set on the supplementary card, eg: if the card limit is set 1,000 on the primary card and supplementary limit is set 10% then the limit on supplementary card is 100, when the primary limit increases to 2,000 the supplementary limit on the card will change from 100 to 200.  
[Can I reduce the limit when I want?](#accordion-f271e902-e322-4bf8-b488-fdd7f9fa8537 "Can I reduce the limit when I want")  
Yes, you may reduce the limit on your card by calling [**600 54 00 00**](tel:600540000) (Minimum product offering limit to be maintained with No Credit Limit Decrease fee).  
[Will the revised limit reflect in AECB?](#accordion-ef2b88a2-6849-46fb-b115-9419ee59fbb5 "Will the revised limit reflect in AECB")  
Yes, the revised limit will reflect on AECB however, this will not hold a negative impact.  
[Does this have any impact on how I earn rewards?](#accordion-b6d2cd3f-794b-4ba5-84df-9b9eb63f83ca "Does this have any impact on how I earn rewards")
title: Increase your Credit Card limit instantly | Emirates NBD

text:
Increase your Credit Card limit instantly | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

All reward capping remains the same as per the credit card product, refer to the **[link](/en/cards/credit-cards)**.  
[Can I reduce the limit on my Supplementary credit card?](#accordion-01645b9e-c6d5-472e-bdef-226a6d77bdc2 "Can I reduce the limit on my Supplementary credit card")  
You may reduce limit on the supplementary card by calling **[600 54 00 00](tel:600540000)**.  
[Can I transfer the limit on my other Emirates NBD credit card?](#accordion-65c18143-413d-4e8e-a7a2-b523250383ae "Can I transfer the limit on my other Emirates NBD credit card")  
Yes, if you hold more than 1 card and wish to transfer limit to the other card, you may choose so by calling **[600 54 00 00](tel:600540000)**. Limit transfer is only permitted within Segment / Package type, individual card limits cannot be transferred to Business or Corporate cards and Business / Corporate card limits cannot be transferred to Individual credit cards.

[Is it safe to share my IBAN?](#accordion-81f717b4-643c-4f56-8b01-0fb402f13ec5 "Is it safe to share my IBAN")  
Yes, it’s safe to share your IBAN as it can be used only to transfer funds into your account. An IBAN cannot be used to debit your account or to transfer funds from it in any way.

## Here's how you can redeem your YOUGotaGift HappyYOU Card in a few easy steps:  
![Step 1](/-/media/enbd/icons/accounts/icon_0001_track-the-balances-in-your-account.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=B554482BFBB8B35F71F9AE45E545FC30)

#### Step 4

![Step 5](/-/media/enbd/images/promotions/2023/Summer-Travel-Offer/offers-and-deals-blue_icon.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=72D58E0D07E3CFE30B22F005498B1E50)

## FAQs  
[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my account number?](#accordion-6c7a3152-a05d-4ef2-92d9-932ef2572a52 "Is it safe to share my account number")  
It’s generally safe to share your account number with trusted people and with the bank. Always avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. Rest assured the bank does not share this information with anyone. Read more [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/security).

I understand that, during the deferment Period, all applicable interest will continue to accrue and will be payable by me pursuant to the Loan Agreement.  
I understand that the Bank reserves the right (at its sole discretion) to cancel this Offer or reject my request at any time.

## FAQs  
[What are the official Emirates NBD brand colours?](#accordion-de9df1d0-76f1-475f-9c73-196650c28ce1 "What are the official Emirates NBD brand colours")  
The Emirates NBD primary brand colours are Emirates NBD Blue and White.
Emirates NBD Blue Pantone® 2767 C · HEX #072447 · RGB 7, 36, 71 · CMYK 100, 90, 10, 77
White HEX #FFFFFF · RGB 255, 255, 255 · CMYK 00, 00, 00, 00
These two colours are supported by an extended palette of secondary greys and one accent blue (Pantone 2935 C / #2765FF)  
[What is the minimum size for the Emirates NBD logo?](#accordion-4deb3ee7-f1a9-430d-b65e-861a3a45dc62 "What is the minimum size for the Emirates NBD logo")  
The minimum logo sizes are:
Horizontal logo (primary) — 10 mm (print) / 30 px (digital)
Vertical logo — 18 mm (print) / 55 px (digital)
The size should always ensure both the brandmark and the wordmark remain fully legible.  
[What are the two versions of the Emirates NBD logo?](#accordion-97dbf874-ccf0-4ed5-8938-176eba2ab2f9 "What are the two versions of the Emirates NBD logo")  
The Emirates NBD logo is available in two orientations:
Horizontal (the primary version) and Vertical (used only when horizontal layout is not possible). Both consist of a brandmark and a bilingual wordmark (English + Arabic) combined as a single lockup.  
[Can the Emirates NBD wordmark be used without the brandmark?](#accordion-72b74cff-4654-4662-ac7f-055fc35c081f "Can the Emirates NBD wordmark be used without the brandmark")
title: Emirates NBD Logo Download & Official Brand Assets | Emirates NBD

text:
Emirates NBD Logo Download & Official Brand Assets | Emirates NBD > FAQs

No, **the wordmark should never be used in isolation**. The logo must always be used as a complete lockup — brandmark and wordmark together.  
[Is it correct to place a box or rectangle around the Emirates NBD logo?](#accordion-cc2b4b2e-7fe6-4e8a-a6ad-7433b86fceae "Is it correct to place a box or rectangle around the Emirates NBD logo")  
No, **never place a rectangular box around the Emirates NBD logo.** This applies to all uses — including partner signage, digital screens and all other communications. Always use the correct master artwork directly on the background.  
[What are the official Emirates NBD brand colours?](#accordion-de9df1d0-76f1-475f-9c73-196650c28ce1 "What are the official Emirates NBD brand colours")  
The Emirates NBD primary brand colours are Emirates NBD Blue and White.
Emirates NBD Blue Pantone® 2767 C · HEX #072447 · RGB 7, 36, 71 · CMYK 100, 90, 10, 77
White HEX #FFFFFF · RGB 255, 255, 255 · CMYK 00, 00, 00, 00
These two colours are supported by an extended palette of secondary greys and one accent blue (Pantone 2935 C / #2765FF)  
[What is the minimum size for the Emirates NBD logo?](#accordion-4deb3ee7-f1a9-430d-b65e-861a3a45dc62 "What is the minimum size for the Emirates NBD logo")

Horizontal logo (primary) — 10 mm (print) / 30 px (digital)
Vertical logo — 18 mm (print) / 55 px (digital)
The size should always ensure both the brandmark and the wordmark remain fully legible.

On dark backgrounds, use the white (reversed/negative) version of the logo. The choice of logo version depends on which provides the most contrast against the background to guarantee legibility. Don’t use the primary blue or black logo on a dark background.  
[What is the official Emirates NBD brand typeface in English?](#accordion-1153dc3c-9e7c-427b-aa42-7b12c4ff7955 "What is the official Emirates NBD brand typeface in English")  
The official English brand typeface is **Plus Jakarta Sans**, available in 6 weights: Light, Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold and ExtraBold. If Plus Jakarta Sans cannot be used, Roboto is the permitted fallback. Plus Jakarta Sans can be downloaded from Google Fonts.  
[What is the official Emirates NBD brand typeface in Arabic?](#accordion-a80634ae-eb93-4300-a299-e4641778a0bb "What is the official Emirates NBD brand typeface in Arabic")  
The official Arabic brand typeface is **Tajawal**, complementary to Plus Jakarta Sans. If Tajawal cannot be used, Myriad is the permitted fallback. Latin numerals must be used in all Arabic communications. Tajawal can be downloaded from Google Fonts.

# Planning your dream car: How to use a car loan calculator effectively  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![planpaymentsthesmartway](/-/media/enbd/images/knowledge-hub/car-dealer-talking-client.png?la=en&h=650&w=975&hash=4DA5EFA8ED97869EEF9161CC1DEE1ED8)  
#####  
Buying a car in the UAE is exciting, but the numbers matter as much as the model. Understanding how to use a car loan calculator before you visit a showroom puts you firmly in control. You'll know your monthly payments, your true interest amount and exactly how much you can afford. This guide walks you through every input, every result and every UAE-specific rule you need to keep in mind to plan confidently.  
Before you commit to a car purchase, the one thing standing between you and a smart financial decision is knowing exactly what your monthly repayments will look like. This is where a car loan calculator comes in. Before you commit to anything, a few numbers entered into the right tool will tell you your estimated monthly instalment, your total interest cost, and whether your salary comfortably clears the UAE's 50% Debt Burden Ratio (DBR) cap. The UAE has specific lending rules that shape every loan offer you'll receive, so getting familiar with them will save you from surprises later.

* Your estimated monthly instalment (EMI)

**Down payment**  
The Central Bank of the UAE requires that a car loan should not exceed 80% of the vehicle's value, meaning a minimum 20% deposit is mandatory. For instance, on an 200,000 car, that's 40,000 upfront. Putting down 60,000 instead reduces the financed amount to 140,000, cutting both your monthly instalment and the total interest you pay.  
**Loan term**  
UAE regulations set a maximum repayment period of 60 months for car loans. A longer term lowers your monthly instalment but increases the total interest paid over the life of the loan. For used vehicles, the loan tenure differs based on the model year.  
**Interest / profit rate**  
The rate field is where most of the confusion arises. A flat rate calculates interest on the original loan amount throughout the entire term, while a reducing rate calculates interest only on the outstanding balance each month, which reduces over time. Emirates NBD's Fixed Rate Auto Loan is advertised at a flat rate of 2.69% p.a., equivalent to a reducing rate of 5.06% p.a.  
If you're using an Islamic bank, the term "profit rate" replaces "interest rate", but the calculator field works identically.

**Understanding your results**  
Raw numbers are only useful when you know what each one is telling you. The three elements below are the ones worth examining closely.  
**Monthly payment explained**  
Under a reducing balance model, your instalment pays interest only on what you still owe, so early payments carry more interest and later payments carry more principal. With a flat-rate loan, interest is calculated on the original loan amount for every month of the term. This matters at settlement: because paying off a flat-rate loan early does not save proportional interest, since the interest was spread evenly across all instalments from the start.  
**Total interest charged**  
For a flat-rate loan, the formula is straightforward:  
**Total Interest = Principal × Flat Rate × Years.**

An amortisation table shows the month-by-month split between principal and interest for every payment. Under a reducing-rate loan, the principal share in each instalment grows steadily as the outstanding balance falls. Many online calculators let you export this table to a spreadsheet, which makes it easy to spot the crossover point where you're paying more principal than interest each month.

A flat rate applies to the original loan principal for the entire tenure. A reducing rate is recalculated each month on the balance you still owe, so it falls over time. Since the flat rate number looks smaller, banks tend to advertise it. To compare two offers fairly, ask each lender for both figures. As a rough guide, a 2.5% flat rate typically corresponds to a reducing rate in the range of 4.7% to 5.0%, depending on the term. Plug the reducing equivalent into your calculator to see the actual EMI.  
**Bank promotions and offers**  
Lenders periodically run campaigns that waive processing fees, reduce insurance costs, or offer discounted rates for a limited period. Before accepting any headline offer, ask the bank two specific questions:  
* Does the promoted rate require a salary transfer arrangement?
* Does it apply to the full loan term or only the initial months?  
Salary transfer typically unlocks a lower rate at most UAE banks. Enter the salary-transfer rate and the non-transfer rate into your calculator separately to see exactly what the difference costs you each month.  
**Online comparison tools**  
Widely used UAE platforms aggregate rates from multiple lenders in one view. Use them to identify the offers, then take each rate and re-enter it into your own calculator. This gives you a consistent, apples-to-apples EMI comparison across all offers, calculated on your exact loan amount and term rather than a generic example.

If the EMI figure comes back higher than you'd like, four practical adjustments can bring it down before you apply.  
**1. Pay a larger down payment**  
Increasing your deposit from 20% to 30% on an 200,000 car reduces the financed amount from 160,000 to 140,000. At Emirates NBD's published flat rate of 2.69% p.a. over 60 months, that reduction translates to a considerably lower monthly instalment and saves several thousand dirhams in total interest over the life of the loan. Run both scenarios in the calculator to see your specific saving.  
**2. Shorten the loan tenure**  
On an 80,000 loan at 2.69% flat, a 60-month term generates 10,760 in total interest. Dropping to 48 months brings that figure to 8,608, resulting in a saving of 2,152. Although the monthly instalment rises, the total cost falls. Re-run the calculator for each scenario to find the tenure that balances your monthly cash flow with the lowest possible interest bill.  
**3. Negotiate insurance costs**  
Comprehensive insurance is mandatory while a car is under finance, but you are not required to purchase it through your lender. Getting quotes from external insurers and entering the lower premium into the calculator's insurance field can significantly change the total monthly cost. Even an 200 per month saving on insurance adds up to 12,000 over a five-year term. Ensure that you review the policy annually and renegotiate during renewal.

text:
Cash advance on your credit card | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[If I make a 100% payment on my cash advance, will I still be charged a fee?](#faqs-if-i-make-a-100-percent-payment-on-my-cash-advance-will-i-still-be-charged-a-fee "If I make a 100 payment on my cash advance will I still be charged a fee")  
Yes, you will still be charged a cash advance fee of 3.15% or 103.95 (whichever is higher).  
[What is the maximum limit I can take as a cash advance on my credit card?](#faqs-what-is-the-maximum-limit-i-can-take-as-a-cash-advance-on-my-credit-card "What is the maximum limit I can take as a cash advance on my credit card")  
If you have a business credit card, you can take a maximum cash advance limit of 75% and with a normal credit card, you can take up to 50% cash advance.  
[How are finance charges calculated?](#faqs-how-are-finance-charges-calculated "How are finance charges calculated")  
[Finance charges](/-/media/enbd/files/csr/glossary/emiratesnbd_credit_card_fees_charges.pdf) are calculated on an average daily balance basis for your retail purchases and cash advance transactions from the transaction date to the repayment date.  
The bank can increase the finance charges if the cardholder is two or more payments overdue.

* If you refinance your loan or defer your payments, your loan will take longer to pay back, and you may pay more interest
* If you can’t meet a monthly payment, [apply in advance for a deferment](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/defer-your-loan-payments). You can do this up to twice a year

# Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth  
17 May 2023  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth ](/-/media/enbd/images/private-banking/inspiring-whats-next/2023/Thought-Leadership/pb_thought_leadership_article_banner_new.jpg?la=en&h=467&w=700&hash=8DD93F2ED59010ABEC542A85A1A1CC02)  
##### Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth  
*This article from WealthBriefing is published in conjunction with Emirates NBD Private Banking, and will be part of a series.*  
An ever-present theme in wealth management, down the years, is how the rising, younger generations have different ideas of what they want to do with the family’s wealth and business.  
According to a report by DHF Capital, about $1 trillion in assets in the Middle East will be transferred to the next generation by 2030.  
It is common today for grown-up children of U/HNW families to study in universities such as in the US, the UK and continental Europe. Inevitably, they come up against different influences and ideas and want to apply what they’ve learnt on their home turf.  
Advisors and other wealth managers know this dynamic is at work; it is no wonder that framing strategies around succession, business transfer and family governance is a hot area. To do this job well, advisors must spend time and energy getting close to families, build trust, and learn their needs.
title: Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth | Emirates NBD
section: Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth

text:
Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth | Emirates NBD > Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth

It is important of course not to exaggerate certain differences. Reports suggest that Gulf region families aren’t notably different from those in other parts of the world about the kind of conversations that go on, but there are differences.  
A NextGen study by PricewaterhouseCoopers in 2022 found that when many NextGen in the region have been focused on their own projects, there is a renewed commitment to the family business. NextGen feel positive about their value and their contribution to the business. But they are not complacent; more than a third feel that the pandemic highlighted the need for them to improve their skills. There are some concerns: Only half of Middle East NextGens are aware of a succession plan (of those, most were involved in its development) and 19 per cent do not know if there is a succession plan, the report said.  
However, in recent times, there’s more interest in family offices. Middle East families want structures that aid them in holding generations together in positive ways. For example, Dubai International Financial Centre has launched a DIFC Family Wealth Centre ‘DFWC’ highlighting how the Middle East jurisdiction is targeting family businesses as a client segment. That centre draws together family-owned businesses, ultra-high net worth individuals and private wealth into a single hub.
title: Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth | Emirates NBD
section: Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth

text:
Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth | Emirates NBD > Different Hopes, Common Themes: Middle East NextGen Prepares For Wealth

The DIFC Foundation regime is becoming a better understood proposition, and this was unavailable to the generation of parents and grandparents. The structures are built to protect and provide governance, oversight, and the control of assets within the DIFC framework. This really gives clients confidence that the structures have the support of the DIFC and DFSA.  
Many Middle East families are exploring avenues on how to fully structure generational wealth transfers. This is caused by factors such as how wealth transfer is a relatively new issue for the region because the generation that built the wealth is still around. The Middle East has only started to build an infrastructure of succession and transfer.  
Domestic private banks, and international firms, are ramping up their offerings to tap into a need for sound succession/estate planning advice.  
The Middle East must navigate challenges that have become familiar in certain other regions of the world. What’s clear is that for the private banks and wealth managers that understand the terrain well, there are plenty of opportunities.

Our Treasury team will tailor a foreign currency transfer, whenever and however you need it at and always at the best possible rates for your business.
title: Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD

text:
Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD > Spot and Forward Contracts

## Spot and Forward Contracts  
A **spot trade** is the instant purchase or sale of a foreign currency or commodity. Spot contracts are the most common type of currency transfers. With a spot trade you can:  
* Trade in more than 25 currencies
* Manage quick overseas or cross-currency payments or receivables  
As a business, you want to avoid risks and uncertainties that are associated with exchange rate movements. A **forward contract** helps you do this by arranging to transfer money at a future date and at an exchange rate that is agreed beforehand. With a forward contract you have:  
* A hedging tool that does not involve any upfront payment
* The certainty of execution on a rate and maturity date agreed beforehand
title: Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD

text:
Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD > Swaps

## Swaps  
If you are looking for a foreign currency loan at a better interest rate than you could obtain by borrowing directly in a foreign market, you need a **currency swap**. With a currency swap you can exchange the principal amount of a loan and the interest payable on it in one currency for the principal and interest in another. By setting up a currency swap you:  
* Agree the exchange of a principal amount at the spot rate
* Swap back the principal at either the prevailing rate or the spot rate or at a pre-agreed rate
* Can manage your cash flows better  
An **interest rate swap** allows you to agree to exchange the future interest rate payments you make over a set period on loans or bonds. LIBOR is the benchmark for floating short-term interest rates and is set daily. With an interest rate swap you:  
* Can manage your cash flows and interest rate risk better
* Make no exchange of the principal
title: Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD

text:
Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD > Currency Options

## Currency Options  
A foreign exchange option (commonly known as an FX option or currency option) gives you the right but not the obligation to exchange money from one currency into another at a pre-agreed exchange rate on a specified date. With such an option you:  
* Have the right to buy or sell without any obligation
* Have the flexibility to decide whether to take up the option depending on circumstances
* Pay an upfront premium for the option  
![PromoCardWithHighlights Forward Rate Agreement](/-/media/enbd/images/business-banking/treasury/fra-1920x1080.jpg?la=en&h=1080&w=1920&hash=080E9B29BC350D76F1648C7015B2F5E7)  
#### Forward Rate Agreement (FRA)  
If you are looking to protect your business against future movements in interest rates, a Forward Rate Agreement, or FRA, is perhaps your best option. By entering into an FRA, you:  
*![Lock in an interest rate for an agreed period starting on a future settlement date](/-/media/enbd/images/business-banking/treasury/cashmgt_standing-instructions.png?la=en&h=100&w=100&hash=79BE8B202A2B336AC76D5840AF2379B5)*  
Lock in an interest rate for an agreed period starting on a future settlement date  
*![Specify a principal amount](/-/media/enbd/images/business-banking/treasury/cashmgt_sweeping-pooling.png?la=en&h=100&w=100&hash=7C41D36DAB634E50211AEC259E5AEAA1)*  
Specify a principal amount

text:
Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD > Structured Deposits and Notes

## Structured Deposits and Notes  
Emirates NBD offers you the benefit of both a deposit and an investment product with our **Structured Deposit**. Features of these deposits include:  
* The potential for higher returns compared to fixed deposits
* May be taken in 'tranches' with either a fixed offer period or available until the tranche is fully subscribed (tranches may come with differing features and returns)
* Returns may depend on the performance of the underlying investment product  
Our **Structured Note** combines a bond (to protect your principal) and a derivative element. The bond makes up most of the investment (typically 80%), and the derivative element gives you exposure to potentially higher returns. Features of the note include:  
* Protection of your principal invested (if held to maturity)
* Terms of between 18 months and six years
* Higher potential returns than a simple deposit
title: Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD

text:
Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD > Dual Currency Deposits (DCI)

## Dual Currency Deposits (DCI)  
An Emirates NBD Business banking dual currency deposit allows us to repay your deposit in a different currency at maturity. This is a short-term investment that offers you the possibility of receiving a higher return through moderate movements in exchange rates. Features of these deposits include:  
* Combination of a cash or money market deposit with a foreign exchange option
* The capital and interest can be converted into an alternative currency
* The more the risk the higher the potential yield
* The yield depends on several variables including currency pair, term, market interest rates and volatility of currencies used
title: Treasury Services for Efficient Financial Management | Emirates NBD

* No Promo Code is needed for this campaign.

## ATM Charges  
Depending on your banking package, withdrawals from Emirates NBD ATMs, along with other ATMs locally and internationally, are free of charge if you’re using an Emirates NBD debit card.  
For more details, read our [Schedule of Fees and Charges](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/terms-and-conditions).

text:
ATM fees and charges | Help and Support | Emirates NBD > Cash Advance Fee on your credit card

## Cash Advance Fee on your credit card  
A Cash Advance Fee of 3% or 99 (whichever is higher) applies when withdrawing cash from an ATM using a credit card. In addition, any time you make a cash advance transaction, you will start incurring finance charges. There’s more information [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/terms-and-conditions).

text:
ATM fees and charges | Help and Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[Is there a fee for cardless ATM withdrawals?](#faqs-is-there-a-fee-for-cardless-atm-withdrawals "Is there a fee for cardless ATM withdrawals")  
No, there are no fees for cardless cash withdrawal.  
[Is there a fee for using Emirates Islamic Bank ATMs?](#faqs-is-there-a-fee-for-using-emirates-islamic-bank-atms "Is there a fee for using Emirates Islamic Bank ATMs")  
No, there are no fees when withdrawing cash using your Emirates NBD Debit Card at an Emirates Islamic Bank ATM. If you withdraw cash using your Emirates NBD Credit Card,[these fees will be applied](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/terms-and-conditions).  
[How are finance charges calculated?](#faqs-how-are-finance-charges-calculated "How are finance charges calculated")  
Finance charges are calculated on an average daily balance basis for your retail purchases and cash advance transactions from the transaction date to the repayment date.  
The bank can increase the finance charges if the cardholder is two or more payments overdue.

[I can’t download ENBD X mobile app. What should I do?](#accordion-b8667808-171d-4c4a-a6bc-50ef8e4ee703 "I cant download ENBD X mobile app. What should I do")  
* Make sure you have enough storage on your device.
* Download the app on a stable network (3G/4G minimum speeds are recommended).
* Update your device to the latest version (Android 7.1 and iOS 13 and above).  
[Will I need a new User ID, password, Smart Pass and security questions on ENBD X?](#accordion-8fd20222-6da1-4bb3-8d1a-2b62d0d6c52a "Will I need a new User ID password Smart Pass and security questions on ENBD X")  
* If you are already registered to the existing Emirates NBD Mobile Banking app or Online Banking, you don’t need to register again. Your login credentials will remain same.
* If you have already activated Smart Pass on the existing Emirates NBD Mobile App, it will remain active on ENBD X, but you will be asked to set your new Smart Pass Pin.
* You will receive push notifications on your mobile device to authenticate Online Banking transactions.

[Is it safe to share my account number?](#accordion-6c7a3152-a05d-4ef2-92d9-932ef2572a52 "Is it safe to share my account number")  
It’s generally safe to share your account number with trusted people and with the bank. Always avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. ## Quick Answers  
[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my card number?](#accordion-c14e16bd-40cc-461b-87a6-b5f8a7f4570b "Is it safe to share my card number")  
You should avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. It’s ok to share this information with the bank in a safe manner. Rest assured we do not share this information with anyone. Read more about how we keep you safe [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/security/?ref=beta).

text:
Loan on Card (LOC) Cancellation Request | Emirates NBD > Quick Answers

## Quick Answers  
[Can I cancel my Loan on Card (LOC) if my card is blocked?](#accordion-78cd27df-81de-4cbc-95f2-0a2c0313444b "Can I cancel my Loan on Card LOC if my card is blocked")  
Yes, you can. LOC cancellation can be done for active and blocked cards. The total amount will be reflected as an outstanding on your credit card statement even if your card is blocked.  
[What will I be paying when cancelling my Loan on Card (LOC)?](#accordion-aa3c52a9-4715-424b-bc64-7fecc370256a "What will I be paying when cancelling my Loan on Card LOC")  
To cancel LOC, you will have to settle the remaining principal outstanding plus the foreclosure fee. The foreclosure fee is 1% of principal outstanding plus 5% VAT.  
[I want to follow up on a previous query.](#accordion-c7f0c34f-8c20-48cb-ae5d-9f44c72aef98 "I want to follow up on a previous query.")  
You can track your loan on card cancellation request by calling us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘follow up on my request’.  
[Can I cancel my Loan on Card (LOC) if my card is blocked?](#accordion-78cd27df-81de-4cbc-95f2-0a2c0313444b "Can I cancel my Loan on Card LOC if my card is blocked")  
Yes, you can. LOC cancellation can be done for active and blocked cards. The total amount will be reflected as an outstanding on your credit card statement even if your card is blocked.

text:
Wholesale Travel Solution Virtual Card | Emirates NBD > Redefining B2B Travel Suppliers’ Payments

A growing number of travel agencies are adopting the merchant of record (MoR) model. As the MoR, the travel agency collects the customer’s payments for all services booked through them, authorizes the transactions and then pays the individual suppliers tied to the booking.  
This solution provides travel intermediaries/agencies with increased choice –ultimately supporting a more thriving travel economy.

Security disclosure policy | Emirates NBD UAE > Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy

### Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy  
If you believe you have found a security issue in one of our systems or services, we encourage you to notify us.  
The submission of your report implies your acceptance of our terms as set out in this Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy (“policy”).  
##### Introduction  
*At Emirates NBD Bank PJSC, along with our subsidiaries and affiliates (referred as to “Emirates NBD Group”, “us”, “our”, “we” which depending on the context, may be interpreted as collective group or individual entities within Emirates NBD group)*, we prioritize information security as an essential and integral part of our mission. We value the efforts of ethical security researchers who help us uphold the highest privacy and security standards for the products and services we offer to our customers via our technology assets. We are committed to thoroughly investigating and resolving security issues on our technology assets and services in collaboration with the security community.  
This policy is intended to give security researchers clear guidelines for conducting vulnerability discovery activities. It outlines our preferred approach for submitting identified vulnerabilities to us. The document also defines the scope covered by the policy and do’s & don’ts. Additionally, it provides instructions on how to transmitvulnerability reports.
title: Security disclosure policy | Emirates NBD UAE
section: Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy

text:
Security disclosure policy | Emirates NBD UAE > Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy

We appreciate security researchers that can contribute to improvement of Emirates NBD security posture and its services as part of the outlined Bug Bounty program.  
##### Authorization  
Provided that you adhere to this policy’s provisions during your security research, we will cooperate with you to understand and resolve the issue quickly. Only in such cases, your research will be considered as authorized, and the Emirates NBD Group will neither pursue nor recommend initiating legal action pertaining to the conducted research.  
##### Scope  
Vulnerabilities in Emirates NBD Group’ products and services are only within the scope of the Bug Bounty program when they meet the following conditions:  
* They have not been previously reported or have not already been discovered by our own internal procedures.
* It can be demonstrated that there would be a real impact to the Emirates NBD Group, its users or its customers should the vulnerability reported be exploited by a malicious actor. The existence of a vulnerability does not necessarily demonstrate that such a potential impact exists theoretical impacts will not be considered as within the scope of the scheme.
title: Security disclosure policy | Emirates NBD UAE
section: Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy

text:
Security disclosure policy | Emirates NBD UAE > Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy

Testing is only authorized for the systems and services listed above, which fall within our permitted scope. (\*.emiratesnbd.com and \*.emiratetesislamic.com and any other international domain/subdomains which are managed and maintained by Emirates NBD) This authorization does not extend to vulnerabilities found in systems belonging to any third party. In such instances, please follow the third party’s vulnerability disclosure policy, if provided.  
We request you to focus your testing and research solely on the services and systems outlined in this policy. If you believe that testing is necessary for systems beyond the mentioned scope, we encourage you to contact us to discuss your concerns prior to any attempt.  
##### Test methods - Do’s and DON’Ts  
###### DOs:  
* Explain where you found the vulnerability and what the potential impact could be
* Work directly with the Emirates NBD on vulnerability submissions
* Provide detailed description of a proof of concept to detail reproduction of vulnerabilities
* Submit your interest in joining ENBD Bounty Program
* Submit the report in English, if possible.  
###### DON'Ts:  
* Test systems different from those mentioned in the section “Scope”
* Attempt non-technical testing such as physical (e.g., tailgating, office access etc.) or social engineering (e.g., phishing vishing etc.) involving customers or employees.
* Upload of any vulnerability or client-related content to third-party platforms (e.g., GitHub, DropBox, YouTube).

* Test Third-party Services. Third-party Services mean services that interact with Emirates NBD technology assets to provide value add to customers but are not owned by Emirates NBD.
* Dive deeper to determine how much more is accessible if your able access to a system, accounts, users, or user data, stop at point of recognition and report.

* Engage in any disruptive testing like Denial of Service or Distributed Denial of Service (DoS/DDoS) or any action that could impact the data, confidentiality, integrity, or availability of ENBD information and systems or interrupt access to them.
* Access unnecessary amounts of data. For example, 2 or 3 records is enough to demonstrate most vulnerabilities (such as an enumeration or direct object reference vulnerability).
* Violate the privacy of Emirates NBD Group’s customers, users, staff, contractors, systems etc. For example, by accessing, using, disclosing, sharing, redistributing and/or not properly securing any data retrieved from our systems or services.

* Communicate any vulnerabilities or associated details via methods not described in this policy or with anyone other than your dedicated Emirates NBD Group’s security contact, modify data in our systems/services with an intent to demonstrate security risk.
* Disclose any vulnerabilities you found in Emirates NBD Group’s systems or services to third parties or the public until Emirates NBD Group confirms that those vulnerabilities have been fixed. However, if a vulnerability affects a third party directly (like a software library or framework they use) you can inform them, but don’t mention specific details related to Emirates NBD Group vulnerability. If you are not sure, ask at **[vdp@emiratesnbd.com](mailto:vdp@emiratesnbd.com)**before notifying a third party.
* Copy, retain, share, alter or delete Emirates NBD Group data
* Test using malicious software  
##### Out of Scope (Low Impact Vulnerabilities)  
The following vulnerabilities are considered to have a minimal impact and would be deemed “Out of Scope”, if submitted:  
* TLS configuration weaknesses (e.g., "weak" cipher suite support, TLS1.0 support, sweet32 etc.)
* SSL/TLS best practices that do not contain a fully functional proof of concept reports indicating that our services do not fully align with "best practice" (e.g., missing security headers or suboptimal DNS or email-related configurations such as CAA, SPF, DMARC, etc.)

text:
Security disclosure policy | Emirates NBD UAE > Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy

* Host header injection where the resulting impact is minimal. (Which does not have any significant impact in nature) Network data enumeration techniques (e.g., banner grabbing, existence of publicly available server diagnostic pages)
* Google Maps API Keys
* Account/e-mail enumeration using brute-force attacks
* Account/e-mail enumeration that does not require brute-force attacks may be considered VALID upon approval
* Clickjacking/UI redressing
* Client-side application/browser autocomplete or saved password/credentials
* Descriptive or verbose error pages without proof of exploitability or obtaining sensitive information
* Issues related to password/credential strength, length, lock outs, or lack of brute-force/rate limiting protections
* Leaking Session Cookies, User Credentials, or other sensitive data will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis
* If leaking of sensitive data requires MiTM positioning to exploit, it will be considered out of scope
* Low impact Information disclosures (including Software version disclosure)
* Missing Cookie flags
* Missing/Enabled HTTP Headers/Methods which do not lead directly to a security vulnerability
* Heartbleed requires a valid POC which shows sensitive data leakage. The sensitivity of the data will be determined by Emirates NBD Security team.
* POODLE requires a POC demonstrating a downgrade, not just the result of SSLScan or Nmap scan.

* Vulnerabilities affecting users of outdated browsers, plugins, or platforms
* Vulnerabilities that allow for the injection of arbitrary text without allowing for hyperlinks, HTML, or JavaScript code to be injected
* Vulnerabilities that require the user/victim to perform extremely unlikely actions (i.e., Self-XSS)
* Self-XSS for a Persistent/Stored XSS will be considered due to the possibility that an admin/superuser may stumble across and execute a payload

If you have come across a potential security vulnerability which falls In Scope, please email at **[vdp@emiratesnbd.com](mailto:vdp@emiratesnbd.com)**.

Security disclosure policy | Emirates NBD UAE > Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy

##### Data Protection  
* **Protection of customer data**  
Any testing or research conducted as part of this vulnerability disclosure policy must not compromise or expose Emirates NBD Group’s customer data or any personal data in any way. Researchers are strictly prohibited from accessing, manipulating, or sharing any customer data or personal data during the testing process. Any accidental exposure or access to customer data or any personal data must be reported immediately at DPO@emiratesnbd.com. Failure to comply with this provision may result in immediate legal actions, as applicable. Emirates NBD Group is committed to safeguard customer and personal data and maintaining the highest standards of data privacy and security.  
* **Your personal data**  
Please note that supplying your contact information with your report is entirely voluntary and at your discretion. You can be assured that Emirates NBD will only use such information to clarify the details of your report with you, if necessary. To learn more about our general privacy policy, please visit:  
[**https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/data-privacy-notice**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/data-privacy-notice)  
##### Bug Bounty  
Regrettably, we do not currently offer a paid Bug Bounty program. However, we would like thank security researchers who take the time and effort to investigate and report security vulnerabilities to us according to this policy.  
##### What to expect from us

text:
Security disclosure policy | Emirates NBD UAE > Emirates NBD Group Security Disclosure Policy

##### What to expect from us  
In response to your initial email as vulnerability submission to vdp@emiratesnbd.com you will receive an acknowledgement reply email from the Emirates NBD Group Security Team, this is usually within 24 hours of your report being received.  
Following the initial contact, our security team will work to triage the reported vulnerability and will respond to you as soon as possible to confirm whether further information is required and/or whether the vulnerability qualifies as per the above scope or is a duplicate report. From this point, necessary remediation work will be assigned to the appropriate Emirates NBD Group teams and/or supplier(s). Priority for bug fixes and/or mitigations will be assigned based on the severity of impact and complexity of exploitation. Vulnerability reports may take some time to triage and/or remediate and researchers are welcome to enquire on the status of the process but please limit this to no more than once every 14 business days; this helps our security team to focus on the reports as much as possible.  
##### Governing Laws  
All testing and research activities conducted under this policy must fully adhere to the laws, regulations and guidelines set forth by the United Arab Emirates and/or any other jurisdiction where Emirates NBD Group entity/subsidiary or affiliate is located as applicable. These includes but is not limited to relevant cybercrime or data protection laws.

If you wish to provide feedback or suggestions on this policy, please contact our security team: **[vdp@emiratesnbd.com](mailto:vdp@emiratesnbd.com)**. This policy will evolve over time and your input will be valued to ensure that it is clear, complete and remains relevant.

Help with Smart Pass | Support | Emirates NBD > Update your Mobile Banking app

## Update your Mobile Banking app  
To use Smart Pass successfully, you need to have the latest version of the Emirates NBD mobile app on your device and [these Android and iOS system requirements](/en/help-and-support/activate-smart-pass).
title: Help with Smart Pass | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Help with Smart Pass | Support | Emirates NBD > Can't activate Smart Pass?

## Can't activate Smart Pass?  
If you have the latest version of the Emirates NBD Mobile Banking app and the right system specs but you still can’t activate Smart Pass on your device, here are some possible reasons:  
**Another user may have previously activated Smart Pass on your device.**For security reasons, every device can only have one unique Smart Pass registration on it during its lifetime. You’ll not be able to activate your Smart Pass on a device which had another user’s Smart Pass on it.  
**Your Online or Mobile Banking is blocked.**Smart Pass can only be activated on an active Online or Mobile Banking profile. Learn how to [unblock your profile](/sitecore/service/notfound.aspx?item=web%3a%7b06F801CB-4B72-4D66-A7FB-7EC8D808B784%7d%40en).  
**Your registered email or mobile number is not updated.**One of the steps to activate your Smart Pass requires authorisation codes that are sent to your registered mobile number and registered email address. If you’ve not received your authorization code, check that your [mobile number](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number)and [email address](/en/help-and-support/update-your-email-address)on record with us are up-to-date.
title: Help with Smart Pass | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Help with Smart Pass | Support | Emirates NBD > Can't authorise transactions?

## Can't authorise transactions?  
If you’re having trouble authorising transactions using Smart Pass, it could be due to one of the following reasons:  
**You're using the wrong PIN.**If you enter the wrong Smart Pass PIN 3 consecutive times, your Smart Pass will be blocked. Here’s how to [reset your PIN](/en/help-and-support/reset-or-change-your-smart-pass-pin).  
**Your Smart Pass token has expired.**A Smart Pass token is only valid for 60 seconds after which a new token is generated. Be sure you enter the token during the 60-second timeframe or use the next one generated, again within its 60-second timeframe.  
**You may have multiple screens or tabs** **open.**During your transaction process, don’t keep different screens or tabs open, this is a security hazard and your transaction may be cancelled.
title: Help with Smart Pass | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Help with Smart Pass | Support | Emirates NBD > Can't generate a Smart Pass token?

## Can't generate a Smart Pass token?  
If you’ve reinstalled the Emirates NBD mobile app, you’ll no longer see the Smart Pass option on the home screen of the app. To resolve this, log in to the mobile app and click on **reactivate Smart Pass** under the hamburger icon.  
If you’re still having trouble, get in touch with us at +971 600 54 0000 and when prompted, say ‘issue with Smart Pass’.
title: Help with Smart Pass | Support | Emirates NBD
section: Can't generate a Smart Pass token?

text:
Help with Smart Pass | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[What’s the difference between a Smart Pass PIN and a Smart Pass Token?](#faqs-whats-the-difference-between-a-smart-pass-pin-and-a-smart-pass-token "Whats the difference between a Smart Pass PIN and a Smart Pass Token")  
A Smart Pass PIN is a 4-digit number which you set while activating Smart Pass. You use this PIN to authorise Mobile Banking transactions on your own device.  
A Smart Pass Token, on the other hand, can be used to authorise an Online Banking transaction and the token is generated by you on your own device by tapping the Smart Pass icon on the home page.  
It’s important never to share your Smart Pass PIN or Token with anyone, including Emirates NBD employees.

# IBOR Transition  
## Preparing for benchmark interest rate reform.  
The London Interbank Offered Rates (**LIBORs**), administered by the ICE Benchmark Administration, are being replaced with alternative reference rates (**ARRs**), including nearly Risk-Free Rates (**RFRs**).  
![apple-phone](/-/media/enbd/images/others/libor/libor_img3_slider.jpg?la=en&h=1400&w=1400&hash=A1BA422A156D156148EBD0FBF5AE80F2)
title: IBOR Transition | Interbank Offered Rates | Emirates NBD
section: Preparing for benchmark interest rate reform.

text:
IBOR Transition | Interbank Offered Rates | Emirates NBD > Background of IBOR Transition

### Background of IBOR Transition  
LIBORs are currently published in five currencies and seven tenors. A lack of liquidity in the unsecured wholesale lending market following the financial crisis of 2007 – 2008 resulted in fewer transaction-based rates being submitted to support LIBOR. As a result, there was an increased reliance placed on “expert judgement” of banks to determine LIBOR rates instead of rates corresponding to actual transactions, which posed systemic risk.  
Regulators and public and private sector working groups in several jurisdictions have been discussing the transition of LIBOR referencing financial products to ARRs. Other Interbank Offered Rates (IBORs) and benchmarks are being reformed or, in some cases, discontinued. For some currencies, the relevant IBOR will continue alongside the ARR. For other currencies, the relevant IBOR will likely cease to be provided and so the principal benchmark rate will be the corresponding ARR.
title: IBOR Transition | Interbank Offered Rates | Emirates NBD

text:
IBOR Transition | Interbank Offered Rates | Emirates NBD > LIBOR Cessation Timelines

### LIBOR Cessation Timelines  
The Financial Conduct Authority announced on 5 March 2021 that the following LIBOR benchmark rates will either cease to be provided or will no longer be representative of the underlying market immediately after the following dates (**Cessation Dates**):  
* **31 December 2021:**  
+ In respect of Sterling, Euro, Swiss Franc and Japanese yen, all LIBOR benchmark rates for all tenors; and
+ In respect of United States dollars (USD), for one week (USD LIBOR 1w) and for two months (USD LIBOR 2m); and  
* **30 June 2023:**  
+ In the case of USD, all LIBOR benchmark rates for the remaining tenors.  
![PromoCardWithHighlights  LIBOR Cessation Timelines](/-/media/enbd/images/others/libor/libor_img3_sliderr.jpg?la=en&h=1400&w=1400&hash=560F71DEDE60281FB9F8F5D0EABA3DB2)  
As a valued client of Emirates NBD BANK (P.J.S.C) (ENBD), the transition from LIBOR to ARRs may impact the products and services that you currently use or will use in the future. At Emirates NBD, we strive to keep our customers informed of the relevant changes in IBORs and how such changes may impact you as our client. Accordingly, for this purpose, we will periodically update this page to keep you informed of the key changes and help you assess the impact of this IBOR transition.
title: IBOR Transition | Interbank Offered Rates | Emirates NBD

## Key market developments and Emirates NBD’s response to those developments  
![ISDA IBOR 2020 Protocol](/-/media/enbd/images/others/libor/libor_img4_slider.jpg?la=en&h=318&w=718&hash=345D082B1393598AB3A20D6B23DFB8D2)  
#### ISDA IBOR 2020 Protocol  
The International Swaps and Derivatives Association (**ISDA**) published the ISDA 2020 Interbank Offer Rate Fallbacks Protocol (**ISDA Fallbacks Protocol**) which enables market participants who and which have adhered to it to automatically incorporate fallbacks in legacy derivative contracts. Emirates NBD has adhered to the ISDA Fallbacks Protocol and you may wish to consider if adherence to it is also appropriate for you.  
[Know more](/-/media/enbd/files/others/libor/isda_libor_faq_andtraining.pdf "ISDA IBOR 2020 Protocol")  
![Sterling RFRWG guideline](/-/media/enbd/images/others/libor/libor_img5_slider.jpg?la=en&h=318&w=718&hash=B88AA3DD3C141C6FA466A10B36DBA6A6)  
#### Sterling RFRWG guideline on ceasing initiation of new GBP LIBOR-linked products  
In line with applicable regulatory guidance, from 1 April 2021, Emirates NBD has stopped offering any new Sterling denominated LIBOR referencing financial products (except in limited permitted circumstances) and will instead offer floating rate Sterling denominated products by reference to the RFR, SONIA.  
[Know more](/-/media/enbd/files/others/libor/gl_comm_libor_transition_update_uae.pdf "Sterling RFRWG guideline on ceasing initiation of new GBP LIBORlinked products")

### Additional considerations  
You should consider the potential impact of any future changes to benchmark rates for financial products and arrangements you have with Emirates NBD.  
We suggest that you, as a valued client of Emirates NBD, consider the following:  
* Familiarize yourself, and stay up to date, with the key changes pertaining to the interest calculation methodologies, including the various conventions recommended by the relevant regulators.
* Review operational readiness, hedging considerations and any applicable accounting changes.
* Engage with your financial institutions prior to the relevant Cessation Date(s) to agree the terms that will apply to the transition of your existing LIBOR referencing facilities and other financial products.
* Contact your professional advisors on the possible impact of LIBOR reforms on the financial products and services you use or may use in the future.  
For any further queries relating to the discontinuation of LIBOR, please contact your Relationship Manager.

### Refer your friends and family  
**Eligibility and mechanics:**  
* PRB RM will record the lead in Siebel CRM
* Referrals will be acted upon by Employee Banking Team who will meet the employer point of contact to start process of listing the company and in parallel engage sales channel to start onboarding relationships
* For a successful referral, minimum of 5 NTB Payroll (Beyond/PRB) accounts need to be opened from referred employer with at least one salary transfer of 15,000 or more reflecting by 30*th*April 2025
* Each successful referral will result in 10,000 reward for PRB RM at end of contest period
* Sales Staff incentive will be paid for NTB Payroll accounts as per existing Xceed structure as BAU  
**Monitoring and fulfilment:**  
* Offer is for selected 470 employers whose C-Suite customer is being managed by PRB RMs
* Participating PRB RM’s will inform of the contest details by PRB segment team
* CIE to circulate a monthly tracker for monitoring the status of referrals in CRM.
* Reward will be paid to eligible PRB RM at end of contest period by Xceed team.
* The cost for this campaign will be booked under Xceed budget.

## Settle in full or in part  
Early loan settlement is an option for you to close or settle your existing loan with your own cash or through another bank, prior to completing the tenure you had originally planned with Emirates NBD.  
While the advantages of settling your personal, home or auto or loan early include less interest which translates to more money saved, an improved credit score when you’re free of debt, free cash to reinvest or use for however you please, there's a downside in the early settlement charges. Speak to our loan experts for advice before you decide to close your loan early.  
You can also clear just part of your loan to reduce the installment amounts or loan tenure. Click [here](/en/help-and-support/apply-for-a-partial-loan-settlement)to know more.

## FAQs  
[What are the requirements if I’m applying for foreclosure or early settlement of my loan through another bank?](#faqs-what-are-the-requirements-if-i-am-applying-for-foreclosure-or-early-settlement-of-my-loan-through "What are the requirements if Im applying for foreclosure or early settlement of my loan through another bank")  
The requirements are different from case to case please visit your nearest Emirates NBD branch before 2 PM along with your Emirates ID, AST closure form and proof of funds. One of our branch representatives will advise accordingly if additional documents are required.  
[What is a post-dated cheque (PDC)?](#faqs-what-is-a-post-dated-cheque-pdc "What is a postdated cheque PDC")  
A post-dated cheque is a cheque with a future date that can be used to collect a payment you owe after the date mentioned. This can be issued to a bank, business or person (known as the payee). You can use post-dated cheques when you don't want the payee to collect payment before a particular date.  
[What if I place a request for foreclosure or early loan settlement after the minimum recommended days?](#faqs-what-if-i-place-a-request-for-foreclosure-or-early-loan-settlement-after-the "What if I place a request for foreclosure or early loan settlement after the minimum recommended days")  
Your next installment might get debited before the request is processed leading to additional costs for you.

[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my account number?](#accordion-6c7a3152-a05d-4ef2-92d9-932ef2572a52 "Is it safe to share my account number")  
It’s generally safe to share your account number with trusted people and with the bank. Always avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. # Bank and earn guaranteed cashback  
Open an Emirates NBD account, transfer your salary and get eligible products to earn cashback of up to **6,000**.  
Offer is valid from 25 September to 24 December 2026  
- Salary: **15,000 – 49,999**; Cashback for meeting step 3 below: 1,500; Cashback for meeting step 4 below: 2,000
- Salary: **50,000+**; Cashback for meeting step 3 below: 2,000; Cashback for meeting step 4 below: 6,000

## Our Highlights  
We have built our capabilities and created a product suite to thoughtfully meet the needs of our clients. Our knowledge of local markets, coupled with global reach, enables us to provide a comprehensive and bespoke service across every major asset class for our Retail, Corporate, and Institutional clients. Our strengths include Foreign Exchange, Fixed Income, Rates, Equities, and Commodities.  
![1](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/common-icons/sales_icon.png?la=en&h=200&w=200&hash=FF5297AD07E382E287A05E093EFB089E)  
#### Sales  
We provide best-in-class Treasury services with a 24-hour online electronic platform, smartDEAL, along with sales coverage for Retail, Corporate and Institutional Banking clients for regional and international products.  
![2](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/common-icons/laptopgraphup_cib_icon_b.png?la=en&h=200&w=200&hash=C178F7424CB690DB465FFA4BED92874D)  
#### Trading  
We are among the biggest market makers in the GCC for Foreign Exchange, Fixed Income, Interest Rate Derivatives and Repo products, and possess the biggest trading books in the Middle East in AED and SAR rates. Notably, we are the largest primary originator and secondary market maker in GCC bonds.  
![3](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/common-icons/book_cib_icon_b.png?la=en&h=200&w=200&hash=50DB5E393EAA3E4C9056F5949CB9A4B5)  
#### Research

**Earning Business Rewards Points**  
Your Company will earn Business Rewards Points for all purchases made using the Emirates NBD Business Rewards Credit Card as per the below structure. Supplementary cards issued to your employees will also earn points at the same rate and these will be accrued in your Emirates Business Rewards account.  
**Business Rewards Points earning rate per 5 USD spent:**  
- **Type of spend**: Retail Spends; **Business Rewards Points**: 1
- **Type of spend**: Spends on emirates.com (i.e. Emirates UAE site for travel bookings); **Business Rewards Points**: 2
- **Type of spend**: Grocery and Supermarkets, Government Services (Including Utility bill payments) and Education; **Business Rewards Points**: 0.25

text:
Activate your card | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[I want my dependents to receive SMS alerts for their supplementary credit card spends on their mobile number. How can I activate this?](#faqs-i-want-my-dependent-to-receive-sms-alerts "I want my dependents to receive SMS alerts for their supplementary credit card spends on their mobile number. How can I activate this")  
You need to provide us with the supplementary credit cardholder’s mobile number for them to start receiving their transaction SMS alerts. You will continue to receive these alerts too. The supplementary cardholder’s alerts will not contain the remaining balance on the credit card. Additionally, authorisation code SMS messages will also be sent to the supplementary cardholder once their mobile number is updated with us.  
**Supplementary debit card** authorisation and transaction SMS messages can only be sent to the primary cardholder’s [registered mobile number](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number).  
[If I’m abroad, is there an online channel I can use to activate my card?](#faqs-if-im-abroad-is-there-an-online-channel-i-can-use-to-activate-my-card "If Im abroad is there an online channel I can use to activate my card ")  
If this is your first Emirates NBD card, the only way you can activate it is by calling us. Our [**contact numbers**](/en/help-and-support/contact-us)are available 24/7. Please click Phone Banking on that link.

## Everything you need to know  
Here's a list of all the fees and charges you will incur on your GlobalCash Card  
* Fee for issue of your first card: 30 (excluding VAT)
* Fee for issue of a second card: 30(excluding VAT)
* Local ATM cash withdrawal fee (including Emirates NBD ATMs): 2
* International ATM cash withdrawal fee: 10(or foreign currency equivalent)
* Purchase transaction fee: Free
* Card inactivity fee (charged after 5 consecutive months of you not using the card): 15per month
* Shortfall fee: 50
* Over-the-counter cash advance fee: 50
* Card replacement fee: 30
* Foreign currency transaction fee: 1.84%(charged in addition to the standard processing fee charged by MasterCard International when you conduct a transaction in a foreign currency)
* Purse-to-purse transfer fee: 1%
* Card unload fee: 15
* Card reload: Free
* ATM balance enquiry: Free

## Your trust in us  
We understand that providing services for trusts, companies and other structures is a long-term commitment that may last for decades. We have the expertise and capability to provide this long-term administration to support your family. There are several key benefits of a trust structure:
title: Trust and Estate Planning | Trust and Wealth Structuring | Emirates NBD

text:
Trust and Estate Planning | Trust and Wealth Structuring | Emirates NBD > Your Family

## Your Family  
To help safeguard what matters the most to you, trust a bank that has your best interests at heart.  
**Private Trusts**  
Trusts and Sharia’a compliant Trusts can play an important role in the wealth protection and management for individuals and families, particularly in family estate and succession planning control, to also include asset management protection and confidentiality.  
**Foundation**  
A variety of foundation structures are being implemented in both DIFC and ADGM to hold real estate, trading companies, and investments. We can help clients establish their UAE foundations which can assist with asset protection, and privacy.  
**Asset holding companies**  
Potential uses for Asset holding companies may include assets such as art, jewellery, aircraft, yachts, intellectual property, and image rights.
title: Trust and Estate Planning | Trust and Wealth Structuring | Emirates NBD

text:
Trust and Estate Planning | Trust and Wealth Structuring | Emirates NBD > Your Business

## Your Business  
Benefit from our experience in structuring and managing bespoke solutions for your business  
**Investment Holding Vehicles**  
We have experience with the Incorporation and administration of Jersey domiciled investment holding vehicles, to include provision of experienced professional corporate directors, and transaction management.  
**Property Holding Companies**  
Jersey has been a destination of choice to hold international property investment via holding structures and is well proven in providing high quality legal, accounting and administration expertise. Property holding entities can be established quickly and cost efficiently with each type of structure providing flexibility to meet the investor's requirements.  
**Jersey Companies for Acquisition**  
Jersey companies are considered as a proven vehicle for the acquisition for private equity investment, or the option to invest on behalf of a corporate institution directly.  
![PromoCardWithHighlights Succession planning](/-/media/enbd/images/private-banking/succession-planning.jpg?la=en&h=1250&w=2500&hash=912BFA7D1211FC221C8950567B66F524)  
#### Succession planning  
We work with you to deliver a plan that will ensure the smooth succession of your global assets, whether that is for family succession, a charitable legacy or business continuity reasons.

# Learn to spot a fake website  
14 October 2025  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![learntospotafakewebsite](/-/media/enbd/images/knowledge-hub/learn_to_spot_a_fake_website.jpg?la=en&h=600&w=800&hash=5495105A20D002F2A043AD1D964FFE93)  
#####  
Fraudsters are always on the lookout to steal your information. One of the ways they can do that is by inviting you into a fake website and then enticing you to click on links and enter your personal or credit card information.  
Shopping on fake websites can cost you a heavy price – so watch out when you’re using your Emirates NBD credit or debit cards online – check if it’s really one of our [**partner sites**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/deals) or a fake one hiding behind their name. If you think you can just click on the link, have a look around and leave safely, you’re mistaken. Simply clicking on some of these dodgy links can download a virus on your computer and your personal and financial information will then be stolen by the fraudster behind the website.  
Fake websites usually imitate established websites, often by adding extra words and characters. So study the URL before clicking. Learn how to spot the red flags. It’s important.
title: Learn to spot a fake website
section: Learn to spot a fake website

text:
Learn to spot a fake website > **Look at the address bar**

## **Look at the address bar**  
A secure website asking for sensitive data will **display the padlock symbol** and the **web address will start with “https://”**. The ‘s’ stands for secure. It’s important to note that even this does not guarantee security.  
You can check the security of a site through [**Google’s safe search site**](https://transparencyreport.google.com/safe-browsing/search?hl=en). Never, ever enter personal data into a site beginning with **http://**.
title: Learn to spot a fake website

text:
Learn to spot a fake website > **Check the domain name**

## **Check the domain name**  
Fraudsters make their websites look genuine by copying web addresses of known brands and institutions. Look out for special characters and subtle differences in spellings. Take noonn.comand amazonn.com, for instance. Notice the difference? Look again.
title: Learn to spot a fake website

text:
Learn to spot a fake website > **Check for security certifications**

## **Check for security certifications**  
This site should have a security certification like Symantec, Verisign, DigiCert. Click on the logos of these certifications to see if it takes you to the relevant sites. If it doesn’t, the logo is just a fake image. Run for your life.
title: Learn to spot a fake website

text:
Learn to spot a fake website > **Look out for poor spelling and grammar**

## **Look out for poor spelling and grammar**  
This one’s easy to spot and is a good indication that the site is fake and could have been put up in a hurry to capitalise on periods when more people tend to shop online, such as the holidays.
title: Learn to spot a fake website
section: **Look out for poor spelling and grammar**

text:
Learn to spot a fake website > **Look for contact information**

## **Look for contact information**  
Does the site list phone numbers, email, live chat, address? Try them out. Get in touch with a real person at the company. If you don’t get any proper responses, chances are it’s a scam. And don’t be fooled by chat bots, these can be generic and are easily set up by fraudsters.  
Genuine shopping sites should have terms and conditions, shipping and returns information. Also look for ‘About us’ and privacy sections.
title: Learn to spot a fake website

text:
Learn to spot a fake website > **Secure payment options**

## **Secure payment options**  
Shopping websites should use secure payment options like credit cards or PayPal just like all Emirates NBD partners do. Money transfers or any other nonrefundable payment methods are a red flag.
title: Learn to spot a fake website

text:
Learn to spot a fake website > **If it’s too good to be true, it’s probably not**

## **If it’s too good to be true, it’s probably not**  
Deals and offers can be real, but always check them out thoroughly before clicking on links. Spotted a great deal to an exciting event in Dubai? Beware! Fake ticket sites abound – check before you click. All the rules above apply.
title: Learn to spot a fake website
section: **If it’s too good to be true, it’s probably not**

text:
Learn to spot a fake website > **Those pesky ads!**

## **Those pesky ads!**  
This is a red flag too. If a site is popping up too many advertisements, run a quick virus scan. Chances are you’ve landed on a fake site that is hacking your information. Keep your anti-virus software up to date.  
**Tip:** Never click on links to websites that come to you via email or text. Always go to the site directly.
title: Learn to spot a fake website

text:
Learn to spot a fake website > **If you’ve used your card on a fake site**

## **If you’ve used your card on a fake site**  
If you’ve used your credit or debit card on a site that you suspect is fake, [**block your card immediately using the ENBD X app**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/block-your-card?source=search). You can block it temporarily if you’re not yet sure, so you can then unblock it and continue using the card if the site was safe after all. But if you’re sure you’ve been scammed, block the card permanently and apply for a new one.  
If, for some reason, you can’t block the card, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:00971600540000) immediately and say ‘fraud’ when prompted. A member of our team will help you block your card right away.  
It’s best you change your device passwords as well.
