# 6 tips to create a budget tailored just for you  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/logomark.svg)  
Curated by Emirates NBD  
2 min read  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/calendar.svg)  
24/06/2025  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/show.svg)  
49,129  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/share.svg)  
Share  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/deals/images/tiles/Finwell_5.jpg)  
A budget is one of the most important tools you need to keep yourself financially stable. No matter how much money you make, or how old you are, a budget can help you plan for the future while enjoying the present. Sounds great, right? If you find budgeting a challenge, there’s help at hand. Here’s a list of tips and tricks to help you create a budget built just for you.
.  
**1. Make it simple**  
Your budget is intended to make your life easier, not harder. Focus on creating a budget that works for you, not the other way around. For example, you might find that the 50/30/20 rule offers you a simple and ideal budgeting solution – 50% of your income goes toward necessities; like rent and food; 30% of your income can be spent on things you want, and the remaining 20% of your income goes straight into savings or paying off debt.  
**2. Needs vs. wants**

text:
6 tips to create a budget tailored just for you | Emirates NBD > 6 tips to create a budget tailored just for you

**2. Needs vs. wants**  
Separating your needs from your wants can be a challenge, but it’s important to be honest with yourself here. For example, you might ***need*** a car to get to work, but that new sports car is what you ***want***. It’s okay to spend on items you ***want*** from time to time – just make sure it’s within your budget.  
**3. Get your priorities straight**  
Even if you go with the 50/30/20 budget, you may want to refine your budget even more so that it works specifically for you. The best way to do this is by creating goals and focusing your attention on what’s most important to you. Using your savings to pay down debt should be your first priority; building emergency savings second; and starting to invest third.  
**4. Keep separate accounts**  
An easy trick for making sure you don’t accidentally dip into your savings is to keep separate bank accounts for different purposes. What might that look like? You could consider a separate bank account for your necessities, another for your wants, and a third for your savings. Some digital banking apps even allow you to create multiple savings accounts within your banking app. This way, you can separate your savings into buckets and use them when needed.  
**5. Use technology and automation**

text:
6 tips to create a budget tailored just for you | Emirates NBD > 6 tips to create a budget tailored just for you

**5. Use technology and automation**  
Technology can be one of your best friends when it comes to budgeting. By using online and mobile banking, you can easily see your entire financial picture at any time and have the real-time control you need to maintain your budget. One of the most useful tech tools for your budget will be automating your savings, which can put your budget on autopilot, save you time, keep you accountable, and send the decided amounts to the right savings account.  
**6. Don’t be afraid to change**  
Budgeting isn’t something that has a one-size-fits-all approach. Life is full of twists and turns and your budget may need to change if your needs change. Though it’s great to commit to following your budget closely, you shouldn’t be afraid to change if something about your budget really isn’t working for you. Remember, your budget only benefits you, so while you can make adjustments as needed, you should try and avoid any **unnecessary changes** to your budgeted savings.

## Emirates NBD receives inaugural Dubai-It award  
Emirates NBD has received the inaugural **Dubai-it Award for Institutions in the field of Economy**, presented by H.H. Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence of the UAE, and Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai.  
The award celebrates the Dubai-it philosophy of turning bold ambitions into reality through excellence and a drive to achieve more. It recognises Emirates NBD’s regional expansion and continued innovation across its products and services.  
From its beginnings as a homegrown bank to becoming a leading regional financial institution, Emirates NBD’s journey reflects the ambition and forward-thinking spirit that continue to define Dubai’s growth story.  
This recognitionis also a testament to the dedication, expertise and innovation of our people across every team and market. Their collective efforts continue to set drive our growth and strengthen our contribution to Dubai’s economic vision.  
As Dubai continues to set new benchmarks, we’re committed to supporting its ambitions, creating new opportunities for our customers and shaping the future of banking.  
Thank you for your feedback!

## How to use your Visa card benefits  
From premium airport lounge access to medical and travel benefits, car rentals and great shopping offers – learn all about what your Visa credit or debit card entitles you to and how to access the benefits.  
**Agoda**  
Agoda provides access to 985,000+ hotels and vacation rentals globally.Visit the [agoda website](http://www.agoda.com/visamena)and pay with an eligible Visa card to receive a discount which will be applied at the point of payment.  
For more information, visit [**agoda.com**](http://www.agoda.com/visamena).  
**Airport lounge access**  
Explore a selection of lounges across global Airport destinations and enjoy privileges, latest updates and much more on the app with your Emirates NBD Visa Card.  
Simply download and register your card on the Visa Airport Companion App.  
**Avis car rental**  
Visa cardholders can get up to 35% discount on Avis car rental standard rates. And up to 30% off on retail rates.  
Visit[the Avis World website](http://www.avisworld.com/visa)for more information and to avail the discount.  
**Digital concierge services**  
Book your flights, car rental or even have a meal with you loved ones while on the go. The Concierge Digital Service platform allows you to discover Visa’s premium world.  
Visit the Visa concierge websiteto access the online platform and discover more.  
**Emergency cash and card replacement**

Visit the Visa concierge websiteto access the online platform and discover more.  
**Emergency cash and card replacement**  
In case of emergencies like a lost or stolen card while travelling, you can get an emergency cash advance up to **USD 5,000** or a **replacement card** anywhere in the world. Simply call the Visa 24-hour Alarm Centre on**[8000 121](tel:8000 121)**, wait for the prompt, and then enter
[866 654 0112](tel:+9718666540112)(in the UAE)or[+1 303 967 1096](tel:+13039671096)(internationally).  
**Emergency medical and legal referral service**  
* 24-hour enquiry services or travel information
* Emergency medical and legal assistance
* Other services, from interpreters to technicians  
To avail these benefits, pay for your travel using your Emirates NBD card.  
For medical or legal referral services, call the **Visa 24-hour Alarm Centre** on**[+44 (0) 20 8762 8373](tel:+44 (0) 20 8762 8373)**.  
**Extended Warranty**  
Enjoy additional retailer’s warranty on your household appliances for a maximum period of 1 year when you use you Emirates NBD credit card to pay for a purchase. Learn more [here](/en/help-and-support/visa-extended-warranty).  
**Fraudulent Card Misuse Protection**  
The Visa Fraudulent Card Misuse Protection feature keeps you protected against unauthorized transactions or fraudulent use of your card. This includes unauthorized charges as a result of loss or theft, use in-store, over the phone, ATM withdrawals and online purchases.

Learn more [here.](https://www.visaconciergecemea.com/product/visa-cemea/homepage)  
**Global customer assistance**  
Global customer assistance supports you when you need it most while travelling. The service includes:  
* Lost or stolen card reporting
* Emergency card replacement
* Emergency cash up to USD 5,000
* Emergency payment authorization  
For more information, call+[971 4 3611234.](tel:+97143611234)  
**International medical and travel assistance**  
This benefit allows you and your immediate family travelling with you outside your principal country up to 90 days to avail:  
* Medical telephonic advice
* Connecting you with local medical service provider
* Someone to monitor your medical condition till you are well.  
Learn more [here](https://cardholderbenefitsonline.com/).  
**Multi-trip Travel Insurance**  
Enjoy your travel experience with Multi-trip Travel Insurance. Some of the benefits include:  
* Emergency Medical Expenses up to USD 1,000,000
* Hospital Daily Cash $100 per day up to USD 3,000
* Trip Cancellation/Curtailment up to USD 7,500
* Delayed departure up to USD 1,000
* Baggage delays up to USD 500

## What are people asking?  
[What is Cardless Cash Withdrawal?](#accordion-549646a4-5520-4044-bd92-bc3041c97b94 "What is Cardless Cash Withdrawal")  
Cardless Cash Withdrawal is a businessONLINE (For non-individual customers) and Mobile App (for individual customers) feature which allows you to provide special access to third parties (with a UAE mobile number and Emirates ID), to withdraw a specified amount of cash from your account through any Emirates NBD ATM.  
[How does Cardless Cash Withdrawal work?](#accordion-cc9d4591-4d83-45b2-97ef-39df3a6d5795 "How does Cardless Cash Withdrawal work")  
For non-individual customers, once you register a person as a beneficiary through businessONLINE, you can log in and initiate a transaction by specifying details such as amount and beneficiary's mobile number. Inform the nominated person about the amount which he/she is allowed to withdraw. Once the request is initiated online, the beneficiary will receive an authorisation code via SMS on their UAE mobile number with which they can visit any Emirates NBD ATM and withdraw the specified amount of cash.  
[Who can access Cardless Cash Withdrawal option in businessONLINE?](#accordion-6a4bf50b-83c4-4693-8bb3-c9de98fdf5f9 "Who can access Cardless Cash Withdrawal option in businessONLINE")  
Any businessONLINE user who has access to the Own Account Payments option, can access Cardless Cash Withdrawal option.
title: Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD

text:
Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

Any businessONLINE user who has access to the Own Account Payments option, can access Cardless Cash Withdrawal option.  
[Will Cardless Cash Withdrawal product follow the same Authorisation Workflow as Own Account Payment product in businessONLINE?](#accordion-91985e4f-4407-4750-bca6-329d9d6f8409 "Will Cardless Cash Withdrawal product follow the same Authorisation Workflow as Own Account Payment product in businessONLINE")  
The Cardless Cash Withdrawal product will be entitled by default, if the Own Account Payment product is entitled to the businessONLINE subscription, Cardless Cash Withdrawal product will follow the same Authorisation Workflow as that of Own Account Payment product. However, the admin user can amend the workflow later on.  
[How can I initiate a Cardless Cash Withdrawal request?](#accordion-54a8b995-b85a-412a-b0d2-94c860e7b564 "How can I initiate a Cardless Cash Withdrawal request")  
For non-individual customers, login to businessONLINE, click on the Payments tab. Click on Initiate Payments, and then on Cardless Cash Withdrawal. To know more, please refer to our user guide. For individual customers, you can login to Mobile app and use the mePay transfer option.  
[What is Cardless Cash Withdrawal?](#accordion-549646a4-5520-4044-bd92-bc3041c97b94 "What is Cardless Cash Withdrawal")
title: Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD

text:
Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[What is Cardless Cash Withdrawal?](#accordion-549646a4-5520-4044-bd92-bc3041c97b94 "What is Cardless Cash Withdrawal")  
Cardless Cash Withdrawal is a businessONLINE (For non-individual customers) and Mobile App (for individual customers) feature which allows you to provide special access to third parties (with a UAE mobile number and Emirates ID), to withdraw a specified amount of cash from your account through any Emirates NBD ATM.  
[How does Cardless Cash Withdrawal work?](#accordion-cc9d4591-4d83-45b2-97ef-39df3a6d5795 "How does Cardless Cash Withdrawal work")  
For non-individual customers, once you register a person as a beneficiary through businessONLINE, you can log in and initiate a transaction by specifying details such as amount and beneficiary's mobile number. Inform the nominated person about the amount which he/she is allowed to withdraw. Once the request is initiated online, the beneficiary will receive an authorisation code via SMS on their UAE mobile number with which they can visit any Emirates NBD ATM and withdraw the specified amount of cash.  
[Who can access Cardless Cash Withdrawal option in businessONLINE?](#accordion-6a4bf50b-83c4-4693-8bb3-c9de98fdf5f9 "Who can access Cardless Cash Withdrawal option in businessONLINE")  
Any businessONLINE user who has access to the Own Account Payments option, can access Cardless Cash Withdrawal option.
title: Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD

text:
Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

Any businessONLINE user who has access to the Own Account Payments option, can access Cardless Cash Withdrawal option.  
[Will Cardless Cash Withdrawal product follow the same Authorisation Workflow as Own Account Payment product in businessONLINE?](#accordion-91985e4f-4407-4750-bca6-329d9d6f8409 "Will Cardless Cash Withdrawal product follow the same Authorisation Workflow as Own Account Payment product in businessONLINE")  
The Cardless Cash Withdrawal product will be entitled by default, if the Own Account Payment product is entitled to the businessONLINE subscription, Cardless Cash Withdrawal product will follow the same Authorisation Workflow as that of Own Account Payment product. However, the admin user can amend the workflow later on.  
[How can I initiate a Cardless Cash Withdrawal request?](#accordion-54a8b995-b85a-412a-b0d2-94c860e7b564 "How can I initiate a Cardless Cash Withdrawal request")  
For non-individual customers, login to businessONLINE, click on the Payments tab. Click on Initiate Payments, and then on Cardless Cash Withdrawal. To know more, please refer to our user guide. For individual customers, you can login to Mobile app and use the mePay transfer option.  
[Can I initiate multiple cash withdrawal requests at a time?](#accordion-d1a1a884-7fee-49b4-91f1-d3e996f4edb0 "Can I initiate multiple cash withdrawal requests at a time")  
Yes multiple Cardless Cash withdrawals can be initiated, till it is within the daily limit.
title: Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD

text:
Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

Yes multiple Cardless Cash withdrawals can be initiated, till it is within the daily limit.  
[Are there any limits for an amount that can be withdrawn?](#accordion-6e725296-9aae-4fe1-82ce-5c2ef7a109fd "Are there any limits for an amount that can be withdrawn")  
Yes. The withdrawal amount should always be in multiples of 100 e.g., 100, 200, 5,000 etc. The maximum withdrawal amount per request is 20,000. You can initiate a maximum of 10 Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests per day from all your company's accounts, collectively (i.e. per CIF).  
For non-individual customers per day, a maximum amount of 200,000 can be withdrawn from all your company's accounts, collectively (i.e. per CIF). For individual customers per day, a maximum amount of 2000 can be withdrawn, and 5000 per month.  
[How will the beneficiary withdraw money from the ATM?](#accordion-3478609e-20d9-4af5-a0bd-8d0b443af9ae "How will the beneficiary withdraw money from the ATM")  
Once the beneficiary receives the authorisation code via SMS, he/she can visit any Emirates NBD ATM and follow the steps below:  
* Tap on the Cardless Withdrawal option on the ATM screen
* Enter the mobile number on which they have received the authorisation code
* Note: If the beneficiary is not an Emirates NBD customer, the ATM will prompt them to insert their Emirates ID for verification
* Enter the amount to be withdrawn
* Enter the authorisation code received on their mobile number
* Tap the Confirm button
title: Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD

text:
Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

* Enter the amount to be withdrawn
* Enter the authorisation code received on their mobile number
* Tap the Confirm button  
[For how long is the authorisation code valid for?](#accordion-e7388e8a-c089-4d4f-af31-4f0c83f26591 "For how long is the authorisation code valid for")  
The authorisation code received via SMS is valid for 24 hours. The expiry date and time will be mentioned in the SMS.  
[What will happen if the beneficiary does not withdraw the amount before the authorisation code expires?](#accordion-9c1d8ed6-b58d-4efc-b991-62925beceb8f "What will happen if the beneficiary does not withdraw the amount before the authorisation code expires")  
If the beneficiary does not withdraw the amount before the authorisation code expires, the request will be cancelled automatically, and the amount will be returned to your account.  
[What will happen if the beneficiary accidentally deletes the SMS containing the authorisation code?](#accordion-cdabe1d5-fb3d-4ac9-9ce0-7ad946ee60e6 "What will happen if the beneficiary accidentally deletes the SMS containing the authorisation code")  
The SMS can only be sent once per Cardless Cash Withdrawal request. In this case, you can cancel the request through businessONLINE and initiate a new request to the beneficiary.  
[If I have initiated a request and wish to cancel it later, is it possible?](#accordion-9537dc04-06fb-43b0-902d-3c9ab4d880bd "If I have initiated a request and wish to cancel it later is it possible")
title: Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD

text:
Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

Yes, a Cardless Cash Withdrawal request to a single beneficiary can be cancelled through businessONLINE as long as the beneficiary has not withdrawn the cash. However, requests initiated to multiple beneficiaries using the Basket or File Upload options cannot be cancelled online.  
[If I entered the beneficiary's mobile number incorrectly when initiating the Cardless Cash Withdrawal request, can I correct the number later?](#accordion-29875884-cc32-44b5-a3ee-c37ea94a5f69 "If I entered the beneficiarys mobile number incorrectly when initiating the Cardless Cash Withdrawal request can I correct the number later")  
Once the request is initiated, you will not be able to correct the mobile number. You can cancel the request through businessONLINE and initiate a new request with the correct mobile number.  
[Can you schedule a cash withdrawal request in advance?](#accordion-f732e9cd-c027-43b3-8687-3b9ef160a434 "Can you schedule a cash withdrawal request in advance")  
Yes, when initiating the request online, you can set up any upcoming date (including bank holidays) when you would like the cash withdrawal request to be executed. Your beneficiary will receive the authorisation code to withdraw the amount on the selected date.  
[Is there any cut off time before which I should initiate Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests?](#accordion-6ad2d116-06f0-426d-9d05-623ec2c74acb "Is there any cut off time before which I should initiate Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests")
title: Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD

text:
Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

No. There is no cut off time to initiate Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests.  
[Will I be able to initiate Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests on bank holidays?](#accordion-a3482b0c-17fb-4654-a20a-152b0602150b "Will I be able to initiate Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests on bank holidays")  
Yes, Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests can be initiated on bank holidays.  
[Are there any charges for initiating Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests?](#accordion-a0c39ed4-246f-4559-84d1-19ef1dcc1cd9 "Are there any charges for initiating Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests")  
No, the Cardless Cash Withdrawal service is free.  
[Can I initiate Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests through Host2Host?](#accordion-9960e395-0792-463a-ac93-d5e5fa2b0a3d "Can I initiate Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests through Host2Host")  
No, currently Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests are not available on Host2Host.  
[Can I use the Basket and Bulk upload options to create Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests to multiple beneficiaries?](#accordion-7dbebf7b-556e-4197-b7d3-1fee7dd515c5 "Can I use the Basket and Bulk upload options to create Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests to multiple beneficiaries")  
Yes.  
[What if the beneficiary enters the incorrect authorisation code when withdrawing the cash?](#accordion-f3aaf2b7-a18c-4c4b-9845-1b6a8c8ebe7a "What if the beneficiary enters the incorrect authorisation code when withdrawing the cash")
title: Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD

text:
Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

If the beneficiary enters the incorrect authorisation code in the ATM three times successively, the request will be cancelled, and an SMS notification will be sent to you and the beneficiary.  
[What happens if the beneficiary enters wrong amount while withdrawing cash?](#accordion-fba43332-1f6f-4b87-b3c9-9798711a3b8c "What happens if the beneficiary enters wrong amount while withdrawing cash")  
If the beneficiary enters the wrong amount when withdrawing the cash, the request will be cancelled, and an SMS notification will be sent to you and the beneficiary.  
[What happens if the beneficiary has multiple Cash Withdrawal requests, and he /she enters wrong authorisation code?](#accordion-189d5e19-fe9b-42a5-9740-64d76a61963f "What happens if the beneficiary has multiple Cash Withdrawal requests and he she enters wrong authorisation code")  
If you have initiated multiple Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests to the same beneficiary and if he/she enters the incorrect authorisation code for any one request, all the Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests for that beneficiary will be cancelled. Once cancelled, both you and the beneficiary, will receive a notification via SMS about the cancelled requests.  
[Does a beneficiary need his/her Emirates ID to withdraw cash?](#accordion-7da9d749-dc6a-4055-9e1b-0e5f36f24791 "Does a beneficiary need hisher Emirates ID to withdraw cash")
title: Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD

text:
Cardless Cash Withdrawal | Cardless ATM | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

The beneficiary would be required to insert their Emirates ID in the ATM when withdrawing cash only if they are not an Emirates NBD customer.  
[Can my beneficiary withdraw the cash from any Emirates NBD ATM?](#accordion-b03e25b7-3882-4057-adf3-224115ddae8d "Can my beneficiary withdraw the cash from any Emirates NBD ATM")  
Yes.  
[Can I initiate a Cardless Cash Withdrawal request in a foreign currency?](#accordion-d36099cf-1936-46ca-bc67-c429ea428d59 "Can I initiate a Cardless Cash Withdrawal request in a foreign currency")  
No. Cash can only be withdrawn from ATMs in AED currency.  
[What happens when the authorisation code expires?](#accordion-62267293-4168-4242-b7eb-81d283242b45 "What happens when the authorisation code expires")  
If the beneficiary does not withdraw cash before the authorisation code expires, the amount will be reversed to your account automatically. Once the code expires, the beneficiary cannot use it to withdraw cash. You would have to initiate a new request to the beneficiary.  
[Can I use an international number when registering my beneficiary?](#accordion-1e88e392-8107-4a1c-a317-03669c013f1c "Can I use an international number when registering my beneficiary ")  
No. Currently, only UAE mobile numbers can be used for Cardless Cash Withdrawal requests.

## Eligibility  
To qualify for the **Dubai International Growth Initiative**, SMEs will need to:  
* Be **founded and operational in Dubai**, demonstrating a successful and sustainable business model.
* Operate within the sectors of  **E-commerce, Food and beverage (F&B), Fast moving consumer goods (FMCG), manufacturing, services and retail (including parts and machinery)** .

* **Effectively manage repayments** based on cashflows from their current operations.
* Present a **comprehensive business** plan outlining their strategy for global growth.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for the Dubai International Growth Initiative  
[What is the Dubai International Growth Initiative?](#faqs-1)  
The Dubai International Growth Initiative is an initiative by the Government of Dubai to accelerate global expansion of Dubai-founded Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs). It offers financial assistance and innovative financial solutions to propel their business into global markets.  
[Who is eligible for the initiative?](#faqs-2)  
The first phase of this strategic initiative is open to SMEs founded in Dubai in various sectors (additional sectors to be added subsequently), encompassing E-commerce, F&B (Food and Beverage), FMCG (Fast moving consumer goods), manufacturing, services and retail (including parts and machinery distribution) and have been operational for three to five years, and are looking to establish their global presence. They must also meet certain financial criteria, including revenue, net profit, free cash flow, and debt-to-EBITDA ratio along with other financial and non-financial criteria.  
[What is the definition of SME?](#faqs-3)  
A SME in Dubai is defined as any enterprise which meets the thresholds of Employee Headcount and Turnover, as applicable to the sector it belongs to. To be classified as a SME, the business may have a maximum of 250 employees with annual turnover less than or equal to AED250 million.  
[What financial support does the initiative offer?](#faqs-4)

[What is the definition of SME?](#faqs-3)  
A SME in Dubai is defined as any enterprise which meets the thresholds of Employee Headcount and Turnover, as applicable to the sector it belongs to. To be classified as a SME, the business may have a maximum of 250 employees with annual turnover less than or equal to AED250 million.  
[What financial support does the initiative offer?](#faqs-4)  
Qualifying SMEs can receive up to 15 million as a facility for a maximum period of 7 years. The initial funding pool for the initiative is 500 million.  
[Is this initiative open to all nationalities?](#faqs-5)  
The initiative is open to all nationalities that have a business founded in Dubai and are applying for global expansion of their existing business.  
[What can the financing be used for?](#faqs-6)  
Financing received under the initiative can be used to cover expenses related to global expansion. This includes operational costs such as rentals, lease payments, capital expenditures for fit-outs, equipment, regulatory fees, and other startup costs associated with establishing and operating a global business.  
[Are there any costs to SMEs for participating in the initiative?](#faqs-7)  
The initiative offers medium-term loans and working capital facilities. The cost of financing will be based on the Emirates’ Interbank Offered Rate (EIBOR), with no additional margin, however the standard bank fees (facility set up/processing fees) may apply.

section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for the Dubai International Growth Initiative

text:
Dubai International Growth Initiative - Empowering SMEs Globally | Emirates NBD > Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for the Dubai International Growth Initiative

[Do I need to have an account at Emirates NBD?](#faqs-8)  
Participants approved under the initiative are required to route their existing business cashflows through Emirates NBD UAE bank accounts and where Emirates NBD group has a branch network the international cash flows must also be routed through the account in the specific country. This ensures transparency for evaluation and assists Emirates NBD in supporting the participant with a suite of products.  
[What is the maximum financing amount available?](#faqs-9)  
The maximum financing amount available to an SME is 15 million.  
[What is the application process?](#faqs-10)  
Upon fulfilling the initial eligibility criteria, a dedicated specialist will conduct a discretionary comprehensive review of the applicant’s business followed by the joint steering committee review for inclusion in the initiative. Qualified applicants will work closely with Emirates NBD to receive tailored financial solutions to address their unique growth needs.  
[How will I know if I have been selected?](#faqs-11)  
A specialist will keep you informed of the decision of Emirates NBD and the joint steering committee. Upon acceptance your specialist will work with you in completing the documentary formalities.

For any reason If Emirates NBD does not approve your application for recommendation to the initiative, the specialist will explain to you the reasons why your application was not approved by Emirates NBD. The joint steering committee while maintaining transparency is not required to disclose the reasons for non-acceptance. This may include but is not limited to viability of the proposal to concentration risk for a specific sector or sub-sector.  
[If my business is not accepted in the initiative are there other financing options that Emirates NBD can offer?](#faqs-12)  
Emirates NBD through its various product offerings can offer you a financial solution that is within its risk appetite and policies; however, it is important to note that such solutions will not fall under this initiative. We offer these products and services in the regular course of our business. If you have completed the detailed review process Emirates NBD may recommend alternate solutions.

[Can I meet the joint steering committee to present my business?](#faqs-13)  
The joint steering committee evaluates all applicants on a fair basis primarily using the evaluation performed by Emirates NBD. The joint steering committee as part of its decision-making process may invite qualified applicants to present their business plans. Though, the joint steering committee does not intend to host each applicant. Emirates NBD will remain the point of contact for applicants and subsequently for all approved participants.  
[What is the governance structure of the initiative?](#faqs-14)  
The initiative is overseen by a joint steering committee comprising representatives from Dubai Government and Emirates NBD. They review and approve applications for inclusion in the initiative, ensure compliance with the initiative criteria, and manage governance.  
Joint steering committee members:  
* Rashed Ali Bin Obood Al Falasi, Chief Executive Officer - Public Debt Management Office of the Department of Finance
* Hadi Badri, Chief Executive Officer - Dubai Economic Development Corporation
* Ahmed Al Qassim, Group Head of Wholesale Banking - Emirates NBD
* Marwan Hadi, Group Head of Retail Banking & Wealth Management - Emirates NBD
* Vinod Ramabhadran, Group Chief Credit Officer - Emirates NBD

The initiative will remain accessible until such time as the initiative is deemed closed by the joint steering committee or reaches its target of AED500 million. Following the initial review, a specialist will contact you for further information and to support your application.

Expat Mortgage | Home Loans for Expatriates | Emirates NBD > Borrow wisely – a few things you should know

### Borrow wisely – a few things you should know  
* If you don’t make the monthly payments towards your loan on time, you will incur a late payment fee
* Missing repayments can affect your credit score, limiting your ability to access loans or financing in the future
* If you refinance your loan or defer your payments, your loan will take longer to pay back, and you may pay more interest
* If you can’t meet a monthly payment, [apply in advance for a deferment](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/defer-your-loan-payments). You can do this up to twice a year  
It’s important to read the terms and conditions and know the fees and charges before you apply for a loan.

text:

## Before you start  
* You’ll be asked security questions, so we can make sure that it’s you. Be prepared with your **credit card number** and [**registered mobile number**](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number).
* Your request will be processed immediately. Once you fill in this form, you will receive an SMS with the request details on your [**registered mobile number**](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number) and the duplicate statement will be sent on your **[registered email address](/en/help-and-support/update-your-email-address)**.

text:
Credit Card Statement Request | Emirates NBD > Quick Answers

## Quick Answers  
[Can I request a credit card duplicate statement more than 1 year old?](#accordion-b8da7e52-1cbb-4d1f-b50c-7f129abee2e2 "Can I request a credit card duplicate statement more than 1 year old")  
Yes, you can. Please call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000), or visit the nearest branch with your Emirates ID.  
[Can I request a duplicate statement for a cancelled credit card?](#accordion-c608a032-c0f5-4b1f-b76b-cf0bdfd69adc "Can I request a duplicate statement for a cancelled credit card")  
Yes, you can, provided you have another active credit card where the charges can be deducted from.  
[What is the charge for a duplicate credit card statement?](#accordion-052fe60c-fa06-4b41-baaf-808de06a4e3f "What is the charge for a duplicate credit card statement")  
The charge for a duplicate credit card statement (up to the last 3 months) is 15 per month + 5% VAT. For statements over 3 months old, the charge is 45 per month + 5% VAT.  
[I want to follow up on a previous request.](#accordion-b9f0fd29-fd39-4dd8-b928-8f4993044c3f "I want to follow up on a previous request.")  
You can track your previous request by calling us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘follow up on my request’.  
[Can I request a credit card duplicate statement more than 1 year old?](#accordion-b8da7e52-1cbb-4d1f-b50c-7f129abee2e2 "Can I request a credit card duplicate statement more than 1 year old")

text:
Priority Banking - Personal Loans | Emirates NBD > The importance of a good credit score

## The importance of a good credit score  
The Al Etihad Credit Bureau creates credit scores for both individuals and businesses. These are three-digit numbers based on your financial history which help banks and other lenders assess the likelihood of you paying loan or credit card instalments on time. The score ranges from 300 to 900. Emirates NBD is proud to have been among the first banks to use Credit Scores for processing new product applications. The higher the score you have the more benefits you can enjoy, such as faster processing of your application, less paperwork, enhanced eligibility, lower interest rates and higher loan amounts and credit limits.

## What are people asking?  
* What does EIBOR stand for?
+ EIBOR is the "Emirates Interbank Offered Rate" or essentially the national base interest rate
* How often does my interest rate change?
+ The FlexiLoan is reviewed every month or 6 months, based on your choice. Your base interest rate will be refreshed to reflect the current EIBOR rate for the period you have selected.
* Why is variable pricing worth considering?
+ A variable rate can be lower than a fixed rate. The cost of your loan is based on the reducing balance, and you also get a guaranteed reduced interest rate for the first 6 months of your loan to save you more.
That’s not all – you will also be offered a first year free Premium Credit Card\* of your choice with all its exclusive benefits. Existing Cardholders will receive a free renewal.

## A loan that does not depend on salary transfer  
We aim to give everyone the opportunity to achieve their goals. Even if you do not have an account with us to which your salary is transferred, you can still apply for a personal loan with Emirates NBD. This loan includes the following features:  
* Loan up to 500,000 for both UAE Nationals and expatriates
* Competitive interest rates starting at 8.99% reducing balance
* Repayment period of up to 48 months
* Repayment through Direct Debit System (DDS)
title: Priority Banking - Personal Loans | Emirates NBD
section: A loan that does not depend on salary transfer

text:
Priority Banking - Personal Loans | Emirates NBD > 7-day Loan Return Option

## 7-day Loan Return Option  
Customers who are not satisfied with the personal loan have the option of returning it with no fees or charges. The following conditions apply:  
* Customer must notify the sales agent/Bank within 7 calendar days.
* The loan proceeds credited to the customer's account are available and have not been withdrawn from the account
* The offer is valid for new applications, without liability settlements (Not applicable to Top Up and Take Over loans)
title: Priority Banking - Personal Loans | Emirates NBD

text:
Priority Banking - Personal Loans | Emirates NBD > Credit life Insurance (CLI)

## Credit life Insurance (CLI)  
Credit life Insurance (CLI) is a personal life insurance cover provided under the Group Credit Life Insurance policy where, in the unfortunate event of borrower’s death, the outstanding loan amount will be covered under this insurance scheme by the insurance company\*.  
\*Subject to Terms of the policy, Terms & Conditions apply.  
**Eligibility:**  
* Proof of employment and salary
* Valid UAE residence visa
* Minimum of 6 months in current job

## A choice of savings plans  
We can help you meet your specific financial goals and secure your legacy with the right personal plan.  
**Protection**  
You never know what is around the next corner. Something unexpected can have devastating consequences on you and your family.  
Let us help you enjoy peace of mind by keeping you and your loved ones protected. If you are the principal wage earner of the family or have dependents, the right protection for that possible rainy day can protect your family’s future finances.  
**Savings**  
Your future aspirations, such as buying your dream home, taking the family on a holiday of a lifetime or building a secure and rewarding retirement, need a proper savings plan. The sooner you start building such a plan, the better the outcome will be.  
We have a wide range of options to help you achieve your specific goals. We can also provide insurance coverage in the event of death, disability or critical illness.  
**Children’s Education**  
We all want to give our children a secure future, and education is the key to their likely success in life.  
Our children’s education plans are tailor-made to help you support your children through their most important formative years.  
**Retirement**  
Whatever life after work might look like to you, one thing is certain – a financially secure retirement requires careful planning.

One Hundred and Fifty (150) Eligible Credit Cardholders, with Eligible Spends during the Promotion Period will stand a chance to get 10,000 as statement credit.  
**Eligible Cardholder** means each primary cardholder of an Eligible Card to whom the offer to participate in the Promotion has been communicated by Emirates NBD.  
**Eligible Spend**  means cumulative domestic or international transactions, at a point of sale or online of AED value within the specified categories as has been communicated by Emirates NBD.  
**Each foreign transaction** (Non-AED) will be converted to AED at the prevailing exchange rates.

## Quick Answers  
[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my account number?](#accordion-6c7a3152-a05d-4ef2-92d9-932ef2572a52 "Is it safe to share my account number")  
It’s generally safe to share your account number with trusted people and with the bank. Always avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. Rest assured the bank does not share this information with anyone. Read more [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/security).

## How to claim  
In case of a claim request please reach out to Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company (ADNIC)  
P. O. Box: 839, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.  
Telephone: [02 4080100](tel:02 4080100)/ fax no: 02 2 6268600  
You may contact Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company (ADNIC) at the toll-free no: [8008040](tel:8008040), or send an email to [service-emiratesnbd@ADNIC.ae](mailto:service-emiratesnbd@ADNIC.ae)
title: Go4it Life Insurance Cover | Help and Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Go4it Life Insurance Cover | Help and Support | Emirates NBD > Documentation for Claims

## Documentation for Claims  
In the event of the death of Cardholder, the following documents will be submitted to the insurance company through Emirates NBD by the beneficiary.  
* Claim Form duly completed and signed by the authorized signatory
* Accident Report (in case of accident)
* Death Certificate (in original) in case of death taking place outside the UAE, such original Death Certificate issued abroad should be attested by the UAE Embassy
* Post Mortem Report (wherever required)
* Police Report – if death due to accident/road traffic accident
* Medical Report from a hospital with a detailed diagnosis, history of illness (if natural death) and cause of death, if the same is not clearly mentioned in the Death Certificate
* Copy of passport including visa page (for expatriates)
* Go4it Credit Application Form/s
* Any other document found necessary
title: Go4it Life Insurance Cover | Help and Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Go4it Life Insurance Cover | Help and Support | Emirates NBD > Exclusions

## Exclusions  
Please note no benefits will be payable if death occurs either directly or indirectly as a result of the following causes  
* Self-inflicted bodily injury regardless of its date and of its cause, or suicide within 12 months of enrolment to this scheme
* A sickness directly or indirectly attributed to HIV and/or any related illness including AIDS, or
* Chronic alcoholism or abuse of alcohol or abuse of addiction to drugs; or
* Nuclear Radiation, Nuclear Fission, Nuclear Fusion and/or Radioactive Contamination. However, medical professionals in the field of radiology are covered
* Insured Credit Cardholder engaging or taking part in any hazardous sports of activities involving a motor engine (including rallies), boxing, scuba/ skydiving, parachuting or hang-gliding  
For detailed terms and conditions, please[**click here**](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/File/Group-Life-Insurance-Emirates-NBD-Go4it-Credit-Cards-TandC.PDF)

text:
Careers Network Programme | Disability Employment | Emirates NBD > The voice of equal opportunities

# Careers Network  
## The voice of equal opportunities  
We believe promoting and contributing to diversity & inclusion at the workplace is everyone’s responsibility.  
Careers Network Programme was launched in partnership with the Community Development Authority, Manzil and Sustainable Square. The programme is advocating for change, creating awareness among organisations to embrace the inclusion of people with disabilities.  
Inclusion is not a necessity  
The focus on inclusion is a part of the wider vision, aligned with United Nations’ SDGs and UAE Vision 2030 of building a cohesive society. In line with this vision, we at Emirates NBD are doing our part in ushering in a positive change to reduce barriers, clear perceptions and advocate the long-lasting benefits of a diversified workplace.  
![PromoCardWithHighlights  Careers Network](/-/media/enbd/images/csr/careers-network-disability-employment/careersnetworkprocess-banner.jpg?la=en&h=700&w=1440&hash=69D46BBD50245914E978B1C91359C1AD)  
##### Careers Network  
#### Collaboration for sustainable impact  
Our process is designed following extensive research. We collaborate with strategic partners and educators to create meaningful and long-lasting solutions. Learnings from our own experiences of creating success for people with disabilities have helped us chart a clear vision with purpose.  
Careers Network Process

## 26 Years Old, Seeking Meaningful Employment (Visually Impaired) Khalfan  
"I love to explore and discover new things, especially any new technology that may be related to visually impaired people. As a child, I loved listening to music that later turned to my passion for playing a piano. When I started playing a piano at an early age, I also started composing my own music notes while playing piano. I like to explore new technology related to music or podcasts as I also give podcast to guide and help people who are visually impaired. I give podcasts in Arabic and English both, I love to socialize and through my podcasts I’m able to reach many people out of my community."  
![Mudhushebanner](/-/media/enbd/images/csr/careers-network-disability-employment/mudhushe-banner.jpg?la=en&h=700&w=1440&hash=119B7C2936DDA66077E1C6A7EA8C13FB)

## 19 Years Old, Laundry Attendant, DoubleTree by Hilton (Down Syndrome) Madhushee  
"I like to do drawing, and I like to do dancing. I like songs. I like to bake and I like baking sweet cakes. First put the cake, put cream, white color pink color after you finish you put in oven, I put in oven. My hobbies are playing basketball, tennis, I like football and cricket. And what else… I am excited to listen to songs, I feel happy to go for outing, my friend and I went to the party and we had nice fun, it was a nice party. I loved the dance. I like dancing, I feel happy with song and I’m so excited.  
I draw circles and trees, paint, coloring. I like to draw house and coloring, painting. That’s it. You know sorry I will tell yellow, orange, green purple, white, I paint in these colors, and I do paint. Purple color you know, I do the painting and coloring and after I do I feel happy."

## 26 Years Old, Supply Chain Assistant, Unilever (Autism Spectrum Disorder) Patrick  
"Lately, I have been sensing the absence of a friend, he’s moving to Canada. I had met him at church during a Friday mass. I think Friday mass at church brought me closer to my family. After Friday mass, we all go out for lunch. I love my family, my life’s been influenced the most by them; they mean a lot to me. My father is my hero. He is always supportive of my dreams and ambitions. My dream is to serve my family and be able to stay close to my loved ones for the rest of my life."  
![Ragadbanner](/-/media/enbd/images/csr/careers-network-disability-employment/ragad-banner.jpg?la=en&h=700&w=1440&hash=987A5E0A907EA2436BD7362F4783D5BA)

Careers Network Programme | Disability Employment | Emirates NBD > 24 Years Old, Seeking Meaningful Employment (Visually Impaired) Ragad

## 24 Years Old, Seeking Meaningful Employment (Visually Impaired) Ragad  
"My parents are truly an incredible source of inspiration. They have always taught me to give back. Give back to people, give back to my community, give back to the world. You know I consider it to be my responsibility. I believe speech is what binds people together; linguistics can break a barrier among any community, bringing forth diversity. It helps develop or perhaps even transcend an understanding of ideologies across various dialects and cultures. I want to become a translator, I just love to learn, and language has always been fascinating to me. I have always been curious to learn new words and phrases. I feel like it’s a great way to get closer to people through emotional understanding."  
![Santibanner](/-/media/enbd/images/csr/careers-network-disability-employment/santi-banner.jpg?la=en&h=700&w=1440&hash=9E00E0AF8F58B60078710EAD62D3B6CE)

Careers Network Programme | Disability Employment | Emirates NBD > 26 Years Old, CSR Coordinator, Emirates NBD (Down Syndrome) Santiago

## 26 Years Old, CSR Coordinator, Emirates NBD (Down Syndrome) Santiago  
"I adore myself and I’m very proud of myself. I had won gold and a bronze medal for the Special Olympics World Games that was held in Abu Dhabi. These days, I’m busy practicing for FAME (fashion, arts, music and entertainment) for special needs. I have been participating since last year, and this year FAME is going to be huge. I’m excited about my cat walk for fashion show and my speech where I will speak about my experience during Special Olympics. I just love it when I get famous; my dream is to become popular across the world like a celebrity. It’s an amazing feeling when I see my family, friends and fans loving me. I want to make my family happy."

##### #TogetherLimitless  
#### A world without barriers for People with Disabilities  
#TogetherLimitless is an advocacy platform for persons with disabilities. A part of Emirates NBD’s Social Investment Strategy Framework, the platform is driven by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and the UAE Vision 2030. Since inception, #TogetherLimitless has undertaken several initiatives for disability mainstreaming, including quarterly town-hall sessions to build community awareness; launching the Careers Network for workplace inclusion; transforming the bank’s branches with disability-friendly facilities and promoting financial inclusion.

## The auto loan with flexible interest rates  
FlexiDrive from Emirates NBD is an auto loan that offers a flexible interest rate that adjusts every month in step with the UAE's EIBOR. This loan has attractive rates starting from 1.50%\* p.a. (flat) and a host of special benefits to get you moving.Other features include:  
* More transparent pricing due to being linked to the UAE's 1-month EIBOR
* Lower EMI with higher eligibility
* Half-day approvals

\*2.80% reducing  
\*\*Applicable on loans of 250,000 and above

## What are people asking?  
* **What does EIBOR stand for?**  
EIBOR is the "Emirates Interbank Offered Rate" or essentially the national base interest rate
* **How does Variable Pricing work?**  
Emirates NBD’s FlexiDrive loan has a variable rate combining the EIBOR base rate plus a margin as agreed upon at the time of application, with a review every month. This means that your base rate will be reviewed and refreshed to reflect the current month’s EIBOR.
* **Where can I find EIBOR rates?**  
EIBOR rates are published and refreshed regularly on the UAE Central Bank website.  
Fixed Deposit Auto Loan

Priority Savings Accounts | Exclusive Benefits | Emirates NBD > A myriad of choices **tailored to you**

# Savings Accounts  
## A myriad of choices **tailored to you**  
Saving is everyone's ultimate financial goal and our Priority Banking Savings Accounts provide many ways to grow your balance over time. With options ranging from a basic interest earner and a family-focused account to conventional and Shari'a-compliant accounts geared to help you meet your future goals, we have a savings account that is tailored just for you.  
[Apply now](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/campaign-form/prb-always-on/?ref=productpage-breadcrumb "Apply now")  
Standard Savings Account
title: Priority Savings Accounts | Exclusive Benefits | Emirates NBD
section: A myriad of choices **tailored to you**

text:
Priority Savings Accounts | Exclusive Benefits | Emirates NBD > Easy access to your savings with benefits

## Easy access to your savings with benefits  
Our Standard Savings Account does the simple things very well for you. Available in UAE Dirhams only, it pays a competitive interest rate and gives you access to your savings whenever and wherever you need them. Its features also include:  
* 0.20% annual interest on balances
* Free international ATM/debit card
* 24-hour access by ATMs, phone (landline or mobile), and online
* Payment facilities for telephone, electricity, Salik recharge, road fines and other bills  
[Required Documents](javascript:ENBD.OpenDialog('RD') "Required Documents")

text:
Priority Savings Accounts | Exclusive Benefits | Emirates NBD > You win with every goal

## You win with every goal  
Celebrate your favourite team with the new Manchester United Savings Account available in UAE Dirhams only. Its unique ability to pay a higher interest rate every time your team scores a goal, plus a range of other benefits and rewards, make this a perfect match. Other features include:  
* Free international Manchester United debit card
* 24-hour easy access through ATMs, over the phone and online, and via branches and ATMs
* Monthly statement
* Bill payment facilities for telephones, electricity, Salik recharge, road fines and more  
[Required Documents](javascript:ENBD.OpenDialog('RD-MASU') "Required Documents")  
#### Smart S@ver Account

text:
Priority Savings Accounts | Exclusive Benefits | Emirates NBD > An online solution with higher rates and currency options

## An online solution with higher rates and currency options  
The Emirates NBD Priority Banking Smart S@ver Account is designed for people who like to manage their account online. It offers a range of currency options, higher interest rates and easy to use management tools. Its features also include:  
**Interest rates calculated on daily balances, paid monthly**  
**Telegraphic transfers also available, with cash pay in facility & CDM**  
**No joint account permissible for Smart S@ver product**  
**Available for AED, USD and GBP**  
**Online transfers made simple**  
**Online statement**  
**No cheque book**  
**No ATM or debit card**  
[Interest rates](javascript:ENBD.OpenDialog('SSA') "An online solution with higher rates and currency options")

Priority Savings Accounts | Exclusive Benefits | Emirates NBD > The more for more savings account

## The more for more savings account  
Like so many things in life, the more you put in the more you get out. Our Tiered Savings Account rewards you by offering a higher interest rate as your savings balance grows, as well as other benefits, which include:  
* Available in AED and USD
* Free international ATM/debit card (only for AED accounts)
* Monthly statement
* No cheque book

## Savings in a range of currencies, with extra services  
If you want to hold balances in different currencies, but with only one account, this is the one for you. It offers attractive interest rates and allows you to pay your bills easily.  
* Available in AUD, BHD, CAD, CNH, GBP, HKD, JOD, KWD, OMR, SAR, SGD, USD
* 0.15% interest for select currencies
* Transfers between Currency Passport Savings Accounts in different currencies permitted.
* Bill payment facilities for a wide range of services, including telephone, electricity, Salik recharge, and road fines
* Quarterly statement

**Earn up to 5 Skywards Miles per US$1 spent on the debit card**

Priority Savings Accounts | Exclusive Benefits | Emirates NBD > A profitable partnership to grow your savings

## A profitable partnership to grow your savings  
Mudaraba is a profit-sharing partnership contract in a joint investment that supports growth in your savings. It is a smart solution for individuals wishing to have their savings managed under a Shari'a-compliant structure. Other features include:  
* Available in AED and USD
* Competitive profit rates
* Minimum balance of 3,000
* Profits paid quarterly
* Minimum tenure of 30 days to receive profit
* For individuals only

Make your savings work really hard for you and enjoy higher interest rates that increase with higher balances.  
* Available in AED & USD currencies

text:
Priority Savings Accounts | Exclusive Benefits | Emirates NBD > One savings account for every member of your family

## One savings account for every member of your family  
Imagine your family each having their own AED Savings Account with a free debit card, all held separately within one account. The Family Savings Account, exclusively for UAE nationals, offers just that, with higher interest rates based on the total of individual balances held. This unique account can be used by up to 10 immediate family members, and it also includes:  
**Complete privacy for each account holder**  
**Available in AED only**  
**Monthly statement**  
**Free international debit card with offers on dining, shopping and travel**  
**Bill payment facilities for telephones, electricity, Salik recharge, road fines and more**  
**24-hour easy access through ATMs, over the phone and online, and via branches**  
**Interest of up to 1.25% p.a. paid to each account holder on pooled balances maintained in family savings accounts based on their balances in the pool**  
[Interest Rates](javascript:ENBD.OpenDialog('FSA') "One savings account for every member of your family")

Emirates NBD Elevates Expo 2020 Dubai Experience with Interactive New Future of Investing Exhibit > Emirates NBD elevates Expo 2020 Dubai experience with interactive new 'Future of Investing' exhibit

## Emirates NBD elevates Expo 2020 Dubai experience with interactive new 'Future of Investing' exhibit  
* Premier Partner and the Official Banking Partner for Expo 2020 Dubai
* New concept democratizes future of investment
* Visitors can experience collecting, trading and sharing alternative asset classes such as art
* Adds to line-up of immersive, innovative exhibits that reimagine the future of banking  
**Dubai, 9 February 2022:** Emirates NBD, a leading banking group in the MENAT (Middle East, North and Turkey) region and a Premier Partner and the Official Banking Partner for Expo 2020 Dubai, has unveiled a new 'Future of Investing' experience at ‘Future Banking by Emirates NBD and Emirates Islamic’ at Expo 2020 Dubai. The exhibit continues the banking group’s innovative showcase of the future of global banking.  
The immersive, interactive concept democratizes access to new and exciting high-ticket asset classes such as art, demonstrating the bank's continued commitment to introduce innovative investment concepts to the region. Based on careful consideration of existing customer data and risk profiling, the new asset class will be introduced as a new investment opportunity for the user to diversify portfolio and reduce cash over-weight.
title: Emirates NBD Elevates Expo 2020 Dubai Experience with Interactive New Future of Investing Exhibit
section: Emirates NBD elevates Expo 2020 Dubai experience with interactive new 'Future of Investing' exhibit

text:
Emirates NBD Elevates Expo 2020 Dubai Experience with Interactive New Future of Investing Exhibit > Emirates NBD elevates Expo 2020 Dubai experience with interactive new 'Future of Investing' exhibit

Through an interactive platform leveraging the power of blockchain tokenization, visitors can experience collecting, trading and sharing alternative asset classes that are currently not easily available to purchase due to high cost of entry.  
The 'Future of Investing' exhibit welcomes visitors with a hologram of a sculpture showcasing various art pieces, which users can browse through, to enhance the immersive experience. They can then purchase tokens representing the artwork that can be liquidated, transferred, or sold like any other asset class. Once the purchase is complete, they receive exclusive keys representing their ownership and can access their personal hologram of the art piece with the option to display it in their homes, offices or on their smart watch of the future. The exhibit allows visitors to experience an unparalleled journey of investing in and owning an alternative asset class such as art.
title: Emirates NBD Elevates Expo 2020 Dubai Experience with Interactive New Future of Investing Exhibit
section: Emirates NBD elevates Expo 2020 Dubai experience with interactive new 'Future of Investing' exhibit

text:
Emirates NBD Elevates Expo 2020 Dubai Experience with Interactive New Future of Investing Exhibit > Emirates NBD elevates Expo 2020 Dubai experience with interactive new 'Future of Investing' exhibit

Supporting Expo 2020 Dubai’s theme "Connecting Minds, Creating the Future" and subthemes Opportunity, Mobility and Sustainability, Emirates NBD’s Expo 'Future Banking' space continues to be a huge draw for millions of residents and international visitors. Spanning ~3,000 square foot in the Al Wasl Avenue, the line-up of deeply innovative and futuristic concept-driven exhibits comprise five distinct pods that enable millions of visitors from across the globe to experience different virtual personas and learn about cutting-edge banking initiatives that aim to fulfil customers’ future needs, aspirations and goals.  
**Abdulla Qassem, Group Chief Operating Officer, Emirates NBD Group said:** "Being an internationally acclaimed digital leader and innovator in the region's financial services sector, Emirates NBD Group is proud to represent the future of banking as a Premier Partner and the Official Banking Partner of Expo 2020 Dubai. We are delighted to add to our line-up of exhibits in the new year and continue sharing our pioneering vision for the future of global banking. Inspired by the commitment of our nation’s wise leaders towards building a sustainable and innovation-driven economy, our exhibits showcase a never seen before demonstration of how advancements in technology, robotics and artificial intelligence will influence and shape our lives in the decades to come."
title: Emirates NBD Elevates Expo 2020 Dubai Experience with Interactive New Future of Investing Exhibit
section: Emirates NBD elevates Expo 2020 Dubai experience with interactive new 'Future of Investing' exhibit

text:
Emirates NBD Elevates Expo 2020 Dubai Experience with Interactive New Future of Investing Exhibit > Emirates NBD elevates Expo 2020 Dubai experience with interactive new 'Future of Investing' exhibit

He added: "As new technologies converge at a rapidly increasing rate, the need to reframe approaches is imperative. The 'Future of Investing' concept integrates next-generation technology to make investing in new alternative high-ticket asset classes more accessible. Expo 2020 Dubai has drawn nearly 10 million visits in its first three months and our presence at this first-in-a lifetime event in our region builds on our legacy of introducing first-to-market meaningful innovations that enhance our customers’ lives. We look forward to continue inspiring visitors and sparking positive conversations around the possibilities of tomorrow."  
To view all exhibits at Future Banking by Emirates NBD and Emirates Islamic, [**Click here**](/-/media/enbd/files/others/emirates-nbd-elevates-expo-2020-dubai-experience/english_factsheet-future_banking_by_emirates_nbd_and_emirates_islamic.pdf)

McArthurGlen Designer Outlet Noventa di Piave is an exceptional shopping destination located just 30 minutes from Venice, blending Italian charm with world-class fashion. Featuring over 160 stores, it offers a remarkable selection of luxury and premium brands, including Prada, Versace, Gucci, and Fendi, with year-round savings of up to 70%.  
Designed in a Venetian-inspired style, this open-air outlet creates a sophisticated and picturesque shopping experience.  
With tax-free shopping, VIP services, and fine dining options, Noventa di Piave is the perfect destination for fashion enthusiasts looking to indulge in luxury while exploring the beauty of Italy’s Veneto region.

text:
Currency Passport Savings Account | Emirates NBD > Requirements and documents for opening an account

## Requirements and documents for opening an account  
[UAE Nationals](#accordion-004ee7c0-aace-4f93-85ec-f95c55f746ac "UAE Nationals")  
* **Identification**
+ Original Emirates ID and copy
+ Copy of passport
* **In case of a salary transfer account, we’ll need one of the following documents:**
+ Copy of Labor Card
+ Copy of Employee ID
+ Latest salary letter  
[Expats](#accordion-57e2bede-b72b-45f5-95bf-909fcdfc9289 "Expats")  
* **Identification**
+ Original Emirates ID and copy
+ Copy of passport
* **In case of a salary transfer account, we’ll need one of the following documents:**
+ Salary transfer letter (not more than 30 days from date of issue for non-government companies. For government companies, validity as mentioned in the letter.)
+ Copy of appointment letter or contract

* If you don’t make the monthly payments towards your loan on time, you will incur a late payment fee
* Missing repayments can affect your credit score, limiting your ability to access loans or financing in the future
* If you refinance your loan or defer your payments, your loan will take longer to pay back, and you may pay more interest
* If you can’t meet a monthly payment, [apply in advance for a deferment](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/defer-your-loan-payments). You can do this up to twice a year  
It’s important to read the terms and conditions and know the fees and charges before you apply for a loan.

text:
Discover the art of saving with your dnata credit card  | Emirates NBD > Online

### Online  
1. After selecting your travel option, proceed to **‘Payment Method’**.
2. Select **dnata Points / Emirates NBD Plus Points**.
3. Enter your card number.
4. A one-time password will be sent to your registered mobile number.
5. Check your dnata Points balance, click on **‘Use my points’** to redeem, and proceed with the booking.  
**Note:** Once redeemed, your points are non-refundable. Any remaining balance of the booking price must be paid with your Emirates NBD credit card.

### In-store or by phone  
1. While making your booking, present the card you would like to use to redeem your Points.
2. Inform the store personnel that you would like to pay using your dnata Points and specify the number of points you wish to redeem.
3. Partial payment with dnata Points is accepted.
4. Once redeemed, your points are non-refundable.

**International transfers:** Requests received before 2 pm, Monday to Saturday will be processed the same working day. Otherwise, they will be processed the next working day at rates applicable during the time of processing.  
Your transfers on time are subject to availability of funds and accuracy of details.

## Visa Debit Card Grocery Campaign Terms  
**Promotion Period**  
24 March – 30 April 2023  
**Qualifying Card**  
This promotion is open to select Base of Visa Debit Card Personal Banking. Enrollment rights are reserved and solely determined by the bank.  
**Qualifying Spends**  
Transactions made on the qualifying Card classified by Visa as below during the promotion period will be part of the qualifying spends.  
* Grocery
* Supermarket  
**Qualifying criteria**  
* Customer needs to opt in and make cumulative spends of 1500.
* Spends made on Supplementary cards attached to the qualifying Debit Card will also be included towards determining the total qualifying spends.
* Transactions on the Card in the form of Cash withdrawal, reversals, refunds, disputed purchases, Bank levied charges and payment/credits on the Card during the promotion period will be excluded from the qualifying spends.  
**Minimum Spend & Prizes**  
* 100 customers to get 100 in cashback in the account linked to the debit card.
* Eligible customers will be credited with the cashback post 60 days of the end date of campaign period.
* Cash back cannot be exchanged or transferred by the bank to any other party.  
**General Terms:**  
* Qualifying customers will be intimated directly by Emirates NBD within a period of 60 days from the completion date through email/letter/phone.
* Cashback will be credited to the account linked to the debit card within 60 days of the campaign end date.

Loan Beyond Credit Limit - Extra Funds Access | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

## What are people asking?  
[What is the Loan on Card beyond credit limit facility?](#accordion-7e2f3444-1ed6-4c1a-80ec-786d96bb43e7 "What is the Loan on Card beyond credit limit facility")  
Loan on Card beyond credit limit is an instalment plan that allows you to access additional cash beyond your available Credit Card limit. The loan amount can be transferred to your bank account or issued as a manager’s cheque.  
[Who can apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-593c7ff5-b4ea-4e34-b2c5-99accc4e3d4a "Who can apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
All primary Emirates NBD Credit Cardholders can apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit, based on card usage and performance.  
[What is the maximum amount I can borrow as Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-bd47d02d-6c32-4b32-b851-8398238c3b81 "What is the maximum amount I can borrow as Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
You can borrow up to 100% of your credit card limit. The amount will vary based on your eligibility and is subject to approval.  
[Can I cancel my existing Loan on Card beyond credit limit plan on my Credit Card, and will I be charged?](#accordion-647a2b1d-2dac-491b-846c-432f42bee761 "Can I cancel my existing Loan on Card beyond credit limit plan on my Credit Card and will I be charged")
title: Loan Beyond Credit Limit - Extra Funds Access | Emirates NBD

text:
Loan Beyond Credit Limit - Extra Funds Access | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

You can prepay or foreclose your loan by contacting our call center at [**600 54 0000**](tel:600540000). A foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding plus 5% VAT will apply.  
[What are the repayment tenures for Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-a098bd17-c8e4-4c54-a0bf-b041632f70f0 "What are the repayment tenures for Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
You can choose to repay over 12, 24, 36 or 48 months.  
[What is the Loan on Card beyond credit limit facility?](#accordion-7e2f3444-1ed6-4c1a-80ec-786d96bb43e7 "What is the Loan on Card beyond credit limit facility")

[Who can apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-593c7ff5-b4ea-4e34-b2c5-99accc4e3d4a "Who can apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
All primary Emirates NBD Credit Cardholders can apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit, based on card usage and performance.  
[What is the maximum amount I can borrow as Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-bd47d02d-6c32-4b32-b851-8398238c3b81 "What is the maximum amount I can borrow as Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
You can borrow up to 100% of your credit card limit. The amount will vary based on your eligibility and is subject to approval.
title: Loan Beyond Credit Limit - Extra Funds Access | Emirates NBD

text:
Loan Beyond Credit Limit - Extra Funds Access | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

You can borrow up to 100% of your credit card limit. The amount will vary based on your eligibility and is subject to approval.  
[Can I cancel my existing Loan on Card beyond credit limit plan on my Credit Card, and will I be charged?](#accordion-647a2b1d-2dac-491b-846c-432f42bee761 "Can I cancel my existing Loan on Card beyond credit limit plan on my Credit Card and will I be charged")  
You can prepay or foreclose your loan by contacting our call center at [**600 54 0000**](tel:600540000). A foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding plus 5% VAT will apply.  
[What are the repayment tenures for Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-a098bd17-c8e4-4c54-a0bf-b041632f70f0 "What are the repayment tenures for Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
You can choose to repay over 12, 24, 36 or 48 months.  
[What are the interest rate to avail Loan on Card beyond credit limit facility?](#accordion-40443fab-b193-4a45-bde7-2e3e614e09d9 "What are the interest rate to avail Loan on Card beyond credit limit facility")  
The interest rate on Loan on Card beyond credit limit is a reducing monthly interest rate determined by Emirates NBD and shall be charged on the loan amount. The interest rates are subject to changes on periodic basis and is also based on Card usage and overall performance.  
[How do I apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-97263717-85ca-4610-ad8e-043b35caaef4 "How do I apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit")
title: Loan Beyond Credit Limit - Extra Funds Access | Emirates NBD

text:
Loan Beyond Credit Limit - Extra Funds Access | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

To apply, SMS '**ALOC**' to **4456**, or call our 24/7 customer care at [**600 54 0000**](tel:600540000). A representative will guide you through the process.  
[How long does it take to process a Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-675ad125-d2ae-4842-b72b-22334108b7f0 "How long does it take to process a Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
Your request will be processed within 2-3 working days and first instalment will be reflected on your second Credit Card statement post booking.  
[Can supplementary cardholders apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-4a5aacaa-5e3e-4078-91f3-6cceace0c436 "Can supplementary cardholders apply for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
No, only primary cardholders can apply.  
[Are there any charges for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-fa288478-dfe0-4e15-aa58-e362b06a4627 "Are there any charges for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
Any applicable fees on the Loan on Card beyond credit limit facility is determined by Emirates NBD and will be charged on the plan.  
Fees are subject to changes on periodic basis. Please[**click here**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/terms-and-conditions)for more information.  
[Will I be eligible for reward points with a Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-4790a407-262d-4011-8946-cf36c9296819 "Will I be eligible for reward points with a Loan on Card beyond credit limit")
title: Loan Beyond Credit Limit - Extra Funds Access | Emirates NBD

text:
Loan Beyond Credit Limit - Extra Funds Access | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

No, currently, there are no reward points associated with a Loan on Card beyond credit limit.  
[Once I avail the Loan on Card beyond credit limit program, will my available balance increase corresponding to transaction amount placed in instalments?](#accordion-edb61e12-95ab-4495-9573-fd310ef03331 "Once I avail the Loan on Card beyond credit limit program will my available balance increase corresponding to transaction amount placed in instalments")  
The Loan on Card beyond credit limit amount is over and above your credit limit, so your credit limit will not be affected by the loan amount.  
[How is the monthly EMI calculated for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit?](#accordion-749de356-6e45-4f12-85a8-cbb9c48fa15e "How is the monthly EMI calculated for a Loan on Card beyond credit limit")  
The EMI will be calculated based on the loan principal and interest for the selected tenure. Any applicable processing fee will be included only in the first credit card statement post booking.  
[When is my first instalment amount billed?](#accordion-2d004c7e-a95c-429d-b2a3-ec1b2de16d88 "When is my first instalment amount billed")  
First instalment will reflect on the second card statement post booking and will include the instalment principal amount and accrued interest billed from the booking date till the second statement date.

text:
Learn about Online Banking | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[How up-to-date is the information on Online Banking?](#faqs-how-up-to-date-is-the-information-on-online-banking "How uptodate is the information on Online Banking")  
All the information on Online Banking is updated in real time except for the following:  
* Once you have linked your new credit card through settings, it will take 24 hours to reflect on Online Banking
* Credit card transactions will reflect in the statement after 24 hours  
[What is a Private Wall? How can I use it?](#faqs-what-is-a-private-wall-how-can-i-use-it "What is a Private Wall How can I use it")  
Your Private Wall lets you reach us directly by sending us a message. Our support team will get back to you immediately on the wall.  
[What is the Emirates NBD Digital Store? What services are available on it?](#faqs-what-is-the-emirates-nbd-digital-store-what-services-are-available-on-it "What is the Emirates NBD Digital Store What services are available on it")  
The Emirates NBD Digital Store on Online Banking gives you easy access to your accounts, cards, loans, investment products and special offers tailored to you. You can track and view your product applications and service requests made via Online or Mobile Banking through the application tracking page and upload documents for a personal loan application. You'll see all your requests and applications initiated within the last 30 days on this page.
title: Learn about Online Banking | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Learn about Online Banking | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

To access the digital store, click on the 'Digital Store' icon on the top of the page once you are logged into Online Banking.  
[I'm having trouble accessing the Online Banking login page. What should I do?](#faqs-i-am-having-issues-accessing-the-online-banking-login-page-what-should-i-do "Im having trouble accessing the Online Banking login page. What should I do")  
There are a number of reasons why you may not be able to log in to your mobile app:  
* You are not connected to the internet or the signal is not strong enough
* You may have entered a wrong password more than three times, you can reset it by following [these instructions](/en/help-and-support/reset-your-digital-banking-password)
* Your web browser is not compatible or it’s not the latest version
* Your browser cache needs to be cleared
* You’re logging in from a restricted or sanctioned country  
If you still need help, please call us on [+971 600 54 0000](tel:+971 600 54 0000).
