### Activate your Card and get started  
* [ENBD X Mobile App](#tab_bs4c65eb0a-1022-4394-ab01-0192055b9e46 "ENBD X Mobile App")
* [Text2Call](#tab_bsf7034ac7-0d97-4316-8e04-aaa4e8c07f53 "Text2Call")  
****ENBD X Mobile App** “Menu”**  
* Register and log in to Mobile Banking app
* Tap on ‘**Services**’ at the footer of the screen and select ‘**Apply for New Service**’
* Click on ‘**Credit Card**’ and select ‘**Activate Credit Card**’ and tap on the Card
* Enter the **Expiry Date** and set your Card **PIN**  
****ENBD X Mobile App** “Dashboard”**  
* Register and log in to Mobile Banking app
* Tap on ‘**Credit Card**’
* Select the Card you want to activate
* Enter the**Expiry Date**and set your Card**PIN**  
* Text ‘ACT’ to 4459 from your registered mobile number
* You will get a call from [+971 431 60 505](tel:+971 431 60 505) in few minutes. Keep the last 6 digits of your Card number handy and follow the instructions to activate your Card  
[![](/-/media/enbd/images/Card-journey/card_activation_video_imgg.jpg?h=450&hash=CA0FF64C1B7E976C9C91D7D2B3F2ABC1)](https://youtube.com/shorts/TXQDNP4DNjc?feature=share)

businessONLINE | Digital Global Cash Management Ecosystem | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

## What are people asking?  
[What is businessONLINE?](#accordion-6e796bb6-7d3a-4963-bcb6-875711c5d4ef "What is businessONLINE")  
businessONLINE is Emirates NBD Bank's powerful user-friendly online banking service that helps Corporate & Institutional Banking and Business Banking clients to execute complex banking transactions from their desktop. This platform offers for additional features to cater to your business needs.  
Key Features:  
* Single window view of all Emirates NBD Bank accounts, mapped to a single User ID. This includes Payments, Account Services, loans, deposits and linked accounts.
* Customizable Dashboard with enriched information reporting and self-service MIS reports.
* Own Account Transfer and Third Party Transfer etc.
* Bulk payments, Utility Bill payments.
* Rests for Deposit opening.
* Cheque Book Requests.  
Key Benefits:  
* Real-time access to all your account information.
* Customisation and Security - You can pre-set the information access, multi-level approval process and transaction authority for various employees, for complete security.
* MIS Integration - You can download your account statement in different formats, including MS Excel or Text file or PDF.
* Audit Trails (View Transaction History and Workflow Details). You can track all transactions by date/ Product Type/ Beneficiary Account etc. to monitor any misuse of access.
title: businessONLINE | Digital Global Cash Management Ecosystem | Emirates NBD

text:
businessONLINE | Digital Global Cash Management Ecosystem | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[Is the businessONLINE platform secure?](#accordion-e2cd0ab8-1b06-4e95-b28f-ed36ce9a3216 "Is the businessONLINE platform secure")  
businessONLINE uses the highest level of security features available at present. All communication between your browser and businessONLINE are fully encrypted using a 256-bit SSL encrypted secure connection and is authenticated with Emirates NBD Bank's world-class Global Trust Infrastructure that meets the global standards.  
[I am interested, how can I apply for this service?](#accordion-0528030c-489e-4400-bc90-cd5b83ccbd7c "I am interested how can I apply for this service")  
Simply obtain the businessONLINE application forms from your Relationship Manager, the nearest Business Banking Center or Branch and provide the requested information.  
[Do I need separate software?](#accordion-d5cc5c16-3339-49fd-8b4c-a1cd40c97eee "Do I need separate software")  
No, all you need is an Internet connection and a compatible browser installed at your computer.  
[What are the system and browser requirements for using the new portal?](#accordion-a695fefc-a518-4cbd-9ea3-0ced5ac49334 "What are the system and browser requirements for using the new portal")  
The system requirements for businessONLINE are as follows:  
* An internet connection
* Subscriber ID, User ID and password (provided by the bank once you subscribe for the service).
* A PC with a browser, preferably Google Chrome.
* For the PC the minimum required configuration is:

Please follow the below steps:

[What is One Time Password (OTP)?](#accordion-73912c3f-1f95-4e78-b453-12770e64384f "What is One Time Password OTP")  
OTP, a unique six-digit numeric code sent to your mobile number registered with Emirates NBD Bank, it is introduced as an additional security feature by Emirates NBD Bank to protect your account from online fraud. It's a security system that protects you whenever a change in your login and transaction pattern is observed by alerting you through OTP and authenticating your transactions.  
The OTP will be sent to you for all funds transfers, bill payment, password reset and payee addition. OTP is confidential and should not be shared with anyone, even if the person claims to be an Emirates NBD Bank's official. Please ensure that your mobile number is accurately updated with us to be able to transact online.

# A new approach to growing and securing your wealth  
Emirates NBD is constantly working to improve our wealth management approach and capabilities to provide you with the best solutions, tailored for your individual needs and aspirations.  
[Contact us](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/campaigns/wealth-management)  
![Promo  Advice you can trust](/-/media/enbd/images/wealth/images-and-icons/advice-you-can-trust_image.jpg?la=en&h=1500&w=2000&hash=B0ED817A0C57527B715453B4AB5FF780)  
#####  
#### Objective advice that you can trust  
Our wealth advisors apply their extensive experience to help you find ways to grow your wealth and secure your financial future. All advice and recommendations draw on our in-house investment knowledge and capabilities, without favouring any particular provider or asset manager, product or account, to give you complete peace of mind.  
![Promo  The right mix of investment](/-/media/enbd/images/wealth/images-and-icons/new-folder/grow-your-wealth_banner.jpg?la=en&h=1080&w=1920&hash=F6239FB10D4F7D5BDA6E186AE4B9B16A)  
#### The right mix of investment and protection for your unique needs  
Whatever your requirement, be it saving to buy a home, preserving and growing your wealth, planning for your children’s education or your own retirement, we structure risk-adjusted portfolios of world-class products that are carefully vetted and selected by our in-house experts.

**Documents required for individuals\*:**

+ Appointment Letter / Contract Copy
+ Pay slip (< 3 months old)
+ Consolidated letter from HR for bulk accounts
+ Most recent statement of account where customer's salary is being transferred  
**Documents required for non-individuals\*:**  
* Commercial/Federal registration certificates (wherever applicable)
* Certificate of commencement of business (for Joint Stock Companies)
* Not applicable for company under formation

text:
Priority Skywards Savings: Earn Miles and Redeem Flights | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[How is my average monthly balance calculated?](#accordion-7b563a47-2ccc-43fd-80be-9c596afaffd2 "How is my average monthly balance calculated")  
Average monthly balance calculation is a function of balance maintained in the account calculated over period of days the balance is maintained. Average balance is calculated at customer level; hence the balance in Current, Savings and Fixed Deposit accounts will be considered to compute the average balance. E.g. If you maintain 5,000 in your account from the first day of the month till the last day of the month, then average balance will be 5,000 for that calendar month. If you maintain zero balance for first 15 days and maintain 10,000 for the next fifteen days, the average balance will also be 5,000 for that calendar month.  
[Am I eligible to request for a cheque book?](#accordion-08b4c31c-f204-4a57-bdfe-cf7c9fdc7105 "Am I eligible to request for a cheque book")  
Current account holders are eligible for a cheque book. First cheque book on account opening is free; on subsequent requests for cheque books, charges are levied as per schedule of charges.  
[How do I request for a cheque book?](#accordion-7731aeab-7fdf-454f-bb1b-e8d71043eff2 "How do I request for a cheque book")  
Cheque book can be requested through online banking, mobile banking, ATMs and branches.

To place a stop payment on a cheque which is not yet presented, you need to visit a branch and submit a formal request. Instructions for stop payment of cheques is accepted in the following conditions only:  
* If the cheque/ cheque book is lost or stolen. A police report needs to be presented in case of lost/ stolen cheque.
* The bearer of the cheque has become bankrupt/ insolvent. A court order is required providing insolvency/ bankruptcy of the bearer.  
[How do I close my Account?](#accordion-dfcbe59d-503c-4265-806e-5a1c0ee42650 "How do I close my Account")  
For account closure, you need to visit a branch to submit the request for closing the account.  
[What will happen to my Direct Debits and Standing orders when I close my account?](#accordion-d5da960a-32f2-4516-988e-bc5db63c9b45 "What will happen to my Direct Debits and Standing orders when I close my account")  
Direct debits and standing instructions will be cancelled on closure of the account. In case of an active loan with direct debit setup, the account cannot be closed till an alternate payment mode is arranged or the loan is settled.

On account closure, Credit Card can continue to be active. For Loans and Overdraft, alternate payment mode has to be arranged, for which has to be discussed and agreed with the bank's representative and the decision taken will solely be based on bank's discretion  
[Do I need to submit my unused cheques/ cheque book/ Debit Card when I close my account?](#accordion-a37a2d01-0764-4ac7-857e-2e4cc640867c "Do I need to submit my unused cheques cheque book Debit Card when I close my account")  
On account closure, unused cheques and Debit Card have to be returned to the bank as a best practice. In case of inability to submit, the remaining cheques and the Debit Card will be de-activated as part of closure process.  
[How will I know when my account is closed?](#accordion-f59df503-500e-4595-bc1f-32181a00c21d "How will I know when my account is closed")  
On account closure, online banking account status will be shown as closed. Alternatively, you can request the bank for a closure confirmation.

## Welcome Offer  
* Receive 2 Free Night Awards on cumulative retail spends of US$ 6,000 in the first 3 billing statements from Card issuance.
* Each Free Night Award can be redeemed for a one-night stay at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels with a redemption level at or under 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points. Additionally, the value of your Free Night Award can be combined with up to 15,000 points to help you access even more hotels you'll love.  
Marriott Bonvoy programme terms and conditions apply.  
**Marriott Bonvoy Points Earning**  
* 3 Marriott Bonvoy points per US$1 on spend at hotels and resorts participating in Marriott Bonvoy.1
* Earn up to 1.5 Marriott Bonvoy points per US$1 on international spend.2
* Earn up to 1.5 Marriott Bonvoy points per US$1 on general domestic spend.3
+ 1.5 points per US$1 on general retail shopping (e.g. apparel, dining, etc.)
+ 0.375 points per US$1 on grocery and supermarkets, insurance, car dealership related, and quick-service restaurants (i.e., fast-food restaurants)4
+ 0.15 points per US$1 on real estate, education, petroleum, government services, car-hailing services, food delivery aggregators, and bill payments (including utility and telecommunication)

text:
Apple Pay | Emirates NBD > Apple Pay, with all the benefits of your Emirates NBD card:

### Apple Pay, with all the benefits of your Emirates NBD card:  
#### touch\_app Easy  
Pay easily using your Emirates NBD card on all your Apple devices.  
#### verified\_user Secure  
Apple Pay uses security features, including Face ID and Touch ID, so only you can authorise payments.  
#### lock Private  
With Apple Pay, your card information is never stored on your device or Apple servers, nor shared by Apple with merchants. This provides an additional level of protection against fraud.

text:
Apple Pay | Emirates NBD > How to add your card to Apple Pay:

### How to add your card to Apple Pay:  
##### ENBD X App  
Add your Emirates NBD card to Apple Wallet directly from the ENBD X app in just a few taps.  
Know more  
##### Apple Watch  
Add your card to Apple Watch and make quick, secure payments right from your wrist.  
Know more  
##### iPhone  
Set up your Emirates NBD card in Apple Wallet on your iPhone for fast, secure contactless payments.  
Know more  
##### Mac, iPad & Vision Pro  
Set up your Emirates NBD card on your compatible Apple devices for seamless purchases across the Apple ecosystem.  
Know more  
All Visa debit cards, Visa credit cards, Mastercard credit cards and Jaywan cards can be added to Apple Pay.  
However, the Webshopper Credit Card and GlobalCash Card cannot be added to Apple Pay.  
![Set Emirates NBD card as default](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/images/enbd-contactlesspay-apple-pay.png)
title: Apple Pay | Emirates NBD
section: How to add your card to Apple Pay:

text:
Apple Pay | Emirates NBD > Default card

## Default card  
If you’ve already added other cards to Apple Pay, set your Emirates NBD card as your default card.  
From the settings menu:  
1. Tap on **‘Wallet & Apple Pay’**
2. Select **‘Default Card’**
3. Select your Emirates NBD card
4. You are now ready to start paying with the Apple Pay  
Alternatively, open the Wallet app, press and hold your preferred card, and drag it to the front.
title: Apple Pay | Emirates NBD

text:
Apple Pay | Emirates NBD > How to pay with Apple Pay

## How to pay with Apple Pay  
**Paying in-store:**  
Quickly and easily pay with Apple Pay on iPhone by double-clicking the side button on your device, authenticating with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode, and holding your device near the card reader. When you see the “done” checkmark, you’re all set.  
**Paying online or in-app:**  
To quickly pay online or in apps on your iPhone, iPad, Mac or Apple Vision Pro, tap the button with the Apple Pay logo. Next, confirm your billing and shipping information and authenticate with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. When you see the ‘Done’ checkmark, you’re all set.

text:
Current Account in the UAE | Emirates NBD > Requirements and documents for opening an account

## Requirements and documents for opening an account  
[UAE Nationals](#accordion-004ee7c0-aace-4f93-85ec-f95c55f746ac "UAE Nationals")  
* **Identification**
+ Original Emirates ID and copy
+ Copy of passport
* **In case of a salary transfer account, we’ll need one of the following documents:**
+ Copy of Labor Card
+ Copy of Employee ID
+ Latest salary letter  
[Expats](#accordion-57e2bede-b72b-45f5-95bf-909fcdfc9289 "Expats")  
* **Identification**
+ Original Emirates ID and copy
+ Copy of passport
* **In case of a salary transfer account, we’ll need one of the following documents:**
+ Salary transfer letter (not more than 30 days from date of issue for non-government companies. For government companies, validity as mentioned in the letter.)
+ Copy of appointment letter or contract
+ Copy of pay slip (less than a month old)
+ Statement with previous month’s salary
+ **For bulk accounts:** consolidated letter from HR (with salary of each employee mentioned)
* **Additional documents**
+ In some cases, additional documents may be requested in order to proceed with opening an account  
[Non-residents](#accordion-06279c9a-ad54-4102-bc58-24e9f2c139e5 "Nonresidents")  
* **Passport and copy with visa page and one of the following documents:**
+ Utility bill (not more than 3 months old)
+ Bank statements (not more than 3 months old, you can print these off Online Banking too)

* The Bank’s decision on the winning customers is final and shall not be challenged by any customer.
* The Bank will notify the winning customers at or after the end of each reward winning draw by sending them a notice to their registered email or contact details maintained with the Bank.

# Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge  
01 November 2022  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/tradition_meets_transformation_thumb_img.jpg)  
##### Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge  
As the UAE becomes the preferred residence of some of the world’s wealthiest people, the private banking and wealth management sectors find themselves in a position of strength, drawing on tradition as well as a future-forward digital-first strategy  
With more than 67,000 millionaires and 13 billionaires, Dubai has [emerged](https://www.henleyglobal.com/publications/henley-global-citizens-report/2022-q3/global-insights/20-wealthiest-cities-world-2022) among the top 25 global destinations for the wealthy, clocking an 18% increase in H1-2022 in the number of the city’s wealthy denizens. When charting millionaire migration trends, the UAE emerges as the world’s number one in [attracting](https://www.henleyglobal.com/publications/henley-global-citizens-report/2022-q2/global-insights/millionaire-migration-trends-2022) high-net-worth individuals (HNWI) in 2022, with 4,000 additional millionaires set to move to the country this year. ![](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/tradition_meets_transformation_img_en1.jpg)
title: Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge
section: Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge

text:
Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge > Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge

The draw of the UAE lies in many factors, including its high-income ecosystem, its reputation for resilience through macro-economic events, its diversified economy, and its appeal as a hub that connects the world. Of course, the many splendored beaches have their own attraction.  
However, one less talked about aspect of Dubai’s strengths is its wealth management industry, which has long catered to a diverse, multicultural set of HNWI and ultra-HNWI, by addressing their personal, local, and global investment requirements.  
A diverse set of HNWI: Dubai, which has historically functioned as a trading port, has a long and illustrious history of banking, going back to 1946. The clientele has included expatriates, merchants, and local businesspersons. In response to customer needs, which are as local as they are global, the UAE’s private banking sector has extended their geographical footprint to include locations such as Singapore, UK, and Saudi Arabia, among others.
title: Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge
section: Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge

text:
Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge > Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge

For a Dubai private bank today, the HNWI client may be a matriarch, preoccupied with inter-generational wealth transfer, which is a global [trend](https://www.capgemini.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Top-Trends-in-Wealth-Management-2022-2.pdf). Or it could be an entrepreneur-turned-venture-capitalist, contributing to the [93%](https://magnitt.com/research/uae-2022-venture-investment-report-50799) growth in start-up and venture capital investments in 2021. It may even be a father and a Gen Z offspring working together to optimize the income from their family business.  
![](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/tradition_meets_transformation_img_en2.jpg)
title: Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge
section: Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge

text:
Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge > Tradition meets transformation as private banks gear to service the wealth surge

![](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/tradition_meets_transformation_img_en2.jpg)  
**The infrastructure advantage**: With the happiness of inhabitants at the centre of policymaking, Dubai and the UAE are known for smart, proactive strategies. Its demographic dividend lies in attracting people from 200 countries to its shores. Ease of residency, along with a robust business climate, coupled with wealth management infrastructure that effectively addresses HNWI concerns, means that Dubai becomes a stable home for the longer term. The UAE has [concluded](https://mof.gov.ae/double-taxation-agreements/) 137 double taxation avoidance agreements and 106 Bilateral Investment Treaties with its trade partners. In [August 2022](http://wam.ae/en/details/1395303072730), the first Global Family Business and Private Wealth Centre in the region and the world was established by the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC).

# How to top up your personal loan in the UAE: Securing the best interest rate

![A person reviewing personal loan documents on their laptop.](/-/media/enbd/images/accounts/top_up_personal_loan_newbg.jpg?la=en&h=600&w=800&hash=88B9CD2E385795510694C10AA997DF7C)  
#####  
Topping up an existing personal loan can be a smarter move than taking out a brand-new one, but only if you approach it with the right information. In this blog, you'll find a clear breakdown of how top-ups work under CBUAE regulations, what affects your personal loan interest rate in the UAE, and a practical step-by-step guide to applying with confidence, whether you're a UAE national or an expatriate.  
Financial needs can change over the life of a loan. Whether you're funding a major purchase, covering an unexpected expense, or consolidating obligations, a personal loan top-up may provide access to additional funds without taking on a separate loan. This guide covers everything from CBUAE regulations to rate comparison approaches for both UAE nationals and expatriates.

Personal loan interest rate UAE: Top-up guide | Emirates NBD > What is a personal loan top-up in the UAE?

## What is a personal loan top-up in the UAE?  
A personal loan top-up is not the same as taking out a completely new loan, and it is not quite the same as refinancing either. The [**CBUAE**](https://rulebook.centralbank.ae/en/entiresection/1715) defines a top-up as "an additional loan obtained by the borrower from the lending bank or finance company prior to the full repayment of the outstanding loan." In plain terms, your existing loan is restructured to include additional funds, and you repay the combined amount under a new schedule.  
There are a few things to be aware of before you proceed:  
* The CBUAE sets a **[maximum tenure of 48 months](https://rulebook.centralbank.ae/en/rulebook/article-7-repayment-installments-0)** for personal loans in the UAE, and a top-up resets this clock from the date of the new arrangement.
* Banks are required by regulation to restrict the frequency of top-ups; they cannot be used repeatedly to roll over debt.  
A simple example: If you originally borrowed 100,000 and have repaid 30,000, a top-up to 150,000 would replace your existing arrangement with a new blended loan, subject to current rates and a fresh eligibility assessment. The extra funds are disbursed once the bank confirms you qualify.

## Eligibility, documents and bank criteria  
Banks assess top-up requests against several criteria and understanding these in advance saves time and improves your chances of approval.  
The key eligibility factors Emirates NBD applies are the following:  
* **Employment tenure:** At least **[six months](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/life-and-living/personal-loans-in-uae-what-are-the-eligibility-criteria-for-expats)** with your current employer
* **Age:** Minimum 21 years of age for most banks.
* **Repayment record:** You'll qualify if you borrowed less than your maximum eligible amount or if you borrowed the full amount and have made at least 12 EMI payments since.
* **Debt burden ratio:** Monthly repayments, including the top-up, must not exceed **[50% of gross salary](https://rulebook.centralbank.ae/en/rulebook/article-3-important-ratios)** (30% for retirees)  
Documents you will typically need to gather before applying are listed below:  
* Valid Emirates ID
* Latest salary certificate
* Last three months' bank statements  
Additionally, expatriates will require a passport and a UAE residence visa.  
Check your **[Al Etihad Credit Bureau (AECB)](https://etihadbureau.ae/Individual/CreditScore)** score before you apply. Scores **[above 700](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/your-credit-score)** are considered good and give you the strongest chance of qualifying for the lowest available personal loan interest rates in the UAE.

## 6 tactics to secure a low-interest personal loan top-up  
Securing a competitive personal loan interest rate in the UAE takes a little preparation. These six steps make a real difference to the final number on your agreement.  
* **Transfer your salary:** Banks consistently offer their lowest rates to salary-transfer customers. This single step can unlock access to better-priced products. Check the **[salary transfer benefits](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/campaigns/transfer-your-salary-earn-more)** available through Emirates NBD.
* **Improve your AECB score first:** Clear outstanding credit card balances, avoid multiple simultaneous loan applications, and keep your credit utilisation low.
* **Choose a shorter tenure:** On a reducing balance loan, a 24-month term pays significantly less total interest than a 48-month term, even though the monthly repayment is higher.
* **Ask about processing-fee waivers:** Switch or buyout offers sometimes come with zero processing fees. Emirates NBD **[personal loans](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/loans/personal-loans)** are worth checking if you are considering moving your loan.

## Application process: How to top up your loan step by step  
Here is the application process for requesting a top-up on a personal loan in the UAE through Emirates NBD:  
* **Check your eligibility:** You may be eligible for a top-up if you have not defaulted on your existing loan. If you have already borrowed your full eligible amount, you should complete at least 12 EMI payments before applying for a top-up.
* **Keep your documents ready:** Depending on your application, you may need documents such as your Emirates ID, latest salary certificate and recent bank statements. If you are eligible for Emirates NBD's Automatic Top-Up Programme, some of these documents may not be required.
* **Submit your application:** You can apply for a personal loan top-up through Online Banking, ENBD X, the Emirates NBD Mobile Banking app, by visiting an Emirates NBD branch or by calling the bank's customer service.
* **Wait for the bank's assessment:** Emirates NBD will review your application and determine your eligibility based on its lending criteria and internal approval process.
* **Review and accept the offer:** If your application is approved, carefully review the loan amount, interest rate, repayment tenure and other terms before accepting the offer.
* **Receive the funds:** Once you accept the approved offer and complete any required formalities, the top-up amount will be credited to your account.

## Top-up vs new loan: Which one's affordable?  
This decision depends on your existing rate, how much you need and where you are in your current repayment term.  
A top-up is generally the better choice when your existing rate is competitive and you want to avoid paying two separate processing fees and two sets of insurance premiums.  
A separate new loan can work in your favour if your current loan is near the end of its term because a top-up would reset the tenure back to up to 48 months on the combined balance. It also gives you flexibility if a different bank is offering a significantly lower rate on fresh borrowing.  
Before deciding, use this checklist:  
* Is your current interest rate competitive with today's market?
* How many months remain on your existing loan?
* Would two separate repayments affect your monthly cash flow?
* Does the top-up keep your total repayment below 50% of your gross salary?
* Have you checked whether any switch or buyout offer improves the numbers?

## Frequently asked questions  
[How soon after taking a personal loan can I request a topup in the UAE?](#faqs-what-is-an-itm "What is an ITM")  
Most banks require a track record of 6 to 12 consecutive on-time repayments before they will consider a top-up. The CBUAE requires lenders to maintain policies that restrict the frequency of top-ups so you cannot request them repeatedly in quick succession.  
[Does topping up my loan change my interest rate?](#faqs-what-is-the-maximum-amount-for-a-transaction-via-itm "Whats the maximum amount for a transaction via ITM")  
Yes, a top-up is treated as a new loan arrangement, which means the bank will apply the prevailing rate at the time of the top-up rather than your original rate.  
[Can expatriates without salary transfers get a top-up?](#faqs-do-you-require-any-documents-from-customer-for-performing-transactions-over-itm "Do you require any documents from customer for performing transactions over ITM")  
Most banks require a salary transfer as a condition for personal loans and top-ups. Some lenders offer products without this requirement, typically at higher rates or with stricter eligibility conditions. Check the specific requirements on the Emirates NBD **[personal loan page](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/loans/personal-loans)** or speak with a relationship manager to confirm what applies to your situation.

[What happens to my existing loan tenure after a topup?](#faqs-what-are-the-itm-service-operating-timings "What are the ITM service operating timings")  
The tenure resets from the date the topup is approved. The CBUAE sets a [**maximum personal loan tenure of 48 months**](https://rulebook.centralbank.ae/en/rulebook/article-2-personal-loan) and your new blended loan will be structured within this limit.  
[Are top-up proceeds taxed in the UAE?](#faqs-what-kind-of-services-itm-can-provide "What kind of services ITM can provide")  
The UAE does not levy personal income tax, and loan proceeds are not considered taxable income. The funds you receive from a top-up are a debt obligation, not earnings. For any tax queries specific to your circumstances, the UAE Federal Tax Authority is the appropriate reference point.

text:
Personalise your card digitally, your way | Emirates NBD > How it works

## How it works  
Six simple steps inside the ENBD X app.  
![Step 1](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/visa-digital-skin/images/icon-login.png)  
Log in to the [**ENBD X app**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/ways-of-banking/mobile-banking#download-enbd-x)  
![Step 2](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/visa-digital-skin/images/icon-home.png)  
Go to your Cards home page  
![Step 3](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/visa-digital-skin/images/icon-palette.png)  
Tap the Personalise icon below the card image  
![Step 4](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/visa-digital-skin/images/icon-view-carousel.png)  
Scroll through the available card skins  
![Step 5](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/visa-digital-skin/images/icon-check-circle.png)  
Select your preferred skin and tap **Change**  
![Step 6](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/visa-digital-skin/images/icon-credit-card.png)  
Your personalised digital card is ready  
![Your personalised card skin also appears in your digital wallet](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/visa-digital-skin/images/wallet-banner-fifa.jpg)  
##### Good to know  
#### Your skin syncs to your digital wallet  
Your chosen skin will also appear in your digital wallet. You can switch back to your original card design any time from your Cards home page in ENBD X.  
[Get the ENBD X app](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/ways-of-banking/mobile-banking#download-enbd-x)

text:
Skywards Signature Credit Card | Skywards Miles | Emirates NBD > Looking for something different?

**Retail spends**  
* Grocery and supermarkets, fast food restaurants, insurance, car dealership earn 25% of domestic spends\*
* Petroleum, transit, government services, utility payments, real estate, education & telecommunications payments earn 10% of the domestic spends\*  
**Duty free, online food delivery and car booking apps**  
* Domestic and international Duty free spends, domestic online food delivery and car booking apps spends earn 2 Miles per USD equivalent; spend on Skywards Infinite Card. 1.5 Miles per USD equivalent spend on Skywards Signature Card  
**International spends**  
Spends made abroad on groceries and supermarkets, insurance, car dealerships, fast food, real estate, education, petrol, government services and utility payments including telecom, earn Miles as per normal international spends.  
Retail spends on merchants in the EU earn 50% of the international spends.  
**Express Miles**  
Cardholders enrolled in the ‘50% more Express Miles every month programme’ are eligible to earn Express Miles. This is subject to a maximum of 4,000 additional Miles per statement. A nominal monthly fee of 250 is charged for the Express Miles programme. The listed annual fee of 1,500 is waived from the 2nd year onwards for cardholders enrolled into the Express Miles Programme. Bonus Miles for spends on Emirates website are excluded for Express Miles calculation.

[How is my average monthly balance calculated?](#accordion-0aa55dfb-9098-4022-9479-ec874632fe02 "How is my average monthly balance calculated")  
Average monthly balance calculation is a function of balance maintained in the account calculated over period of days the balance is maintained. Average balance is calculated at customer level; hence the balance in Current, Savings and Fixed Deposit accounts will be considered to compute the average balance. E.g. If you maintain 5,000 in your account from the first day of the month till the last day of the month, then average balance will be 5,000 for that calendar month. If you maintain zero balance for first 15 days and maintain 10,000 for the next fifteen days, the average balance will also be 5,000 for that calendar month.  
[Am I eligible to request for a cheque book?](#accordion-0ebfaa20-91c7-4419-aeea-b794b00c688c "Am I eligible to request for a cheque book")  
Current account holders are eligible for a cheque book. First cheque book on account opening is free; on subsequent requests for cheque books, charges are levied as per schedule of charges.  
[How do I request for a cheque book?](#accordion-8e052510-fc09-445f-be8c-675ecaec7ade "How do I request for a cheque book")

* If the cheque/ cheque book is lost or stolen. A police report needs to be presented in case of lost/ stolen cheque.
* The bearer of the cheque has become bankrupt/ insolvent. A court order is required providing insolvency/ bankruptcy of the bearer.  
[How do I close my Account?](#accordion-7b827875-bde1-4f38-8470-a399b3092ebb "How do I close my Account")

[What will happen to my Direct Debits and Standing orders when I close my account?](#accordion-847f0349-bf12-44fe-b8c4-632136f99350 "What will happen to my Direct Debits and Standing orders when I close my account")  
Direct debits and standing instructions will be canceled on closure of the account. In the case of an active loan with direct debit setup, the account cannot be closed till an alternate payment mode is arranged, or the loan is settled.

[What is a Skywards savings account and Visa debit card?](#accordion-26801025-1281-4def-bf9e-2491def7b85c "What is a Skywards savings account and Visa debit card")
title: Skywards Visa Debit Card | Skywards Savings Account | Emirates NBD

text:
Skywards Visa Debit Card | Skywards Savings Account | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

The new Emirates NBD Skywards savings account and Visa debit card is one-of-a-kind program and a market first and offers the highest Skywards miles earning in the UAE. The product also comes packed with travel and lifestyle benefits to best suit the frequent traveler's lifestyle.  
[I am an existing customer, how can I sign up for a Skywards savings account and Visa debit card?](#accordion-b4d74deb-1555-4ad2-858e-8a7924035227 "I am an existing customer how can I sign up for a Skywards savings account and Visa debit card")  
You can contact your relationship manager to open a Skywards Savings Account and Visa Debit Card. Alternatively, you can call our 24/7 call center 600 54000 or visit any of our branches.  
[What is the minimum average monthly balance required to be eligible to open a Skywards savings account?](#accordion-0b983d8f-5587-4c26-8295-274e205c89f2 "What is the minimum average monthly balance required to be eligible to open a Skywards savings account")  
The minimum average monthly balance required is 500,000.  
[What benefits do I get with my Skywards savings account and Visa debit card?](#accordion-39b2221d-0488-4700-bdc1-548096573809 "What benefits do I get with my Skywards savings account and Visa debit card")  
The new Emirates NBD Skywards Savings Account and Visa Debit Card offers a wide range of benefits.  
* You can earn up to 5 Skywards miles per USD equivalent spend on the Debit Card
* You get a complimentary Emirates Skywards silver membership
title: Skywards Visa Debit Card | Skywards Savings Account | Emirates NBD

text:
Skywards Visa Debit Card | Skywards Savings Account | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

* You can earn up to 5 Skywards miles per USD equivalent spend on the Debit Card
* You get a complimentary Emirates Skywards silver membership
* You get complimentary access to 900+ airport lounges worldwide via LoungeKey
* Up to 0.25% interest p.a. on the Savings Account balance
* You can share the savings with the supplementary cards and earn Skywards miles on the spend
* If you book your ticket with your debit card and get covered up to US $500,000 for travel accident and travel inconvenience on all trips up to 90 days.
* You can get an additional warranty period of up to 1 year from the end of manufacturer warranty for items purchased with the Visa Debit Card
* International Medical & Travel assistance Service helps you and your immediate family when you are travelling together to a location outside of your principal country of residence for up to 90 days. Services such as medical telephone advice, putting you in touch with a local medical service provider
* Purchase protection covers theft or accidental damage of articles purchased with your Visa Debit Card  
[I am an existing customer, will I be eligible for the benefits of Skywards Savings Account and Visa Debit Card if I transfer the minimum balance required from an existing account?](#accordion-6d501927-3269-49cb-aab2-dfa6ad68a84d "I am an existing customer will I be eligible for the benefits of Skywards Savings Account and Visa Debit Card if I transfer the minimum balance required from an existing account")
title: Skywards Visa Debit Card | Skywards Savings Account | Emirates NBD

text:
Skywards Visa Debit Card | Skywards Savings Account | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

Yes, as long as you meet the minimum 500,000 account opening balance criteria in the Skywards Saving Account, the benefits will be available. You can transfer from existing account to Skywards Savings Account or bring in additional 500,000.  
[Can I link my Skywards Visa debit card to my existing non Skywards savings account?](#accordion-04b2fa55-3b63-43a7-a330-7985f09d064c "Can I link my Skywards Visa debit card to my existing non Skywards savings account")  
No, the Skywards Visa debit card can be linked only to your Skywards savings account.  
[What are the fees associated with my Skywards savings account?](#accordion-4a104a91-ca84-43b0-8232-f55473e59374 "What are the fees associated with my Skywards savings account")  
Joining fee of 2,500 in for the first year and monthly fee of 200 from 2nd year of account opening onwards.  
[I am an existing Skywards credit card holder, do I still need to provide my Skywards number?](#accordion-bf56940b-13e6-4661-8eec-7c10275c2bf5 "I am an existing Skywards credit card holder do I still need to provide my Skywards number")  
Yes, you are required to provide your Skywards number.  
[When will my bonus miles get credited to my Skywards savings account?](#accordion-9ac28ff6-919e-476e-a80c-ea451a371b93 "When will my bonus miles get credited to my Skywards savings account")
title: Skywards Visa Debit Card | Skywards Savings Account | Emirates NBD

text:
Skywards Visa Debit Card | Skywards Savings Account | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

Initially 25,000 miles will be credited to your Skywards Savings Account, 45 days after the joining fee of 2,500 is paid. Another 25,000 miles will be credited 45 days after the average balance in the account is more than 750,000 on the 3rd month of account opening.  
[Can I open the Skywards savings account in a foreign currency?](#accordion-d754cba2-2a3a-42ee-9712-a2f4ecb7b739 "Can I open the Skywards savings account in a foreign currency")  
No, you can only open a Skywards account in UAE dirham.  
[In case I have a supplementary Visa debit card, where will the miles go to?](#accordion-078cf0f4-74cb-492e-a425-1f00b9e40912 "In case I have a supplementary Visa debit card where will the miles go to")  
All miles earned by primary and supplementary will go to the Skywards savings account of the primary debit cardholder.

text:
Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Eligibility

## Eligibility  
To apply for a home loan with us, you need to be:  
* a UAE National earning at least 10,000, or a UAE resident earning at least 15,000
* an expat employed in the UAE for at least 3 years with at least 1 year in your current job
* not older than 65 years old if salaried, or 70 years old if self-employed\*, when the loan matures  
\*If you are self-employed, your company should be in operation for at least 3 years.  
Learn more about our home loans [here](/en/loans/home-loans).
title: Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:

## Apply for a home loan  
Choose one of the following options to apply now:  
If you’re self-employed, you can apply for a home loan only through our website, or by visiting one of our[branches](/en/branches-and-atms).

text:
Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD > How long it will take

## How long it will take  
Your application will be processed within 3 to 5 working days. Once your application is approved, your loan amount will be transferred to the dealership or seller.
title: Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Documents required

## Documents required  
* Your passport
* UAE residence visa and Emirates ID with copies
* Salary Certificate addressed to Emirates NBD. If there is more than a 10% variance in salary, we’ll need payslips for the last three months
* If you’re self-employed, we’ll need your Trade License copy, Audited Report for the last 2 years, UAE Chamber of Commerce License, Share Certificate and Memorandum and Articles of Association
* Last 6-month's Bank Statement
* Proof of address (this can be your Tenancy Contract, Bank Statement with current address or Title Deed)
* Property documents (only in case of loan against property)
* Loan Account Statement for loan take over
* Title Deed of property to be acquired  
If any additional documents are required, we’ll inform you during the application process.
title: Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Fees and Charges

## Fees and Charges  
These are the fees and charges for a home loan:  
* Loan Processing Fee: 1.05% of the loan amount (inclusive of VAT)
* Credit Life Insurance Coverage: as per the quote
* Valuation charge: 3,150 for completed property (inclusive of VAT) and 20,000 for self-constructed property  
View our other fees and charges [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/File/Personal_Banking_SOC_POSTER.pdf).

text:
Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[I currently have my own life insurance. Can I link this insurance with my home loan?](#faqs-i-currently-have-my-own-life-insurance-can-i-link-this-insurance-with-my-home-loan "I currently have my own life insurance. Can I link this insurance with my home loan")  
Yes, you can, however it is subject to bank approval.  
[Can I get 100% finance for my new home? Or do I have to finance part of it?](#faqs-can-i-get-100-finance-for-my-new-home-or-do-i-have-to-finance-part-of-it "Can I get 100 finance for my new home Or do I have to finance part of it")  
No, as per UAE regulations, you must pay a down payment towards your new home. Furthermore, the amount of finance you receive for your home loan will depend upon your age, salary, employment tenure, credit score and length of relationship with the bank.  
[Can I take a home loan to cover only part of the cost of my new home?](#faqs-can-i-take-a-home-loan-to-cover-only-part-of-the-cost-of-my-new-home "Can I take a home loan to cover only part of the cost of my new home")  
Yes, you can use the loan to pay only part of the original cost of your new home.  
[Can I take a home loan to refurbish or remodel my existing home?](#faqs-can-i-take-a-home-loan-to-refurbish-or-remodel-my-existing-home "Can I take a home loan to refurbish or remodel my existing home")  
Yes, you can. This is subject to bank review and a refurbish quote.
title: Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

Yes, you can. This is subject to bank review and a refurbish quote.  
[Does the bank insure my property?](#faqs-does-the-bank-insure-my-property "Does the bank insure my property")  
Yes, the bank will insure the property for the term of the loan.  
[Can I take a joint home loan together with my partner or spouse?](#faqs-can-i-take-a-joint-home-loan-together-with-my-partner-or-spouse "Can I take a joint home loan together with my partner or spouse")  
Yes, you can take joint a home loan with your spouse or other approved relations, as per bank policies.  
[If I don’t meet the salary criteria, can I take a joint home loan with my spouse, family member or friend?](#faqs-if-i-dont-meet-the-salary-criteria-can-i-take-a-joint-loan-with-my-spouse-family-member-or-friend "If I dont meet the salary criteria can I take a joint home loan with my spouse family member or friend")  
No, a minimum salary criteria should be met by every borrower in the application.  
[Will the interest rate on my home loan change over the course of the years? Or is it fixed?](#faqs-will-the-interest-rate-on-my-home-loan-change-over-the-course-of-the-years "Will the interest rate on my home loan change over the course of the years Or is it fixed")  
The interest rate on your home loan depends on whether you signed up for a fixed or variable rate. Fixed rates are usually for the initial loan period which can be 2, 3 or 5 years. After that, you switch to the prevailing interest rate which is variable.
title: Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a home loan | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

[What if I want to move my loan to another bank, is this possible? Is there a charge for this?](#faqs-what-if-i-want-to-move-my-loan-to-another-bank-is-this-possible-is-there-a-charge-for-this "What if I want to move my loan to another bank is this possible Is there a charge for this")  
Yes, early settlement charges are applicable if you move your loan to another bank.  
[What if I want to settle my loan early? Will I have to pay a charge?](#faqs-what-if-i-want-to-settle-my-loan-early-will-i-have-to-pay-a-charge "What if I want to settle my loan early Will I have to pay a charge")  
Yes, you can ask for early settlement of your loan and there is a charge for this.  
[What if I can’t pay my home loan installments, can I refinance the loan? Will the bank give me a loan holiday?](#faqs-what-if-i-cant-pay-my-home-loan-installments-can-i-refinance-the-loan "What if I cant pay my home loan installments can I refinance the loan Will the bank give me a loan holiday")  
No, deferment on home loans is not allowed.

## FAQs  
[What is the difference between registering with an account and registering with a bank card?](#faqs-whats-the-difference-between-registering-using-an-account-and-registering-using-a-credit-card "What is the difference between registering with an account and registering with a bank card")  
When you register with your account and credit card, you will be able to view all banking products in your banking profile and also have access to all our online/mobile banking services.  
When you register with your bank card, you will only have access to the details and services of the bank card.  
[I registered for Online Banking and Mobile Banking using my credit card. If I apply for other bank products will I see them when I log in?](#faqs-i-registered-for-online-and-mobile-banking-using-my-credit-card "I registered for Online Banking and Mobile Banking using my credit card. If I apply for other bank products will I see them when I log in")  
If you’ve registered for Online and Mobile Banking using your credit card, you’ll only see details related to your credit card. To view all your banking products, you’ll need to register for Online and Mobile Banking again using your account. Call us on [+971 600 54 0000](tel:+971600540000), and we’ll help set that up for you.

text:
All about End of Service Benefits  | Support | Emirates NBD > What happens when you change or lose your job

## What happens when you change or lose your job  
If you have a salary transfer account with Emirates NBD, your employer will most likely transfer your End of Service Benefits (EOSB) to that account. If you have liabilities with the bank in the form of a personal loan or have irregular payments with your other liabilities, access to your End of Service Benefits will be restricted until you provide us with your new employment details, or your liabilities are cleared.  
The bank can take the following actions:  
**If you have a credit card:**  
* Your card limit will be temporarily decreased to the amount of your outstanding balance plus 5,000.
* If your card limit is used in full, your outstanding amount will be debited from your End of Service Benefits and your credit card will be temporarily blocked.  
**If you have a personal loan:**  
* The outstanding loan amount will be blocked from your End of Service Benefits.
* If your outstanding loan amount is more than your End of Service Benefit, the End of Service Benefit will be blocked in full.  
**Overdue payments or delinquency on other liabilities:**  
* The bank might debit all overdue payments from your End of Service Benefits or block any outstanding amounts owed to the bank in your account.

text:
All about End of Service Benefits  | Support | Emirates NBD > Update your new employment details with us

## Update your new employment details with us  
To update your new employment details, visit your [nearest Emirates NBD branch](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/branches-and-atms/?ref=header-navigation) with the following documents:  
* Your new offer letter, contract, or official employment letter
* Passport and Emirates ID
* A salary transfer letter if you’re transferring your new salary to us  
**Note:** If you have a personal loan with us, and you want to continue enjoying your existing interest rate, your first salary must be transferred to us. Just give your new employer your account details, so they can continue transferring your salary to us.  
**What’s next**  
Once we have your new employment details, please contact the Collections Department on [+971 600 54 0040](tel:+971 600 54 0040), Monday to Friday between 9am and 4pm and request a release of your funds.  
Once your request is processed, your end of service will be released within 1-2 working days.

text:
All about End of Service Benefits  | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[Once I pay off my liabilities, how can I release my End of Service Benefits from the bank?](#faqs-once-i-pay-off-my-liabilities-how-can-i-release-my-end-of-service-benefits-from-the-bank "Once I pay off my liabilities how can I release my End of Service Benefits from the bank")  
Please contact the Collections Department on [+971 600 54 0040](tel:+971 600 54 0040) Monday to Friday, 9am to 4pm and they will be happy to help.  
[If I am changing my job, or have lost my job, do I need to inform the bank?](#faqs-if-i-am-changing-my-job-or-have-lost-my-job-do-i-need-to-inform-the-bank "If I am changing my job or have lost my job do I need to inform the bank")  
You should inform the bank if you have liabilities with us including loans or credit cards. You will need to provide us with your new employment details or pay off your dues failing which your End of Service Benefits will be blocked and / or your accounts frozen.  
[Does Emirates NBD have the right to block all or a portion of my End of Service Benefits towards my liabilities without my consent?](#faqs-does-emirates-nbd-have-the-right-to-block-all-or-a-portion-of-my-end-of-service-benefits "Does Emirates NBD have the right to block all or a portion of my End of Service Benefits towards my liabilities without my consent")  
Yes, as per the terms and conditions on the loan or credit card contract, the bank can block or debit any outstanding amounts from your End of Service Benefits.
title: All about End of Service Benefits  | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
All about End of Service Benefits  | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

[Will the bank notify me when my account or End of Service Benefits are being put on hold?](#faqs-will-the-bank-notify-me-when-my-account-or-end-of-service-benefits-are-being-put-on-hold "Will the bank notify me when my account or End of Service Benefits are being put on hold")  
Yes, you will be notified when the End of Service Benefits is received and if any or all of it is being put on hold.  
[Can I continue with my salary transfer account when I change or lose my job?](#faqs-can-i-continue-with-my-salary-transfer-account-when-i-change-or-lose-my-job "Can I continue with my salary transfer account when I change or lose my job")  
Yes, you can. If you’re in a new job, just let your new employer know your account details so they can continue to transfer your salary there.  
[My salary will be changing at my new job. Does the bank need to know?](#faqs-my-salary-will-be-changing-at-my-new-job-does-the-bank-need-to-know "My salary will be changing at my new job. Does the bank need to know")  
No, but we do recommend you update your details with us so we can offer you the most suitable products for your salary bracket.  
[What documents do I need to submit to the bank if I have a loan and I change my job?](#faqs-what-documents-do-i-need-to-submit-to-the-bank-if-i-have-a-loan-and-if-i-change-my-job "What documents do I need to submit to the bank if I have a loan and I change my job")

* Your Emirates ID
* Salary transfer letter
* Passport
* Salary credit from the new employer if you are holding a personal loan with us  
Please note, your new salary needs to be transferred to us if you want to continue with the existing rate of interest.

[Is it safe to share my account number?](#accordion-6c7a3152-a05d-4ef2-92d9-932ef2572a52 "Is it safe to share my account number")  
It’s generally safe to share your account number with trusted people and with the bank. Always avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. text:
Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD > Buy now, pay in instalments

## Buy now, pay in instalments  
If you’ve made a big purchase and would like to pay in instalments, you can convert your transaction into a convenient instalment payment plan. What’s more, you can choose between a regular Instalment Payment Plan (IPP) and a 0% interest Instalment Payment Plan. Applying is easy, just follow the instructions below.
title: Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD > Eligibility

## Eligibility  
Primary credit cardholders can convert any transaction done in the last 55 days. This means the transaction should be in your latest statement or current billing cycle. You can apply for a regular Instalment Payment Plan (IPP) or a 0% interest Instalment Payment Plan.  
Please note, supplementary credit cards, business credit cards, forex credit cards and the Webshopper card are not eligible.  
**Regular Instalment Payment Plan**  
To apply for a regular Instalment Payment Plan, your transaction needs to be worth a minimum of 750. You can apply for 12, 18, 24, 36, or 48 equated monthly payments.  
**0% interest Instalment Payment Plan**  
To apply for a 0% interest Instalment Payment Plan, you need to have made a purchase at one of our [participating partners.](/en/deals/0-epp)  
You can also convert your entire credit card outstanding amount into easy instalments. [Read more about our Balance Conversion Plan](/en/help-and-support/pay-your-credit-card-dues-in-installments).
title: Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD > Converting purchases into instalments

## Converting purchases into instalments  
You can convert a purchase into instalments at the time of purchase. Please remember that only a primary credit cardholder can apply for an Instalment Payment Plan.  
Choose one of the options below for steps to apply for an instalment plan:
title: Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD > Cancelling your Instalment Payment Plan

## Cancelling your Instalment Payment Plan  
You can cancel your Instalment Payment Plan at any time, but note that a foreclosure fee applies.
title: Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD > Fees, charges and interest

## Fees, charges and interest  
A nominal interest rate applies on regular Instalment Payment Plans and is based on your credit card history and usage. The interest rate is subject to change at anytime.  
0% interest Instalment Plans have a processing fee of 51.45 (inclusive of VAT) per transaction.  
A foreclosure fee of 1.05% of the remaining balance (inclusive of VAT) applies.  
For more details, read out [Schedule of Credit Card Fees and Charges](/-/media/files/help-and-support-pdf/emiratesnbd_credit_card_fees_charges.pdf).
title: Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[Can I change the tenure of my Instalment Payment Plan?](#faqs-can-i-change-the-tenure-of-my-installment-payment-plan "Can I change the tenure of my Instalment Payment Plan")  
You can’t change the tenure of an Instalment Payment Plan but you can cancel the plan. Remember that a foreclosure fee applies if you cancel.  
[What happens if I miss paying an instalment towards my Instalment Payment Plan?](#faqs-what-happens-if-i-miss-paying-an-installment-towards-my-installment-payment-plan "What happens if I miss paying an instalment towards my Instalment Payment Plan")  
If you fail to pay your instalments for two consecutive months, your plan will be foreclosed. Your entire outstanding Instalment Payment Plan amount will immediately be due for payment in full. Any remaining outstanding balance will attract our regular finance charges. Read more in our [Schedule of Credit Card Fees and Charges](/-/media/files/help-and-support-pdf/emiratesnbd_credit_card_fees_charges.pdf)[.](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/File/EmiratesNBD_Credit_Card_Fees_Charges.pdf)  
[Can I still earn reward points if I convert my transaction to a regular or 0% interest Instalment Payment Plan?](#faqs-can-i-still-earn-reward-points-if-i-convert-my-transaction-to-a-regular "Can I still earn reward points if I convert my transaction to a regular or 0 interest Instalment Payment Plan")
title: Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

You will earn reward points if you convert your transaction to a regular Instalment Payment Plan, however rewards will be forfeited for transactions converted to a 0% interest Instalment Payment Plan except for the following credit cards:  
* Skywards Credit Cards
* Skywards Business Credit Cards
* Marriott Bonvoy® Credit Cards
* On dnata cards, transactions conducted at dnata outlets and dnata online
* U by Emaar Credit Cards on Emaar spends
* LuLu Credit Cards on LuLu spends
* Darna Credit Cards on Aldar spends
* noon One Credit Cards on Noon platform spends
* Share Credit Cards on spends in MAF ecosystem
+ For spends outside MAF ecosystem, only the Share Platinum Variant will forfeit the points  
[My credit card dues have built up over the last few months. What options do I have?](#faqs-my-credit-card-dues-have-built-up-over-the-last-few-months-what-options-do "My credit card dues have built up over the last few months. What options do I have")  
If your transactions are not in your current billing cycle or last statement, you can’t opt for an [Instalment Payment Plan](/en/help-and-support/installment-payment-plan), but you can apply for a [Balance Conversion Plan](/en/help-and-support/pay-your-credit-card-dues-in-installments).
title: Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Installment Payment Plan | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

[Am I eligible for an Instalment Payment Plan for a purchase that is more than two months old?](#faqs-am-i-eligible-for-an-installment-payment-plan-for-a-purchase-that-is-more-than-two-months-old "Am I eligible for an Instalment Payment Plan for a purchase that is more than two months old")  
No, you can only convert purchases that are in your latest statement and current billing cycle into [Instalment Payment Plans](/en/help-and-support/installment-payment-plan).

[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my card number?](#accordion-c14e16bd-40cc-461b-87a6-b5f8a7f4570b "Is it safe to share my card number")  
You should avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. It’s ok to share this information with the bank in a safe manner. API banking refers to a set of protocols that makes a bank’s services available to other third-party companies via APIs.

API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD > API Security Controls

## API Security Controls  
As with all other offerings, our API Banking protocols also meet the highest standards of security to give you complete peace of mind. These include:  
![Transport Layer Security](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/cib_ds_apibanking_transport_layer_security_icon.png?la=en&h=250&w=250&hash=CD42B8723C13125AD8F93CE2AA832C8B)
title: API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD

text:
API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD > Transport Layer Security

### Transport Layer Security  
API calls are made over HTTPS using Transport Layer Security (mTLS 1.2).  
![Authentication](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/cib_ds_apibanking_authentication_icon.png?la=en&h=250&w=250&hash=2AE2946E01F393201D341C110AC4210E)
title: API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD

text:
API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD > Authentication

### Authentication  
As an API client, you must present a client specific key, secret and a certificate as per industry standard OAuth 2.0 protocol.  
![JWT Token](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/cib_ds_apibanking_jwt_icon.png?la=en&h=250&w=250&hash=14676DBCD9EC1AAE81877F9314E8DBEB)
title: API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD

text:
API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD > JWT Token

### JWT Token  
API calls carry a valid JWT token (JSON Web Token), digitally signed by a known token issuer. JWT token must be valid and provide the identity of the user/system consuming the API.  
![Authorisation](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/cib_ds_apibanking_authorisation_icon.png?la=en&h=250&w=250&hash=5DB4AD53E4209040A50FE7D9784694F3)
title: API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD

text:
API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD > Authorisation

### Authorisation  
API clients need to be onboarded to the API Banking engine to utilise APIs with proper access permission to the bank and other resources. other resources.  
![Message Layer Security](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/cib_ds_apibanking_message_layer_security_icon.png?la=en&h=250&w=250&hash=66418E58762E8188CB23CD809E9279CE)
title: API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD

text:
API Banking | Application Programming Interface Banking | Emirates NBD > Message Layer Security

### Message Layer Security  
The API request parameters and payload must be digitally signed using a secure, client-specific private key.

text:
Lending Solutions | Meet Financial Requirements | Emirates NBD > Your next can be as big as you believe it to be.

## Your next can be as big as you believe it to be.  
We support you in achieving your dreams with our customized Lending Solutions to meet your diverse financing requirements.  
We offer a multitude of financing solutions made available to individuals, families, investment companies, offshore trusts and holding companies. We tailor lending solutions to your individual needs, paying close attention to your situation and cash flow requirements.  
Under our Lending program, we offer secured lending against liquid assets such as investment securities, deposits and precious metals. Our Singapore office is able to offer premium financing of high-value universal life insurance policies (Jumbo Insurance).  
You may choose to borrow against an existing portfolio of assets or acquire new assets by contributing equity in addition to leverage provided by the Bank. Additionally, we also accommodate IPO financing and can assist in hedging currency and interest rate exposures through SWAPS and FX forward transactions.  
We also offer an array of real estate financing options, such as acquisition, refinancing and equity release. Real estate financing is available on residential and income-generating properties in the UAE as well as residential and commercial properties in the UK. You can also enjoy direct access to various trade finance solutions provided by our Wholesale Banking team.

#### Interest rate risk  
Market interest rates are a function of several factors such as the demand for, and supply of, money in the economy, the inflation rate, the stage that the business cycle is in, as well as the government's monetary and fiscal policies. Should the market interest rate rise from the date of the security’s purchase, the security’s price will fall accordingly. The security will then trade at a discount to the purchase price.  
#### Market risk  
Market movement, which can be influenced by many factors, including, but not limited to, issuer risk, interest rate risk, market sentiment and changes in economic, financial or political environments may result in the fluctuation of prices. Market risk results from the unpredictability of market movements and is inherent in any investment; such risk may cause the value of the investment to fall rapidly, as well as rise, and you may not get back the amount originally invested.

Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD > Understanding Credit Card Interest Rates and Fees in the UAE

# Understanding Credit Card Interest Rates and Fees in the UAE  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![understandingcreditcardinterestratesandfeesintheuae](/-/media/enbd/images/help-and-support/images/understanding-credit-card.jpg?la=en&h=600&w=800&hash=EF45975ACD525EBCB271AB715204F5BB)  
#####  
Credit cards are one of the most useful financial tools available to UAE residents, but only when you understand what they actually cost. Here’s how interest works, which fees the CBUAE regulates, and how to check if a cashback card’s rewards are worth the cost.You'll also find practical tips you can act on right away.  
Understandinghow interest works, which categories earn rewards, and what fees apply makes a real difference to what you actually get from it. The mechanics aren't complicated once you know what to look for. UAE credit cards can work significantly in your favour when you use them with the full picture in mind.
title: Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD
section: Understanding Credit Card Interest Rates and Fees in the UAE

text:
Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD > How credit cards work in the UAE

## How credit cards work in the UAE  
A credit card lets you spend up to an approved limit, with the issuing bank paying the merchant on your behalf. Under CBUAE guidelines, you then repay that amount at the start of the following billing cycle or in instalments. Emirates NBD gives you a [25-day grace period](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/-/media/enbd/files/credit-cards/emiratesnbd_credit_card_fees_charges.pdf) from your statement date to settle the balance in full.  
Pay the full amount by the due date, and no finance charges apply to your purchases. Carry any portion of the balance forward, and interest begins to accrue. That unpaid portion is called a revolving balance, and it's where credit card charges become significant.  
Most cards also specify a minimum payment, typically a small percentage of the outstanding balance. Paying only that minimum keeps your account current but leaves the remaining balance attracting interest every month.
title: Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD
section: How credit cards work in the UAE

text:
Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD > Interest rates explained: APR vs monthly interest

## Interest rates explained: APR vs monthly interest  
The Annual Percentage Rate, or APR, is the full annual cost of borrowing on your card, expressed as a percentage of the total amount owed. The [CBUAE Consumer Protection Regulation](https://rulebook.centralbank.ae/en/rulebook/consumer-protection-regulation) requires banks to disclose APR clearly on all credit products, including in marketing materials.  
UAE banks usually quote interest as a monthly rate. Emirates NBD applies a monthly finance charge on premium-tier cards and standard cards. For current rates, see the Emirates NBD [fees and charges page](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/-/media/enbd/files/credit-cards/emiratesnbd_credit_card_fees_charges.pdf). Under CBUAE rules, banks must use the [reducing balance method](https://rulebook.centralbank.ae/en/rulebook/article-7-responsible-financing-practice) to calculate interest, and they cannot charge interest on interest already accrued.
title: Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD
section: Interest rates explained: APR vs monthly interest

text:
Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD > Common credit card fees and charges

## Common credit card fees and charges  
Most credit card fees fall into clear categories. Here’s what to look out for, along with the relevant CBUAE limits where applicable.  
- **Fee type**: Annual fee; **What triggers it**: Holding the card; **CBUAE cap (ex-VAT)**: No universal cap; varies by card
- **Fee type**: Late payment fee; **What triggers it**: Minimum balance not paid by due date; **CBUAE cap (ex-VAT)**: 230 per occurrence
- **Fee type**: Over-limit fee; **What triggers it**: Spending beyond your credit limit; **CBUAE cap (ex-VAT)**: Not capped
- **Fee type**: Cash advance fee; **What triggers it**: Withdrawing cash on your card; **CBUAE cap (ex-VAT)**: Not capped
- **Fee type**: Foreign transaction fee; **What triggers it**: Spending in a non-AED currency; **CBUAE cap (ex-VAT)**: Not capped
- **Fee type**: Card replacement fee; **What triggers it**: Replacing a lost or damaged card; **CBUAE cap (ex-VAT)**: 75  
One charge many UAE residents overlook is dynamic currency conversion (DCC). When you pay abroad and a merchant offers to charge you in dirhams rather than the foreign currency, they are applying their own exchange rate, often less favourable than your bank's. Accepting DCC can add another cost on top of that, so it is nearly always worth choosing to pay in the local currency.
title: Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD
section: Common credit card fees and charges

text:
Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD > Credit card benefits vs costs

## Credit card benefits vs costs  
Credit cards offer genuine value beyond convenience. Emirates NBD credit cards include cashback, air miles with Skywards and Etihad Guest, LoungeKey access to airport lounges across the world for premium cardholders, cinema discounts, and lifestyle offers. Whether those benefits outweigh the annual fee depends on your spending patterns.  
Here’s a simple way to see when benefits may outweigh costs, and when charges may exceed them:  
- **Scenario**: High spender who pays in full monthly; **Likely outcome**: Benefits often exceed costs
- **Scenario**: Moderate spender who sometimes revolves a balance; **Likely outcome**: Interest erodes rewards quickly
- **Scenario**: Low spender with a premium annual fee; **Likely outcome**: Charges likely outweigh benefits
- **Scenario**: Traveller using lounge access regularly; **Likely outcome**: Perks can deliver strong value

## Smart ways to reduce interest and avoid fees  
Small habits make a measurable difference to what your credit card actually costs. These seven steps cover the most effective actions available to UAE cardholders.  
1. **Pay the full balance every month:** Under CBUAE rules, no interest applies to purchase balances settled in full by the due date. This single habit eliminates finance charges entirely.
2. **Set up auto-debit:** Automating the full payment removes the risk of a late payment fee and any higher penalty rate that may apply if you miss 2 payments in 6 months.
3. **Use 0% instalment plans:** Emirates NBD's Instalment Payment Plan converts large purchases into manageable monthly payments at 0% interest. A small processing fee applies per transaction. See the [fees page](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/-/media/enbd/files/credit-cards/emiratesnbd_credit_card_fees_charges.pdf) for the current amount.
4. **Consider a balance transfer:** If you're carrying a balance from another bank, Emirates NBD's balance transfer option offers a substantially lower rate than the standard revolving charge. Check [current balance transfer rates](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/-/media/enbd/files/credit-cards/emiratesnbd_credit_card_fees_charges.pdf).
5. **Avoid cash advances:** Cash withdrawals on a credit card start accruing interest immediately, with no grace period and a higher fee structure. Use a debit card or make a transfer instead.

7. **Protect your AECB credit score:** Your score with the Al Etihad Credit Bureau ranges from 300 to 900. A score above 700 is typically required to be eligible for most [credit cards](https://www.stashaway.ae/r/complete-guide-aecb-credit-score) and late payments can remain on your record for up to five years.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)  
[How is credit card interest calculated daily in the UAE?](#question-1 "question-1")  
Most UAE banks use the average daily balance method. Each day's outstanding balance is recorded, the daily figures are summed over the billing cycle, and the applicable monthly rate is applied to that average. Emirates NBD charges interest from the transaction date through to the date of repayment, so the longer the balance remains unpaid, the more it costs.  
[What is the grace period on UAE credit cards?](#question-2 "question-2")  
Emirates NBD provides a 25-day grace period from the statement date. Under CBUAE regulations, no interest applies to purchase balances if the full amount is paid by the payment due date. Cash advances are excluded from the grace period and begin accruing interest immediately from the date of withdrawal.  
[Can annual fees be waived or negotiated?](#question-3 "question-3")  
Some Emirates NBD credit cards carry no annual fee at all, like the Emirates NBD noon One Visa Credit Card. For cards with an annual fee, first-year waivers are sometimes available, and ongoing waivers may apply when you meet a qualifying annual spend threshold. It's worth calling your relationship team to ask, as fee arrangements can vary. Note that once a card is activated, fees already charged are not typically reversed.  
[What happens if I pay only the minimum amount due?](#question-4 "question-4")

Understanding credit card fees in the UAE | Emirates NBD > Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

[What happens if I pay only the minimum amount due?](#question-4 "question-4")  
Paying the minimum keeps your account in good standing and avoids a late payment fee, but interest continues to accrue on the full outstanding balance from the transaction date. Over time, this significantly increases what you repay relative to the original purchases. It also slows down your progress against the principal, meaning the balance takes much longer to clear.  
[How do cashback caps and thresholds work?](#question-5 "question-5")  
Cashback cards often apply limits on how much you can earn per category, per merchant, or per month. For example, some cards cap earnings at a set AED amount per merchant per billing cycle, regardless of how much you spend there. Always read the card's specific terms to understand whether the headline cashback rate applies to all spending or just to qualifying categories up to a monthly ceiling.
