## FAQs  
[What if I just want an account and don’t want a banking package?](#faqs-what-if-i-just-want-an-account-and-do-not-want-a-banking-package "What if I just want an account and dont want a banking package")  
A banking package will always be assigned to you by default as this helps us provide you with services, pricing and offers that best suit your needs.  
[I have opened an account recently, but I don't know what banking package I have. How do I find out?](#faqs-i-have-opened-an-account-recently-but-ive-not-been-informed-about-my-banking-package "I have opened an account recently but I dont know what banking package I have. How do I find out")  
You can look up your banking package at any time on[Online Banking](https://online.emiratesnbd.com/) under **Settings > My profile**.  
[If my financial circumstances change, do I need to inform the bank to change my banking package?](#faqs-if-my-financial-circumstances-change-do-i-need-to-inform-the-bank-to-change-my-banking-package "If my financial circumstances change do I need to inform the bank to change my banking package")
title: Banking Packages Eligibility, Fees and FAQs | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Banking Packages Eligibility, Fees and FAQs | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

If your circumstances change, it's good for us to know, so we can assign you a package that suits your needs better. If we make any changes based on your salary transferred to your account or account balance, we’ll always notify you, so be sure to keep your[registered mobile number](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number) and [email address](/en/help-and-support/update-your-email-address)up to date on our records. If you feel your current banking package doesn't suit your needs, you can always let us know by calling [+971 600 54 0000](tel: +971 600 54 0000) and when prompted, say 'change banking package'.  
[If my minimum balance falls short, will I be charged a fee?](#faqs-if-my-minimum-balance-falls-short-will-i-be-charged-a-fee "If my minimum balance falls short will I be charged a fee")  
If you hold a payroll or salary transfer account with Emirates NBD, you don't need to maintain a minimum average monthly balance. If you don't have a payroll or salary transfer account with us, or if you hold a company account, then you need to maintain a monthly minimum balance based on your banking package. If you fall short of this balance, you will be charged a fee.  
The fees and charges for banking services are always determined by your banking package. To learn more [click here](/en/terms-and-conditions).

[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my account number?](#accordion-6c7a3152-a05d-4ef2-92d9-932ef2572a52 "Is it safe to share my account number")  
It’s generally safe to share your account number with trusted people and with the bank. Always avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. Rest assured the bank does not share this information with anyone. Read more [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/security).

Priority Banking Solutions | Priority Accounts | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

## What are people asking?  
[What solutions are offered under Emirates NBD Priority Banking?](#accordion-3c76ac54-0770-4cde-91e2-68a43c70f92d "What solutions are offered under Emirates NBD Priority Banking")  
Emirates NBD Priority Banking provides a comprehensive range of solutions, including accounts, deposits, credit cards, loans, wealth management, and insurance services. These offerings are designed to meet both everyday banking and long-term financial goals. Customers also benefit from lifestyle privileges and personalised advisory, making it a holistic financial solution for affluent individuals.  
[What is included in Priority Banking financial solutions?](#accordion-b103a531-d41a-4acd-b3ff-24e37797f684 "What is included in Priority Banking financial solutions")  
Priority Banking solutions typically include savings and current accounts, premium credit cards, lending options like personal loans and mortgages, and investment products. Emirates NBD enhances these with personalised advice, preferential rates, and access to exclusive opportunities, ensuring a well-rounded financial experience tailored to individual needs.  
[How does Priority Banking help manage wealth and investments?](#accordion-ce2b1086-61b3-4a7d-a1ae-9875b47e8185 "How does Priority Banking help manage wealth and investments")
title: Priority Banking Solutions | Priority Accounts | Emirates NBD

text:
Priority Banking Solutions | Priority Accounts | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

Priority Banking offers access to tailored wealth management services, including portfolio advisory, diversified investment products, and market insights. Emirates NBD supports clients in growing and preserving wealth through customised strategies aligned with their financial goals, risk appetite, and time horizon.  
[What types of lending solutions are available in Priority Banking?](#accordion-8a6b7937-0741-4e8a-8f07-c2a307726691 "What types of lending solutions are available in Priority Banking")  
Emirates NBD Priority Banking offers a range of lending solutions such as personal loans, home loans, and overdraft facilities. These come with preferential rates and flexible repayment options. The solutions are designed to support major financial decisions like property purchase, business expansion, or personal financing needs.  
[Are there exclusive cards available with Priority Banking solutions?](#accordion-b834e707-9ada-4151-8936-25d6aa934605 "Are there exclusive cards available with Priority Banking solutions")  
Yes, Priority Banking customers have access to premium credit and debit cards that offer enhanced rewards, travel benefits, airport lounge access, and lifestyle privileges. These cards are designed to complement the broader financial solutions and provide added convenience and value.

* Unlimited cheque books

text:
Priority Banking Solutions | Priority Accounts | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[What is a Demand Draft?](#accordion-9a389ef2-ac07-4165-b2ea-d84e0cba3912 "What is a Demand Draft")  
Demand draft is a process you can opt in order to transfer funds from your bank account to another account.  
[How do I apply for a Demand Draft?](#accordion-2cd6d939-149b-4d3c-b646-ea2fd01af7b3 "How do I apply for a Demand Draft")  
You can apply for a demand draft using any of the below channels:  
* Online Banking
* Phone Banking
* Emirates NBD Branches  
[What are the documents required to apply for a Demand Draft?](#accordion-7bab4826-4f38-4346-b858-b09ddcd320ab "What are the documents required to apply for a Demand Draft")  
You are required to submit a duly signed and filled Demand draft form.  
[Who should I contact if I have any complaints or queries related to my Demand Draft?](#accordion-760dc80a-e8af-47df-a7a5-31b248a68a27 "Who should I contact if I have any complaints or queries related to my Demand Draft")  
In case you have any query or complaint related to your Demand Draft, please contact our 24/7 customer service center at 600 540000 and enjoy friendly service with personal touch from our Phone Banking Officers.  
[Are there any charges for a Demand Draft?](#accordion-38a31bd7-f8df-461e-b15c-0011ae0702bd "Are there any charges for a Demand Draft")  
For information related to fees and charges, please [click here](/-/media/enbd/files/priority-banking/common-pdf/personal_banking_soc_poster.pdf)and refer to Emirates NBD's schedule of fees and charges.
title: Priority Banking Solutions | Priority Accounts | Emirates NBD

text:
Priority Banking Solutions | Priority Accounts | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[What is the maximum transaction amount that can be taken as Demand Draft?](#accordion-69ea2281-2622-451e-b3ee-4cca066f2fbf "What is the maximum transaction amount that can be taken as Demand Draft")  
You can transact up to 100,000 using our Demand draft facility.  
[Can I make an international transfer using Demand draft?](#accordion-b3221f18-bbc0-4641-ae5f-50141863e22f "Can I make an international transfer using Demand draft")  
Yes, Emirates NBD Demand draft feature is available for both local and international transfers.  
[How do I collect my Demand Draft/Cashier's order after I have made the purchase?](#accordion-b7893ee6-f308-4596-a9ae-c70e94ee0535 "How do I collect my Demand DraftCashiers order after I have made the purchase")  
You can visit your nearest Emirates NBD branch to receive your Demand draft, or to make it more convenient for you, we can send it to you via courier.  
[How long does it take to issue a Demand Draft?](#accordion-9dca7511-2991-48c5-8238-b40339de556a "How long does it take to issue a Demand Draft")  
You can receive your Demand draft within 3 working days from the date of request submission if you choose to obtain one using our Online banking or Phone banking. However, if you wish to receive your Demand draft immediately, please visit your nearest Emirates NBD branch.
title: Priority Banking Solutions | Priority Accounts | Emirates NBD

text:

The exchange rate on the date of transaction will be applicable on your purchase.  
[Is it mandatory for the beneficiary to bank with Emirates NBD in order to receive the Demand Draft?](#accordion-02ba256d-b731-4bcf-b2b2-1500c4323846 "Is it mandatory for the beneficiary to bank with Emirates NBD in order to receive the Demand Draft")  
No, the beneficiary is not necessarily required to be an Emirates NBD customer.

**Eligibility criteria**  
Any entity with UAE National shareholders (whether individual, company or a combination of both) holding 25% or more of the shareholding, either singly and/or jointly, would be eligible for the Emirati Business package.  
However, an entity will not be eligible where a UAE National individual holds exactly 51% of the shares in the said entity but is not a signatory of the said entity.

\*What is LTV?

![A finance professional sending a digital invoice from a laptop in a Dubai office](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/e-invoice/einvoicing-hero-mobile.jpg)  
##### e-Invoicing  
# Getting ready for e-Invoicing in the UAE  
The UAE is introducing mandatory e-Invoicing for businesses. Here is what it means, how it is being rolled out, and what EmiratesNBD needs from you so your invoices keep reaching you.  
##### The essentials  
## What is an e-Invoice?  
An e-Invoice is a structured, machine readable invoice that is created, sent and received in a standard digital format, and exchanged directly between the supplier and buyer systems. It is not a PDF, a scanned copy or an email attachment. In the UAE, e-Invoices are exchanged through the global Peppol network, so your invoice data moves securely between businesses and the required details are reported to the Federal Tax Authority.  
[Click here for Emirates NBD Customer FAQs](#faqsc "Know More")
[Click here for Emirates NBD Suppliers FAQs](#faqss "Know More")  
![How an e-Invoice moves between business systems](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/e-invoice/einvoicing-flow.jpg)
title: e-Invoicing in the UAE | Emirates NBD

text:
e-Invoicing in the UAE | Emirates NBD > How e-Invoicing is becoming mandatory

### How e-Invoicing is becoming mandatory  
In September 2025 the UAE Ministry of Finance issued Ministerial Decisions 243 and 244 of 2025, which set out the e-Invoicing framework and the timeline for rolling it out. The VAT legislation has been updated so that, once your business goes live, the e-Invoice becomes your legal tax invoice.  
The UAE has adopted a decentralised, five corner model built on the global Peppol network. Every business appoints an Accredited Service Provider, which validates each invoice, exchanges it with your customer's provider over Peppol, and reports the required data to the Federal Tax Authority, in near real time.  
The mandate applies to business to business (B2B) and business to government (B2G) transactions. Business to consumer (B2C) transactions are outside the mandate for now.

Taxpayers that have registered with the Federal Tax Authority (FTA) for any tax type, either for Value Added Tax (VAT) or corporate tax, will have been issued a TIN. TIN is the first 10 digits of the Tax Registration Number (TRN) that you have been issued.  
In the case of a tax group, TIN is the first 10 digits of your own standalone company TRN and not the first 10 digits of the tax group's TRN.  
##  
No. Additionally, a TIN and VAT TRN do not always have the same first 10 digits.  
A VAT TRN is a 15-digit tax registration number issued by the FTA to each taxpayer on a standalone basis. If the taxpayer subsequently registers as part of a VAT group the FTA will issue an additional VAT TRN for the group. The first 10 digits of the standalone VAT TRN and the VAT group TRN differs. Therefore, to the extent that you are part of a tax group, your group TRN is not the same as your TIN.  
For e-Invoicing, the TIN of your own standalone entity is required and not the first 10 digits of the tax group TRN.

### Bridge Financing  
We help you identify and utilize the best bridge finance opportunity for your situation while allowing you to continue operating before a loan, debt or equity capital markets take-out takes place.  
This:  
* Enables clients to negotiate better commercial terms for the long-term take-out, in whichever format it may be
* Addresses the short-term funding requirements
* Eliminates the timing risk when it comes to public market issuances

## Membership eligibility  
To qualify for the **VIP Privilege Programme**, customers need to earn at least **100,000 points** in the last 12 months with **Emirates NBD Business Banking**.

text:
VIP Privilege | Emirates NBD > **Points earning** Customers can earn points through eligible account balances and transactions, as shown below.

### **Points earning** Customers can earn points through eligible account balances and transactions, as shown below.  
- How to earn points: **Increase your balances**   Earn 1 point for every 1,000; Product/service: Business Current and Call Accounts (CASA); Basis for calculation: Average monthly account balance
- How to earn points: Business Fixed Deposit (FD) ccounts; Product/service: Average monthly fixed deposit balance
- How to earn points: Wealth management and investment products; Product/service: Month-end balance in the wealth or investment account.
- How to earn points: All loan products; Product/service: Average outstanding loan amount during the applicable calculation period.  
**and/or**  
- How to earn points: **Increase your transactions**   Earn 1 point for every 250; Product/service: Foreign Exchange (FX); Basis for calculation: Eligible FX transfers and gold or silver buy/sell transactions where the transaction currency differs from the source account currency.
- How to earn points: Trade Finance; Product/service: Eligible Trade Finance transactions

## Getting started  
[What is Sheikh Zayed Housing programme(SZHP)?](#accordion-c90ddc54-8552-4ea6-ab35-cee9bc57cdd6 "What is Sheikh Zayed Housing programmeSZHP")  
The Sheikh Zayed Housing Program is a government initiative aimed at providing affordable housing solutions to eligible customers.  
[Who is eligible for a home loan under this programme?](#accordion-5a0f0ba4-e51d-471c-b594-86ce6e76d454 "Who is eligible for a home loan under this programme")  
The programme is exclusive for UAE Nationals as per the list that SZHP provides to Emirates NBD.  
[What are the benefits of obtaining a home loan through Emirates NBD under this programme?](#accordion-b956a594-ee80-4fba-be14-1f628f2ca9a4 "What are the benefits of obtaining a home loan through Emirates NBD under this programme")  
Emirates NBD offers interest free for maximum finance amount of 800,000 and competitive interest rates flexible repayment options and personalized assistance throughout the loan process.  
[Do I have to transfer my salary to Emirates NBD to apply?](#accordion-a5b365c5-572b-4df0-907b-52d744fdfa56 "Do I have to transfer my salary to Emirates NBD to apply")  
No, a salary transfer is not mandatory. However, you are encouraged to transfer your salary to Emirates NBD if you intend to avail other benefits, we offer to the UAE national segment.  
[What loan finance is available?](#accordion-3738b252-dfa5-40a5-b54c-660879e8c299 "What loan finance is available")
title: Sheikh Zayed Housing Programme (SZHP) Offers on Home Loans | Emirates NBD

text:
Sheikh Zayed Housing Programme (SZHP) Offers on Home Loans | Emirates NBD > Getting started

[What loan finance is available?](#accordion-3738b252-dfa5-40a5-b54c-660879e8c299 "What loan finance is available")  
The maximum home finance amount available is 800,000 (interest free - at an interest rate subsidized by SZHP). If you require an additional finance amount, subject to your eligibility, the financing will be provided based on a special competitive commercial rate.  
[What is the loan tenor available for home loan under this programme?](#accordion-1af14c91-b82d-41a3-9ee3-9b45eb6e6903 "What is the loan tenor available for home loan under this programme")  
The maximum finance tenor is 25 years.  
[At what rate is the financing provided?](#accordion-e34ecc33-574e-479c-bebd-ae3755cd38e4 "At what rate is the financing provided")  
The financing of the 800,000 amount is interest free for the customer. Any additional amount required will be given back on your eligibility and on a special competitive commercial rate.  
[What type of properties can be financed under this programme?](#accordion-9a7b43d7-e718-40cf-8dbf-d859fc655c61 "What type of properties can be financed under this programme")  
Financing is provided for both self-construction and ready property projects as follows:  
* Ready property finance – developed by SZHP
* Ready property finance – developer or secondary market in the UAE
* Self-construction finance – on own or gifted plot

text:
Local Outward Remittance Complaint | Emirates NBD > Before you start

## Before you start  
* You’ll be asked security questions, so we can make sure that it’s you. Be prepared with your **[account number](/en/help-and-support/view-your-account-details-and-transactions)** and [**registered mobile number**](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number).
* Please keep your **transfer details** at hand to complete this form.
* While we’re committed to resolving your service request as quickly as possible, if your request involves other banks and institutions, it can take up to 15 working days for local transfers and up to 19 working days or more for international.  
**Local transfers:** AED transfer requests received before 6 pm and requests in other currencies received before 2 pm, Monday to Saturday will be processed the same working day. Transfers made after these times will be processed the next working day.  
Your transfers on time are subject to availability of funds and accuracy of details.  
There may be times when the transfer may take slightly longer. Please find more information about this [here](/en/help-and-support/help-with-transfers-and-payments).

Block your card | Support | Emirates NBD > Temporary lock or permanent block?

## Temporary lock or permanent block?  
Whether you should lock your card temporarily and unblock it later, or permanently block and replace your card, depends on the situation.  
If you can’t find your card, it’s best that you put a temporary lock on it immediately until you find it. This will protect your card until you can unblock it. You can temporarily lock and unlock your card in a few easy steps using [Online Banking](https://online.emiratesnbd.com/)or [Mobile Banking](/en/ways-of-banking/enbd-x).  
**Temporary locking your card will stop the below transactions:**  
* Online and in-store shopping
* Cash withdrawals
* Card Contactless payments
* Wallet based payments (Apple Pay, Google pay etc.)
* All debit and credit card subscriptions  
But if your card is lost, or if you suspect it has been compromised, you should permanently block it immediately and ask for a replacement.  
**Permanently blocking your card under Lost/Stolen will stop the below transactions:**  
* Online and in-store shopping
* Cash withdrawals
* Contactless payments using physical card
* Temporarily suspend Wallet based payments (Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, Google Pay etc.). Once the replacement card is activated, wallet-based payments will get resumed
* All debit and credit card subscriptions  
If you suspect that the card details are compromised or suspected wallet is created, then the card should be blocked under “**FRAUD**”. This will ensure all transactions on the card/wallets are stopped.

## FAQs  
[Do I need my PIN to request a replacement card by phone?](#faqs-do-i-need-my-pin-to-request-a-replacement-card-by-phone "Do I need my PIN to request a replacement card by phone")  
Yes, you do. If you’re not PIN verified when you call us, our customer service agent will direct you to the card replacement option where you'll be asked to enter your [registered mobile number](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number)and PIN for verification. If you’ve forgotten your PIN, you can [reset it](/en/help-and-support/reset-your-card-pin)at any time.  
If you can't reset your PIN, please visit your [nearest Emirates NBD branch](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/branches-and-atms)and we'll help. Bring your passport or Emirates ID for identification.  
[Is it possible to temporarily block and then unblock my card?](#faqs-is-it-possible-to-temporarily-block-and-then-unblock-my-card "Is it possible to temporarily block and then unblock my card")
title: Block your card | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Block your card | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

Yes, you can block a debit or credit card temporarily through [Online Banking](https://online.emiratesnbd.com/) or [Mobile Banking](/en/ways-of-banking/enbd-x). Just select **Temporary Block**as the reason for blocking the card. You can unblock your card the same way by selecting **Unblock this card**. If your card is temporarily blocked by Emirates NBD’s security team, you can’t unblock the cards through Online or Mobile banking. You’ll need to call [+971 600 54 0000](tel:971600540000) and when prompted say, ‘unblock card’. You'll know if your card was blocked by us as you'll receive an SMS informing you.  
[How long will a temporary block remain on my card?](#faqs-how-long-will-a-temporary-block-remain-on-my-card "How long will a temporary block remain on my card")  
The temporary block will remain in place until you unblock the card or report it lost or stolen, and you can then choose to request a replacement card.  
[If I block my debit card, will my direct debits and standing orders from my account be stopped?](#faqs-if-i-block-my-debit-card-will-my-direct-debits-and-standing-orders-from-my-account-be-stopped "If I block my debit card will my direct debits and standing orders from my account be stopped")  
No, direct debits and standing orders from your account will not be affected.  
[Can I withdraw cash using a blocked card?](#faqs-can-i-withdraw-cash-using-a-blocked-card "Can I withdraw cash using a blocked card")
title: Block your card | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Block your card | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

[Can I withdraw cash using a blocked card?](#faqs-can-i-withdraw-cash-using-a-blocked-card "Can I withdraw cash using a blocked card")  
No, you can’t withdraw cash using a blocked card, but you can always visit [your nearest branch](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/branches-and-atms) to make a withdrawal. Make sure you’re carrying your passport or Emirates ID and we’ll be happy to help.  
[I’m not sure if my card is misplaced, lost or stolen. What should I do?](#faqs-im-not-sure-if-my-card-is-misplaced-lost-or-stolen-what-should-i-do "Im not sure if my card is misplaced lost or stolen. What should I do")  
You should immediately log in to [Online Banking](https://online.emiratesnbd.com/) or [Mobile Banking](/en/ways-of-banking/enbd-x)and temporarily block the card. You can also call us on [+971 600 54 0000](tel:971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘lost or stolen card’. Please note, if you call us, we’ll cancel and replace your card with a new one that has a new card number. You should do this only if you’ve lost the card or if it’s been stolen. But if you feel you may find the card, just temporarily block it so you can unblock it later. If you fail to find the card, you can proceed to [block and replace it](/en/help-and-support/block-your-card).

### Key Fact Statement (KFS) – Current and Savings Account  
This product is a bank account for your transaction and savings needs. This KFS provides you with key product features, indicative information about the product and applicable profit, fee, and charges.  
#### Product Information  
- Product description: **Shariah basis**; Current Account   An interest free loan given by you to the Bank and is available for withdrawal at all times: **Qard Hasan** (Interest-free loan); Savings Account (Mudaraba)  A profit-sharing partnership contract between, you as a capital provider (Rab-ul-Mal) , and the Bank as a fund manager (Mudareb) , in a joint investment.: **Mudaraba**; Savings Account (Wakala)  An agreement where you authorise the Bank as your Wakil “agent”, to invest your funds in Shariah approved activities for profit.: **Wakala**
- Product description: **Applicable for**; Current Account   An interest free loan given by you to the Bank and is available for withdrawal at all times: UAE residents; Savings Account (Mudaraba)  A profit-sharing partnership contract between, you as a capital provider (Rab-ul-Mal) , and the Bank as a fund manager (Mudareb) , in a joint investment.: UAE residents and non-residents and minors; Savings Account (Wakala)  An agreement where you authorise the Bank as your Wakil “agent”, to invest your funds in Shariah approved activities for profit.: UAE residents and non-residents

text:
Special Current Account in the UAE | Emirates NBD > Requirements and documents for opening an account

## Requirements and documents for opening an account  
[UAE Nationals](#accordion-4e8ea425-8489-4955-91be-e62d66020740 "UAE Nationals")  
* **Identification**
+ Original Emirates ID and copy
+ Copy of passport
* **In case of a salary transfer account, we’ll need one of the following documents:**
+ Copy of Labor Card
+ Copy of Employee ID
+ Latest salary letter
+ Copy of employment visa page from passport  
[Expats](#accordion-ea69a286-0898-4ae7-8453-0fca3d2cd36e "Expats")  
* **Identification**
+ Original Emirates ID and copy
+ Copy of passport
* **In case of a salary transfer account, we’ll need one of the following documents:**
+ Salary transfer letter (not more than 30 days from date of issue for non-government companies. For government companies, validity as mentioned in the letter.)
+ Copy of appointment letter or contract
+ Copy of payslip (less than months old)
+ Statement with previous month’s salary
+ **For bulk accounts:** consolidated letter from HR (with salary of each employee mentioned)  
[Non-residents](#accordion-417239bb-2ae1-4dd1-b62e-e0208fb88b52 "Nonresidents")  
* **Passport and copy with visa page and one of the following documents:**
+ Utility bill (not more than 3 months old)
+ Bank statements (not more than 3 months old, you can print these off Online Banking too)

+ Utility bill (not more than 3 months old)

+ UAE National ID
+ Labour Card and copy
+ Work Permit and copy
+ Letter from employer
+ Copy of recent telephone or electricity bill (not more than 3 months old)
+ Tenancy contract in your name

* Memorandum of association (MOA)
* Board resolution

Our industry knowledge and regional expertise are here to support your business as it realizes new possibilities.  
![Promo  Financial Institutions](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/dedicated-coverage/financial-institution_1920x1080.jpg?la=en&h=1080&w=1920&hash=E57D2012CFF16C2E70A790B0476B8F68)

We serve banks, Sovereigns, Multilaterals, NBFIs, Insurance Companies, broker houses, exchange houses and payment service providers. We work with government related entities and government related departments including public power utilities, transportation and mass transit agencies, airports, seaports and more. As a banking partner for government, we’re committed to establishing long-term partnerships with all public sector agencies.

text:
Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD > What you need to know

## What you need to know  
All transfers and payments are reliable, secure and fast with Emirates NBD. You can pay or transfer money to anyone or to any business internationally or locally in any of the world’s major currencies.  
**You need the following information to make a transfer or payment:**  
* Your beneficiary's name
* Beneficiary's International Bank Account Number (IBAN)
* Beneficiary's SWIFT (also known as MT103), BIC (unique Bank Identifier Code), Routing Number
* If an IBAN not available, you must know the beneficiary's account number
* A suitable ‘purpose of payment’
title: Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD > Charges

## Charges  
While making a transfer, you can set charges to one the following:  
**BEN**- The beneficiary incurs all the payment transaction fees  
**SHA**- Charges are shared, the payer pays the fees to send, and the beneficiary pays their fees to receive  
**OUR** -The payer will bear all the payment transaction fees
title: Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD > Worried about the status of your transfer?

## Worried about the status of your transfer?  
When you place a transfer request, we process it and send it to your recipient’s bank which will credit your recipient’s account with the money you have transferred.  
The time at which your transfer is processed will depend on when you’ve placed your request:  
* **AED local transfers:** Requests placed before 6pm UAE time (Monday to Saturday) will be processed on the same working day. Otherwise, they will be processed the next working day.
* **Foreign currency local and international transfers:** Requests placed before 2pm UAE time (Monday to Saturday) will be processed the same working day subject to availability of funds. Otherwise, they will be processed the next working day.  
It usually takes 1 working day for local transfers and 2 to 3 working days for international transfers to be credited to your recipient’s account. However, there may be times when it may take slightly longer for the following reasons:  
* Certain banks and payment service providers don’t process transfers during weekends or bank holidays.
* There might be a discrepancy in the recipient’s account details such as the name or account number. This will result in the funds being returned to your account within 2 working days once the funds have been transferred by the correspondent bank.
* Banks and payment service providers are required to run regulatory checks on transfers which could cause a delay.
title: Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD
section: Worried about the status of your transfer?

text:
Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD > Is your DirectRemit transfer or payment taking longer than usual?

## Is your DirectRemit transfer or payment taking longer than usual?  
Even though it's uncommon, there may be times when your transfer could take longer than normal to reach your receiver. Please be aware of these situations:  
* Each of our DirectRemit countries has its own processing and crediting schedules. These vary depending on the country and bank to which you are transferring. Any transactions initiated after processing hours will be credited to your recipient the next business day.
* During holidays some banks and payment systems do not execute transfers.
* To comply with regulations, all banks and payment service providers are required to conduct checks on your payments and this may sometimes result in delays.
* If the recipient bank discovers a discrepancy between the account data you provided, such as the name or account number, the transfer will be returned to your Emirates NBD account within 2 working days once the funds have been transferred by the partner or correspondent bank.  
In rare cases, we may request extra information to execute your DirectRemit transfer. If this happens, your transfer will be changed to a SWIFT international transfer. You’ll be alerted before you submit your request. International transfers will be credited to your recipient in 2 to 3 business days.
title: Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD
section: Is your DirectRemit transfer or payment taking longer than usual?

text:
Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD > Was your payment successful?

## Was your payment successful?  
A payment is completed in two steps:  
* Once you submit a payment request, it is processed and sent to the service provider
* The service provider then credits it to your beneficiary  
Since our systems are directly linked to service providers, your payment is usually completed instantly. If your payment is delayed, it could be due to one of the following reasons:  
* **A technical issue has occurred:** In this case, your payment will take up to 24 hours to get credited.
* **The payment details are incorrect**: You will need to contact your service provider and give them the correct payment details.

text:
Need help with transfers and payments | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[What’s the difference between an e-advice and a SWIFT Payment copy?](#faqs-what-is-the-difference-between-an-e-advice-and-a-swift-payment-copy "Whats the difference between an eadvice and a SWIFT Payment copy")  
A SWIFT Payment copy, otherwise known as an MT103, is a standardised payment message used between banks specifically for foreign currency or cross border or international transfers. An e-advice, on the other hand, is a proof of payment generated every time you submit a local or international transfer request and can be instantly retrieved via Online Banking.  
While both these payment messages include these transfer details, some banks won’t accept an e-advice:  
* Your name and account details
* Your recipient’s name and account details
* Date the transfer was made
* Transfer currency and amount

# ICCS Collect from businessONLINE  
## Digitally scan and deposit cheques seamlessly from your office or premises using a special cheque scanning device  
Enjoy complete peace of mind with added convenience for all your cheque deposits. businessONLINE’s ICCS collect allows you to digitally scan and deposit cheques from your office or premises using a special cheque scanning device. With ICCS Collect, simply clear current and post-dated cheques online. Once cleared, you can use our integrated courier pickup service to submit the cleared cheques to the bank.  
businessONLINE’s ICCS Collect is regulated by the Central Bank of UAE and follows all consumer protection and security guidelines.  
#### Why ICCS Collect?

cheques to the bank.

# Terms & Conditions  
## Emirates NBD Debit Cards Spend Activation Campaign – Taxi MCC  
**Promotion Period:**  1st May to 31st May 2023  
**Applicable for:**  Selected Emirates NBD PSB Visa Debit Cardholders  
**Qualifying Customer:**  
* This promotion is open only to preselected Emirates NBD Visa Debit Cardholders (“Cardholders/ Cardholder”)
* The eligible Cardholders will receive specific communication from the Bank through SMS, e-mail, online popup, mobile pop up or ATM communication, with respect to the specific promotion period. Enrollment rights are reserved and solely determined by the bank.  
**Qualifying Criteria and Reward Details:**  
* To qualify cardholders will have to make a minimum spend of 200 for Taxi transactions on their debit card during campaign period.
* Cardholders should also register/opt in to be eligible for the promotion. Customer can opt in through ATM/Email/Mobile and Online Banking or by sending SMS “TAXI” to 4456 from the mobile number registered with Emirates NBD.
* The first 500 customers to achieve the minimum spend of 200 will qualify to receive 25 cashback.
* Transactions done only at local taxi merchants – DUBAI TAXI, NATIONAL TAXI, ARABIA TAXI, CARS TAXI, METRO TAXI, EMIRATES TAXI, will be considered for the eligible spends.
* Ride hailing App (Hala/Careem, UBER) transactions are excluded from the qualifying spends.

Loans in Dubai and UAE | Apply for a Loan Online | Emirates NBD > Easy top-up

### Easy top-up  
Get additional funds easily with our loan top-ups  
[Where can I find more information about Emirates NBD loans?](#accordion-cbdb711d-55fe-42b1-a24a-94b80391b6cb "Where can I find more information about Emirates NBD loans")  
You’ll find detailed information about our personal, auto and home loans on this page: <https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/loans>.  
[Who can apply for Emirates NBD loans in the UAE?](#accordion-fac5cbc4-c55b-4c66-81cd-f394bf8a7772 "Who can apply for Emirates NBD loans in the UAE")  
UAE citizens and residents over the age of 21, and business owners can apply for loans based on employment profile, income and nature of business. All applications are subject to eligibility and terms and conditions. Learn more [here](/en/help-and-support).  
[What documents do I need to apply for a loan?](#accordion-3c98cf08-a29d-4a62-98ca-5626442b9187 "What documents do I need to apply for a loan")  
The documents required depend on the loan you choose and your profile. You’ll need identification documents such as your passport or Emirates ID, income or business proof and property or vehicle documents. You will also need to fill in forms needed for assessment. Check our [loans page online](/en/help-and-support/apply-for-a-personal-loan) for more details before you apply.  
[How can I apply for a loan online?](#accordion-c9976246-e19b-4ca8-8e99-7ab18207f38d "How can I apply for a loan online")
title: Loans in Dubai and UAE | Apply for a Loan Online | Emirates NBD

text:
Loans in Dubai and UAE | Apply for a Loan Online | Emirates NBD > Easy top-up

[How can I apply for a loan online?](#accordion-c9976246-e19b-4ca8-8e99-7ab18207f38d "How can I apply for a loan online")  
Visit [our loans page](/en/loans), choose the loan you want and click on ‘Apply now’. Make sure you review the eligibility and documents needed before you start so you have everything you need ready and can apply smoothly.  
[Where can I find details about fees and charges for Emirates NBD loans?](#accordion-f8861400-f5b2-400b-b3b4-9c8095ef6561 "Where can I find details about fees and charges for Emirates NBD loans")  
You can read our loans [Key Facts Statement](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/enbd/files/pdf/kfs_personal_loan_fixed_interest_rate.pdf) for details about fees and charges. Eligibility requirements and documents needed are on our website [here](/en/help-and-support/apply-for-a-personal-loan).  
[How can I get help with my existing loan?](#accordion-df62d552-7b59-44f5-abc4-8a6c40db530a "How can I get help with my existing loan")  
If you already have a loan with us, we can support you with restructuring of your loan, top-ups, payment deferrals, setting up direct debits and liability-related requests based on your changing needs.  
Explore our [Support Centre](/en/help-and-support/contact-us) for help articles on loans – simply type ‘loans’ into the search bar to see a list of articles. If you need to contact us, use the information [here](/en/help-and-support/contact-us).

text:
Loans in Dubai and UAE | Apply for a Loan Online | Emirates NBD > Easy top-up

[How do I know if an Emirates NBD personal loan is the right option for me?](#accordion-d9249bb5-e50f-4594-b843-6d3d676e13b5 "How do I know if an Emirates NBD personal loan is the right option for me")  
Our personal loans may be suitable options when you need flexibility, and your borrowing is not linked to a specific need such as a car or property purchase. Before you apply, consider how much you need to borrow your monthly budget and the repayment period that works for you. Make sure you review the features, eligibility criteria, fees as well as terms to help you make an informed decision. Learn more [here](/en/loans/personal-loans).  
[I’ve decided to apply for an Emirates NBD personal loan. What should I do next?](#accordion-e906d9e7-471a-41f2-9165-1cb298c56d50 "Ive decided to apply for an Emirates NBD personal loan. What should I do next")  
Once you’ve decided on the type of loan you want, you should review our loans [Key Facts Statement](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/enbd/files/pdf/kfs_personal_loan_fixed_interest_rate.pdf)to know more about fees, charges and eligibility as well as documents required to apply. If you match all the eligibility criteria and agree to the terms and conditions, then go ahead and apply online [here](/en/loans/personal-loans) or through the ENBD X app.  
[Where can I find more information about Emirates NBD loans?](#accordion-cbdb711d-55fe-42b1-a24a-94b80391b6cb "Where can I find more information about Emirates NBD loans")

# Automatic Exchange of Information – FATCA & CRS  
##  
**Automatic Exchange of Information**  
The Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) and the Common Reporting Standard (CRS) are two international tax agreements that require financial institutions to provide information about their foreign account holders to their respective tax authorities in order to combat tax evasion.  
**FATCA – Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act**  
The United States enacted FATCA in 2010, requiring financial institutions to submit information on their U.S. account holders to the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) . The account holder's name, address, taxpayer identification number, and account balance must all be provided.  
FATCA applies to all financial institutions globally, and noncompliant financial institutions may face penalties. FATCA has been shown to be effective in increasing the amount of tax income received by the IRS while also discouraging tax evasion by US citizens and residents.  
**CRS – Common Reporting Standard**

text:
FATCA & CRS - Terms and Conditions | Emirates NBD > Automatic Exchange of Information – FATCA & CRS

**CRS – Common Reporting Standard**  
CRSwas created in 2014 by the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) and is based on FATCA principles. Financial institutions are required by CRS to provide information on their account holders to the tax authorities in the country where the account holder resides. The account holder's name, address, taxpayer identification number, and account balance must all be provided. CRS is used by financial institutions in over 100 countries and has been shown to increase tax revenue collected by tax authorities globally.CRS has also aided in the prevention of tax evasion by individuals and corporations with foreign accounts.  
**What is the difference****?**  
The main difference between FATCA and CRS is that FATCA is a unilateral agreement between the United States and other nations, whereas CRS is a multilateral agreement between the OECD and its member countries. This means that FATCA exclusively applies to US account holders, whereas CRS applies to all nations that have signed the agreement.  
For further information on FATCA – please visit IRS [**website**](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/corporations/foreign-account-tax-compliance-act-fatca)  
For further information on CRS – please visit OECD [**website**](https://www.oecd.org/tax/exchange-of-tax-information/)

![growyourwealth](/-/media/enbd/images/accounts/savings-deposit-account_banner.jpg?la=en&h=1500&w=2000&hash=680D66BDDECBC6DC8E05CDF164BBD306)  
#####  
Leaving your money in a low-yield account isn't a neutral choice; it's a quiet cost. With interest rates in the UAE still at meaningful levels, picking the right savings account can add hundreds of dirhams to your balance each year without any extra effort on your part. Whether you're building your first emergency fund or looking to get more from cash you're already setting aside, this article walks you through the rates, the accounts and the steps to get started.  
Your cash is working either way. The question is how hard you're making it work. There's a version of saving where you park money in an account, forget it's there and collect a negligible return. Then there's a version where you choose a savings account with a competitive interest rate, let it compound month after month and watch a meaningful sum build up over time. The difference between those two outcomes often comes down to one decision: what kind of account you’ve opened.

Best Savings Account Rates | Grow Your Wealth | Emirates NBD > Grow Your Wealth: Finding The Highest Interest Rate Savings Account

In the UAE, where central bank rates have been elevated since 2022 and banks are competing for deposits, the gap between the lowest and highest interest rate savings accounts is significant. Understanding what drives that gap, and knowing which features to look for, puts you firmly in control.

text:
Best Savings Account Rates | Grow Your Wealth | Emirates NBD > What is a savings account?

## What is a savings account?  
A savings account is a deposit account that keeps your money safe while paying you interest on the balance you hold. Unlike a current account, which is designed for day-to-day transactions, a savings account encourages you to leave funds untouched, rewarding you for doing so with regular interest payments.  
Your principal is protected. The money you deposit doesn't decrease simply because you hold it in the account. Interest typically accrues on your daily closing balance and is credited monthly, meaning the longer your money sits, the more it earns.  
To put that in practical terms: 10,000 held at 4% per year earns 400 in interest over 12 months, with no risk to the original sum.  
Most savings accounts in the UAE do carry a minimum balance requirement. At Emirates NBD, for example, a fall-below fee of 26.25 per month applies if your monthly average balance drops below 3,000.
title: Best Savings Account Rates | Grow Your Wealth | Emirates NBD

text:
Best Savings Account Rates | Grow Your Wealth | Emirates NBD > How savings account interest rates are set

## How savings account interest rates are set  
The rate you earn on a savings account doesn't appear from nowhere. In the UAE, bank deposit rates are closely linked to the Central Bank of the UAE's base rate, which is itself pegged to the US Federal Reserve rate. When the Fed cuts rates, the CBUAE typically follows, and savings rates across the market soften as a result. The CBUAE cut its base rate to 3.90% in October 2025 and then to 3.65% in December 2025, following Fed reductions.  
Most savings accounts use a variable rate structure, which means your return can change without notice. Tiered rates add another layer; the more you deposit, the higher your rate of return.  
**A typical structure works like this:**  
* Tier 1 (e.g., 0 to 49,999): base rate applies
* Tier 2 (e.g., 50,000 to 499,999): mid- rate applies
* Tier 3 (e.g., 500,000 and above): top rate applies  
Compounding frequency also matters. Interest credited monthly compounds faster than interest credited quarterly, because each credit becomes part of the balance that earns the next month's interest.

## Choosing the best bank for a savings account  
The best bank for a savings account isn't purely about the headline rate being offered. A 4% account that reverts to 1% after three months may deliver less than a steady 2.5% account over a full year.  
**Here are the factors worth weighing:**  
* **Rate longevity:** Is the rate promotional or ongoing? Check when it expires and what the reversion rate is.
* **Fees and minimums:** Fall-below fees erode returns if your balance dips. Know the threshold before you open.
* **Digital access:** Can you open the account, monitor itand move money through an app? Emirates NBD's ENBD X app covers all of this, giving you access to your savings from wherever you are.
* **Shari'a** **compliance:** If you prefer a Shari'a-compliant products, the Emirates Islamic e-Savings (Wakala-based) and Kunooz (Mudaraba-based) is designed for you, offering profit rates rather than interest.
* **Prize and reward features:** The Emirates NBD Millionaire Savings Account runs until 31 August 2026 with an 57 million total prize pool and 28 guaranteed millionaires, offering an incentive that no interest rate alone can match.
* **Branch and ATM network:** Emirates NBD has multiple branches, ATMs and CDMs across the UAE, easily accessible when you need in-person support.

Best Savings Account Rates | Grow Your Wealth | Emirates NBD > Opening a high-interest savings account: Step-by-step

## Opening a high-interest savings account: Step-by-step  
Most UAE banks now offer fully digital account opening, so the process takes minutes rather than days. Follow these five steps:  
1. **Gather your documents:** You'll typically need your Emirates ID and proof of residence. Some accounts may also ask for a salary certificate or bank statement. Emirates NBD's account terms require you to keep your documents current at all times.
2. **Compare rates:** Confirm the latest figures on the bank's website. Pay attention to promotional end dates and reversion rates.
3. **Apply online or via the app:** Emirates NBD customers can open a savings account through the ENBD X app.
4. **Fund the account:** Transfer your opening deposit as soon as the account is live. Many tiered accounts only start earning at the higher rate once you meet the relevant balance threshold, so aim to hit it on day one.
5. **Set up automatic transfers:** Schedule a standing order on payday so that a fixed amount moves into your savings account each month before you can spend it.

## Smart ways to grow your savings faster  
The account you choose creates the opportunity to grow smartly:  
* **Automate on payday.** Set a standing order to transfer a fixed sum the day your salary arrives. Saving what's left over at the end of the month rarely works. Saving before you spend almost always does.
* **Use tiers strategically.** If your account offers a higher rate above a certain balance, treat that threshold as a target. The Emirates NBD Family Savings Account pools balances across family members, which is a natural way to reach the top tier without each person needing a large individual sum. The Plus Saver Account works on the same principle, with tiered ongoing rates that rise as your balance grows.
* **Review your rate every quarter.** Savings rates move with the market. A rate that was competitive in January may look modest by April. Set a calendar reminder to compare your current rate against the best available, and switch if the difference justifies it.
* **Combine rewards where you can.** The Emirates NBD Millionaire Savings Account adds draw entries for every 10,000 you hold, tracked through the ENBD X app. Pairing a high-yield account with a prize-linked account lets you pursue both returns and rewards simultaneously.
* **Stay above your minimum balance.** A fall-below fee and a lower interest rate together can turn a month of low balances into a costly one. Keep a buffer above the threshold as your default.

Best Savings Account Rates | Grow Your Wealth | Emirates NBD > Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)  
[Are savings account interest rates guaranteed?](#faqs-what-is-an-itm "What is an ITM")  
Most savings account rates in the UAE are variable, meaning they can change as the CBUAE adjusts its base rate. Banks fix promotional rates for a stated period, but these rates revert to standard tiered rates once the promotion ends. Always check the reversion rate, not just the headline figure.  
[How often does the bank pay out interest?](#faqs-what-is-the-maximum-amount-for-a-transaction-via-itm "Whats the maximum amount for a transaction via ITM")  
It depends on the account. For instance, the Emirates NBD Plus Saver Account calculates interest on daily closing balances and credits it monthly. If you hold an Emirates Islamic account, the bank distributes profit on a calendar-quarterly basis.  
[Can I open multiple savings accounts?](#faqs-do-you-require-any-documents-from-customer-for-performing-transactions-over-itm "Do you require any documents from customer for performing transactions over ITM")  
Yes, you can hold more than one savings account, even with the same bank, and use each one for a different goal — an emergency fund, a holiday pot, or a longer-term target.  
[Will withdrawing money reduce my interest?](#faqs-what-are-the-itm-service-operating-timings "What are the ITM service operating timings")
title: Best Savings Account Rates | Grow Your Wealth | Emirates NBD

text:
Best Savings Account Rates | Grow Your Wealth | Emirates NBD > Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

[Will withdrawing money reduce my interest?](#faqs-what-are-the-itm-service-operating-timings "What are the ITM service operating timings")  
It can. For instance, with the Emirates NBD Plus Saver Account, you are permitted up to five withdrawals per month. Exceeding that limit may affect the interest applied for that month, calculated at the rate of 0.25% p.a. Check your account's withdrawal conditions before moving funds.  
[How does a tiered savings account actually work?](#faqs-what-kind-of-services-itm-can-provide "What kind of services ITM can provide")  
A tiered savings account rewards you by offering a higher interest rate as your savings balance grows. However, the higher rate applies to your entire balance, not just the portion above a threshold.

Skywards Infinite Credit Card: Earn Miles and Travel More | Emirates NBD > Looking for something different?

SKYWARDS MILES
Now your spends are your ticket tomore travels  
**Maximum eligible spends**  
In a given statement cycle, Miles can be earned for eligible spends up to the credit limit, or 100,000 for Skywards Infinite Card / 50,000 for Skywards Signature Card, whichever is lower. Miles will be awarded for eligible transactions in chronological order up to the credit limit or above stated cap, whicheveris lower.  
**Retail spends**  
* Grocery and supermarkets, fast food restaurants, insurance, car dealership earn 25% of domestic spends\*
* Petroleum, transit, government services, utility payments, real estate, education & telecommunications payments earn 10% of the domestic spends\*  
**Duty free, online food delivery and car booking apps**  
* Domestic and international Duty free spends, domestic online food delivery and car booking apps spends earn 2 Miles per USD equivalent; spend on Skywards Infinite Card. 1.5 Miles per USD equivalent spend on Skywards Signature Card  
**International spends**  
Spends made abroad on groceries and supermarkets, insurance, car dealerships, fast food, real estate, education, petrol, government services and utility payments including telecom, earn Miles as per normal international spends.  
Retail spends on merchants in the EU earn 50% of the international spends.  
**Express Miles**

# How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf  
21 August 2023  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf](/-/media/enbd/images/private-banking/inspiring-whats-next/2023/Thought-Leadership/how_ai_can_raise_the_wealth_management_game_in_the_gulf.jpg?la=en&h=467&w=700&hash=5DCF49D1BC934099EA1E675B577F7698)  
##### How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf  
*This article from WealthBriefing is published in conjunction with Emirates NBD Private Banking and is part of a series.*  
The recent launch of ChatGPT has ignited interest into the power of generative AI and represents a breakthrough that could lead to exponential efficiencies for both individuals and industry. AI’s potential is being explored in every industry, leading to transformative solutions and possibilities. Whether it is the use of machine learning to crunch data and identify patterns or develop “chat” communications channels and personalize information to suit individual users, AI applications continue to grow more sophisticated.  
According to a recent Goldman Sachs report, the potential of generative AI could raise global GDP by 7%, which amounts to USD 7 trillion in GDP and a 1.5% boost to productivity growth over the next 10 years.
title: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD
section: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

text:
How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD > How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

Generative AI is already a big focus for the world’s wealth management sector. It’s debatable whether AI will push humans out of work or augment the capabilities of people. However, there is a shortage of skilled workers in many parts of the world, and just as other bottlenecks across the decades drove innovation, the dynamic use of AI and human activity is likely to be no different. There are a few broad areas where AI affects the financial sector, mainly across Portfolio management; Augmented Advisory and “next best action”; Tax Planning; Client on-boarding and Cyber Security.  
The biggest opportunity for AI in the Middle East and Africa region is in the financial sector. Much of the technology surrounding AI is still in its early stages, and many pure-play AI companies are either startups or private companies. Global corporates and governments are continuously on the lookout for M&A opportunities. According to McKinsey research, AI has the potential to deliver real value in the GCC, as much as USD 150 billion, which is equivalent to 9% or more of the GCC countries’ combined GDP. The UAE has given AI ministerial status.
title: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD
section: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

text:
How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD > How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

According to a report published by PwC (1), AI is likely to contribute about USD 135.2 billion (12.4%) of KSA’s GDP in 2030; USD 96 billion (13.6%) in the UAE; and USD 45.9 billion (8.2%) in Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman and Qatar. (Those figures go beyond financial services to include other sectors like retail and manufacturing, but they are certainly indicative.) As PwC put it: “The annual growth in the contribution of AI is expected to range between 20% and 34% per year across the region, with the fastest growth in the UAE followed by Saudi Arabia.”  
Investing in AI is not a new trend: During the 2008–2018 period, the UAE invested USD 2.15 billion in AI (this data was cited (2) in “Economics of Artificial Intelligence in the Gulf Cooperation Council Countries”, Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers, December 2021). The KSA has invested in AI-driven tech companies through its stake in the Softbank Vision Fund (amongst other investments). Oman has created a sovereign Oman Technology Fund to attract foreign entrepreneurs.
title: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD
section: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

text:
How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD > How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

As explained by Capgemini in a 2022 paper, The Role of AI In Wealth Management, “AI can help churn huge chunks of data instantaneously and derive meaningful, context-relevant insights. Financial Institutions can leverage this functionality to generate portfolio insights sensitive to dynamic and wider contexts.” In other areas, AI can help firms arrive at bespoke recommendations for each client. Banks are developing “next best actions” (NBA) systems, which use machine learning to consider clients’ life events and develop personalised investment proposals almost instantly. As far as tax planning is concerned, AI can come up with tailor-made solutions for a client, saving human labour for more higher-value work. And when it comes to on-boarding clients, AI can use technologies such as natural language processing (NLP) to sift through information about prospective clients to avoid problems. In cyber security, it can help to flag threats and develop rapid responses to them.
title: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD
section: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

text:
How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD > How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

The deployment of AI within the banking sector will drive a revolutionary change in how banking operations function, redefining processes, and customer engagement paradigms. Within wealth management, AI will influence every aspect of from portfolio management to automated trading. Many wealth management firms are already integrating applications such as improved customer service, enhanced portfolio management and personalised investment advice. By leveraging this technology, wealth managers can offer enhanced and more cost-effective services, complementing advisors in the decision-making process. In addition, automating administrative tasks can make wealth managers more efficient, eliminating repetitive tasks such as scheduling and compliance reporting. AI can also provide predictive insights to optimise investment strategies tailored to each client’s risk profile and financial goals.
title: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD
section: How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

text:
How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf | Emirates NBD > How AI Can Raise the Wealth Management Game In The Gulf

Getting the AI strategy right isn’t easy because predicting where the industry might be in five, let alone a decade’s time is difficult. An issue that’s likely to remain important in the GCC, is human culture. Perhaps more than any other region of the world, this is one that prizes trust and the need to build relationships with families over the long term. In that context, AI cannot replace the human element, but must be seen to add to it and give people better ways to analyse data. People paying for the bespoke services of a private bank expect to be served by other people, even if technology adds to the mix. That said, the region, along with others, was affected by a move to “remote working” during the pandemic, increasing exposure to modern technology. Rising compliance oversight and client demands in a fast-growing region also puts a premium on tools that advisors use to manage client books.  
It is truly an exhilarating time for technology, innovation, and human potential. AI holds the promise to revolutionise every facet of our lives, from healthcare and finance to education and climate change.

SKYWARDS MILES
Now your spends are your ticket tomore travels  
**Maximum eligible spends**  
In a given statement cycle, Miles can be earned for eligible spends up to the credit limit, or 100,000 for Skywards Infinite Card / 50,000 for Skywards Signature Card, whichever is lower. Miles will be awarded for eligible transactions in chronological order up to the credit limit or above stated cap, whicheveris lower.  
**Retail spends**  
* Grocery and supermarkets, fast food restaurants, insurance, car dealership earn 25% of domestic spends\*
* Petroleum, transit, government services, utility payments, real estate, education & telecommunications payments earn 10% of the domestic spends\*  
**Duty free, online food delivery and car booking apps**  
* Domestic and international Duty free spends, domestic online food delivery and car booking apps spends earn 2 Miles per USD equivalent; spend on Skywards Infinite Card. 1.5 Miles per USD equivalent spend on Skywards Signature Card  
**International spends**  
Spends made abroad on groceries and supermarkets, insurance, car dealerships, fast food, real estate, education, petrol, government services and utility payments including telecom, earn Miles as per normal international spends.  
Retail spends on merchants in the EU earn 50% of the international spends.

# Key Facts Statement (KFS) Home Loan - Fixed & Variable Interest Rate  
Home Loan unlocks the doorway to your dream home. This product is an
installment loan. This KFS provides you with indicative
information about interest, fees and charges of this product. Kindly refer to our Welcome Letter for the
final terms of your loan.  
#### Product Information - Home Loans for  
- Loan Type: Loan Amount; Home Loan: Up to 15,000,000   Loan to value (Loan amount as % property cost): up to 85% for UAE Nationals and 80% for Expatriates
- Loan Type: Down payment; Home Loan: Minimum 15% for UAE Nationals & 20% for Expatriates of the property cost
- Loan Type: Loan Currency; Home Loan: AED (Arab Emirates Dirham)
- Loan Type: Loan Period; Home Loan: Up to 300 months (25 years)
- Loan Type: Interest Rate (Indicative)- Variable; Home Loan: Starting from 2.14% up to 6.00% per annum. There are two options:  * The interest rate is fixed for an introductory period (i.e. 2/3/5 years). For   the   remaining period, the interest rate is variable, linked to EIBOR1 (i.e. EIBOR +   fixed   margin) * Fully variable rate: The interest rate for the entire period of the loan is   variable   and linked to EIBOR (i.e. EIBOR + fixed margin)
- Loan Type: Annualised Percentage Rate (APR) (Indicative); Home Loan: Starting from 2.22% up to 6.08%. APR is a reference rate, which includes applicable interest, fees and charges of the product, expressed as an annualised rate.
title: Transaction Banking

text:
Transaction Banking > Key Facts Statement (KFS) Home Loan - Fixed & Variable Interest Rate

- Loan Type: Loan Repayment; Home Loan: Your loan repayment is in Equated Monthly Installment (EMI) and if you have a variable rate loan may vary based on EIBOR rate. EMI is calculated by adding the principal loan amount and total interest and dividing this total by the loan period in months.  
When variable interest rate is linked to EIBOR (The Emirates Interbank Offered Rate) i.e. EIBOR + Fixed
Margin, the EMI will
change depending on the actual EIBOR rate on the review date. You can choose variable price linked to 1
month or 6 months
EIBOR. Variable pricing linked to 1-month EIBOR will be reviewed monthly and variable pricing linked to
6-months EIBOR will
be reviewed every 6 months.

# How to Choose the Best Savings Account in the UAE for Maximum Interest  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![choosethebestsavingsaccount](/-/media/enbd/images/accounts/savings-account_banner.jpg?la=en&h=1500&w=2000&hash=F5041082AA6CC7C71A8F2A12A646B296)  
#####  
Picking a savings account in the UAE comes down to more than hunting the highest headline rate. You need to weigh fees, access rules, withdrawal limits and whether the account stays competitive once the promotional window closes. By the end of this article, you'll know exactly which factors matter, how today's top rates compare and how to build a savings habit that keeps your money working harder every month.  
Want to open a savings account in the UAE? Simply chasing the highest advertised rate without reading the fine print is not a good idea. Making an informed decision can really help you, since the best savings account in the UAE can earn you an interest on your deposit while keeping your funds accessible.  
In this article, learn about the rates and eligibility details of different kinds of accounts, including both conventional and Islamic options. Savings account options like the Emirates NBD Plus Saver Account and Millionaire Savings Account are worth considering.  
Whether you're a UAE national or an expat building an emergency fund, you'll find a clear path forward.

## Why a savings account matters in the UAE  
A savings account does something a current account cannot: it puts your idle money to work. Because the AED is pegged to the US dollar at a fixed rate of 3.6725 since 1997, your savings hold their value in predictable, exchange-rate-stable terms, making AED-denominated savings especially easy for residents saving in local currency.  
Here is how a savings account compares to other common alternatives:

## Key factors to compare before you decide  
Before opening any savings account, weigh these four factors against your personal goals:  
* Match your typical balance to the right balance tier, because rates jump significantly at higher thresholds.
* Compare the net return after fees, not just the gross interest rate.
* Decide how much flexibility you need. If you dip into savings regularly, a high-rate account with strict withdrawal limits will penalise you.

### Interest rates and profit calculation  
UAE savings rates currently span a wide range. However, most banks quote an annual rate but calculate interest on your daily closing balance and credit it monthly, which means depositing funds early in the month rather than late makes a genuine difference to your return.  
The Emirates NBD Plus Saver Account is particularly compelling for maximising interest earnings in the UAE. Here’s why it stands out as one of the best savings accounts available:  
* **High promotional rate:** Earn up to 5% p.a. on new money (promotional rate until 30 June 2026); one of the highest savings account interest rates available in the UAE right now.
* **Daily interest calculation:** Interest is calculated on your daily closing balance and credited monthly, so depositing early in the month genuinely increases your earnings.
* **Tiered rates that grow with you:** Ongoing rates scale from 1% p.a. on balances up to 99,000, rising to 3.5% p.a. at AED 24,999,999. A bonus rate of 1.5% p.a. will apply too. So, the more you save, the more you earn.
* **Multi-currency flexibility:** Available in both AED and USD, giving you the flexibility to save in the currency that suits your goals.
* **Digital-first convenience:** Open and manage your account instantly via the ENBD X app or Online Banking, with branch and ATM access available across the UAE.

### Minimum balance, fees, and penalties  
Minimum balance requirements vary widely across the market. Here is a quick snapshot of the typical bands you will encounter:  
* **0:** Some digital accounts require no minimum to open or maintain
* **3,000:** Common threshold for earning interest and avoiding fall-below fees (approximately 25 per month if breached)
* **5,000 to 100,000:** Typical range for non-resident savings accounts, which carry higher minimums
* **50,000+:** Often required to unlock the highest bonus rates at certain banks  
Beyond the fall-below fee, watch for international ATM charges and currency conversion costs, which can quietly erode returns on smaller balances. If your balance fluctuates month to month, a zero-fee digital account with no minimum requirement removes this risk entirely and is worth prioritising.

### Access online, branch and currency options  
How you want to manage your account day-to-day matters as much as the rate. Fully digital accounts can be opened and managed entirely through a mobile app, which is convenient but often comes with higher promotional rates.  
Emirates NBD offers a middle path: the Emirates NBD Plus Saver Account can be opened instantly via the ENBD X app or Online Banking, but you also have access to multiple branches, ATMs and CDMs across the UAE. Currency flexibility is another differentiator—the savings account is available in AED and USD. This is worth noting if you hold or receive funds in multiple currencies.

## Step-by-step account opening process  
Here's a list of documents required to open a savings account in the UAE:  
* Emirates ID (mandatory for UAE residents)
* Passport with a valid residence visa page
* Salary certificate or recent payslip (issued within 30 days for non-government employees)
* Recent bank statement (typically three months, required for some accounts)  
Once you have your documents, the next steps are:  
1. Choose your account based on the rate, minimum balance and access method that suits your goals
2. Apply online through the ENBD X app or visit the branch.
3. Verify your identity through Emirates ID scanning and biometric checks if applying online. Branch applications follow the standard Know Your Customer (KYC) process.
4. Add funds to your account.  
If you are a non-resident, the process differs. Most UAE banks allow non-residents to open savings accounts (not current accounts), but you will need to visit a branch in person, provide proof of address abroad and source-of-funds documentation and meet a higher minimum balance.

text:
Savings Account UAE: Compare and Choose The Best For You > Tips to maximise your interest earnings

## Tips to maximise your interest earnings  
The difference between a good savings rate and a great return often comes down to how actively you manage your account. Four habits make a real difference.  
* **Transfer your salary on day one**
Emirates NBD's savings accounts calculate interest on your daily closing balance. The earlier in the month your funds sit in the account, the more interest days you accumulate.
* **Use laddering to capture the best promotional rates**
UAE residents can legally hold accounts at multiple CBUAE-licensed banks. Thus, opening accounts at multiple banks and rotating funds into the one running the highest promotional rate can fetch you better returns.
* **Protect your balance tier**
Falling below a minimum balance may trigger a fee of around 25 per month and drop you into a lower interest tier.
* **Review rates every six months**
Promotional windows expire. So, a quick check twice a year keeps you in control of your interest rate earnings.

section: Tips to maximise your interest earnings

text:
Savings Account UAE: Compare and Choose The Best For You > Common mistakes to avoid

## Common mistakes to avoid  
Even a well-chosen savings account can underperform if these traps catch you out.  
* **Ignoring fall-below fees**
Keeping 2,500 in an account with a minimum of 3,000 will cost you approximately 25 per month in fees. On a small balance, that fee can wipe out several months of interest in a single statement.
* **Missing the promotional expiry date**
Market rates drop significantly once their promotional windows close. Always note the end date of any promotional rate and plan your next move before it arrives.
* **Exceeding withdrawal limits.** The Emirates NBD savings account allows up to five free withdrawals per month. Exceed that limit in any month and you end up paying for each transaction.
* **Leaving savings in the wrong currency**
USD balances on some AED savings accounts earn significantly lower rates than their AED equivalent. Check the rate schedule for each currency before depositing foreign funds.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)  
[Can non-residents open a UAE savings account?](#faqs-what-is-an-itm "What is an ITM")  
Yes, most UAE banks allow non-residents to open savings accounts but not current accounts. Non-resident accounts often have higher minimum balance requirements, typically between 5,000 and 100,000, depending on the bank.  
[Are interest and profit from UAE savings accounts taxable?](#faqs-what-is-the-maximum-amount-for-a-transaction-via-itm "Whats the maximum amount for a transaction via ITM")  
The UAE levies no personal income tax, so interest and profit are not taxed locally. However, Common Reporting Standard rules mean your UAE account details may be shared with your home country's tax authority if you are a non-resident taxpayer.  
[How often do banks change savings rates?](#faqs-do-you-require-any-documents-from-customer-for-performing-transactions-over-itm "Do you require any documents from customer for performing transactions over ITM")  
Most savings rates are variable and can change without prior notice. Promotional rates carry fixed end dates, while ongoing base rates tend to move in line with broader market conditions.  
[Is early withdrawal allowed from a savings account?](#faqs-what-are-the-itm-service-operating-timings "What are the ITM service operating timings")
title: Savings Account UAE: Compare and Choose The Best For You

text:
Savings Account UAE: Compare and Choose The Best For You > Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Savings accounts allow withdrawals at any time, unlike fixed deposits. Some accounts impose monthly limits: the Emirates NBD Savings Account permits up to 5 withdrawals per month before a rate penalty applies. Always check the withdrawal terms before opening.  
[What deposit protection applies to UAE savings accounts?](#faqs-what-kind-of-services-itm-can-provide "What kind of services ITM can provide")  
The UAE does not currently operate a formal retail deposit insurance scheme. The CBUAE holds enabling legislation for a depositor compensation fund and the government has historically intervened to protect depositors during systemic stress.

## What are people asking?  
[What is an Islamic Fixed Deposit?](#accordion-52481e15-2a0b-417b-aaba-77449e8b6659 "What is an Islamic Fixed Deposit")  
Islamic Fixed Deposits are Shari'ah compliant financial instruments offered by Emirates NBD Islamic that allow customers to earn profit on the funds placed with the bank.  
[What are the types of Islamic Deposits offered by Emirates NBD Islamic?](#accordion-ea65b867-0556-4419-ae90-c02812560080 "What are the types of Islamic Deposits offered by Emirates NBD Islamic")  
**Mudaraba Deposits**  
* Based on a Mudaraba structure where you and the bank enter into a profit sharing Shari'ah compliant partnership.
* Flexible tenors from 1, 3, 6, 9, 12, .etc.  
**Wakala Deposits**  
* Based on a Wakala structure where you appoint the bank as your agent to invest the funds in profit generating Shari'ah compliant assets and generate an expected income.  
[How can I open an Islamic Fixed Deposit?](#accordion-f4f92b41-0fa2-4463-9e1d-e7876daca00e "How can I open an Islamic Fixed Deposit")  
Islamic Fixed Deposit accounts may be opened by residents and non-residents. An operative account (Current or Savings) is mandatory prior to opening an Islamic Fixed Deposit account.  
For existing account holders, an individual can apply through branch application.

**How it Works:**
