text:
Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD > Responsible borrowing avoids unmanageable debt

## Responsible borrowing avoids unmanageable debt  
At Emirates NBD we take our responsibility to you, our client, very seriously. Through this article, we aim to inform you about how to borrow money safely, so you can benefit from the power of our loans while avoiding unmanageable debt.  
Responsible lending and borrowing are good for our clients and for the industry. As a responsible lender, we will never over-stretch you. We will only offer you loans that fit your budget, so you can pay back comfortably. Don’t be tempted by more money from lenders if you can’t afford it, that will only lead to a debt burden that will quickly spiral out of control.  
**Ask yourself the following questions before you take a loan:**  
* How much can I afford to borrow?
* Do I trust the bank I’m dealing with?
* Is the interest rate competitive?
* How much will I be paying back every month?
* Are the terms and conditions of the loan clear to me?
* Is the loan insured?
* If I can’t pay back at any time, do I know what options I have?
title: Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD > Arm yourself with all the information you need

## Arm yourself with all the information you need  
Once you answer all the questions above, you need to understand the common concepts and terminology associated with loans. Here, we present the most important ones – read and understand so you can borrow wisely.  
**Equated monthly instalments**  
An equated monthly instalment (EMI) is a fixed payment you will make to the bank on a specified date every month. Your EMIs will include both interest and principal, so the loan will be fully paid off over a specified number of years.  
**Debt burden ratio**  
Your debt burden ratio (DBR) measures your ability to manage monthly payment and repay debts. DBR is calculated by dividing total recurring monthly debt by gross monthly income, and it is expressed as a percentage. The total recurring debts will include all EMIs and 5% of the total credit limit of all credit cards held. DBR is capped at 50% by the Central Bank of the UAE.  
Learn more about your[debt burden ratio](/en/help-and-support/your-debt-burden-ratio)and your[credit score](/en/help-and-support/your-credit-score).  
**Credit reports**  
A credit report helps lenders assess your credit-worthiness or your ability to pay back a loan. It can affect the interest rate and other terms of a loan. The report includes a record of current and previous credit, payment history over the last 24 months, payments overdue and records of any defaults.
title: Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD
section: Arm yourself with all the information you need

text:
Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD > Arm yourself with all the information you need

The Al Etihad Credit Bureau (AECB) in the UAE collects and maintains individual credit information from banks and financial organisations. Any lender can request the AECB for your credit report when you apply for a loan. It’s a good idea for you to request a credit report for your own records, or before you apply for a loan. There is a small charge for this. Learn more[here](/en/help-and-support/your-debt-burden-ratio).  
**Risk-based pricing**  
Risk-based pricing is a form of price discrimination based on expected risks for different borrowers. The interest rate offered to you is based on your previous banking history. If you have a good banking history, you’ll be offered a preferential rate as compared to customers who may have defaulted on repayments.  
**Flat rate vs. reducing rate**  
A flat interest rate is calculated on the full loan amount for the whole term without taking into consideration that payments over time reduce the amount borrowed. In other words, interest is charged on the full amount of the loan throughout the loan tenure.  
A reducing interest rate, on the other hand, is calculated every month on the outstanding loan balance. EMI payment every month contains interest payable for the outstanding loan amount plus principal repayment. On every EMI payment, outstanding loan amount reduces by the amount of principal repayment. So interest for the next month is calculated only on the outstanding loan amount.  
**Converting a flat rate to a reducing rate**
title: Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD
section: Arm yourself with all the information you need

text:
Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD > Arm yourself with all the information you need

**Converting a flat rate to a reducing rate**  
Some banks use flat rates when promoting loans as they appear much cheaper, but in reality this may be more expensive than a reducing rate. To convert a flat interest rate to a reducing interest rate, multiply it by 1.8 and in case you wish to go from reducing to flat, then divide the given rate by 1.8%. For example a flat rate of 3.99% is more expensive than a reducing rate of 6.99% (3.99 X 1.8 = 7.18%).  
**Deferment**  
A deferment allows you to postpone your EMI payments by one month. A fee of 100 applies. You can defer 2 loan instalments in one loan year.  
**Credit Life Insurance**  
When you take out a loan, you also purchase credit life insurance that protects both you and the bank. This is generally a one-time amount that is paid on the entire loan amount.  
**Early settlement fee**  
An early settlement fee is charged by the bank if you pay off a loan or mortgage before the scheduled term of the credit facility. This is usually 1% of the loan outstanding at the time of loan repayment but can vary based on the type of loan.  
**Overdraft**
title: Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD
section: Arm yourself with all the information you need

text:
Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD > Arm yourself with all the information you need

**Overdraft**  
An[overdraft](/en/help-and-support/apply-for-an-overdraft)is a loan arrangement under which a bank extends credit up to a maximum amount (called overdraft limit) against which a current account customer can write cheques or make withdrawals. The credit limit is the amount you can withdraw once the current account balance reaches zero. Interest is charged only on the daily overdraft (debit) balance in the account.  
**Loan against fixed deposit**  
A loan against your[fixed deposit](/sitecore/service/notfound.aspx?item=web%3a%7bB8E97B3E-8F81-49F7-9C2F-9E44904F1886%7d%40en)for NRIs at the bank usually has the advantage of a lower interest rate than that on a conventional personal loan since it’s secured by the underlying deposit. You can get up to 90% of the value of your fixed deposit and the loan can be taken for any term as long as it does not exceed the deposit's tenure.  
**Overdraft against fixed deposit**  
An overdraft against a[fixed deposit](/en/help-and-support/open-a-fixed-deposit)is a quick and efficient way to meet short-term commitments. Interest will be charged on the amount and the period for which you use the overdraft.  
**Amortization schedule**
title: Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD
section: Arm yourself with all the information you need

text:
Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD > Arm yourself with all the information you need

**Amortization schedule**  
An amortization schedule is a schedule of payments showing the amount of principal and the amount of interest that comprises each EMI until the loan will be paid off at the end of its term. An amortization schedule will also include additional information such as the amount of interest and principal paid as well as the remaining principal balance.  
**Short-term cash loans**  
Short term cash loans cater to small and mid-size expenditures which can be converted to 12 EMIs so as to ease the burden of one-time payment. Expenses such as school fees, house rent and travel expenses can be paid with a short-term cash loan. This loan is offered at lower interest rates and may be repaid in up to 12 instalments. It’s more beneficial than[borrowing cash on credit cards](/en/help-and-support/loan-on-card).  
**Topping-up your personal loan**  
If you need more cash, you can[top up your Emirates NBD personal loan](/en/help-and-support/apply-for-a-personal-loan-top-up)at any time.

text:
Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD > Choosing a bank you trust

## Choosing a bank you trust  
Do your research. Talk to your associates and friends about their experiences with banks. A reputable bank will ensure that you have peace of mind and a pleasant banking experience.  
Here are some things to consider:  
* **Transparency:**ask about fees and charges including early settlement and partial settlement fees.
* **Interest rate:**is it the most competitive rate available?
* **Flat rate vs reducing rate:**don’t be misled, a low flat rate could actually prove more expensive than a higher reducing rate! Check the point above.
* **Systems and processes:**choose a bank that has the systems, processes and staff trainedto advise you well and manage your personal loan efficiently.
* **Access to your bank**: try not to be too far away from your branch or ATM. With Emirates NBD, you will have access toa network of over**227 branches**and**1,065 ATMs.**
title: Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD > Lower EMI vs faster repayment

## Lower EMI vs faster repayment  
Low EMIs could lead to longer payment periods. In the long run, this could prove more expensive as you will be paying more interest. Talk to your loan consultant and work out a payment period that suits you best. Don’t stretch the loan for longer than you really need to if you want to save on interest payments and become debt-free earlier.  
Be careful not to take hasty decisions as changing anything once you’ve signed up for your loan will always have associated fees. Ask all the questions you need to, there is no hurry!
title: Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD

* Borrow the amount you need and no more
* Live within your income
* Set achievable financial goals
* Prepare for financial emergencies - always have some money readily available that can help you tide over any crisis
* Develop wise money management habits

## FAQs  
[How much can I borrow on a personal loan?](#faqs-how-much-can-i-borrow-on-a-personal-loan "How much can I borrow on a personal loan")  
Most banks will prescribe a limit on your [personal loan](/en/loans/personal-loans/salary-transfer-loans-for-uae-nationals)based on your income and ability to repay. However, it’s always advisable to borrow an amount that you will be able to safely repay without getting into debt you can’t manage.  
[If my company is listed, but my salary is transferred to another bank, can I get a personal loan with Emirates NBD?](#faqs-if-my-company-is-listed-but-my-salary-is-transferred-to-another-bank-can-i-get-a-personal "If my company is listed but my salary is transferred to another bank can I get a personal loan with Emirates NBD")  
Yes, you can still get a personal loan even if your salary is not transferred to Emirates NBD – learn more [here](/en/loans/personal-loans/salary-transfer-loans-for-uae-nationals).  
[Do UAE Nationals get higher personal loan amounts?](#faqs-do-uae-nationals-get-higher-personal-loan-amounts "Do UAE Nationals get higher personal loan amounts")  
As a UAE National, you can turn your rental income or earned sponsorship fee into a loan opportunity and get additional financing for any anticipated or unexpected expense with our additional income or co-applicant schemes. Our [salary transfer loans for UAE nationals](/en/loans/personal-loans/salary-transfer-loans-for-uae-nationals)may be of interest to you as well.
title: Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Borrow wisely | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

[A salesperson called me offering me a personal loan. Is it safe to apply?](#faqs-a-salesperson-called-me-offering-me-a-personal-loan "A salesperson called me offering me a personal loan. Is it safe to apply")  
It's safe only if it’s from a reputable bank. Make sure you have understood the terms and conditions correctly. Don’t be pressurized to take hurried decisions – ask for all the information you need to make a sound decision.  
[Some banks promise faster processing while others talk of lower interest rates. Which one should I opt for?](#faqs-some-banks-promise-faster-processing-while-others-talk-of-lower-interest-rates "Some banks promise faster processing while others talk of lower interest rates. Which one should I opt for")  
A low EMI could actually lead to a longer payment period and could prove more expensive as you will pay more interest. Moreover, fast processing may force you to take a hasty decision without complete information, so be careful and ask all the questions you need to before you sign up.  
[What can I do if I miss a loan instalment or EMI?](#faqs-what-can-i-do-if-i-miss-a-loan-instalment-or-emi "What can I do if I miss a loan instalment or EMI")  
If you miss/default a loan instalment (EMI) payment please [contact us](/en/help-and-support/contact-us)and we’ll do our best to help.

[What happens in case of the untimely death of a person who has a personal loan? Does it burden the family?](#faqs-what-happens-in-case-of-the-untimely-death-of-a-person-who-has-a-personal-loan "What happens in case of the untimely death of a person who has a personal loan Does it burden the family")  
Emirates NBD personal loans are all automatically insured at a nominal cost to the borrower. In the case of an untimely death, the insurance company covers the entire loan amount saving the family from any burden.  
[What is the difference between a clearance letter and a no-liability letter?](#faqs-what-is-the-difference-between-a-clearance-letter-and-a-no-liability-letter "What is the difference between a clearance letter and a noliability letter")  
The bank will issue you a [clearance letter](/en/help-and-support/request-a-clearance-letter)when a specific liability, such as a personal or car loan, has been cleared by you while a [no-liability letter](/en/help-and-support/request-a-liability-or-no-liability-letter)will be issued only if you have no existing liabilities with the bank.  
[What is the maximum tenure for Emirates NBD personal loans?](#faqs-what-is-the-maximum-tenure-for-emirates-nbd-personal-loans "What is the maximum tenure for Emirates NBD personal loans")

### **A systematic approach**  
Our approach to advising you on your investments follows a systematic process that involves a thorough understanding of your needs, a portfolio constructed with carefully selected products, periodic reporting and regular rebalancing.  
1  
**Client Profiling**  
Detailing your objectives, cash flow needs and risk appetite - Cautious, Moderate or Aggressive

3  
**Portfolio Reporting**  
Periodic 360 degree reporting, monitoring and analysis

**Portfolio Review**  
Regular reviews and rebalancing of your portfolio to suit our SAA, the changing markets and your risk appetite

### **Portfolio Construction**  
A well-diversified portfolio is constructed using a core of carefully selected Mutual Funds complemented by Bonds/Sukuks, Single Stocks, Structured Products, Alternative Investments and FX & Commodities solutions for enhanced returns on your investments.  
Our CIO office offers efficient global multi-asset portfolios, differentiated according to our clients’ risk profile –Cautious, Moderate or Aggressive. Bespoke investment solutions are devised for clients with specific requirements.

### **Review and Rebalancing**  
Our dedicated Investment Advisors periodically review your portfolio and compare its performance against the benchmark and risk parameters. Taking into account the latest Tactical Asset Allocation, your Investment Advisor will discuss the below steps and suggestions for rebalancing together with you, to achieve optimal portfolio performance.  
* Performance of the Portfolio and timely amendments required
* Risk and return analysis
* Rebalancing against the recommended Asset Allocation

title: How to reset your digital banking password | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
How to reset your digital banking password | Support | Emirates NBD > Things to keep in mind

## Things to keep in mind  
When you’re recovering your Online or Mobile Banking password, keep the following things in mind:  
* Make sure your password meets the following requirements:
+ Includes uppercase and lowercase letters.
+ Includes one of the special characters: @, $, ^, #, !, %, \*, ?
+ Includes at least 1 number.
+ Is at least 8 characters long.  
* Avoid using your name or date of birth in your password.
* Avoid using the same password as your email or social media accounts.
* Password reset and sign in are disabled on Android devices after the initial set up.
+ You must set up biometrics to sign in and recover access.
* If we can't verify your identity using your device's camera, you’ll receive a call from Emirates NBD to complete the verification process.

text:
International Fraud Awareness Week | Emirates NBD > Fraud Awareness Week

# Fraud Awareness Week  
As part of "**International Fraud Awareness Week**", we would like to remind you to be vigilant while dealing with unfamiliar or unknown sources. Fraudsters often take advantage of busy moments, attempting to manipulate you into actions that could result in significant financial loss.
title: International Fraud Awareness Week | Emirates NBD

text:
International Fraud Awareness Week | Emirates NBD > Here are some common scams to watch out for, and how you can protect yourself:

## Here are some common scams to watch out for, and how you can protect yourself:  
![1](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/accservices_icon_b.png?la=en&h=200&w=200&hash=50C996E80E9DE503799194893437FC74)  
#### Bank representatives offering credit cards or products  
Always verify the representative’s credentials through official bank channels before sharing any information.  
![Prize](/-/media/enbd/icons/accounts/benefit-icons/mobile-banking-blue_icon.png?la=en&h=512&w=512&hash=CD696C8B0DECBEEDF192EFFF1C47CEAA)  
#### Suspicious links for delivery or updates on personal details  
If you receive a link to update your personal information or credit card details for receiving payment or delivery, do not click the link or share sensitive information.  
![Prize](/-/media/enbd/icons/packages/blue-icons/call-us_icon.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=DAA060D80F14B3CC1E14E0F99871FEB6)  
#### Calls claiming to be from the Police Department  
If someone claims to be from the police and sends OTPs from different government websites to gain your trust, do not panic. These requests are a tactic to gain trust and get access to your information.  
![Prize](/-/media/enbd/images/promotions/2024/salary-transfer-account-offer/offer-terms-and-conditions-blue_icon.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=840A6D59C10AABB5F2C93F1A384FA5D8)  
#### Fake documents or unverified payment requests
title: International Fraud Awareness Week | Emirates NBD
section: Here are some common scams to watch out for, and how you can protect yourself:

text:
International Fraud Awareness Week | Emirates NBD > Here are some common scams to watch out for, and how you can protect yourself:

#### Fake documents or unverified payment requests  
If you receive fake documents with new account details or to send money to an updated IBAN number always verify directly with the original source before taking any action.  
![Prize](/-/media/enbd/icons/accounts/benefit-icons/open-through-mobile-banking-blue_icon.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=8825ACFEBBF469EA34A5FA80FB05B682)  
#### Requests to share OTPs to cancel orders or rides  
Never share OTPs or click on unsolicited links. Scammers may use these to gain unauthorized access.  
#### Practicing digital hygiene  
As a matter of digital safety, never share sensitive information, credentials, or OTPs with anyone over phone calls or messages. Avoid clicking on links from unknown or suspicious sources.

You can track your Loan Clearance Letter request by calling us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘follow up on my request’.

### Borrow wisely – a few things you should know  
* If you don’t make the monthly payments towards your loan on time, you will incur a late payment fee
* Missing repayments can affect your credit score, limiting your ability to access loans or financing in the future
* If you refinance your loan or defer your payments, your loan will take longer to pay back, and you may pay more interest
* If you can’t meet a monthly payment, [apply in advance for a deferment](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/defer-your-loan-payments). You can do this up to twice a year  
It’s important to read the terms and conditions and know the fees and charges before you apply for a loan.

* If you don’t make the monthly payments towards your loan on time, you will incur a late payment fee
* Missing repayments can affect your credit score, limiting your ability to access loans or financing in the future
* If you refinance your loan or defer your payments, your loan will take longer to pay back, and you may pay more interest
* If you can’t meet a monthly payment, [apply in advance for a deferment](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/defer-your-loan-payments). You can do this up to twice a year  
It’s important to read the terms and conditions and know the fees and charges before you apply for a loan.

# The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat  
01 April 2022  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![The postExpo economy puts investors in the drivers seat](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/post_expo_economy_thumb1_img.jpg)  
##### The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat  
An economic transformation driven by forward-facing policy and strategic initiatives has positioned Dubai and the UAE as one of the most-preferred places in the world to live, work, and invest in, as Expo 2020 Dubai has left a positive impact on key sectors, says **Saod Obaidalla, Executive Vice President and Head of Private Banking, Emirates NBD**  
Dubai has impeccably hosted 192 national pavilions for 182 days in the first World Expo to take place in the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia (MEASA) region in the event’s 168-year history. Economic impact studies have shown that the Expo contributed 122.6 billion of gross value added (GVA), along with 905,200 job-years, to the UAE’s economy up to 2031. The mega event welcomed more than 20 million visitors and has played a key role in enhancing strategic sectors such as tourism, hospitality, and real estate.
title: The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat
section: The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat

text:
The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat > The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat

With the understanding that uncertainty is the investor’s worst enemy, Dubai and the UAE have taken multiple steps to develop a financial ecosystem that maintains a competitive edge in an increasingly globalized investment and business environment. With the dual objective of attracting foreign direct investment (FDI) and strengthening home-grown businesses and markets, the initiatives are widely expected to enhance economic growth, foster innovation, and put investors firmly in the driver’s seat.  
In November 2021, the UAE announced the largest legislative reform in its history, with a basket of over 40 laws covering trade, industrial property, online security, copyright, digital signatures, and residency, making it more attractive for investors. The reforms also strengthen the knowledge economy with regulatory support. Already, the share of the digital economy in the UAE’s GDP has doubled from 4.3 per cent in 2019 to 9.7 percent in 2021.  
Investors and entrepreneurs can now establish onshore companies in most sectors, with 100 per cent ownership. Additionally, to accelerate new listings in sectors such as energy, logistics, and retail, Dubai announced plans in November 2021 to list 10 government and state-owned companies on the Dubai Financial Market (DFM), and approved a market-making fund of up to 2 billion, along with an 1 billion fund to support tech company IPOs. This also aligns with a broader plan to double the financial market’s size to 3 trillion.
title: The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat
section: The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat

text:
The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat > The post-Expo economy puts investors in the driver’s seat

Building on a raft of such initiatives that have been announced since 2013, when Dubai won the bid to host the World Expo, the economic transformation has been combined with an agile and responsive visa and residency administration as well as the alignment of the work week with global markets.  
Investors across the world have sat up and taken notice. Dubai attracted 15.9 billion (USD 4.3 billion) in FDI in the first nine months of 2021, with 58 per cent of the capital going into strategic sectors and 64 per cent comprising high and medium technology. The positive growth places Dubai third globally in the number of greenfield FDI projects and fourth in greenfield FDI capital flows, according to the ranking by Financial Times’ fDi Markets, which captures and compares FDI data across the world.  
The continuous development of policy infrastructure is part of a larger strategic shift intended to cultivate a diversified knowledge economy. In March 2021, His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of UAE and Ruler of Dubai, launched the 10-year Industrial Strategy titled ‘Operation 300bn’, to increase its contribution to GDP from the current 133 billion to 300 billion by 2031. A year later, in March 2022, the UAE cabinet authorized the use of crowdfunding by both public and private sectors, opening doors for entrepreneurs to finance innovative business ideas.

![](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/the-post-expo-economy-thumb1_img_infographic.jpg)  
The planned and robust diversification away from oil and the proactive support for non-oil businesses – coupled with the UAE’s handling of the pandemic and supportive macroeconomic policies, among other factors – will result in a 3.5 per cent growth in the UAE economy in 2022, driven mainly by non-oil GDP expansion of 3.4 per cent, according to the most recent forecast by the International Monetary Fund (IMF).  
It’s a dramatically different world today than it was in 2013. The legacy of Expo 2020 Dubai is not just the spectacular District 2020, but in the way the event has positioned Dubai to play an expanded role in the global future, with innovation, health, technology, creativity, and human connections at its heart, to attract entrepreneurship and investment. The making of the event has aligned with the making of a more diversified, resilient, sustainable, and knowledge-driven economy.

## Islamic Investment Banking with Emirates NBD Capital  
Emirates NBD Capital currently holds a leading league table position in international Sukuk with transactions successfully completed across the GCC, Turkey, India, China and Indonesia.  
We offer a full spectrum of Shari'ah compliant investment banking products and services.  
[Know more](/en/corporate-and-institutional-banking/investment-banking "Islamic Investment Banking with Emirates NBD Capital")

##### Islamic Investment Banking  
#### Syndicated Islamic facilities  
We offer origination, distribution and agency services, wherein we act in lead roles as advisor, arranger and co-arranger in the region through our Investment Banking team. We assist our clients by forming a consortium of financial institutions, through our strong partnerships with local as well as international banks, in arranging financing for large-sized Shari’ah compliant transactions. Emirates NBD - Emirates NBD Islamic has successfully executed several high-profile transactions wherein we act in lead roles as advisor, arranger and co-arranger.

text:
Islamic Investment Banking | Emirates NBD > Sukuk

### Sukuk  
Sukuk is an Islamic financial certificate that represents a portion of ownership in a portfolio of eligible existing or future assets. Emirates NBD Capital's award-winning Debt Capital Markets (DCM) platform has consistently ranked amongst the top 5 International Sukuk houses and the top 5 GCC Bond and Sukuk houses. With a dedicated syndicate desk based in Dubai, and through Emirates NBD's global sales force, the DCM team can distribute Sukuk to investors in the Middle East, Asia and Europe. Post issuance, Emirates NBD's sales and trading teams actively support our DCM transactions, adding critical liquidity and creating benchmarks in the secondary market.

text:
Recover your online or mobile banking user ID | Support | Emirates NBD > Forgot your user ID?

## Forgot your user ID?  
If you’ve forgotten your digital banking user ID, don’t worry, you can retrieve it instantly using Online or Mobile Banking.  
* If you have an active Emirates NBD account, you need to use an active debit card linked to the account to retrieve your user ID
* If you only have an Emirates NBD credit card, you can use that instead  
To authorise the reset, you'll need to use Smart Pass or an SMS authorisation code which we’ll send to your [registered mobile number](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number).  
The authorisation code is valid for 5 minutes and 3 attempts only. If you fail all three attempts, just switch to Mobile Banking if you’re using Online Banking, or Online Banking if you're using Mobile Banking.

text:
Recover your online or mobile banking user ID | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[How many times can I request an authorisation code to be sent to me?](#faqs-how-many-times-can-i-request-an-authorisation-retrieve-your-user-id "How many times can I request an authorisation code to be sent to me")  
There is no limit to the number of times you can request an authorisation code, however the code is valid for 5 minutes and 3 attempts only. If you’ve failed all three attempts, you can switch to Mobile Banking if you’ve been using Online Banking, or vice versa.  
If you have exceeded the attempts on Online and Mobile banking as well, you can generate a new code at an Emirates [NBD ATM or branch](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/branches-and-atms), or by calling us on [+971 600 540000](tel:971600540000).  
[Is there a charge for requesting a new authorisation code?](#faqs-is-there-a-charge-for-requesting-a-new-authorisation-code-retrieve-your-userid "Is there a charge for requesting a new authorisation code")  
No  
[What happens if I fail to retrieve my Online Banking User ID using authorisation codes by all available means?](#faqs-what-happens-if-i-fail-to-retrieve-my-online-banking-user-id-using-authorisation "What happens if I fail to retrieve my Online Banking User ID using authorisation codes by all available means")  
You will need to visit your nearest Emirates NBD branch with your passport or Emirates ID for identification.
title: Recover your online or mobile banking user ID | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Recover your online or mobile banking user ID | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

You will need to visit your nearest Emirates NBD branch with your passport or Emirates ID for identification.  
[What if I don’t remember my User ID and the answers to my secret questions?](#faqs-what-if-i-dont-remember-my-user-id-and-the-answers-to-my-secret-questions "What if I dont remember my User ID and the answers to my secret questions")  
Don't worry, call us on[+971 600 54 0000](tel:00971600540000) or visit your [nearest Emirates NBD Branch](/en/branches-and-atms)before 2 pm with your passport or Emirates ID, and we’ll be happy to help.  
[I don’t have my registered mobile number with me, can I request the authorisation code to be sent to another number?](#faqs-i-dont-have-my-registered-mobile-number-with-me-can-i-request-the-authorisation "I dont have my registered mobile number with me can I request the authorisation code to be sent to another number")  
No, we can only send your authorisation code to your registered mobile number. If you want us to use another number, please[update our records](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number)with the new number.

# Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies  
01 August 2022  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![Womens growing wealth challenges private banking strategies](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/Womens_growing_wealth_thumb_img.jpg)  
##### Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies  
As the UAE embraces a more diverse, inclusive future, private banking and wealth management too need to evolve to include the aspirations and goals of women investors who are emerging as a strong voice with well-defined priorities  
The UAE’s Year of the 50th celebrations that ended in March 2022 launched a strategy for the next half century for the young nation. Diversity and innovation are vital components of the country’s strategic focus. The UAE, which is located at the geographic centre of the world, is poised to [**bridge**](https://www.arabianbusiness.com/gcc/uae/470721-why-centre-of-global-economic-gravity-is-shifting-towards-the-uae) the shifting centre of global economic gravity, and is home to a [**youthful**](https://www.youthpolicy.org/mappings/regionalyouthscenes/mena/facts/) and diverse population.  
To stay relevant and responsive to a diverse group of stakeholders, wealth planning too needs to evolve to include their aspirations and goals. Women investors in particular have emerged as a strong voice, globally and in the region, with well-defined priorities.
title: Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies
section: Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies

text:
Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies > Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies

Women make up half of the world’s population. They are custodians of a third of the world’s wealth, adding [**USD 5 trillion**](https://www.bcg.com/publications/2020/managing-next-decade-women-wealth) a year to the global wealth pool. This wealth creation is expected to grow at a CAGR of 7.2% between 2019 and 2023, outpacing the overall market growth of 5.8%. Women’s wealth in the Middle East is expected to rise at a CAGR of 8.8% during the same period.  
![](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/Womens_growing_wealth_thumb1_img.jpg)  
The UAE continues to make great strides in achieving gender balance, with measures covering talent participation at the highest levels, leadership positions, and political empowerment. The country ranks first [**globally**](https://wam.ae/en/details/1395302995118) on as many as nine gender balance indices, including the Women in Parliament Index. It ranks [**ninth**](https://wam.ae/en/details/1395302995118) globally in the Women’s Leadership Opportunities pillar of INSEAD’s Global Talent Competitiveness Index.
title: Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies
section: Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies

text:
Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies > Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies

Pre-COVID data show that more than [**40%**](https://www.zawya.com/en/wealth/uae-and-saudi-women-control-assets-worth-326bln-bcg-x66578pw) of women’s wealth in the Middle East is concentrated in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. As investors, heirs, business owners, partners, CEOs, and professionals, UAE women control assets worth USD 102 billion. It’s reasonable to infer that wealth managers and private bankers have been advising an increasing number of women clients.  
![](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/Womens_growing_wealth_thumb2_img.jpg)  
Responsive wealth management for women will need a clear, well-defined shift. Global [**research**](https://cebr.com/reports/financial-times-neglected-heirs-widows-who-take-over-the-family-finances/) tells us that wealth management [**needs**](https://cebr.com/reports/financial-times-neglected-heirs-widows-who-take-over-the-family-finances/) to reinvent itself to reflect deep demographic transformations. The same old wealth management strategies – with a superficial pink-wash, perhaps – would not work for women’s aspirations. [**Research**](https://yougov.co.uk/topics/politics/articles-reports/2018/04/12/over-half-women-have-never-held-investment-product) shows key differences in how women approach wealth. Wealth managers and bankers can best respond by being attuned to the real needs of this clientele instead of relying on stereotypes.
title: Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies
section: Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies

text:
Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies > Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies

For instance, more [**women investors**](https://www.bcg.com/publications/2020/managing-next-decade-women-wealth) compared to men follow a goal-based approach instead of building wealth for its own sake. They also emerge as less reluctant to ask questions, seek precise data, and tend to weigh choices rationally rather than relying on ‘gut feel’. Women investors across the high-net-worth spectrum tend to be more risk-averse. [**Impact**](https://www.privatebankerinternational.com/news/womens-wealth-75-lack-financial-confidence-survey-finds/) investing with a holistic approach that is socially and environmentally responsible is more prevalent among women investors.  
![](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/Womens_growing_wealth_thumb3_img.jpg)  
In fact, these may be some of the reasons that investments held by women tend to perform [**better**](https://www.fidelity.com/bin-public/060_www_fidelity_com/documents/about-fidelity/FidelityInvestmentsWomen&InvestingStudy2021.pdf).

Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies > Women’s growing wealth challenges private banking strategies

Client priorities have deep implications for wealth management and affect how products and advice are tailored. At the same time, true diversity, equity, and inclusivity also make business sense. Organisations that score higher on gender diversity on executive teams are 25% [**more likely**](https://www.mckinsey.com/featured-insights/diversity-and-inclusion/diversity-wins-how-inclusion-matters) to have above-average profitability. A diversity-driven wealth management strategy would pay dividends for not just the client but also the financial institution, as well as society as a whole.

[Garmin Pay](/en/cards/contactless-payments/garmin-pay)  
![Contactless Card](/-/media/enbd/images/card/contactless-payments/universal_contactless_card_symbol.svg?la=en&hash=7607A7BC897967C6EE414523955BC0FE)  
Our cards come with the contactless technology. You can use it wherever you see the contactless symbol!  
[Know more](/en/cards/credit-cards)  
![Promo  Fast](/-/media/enbd/images/products/cards/contactless-payments/fast-contactless_1920x1080.jpg?la=en&h=1080&w=1920&hash=C73EB1E1536818D03980B72C4DC21C69)  
##### Fast  
#### 0-60 in 2 seconds  
Less processing and handling of cash occurring, transactions are completed at a faster rate, turnover is likely to improve and queues are less likely to build up. As PIN are no longer needed and the transaction only needs a tap on a reader  
![Promo  Convenient](/-/media/enbd/images/products/cards/contactless-payments/convenient-contactless_1920x1080.jpg?la=en&h=1080&w=1920&hash=17D86D85FFEC053E867A5E66D9FB5C51)  
##### Effortless, touch-free  
#### Convenient  
Contactless payments aren't restricted to just cards. The NFC technology within contactless readers can interact with phones and connected accessories such as watches or rings. Apple Pay's launch in 2014 allowed users to pay if they had forgotten their card or if it was out of reach, by using their phone to carry out the transaction.

#### Secure  
Built-in protection ensures that the same transaction doesn't occur twice by accident and that if intercepted, the details and numbers linked to the card cannot be decrypted as unique numbers are used for transactions that don't correlate to card numbers.

text:
Defer your Loan Payment  | Auto Loan and Personal Loan Deferment | Emirates NBD > Before you start

## Before you start  
**Important information to be noted before you start:**  
* If you choose to opt for deferment of your loan installments, please be informed that this can result in the increase of the last instalment amount/the installments post deferment will vary in comparison to the other instalments as per repayment schedule.
* Additionally, the loan tenor set out in the Loan Agreement/schedule may correspondingly increase.
* Please note that you can defer your loan only if the repayment mode is set to 'auto debit'. If this is not the case, or if you're not sure, please call us on [**+971600540000**](tel:+971600540000)and we'll be happy to help. Answers to security questions will be required, so please be ready with your **account/loan number** and [**registered mobile number**](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number), when you make that call.
* This service under the Deferral Relief Programme is **Free of charge**.
* Your request will be processed within **4 working days**.
* Once done, you will receive an SMS with the details of the request on your [**registered mobile number**](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number).  
Refer to the Deferral Relief Programme FAQs **[here](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/enbd/files/pdf/deferment_relief_program_faqs.pdf)**.

## To stay protected, it is crucial to be aware of the types of fraud occurring:  
![1](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/accservices_icon_b.png?la=en&h=200&w=200&hash=50C996E80E9DE503799194893437FC74)  
#### Impersonating police, bank or central bank, or government staff  
Beware of fraudsters calling from private or unknown numbers asking for personal information.  
![Prize](/-/media/enbd/icons/packages/blue-icons/payback-blue_icon.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=D1E49FAA94A628882223FC6B9F88FBEF)  
#### Stealing information via WhatsApp messages pretending to be from official authorities  
Block and report WhatsApp messages from known or unknown numbers asking you to share OTPs or sensitive information.  
![Prize](/-/media/enbd/images/ways-of-banking/e-transfer_icon.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=7B29F244F851C6D1BF84E1555CD5F263)  
#### Delivery SMS from private numbers with malicious links  
Do not click on suspicious links from private or unknown numbers pretending to be brands.  
![Prize](/-/media/enbd/images/ways-of-banking/e-transfer_icon.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=7B29F244F851C6D1BF84E1555CD5F263)  
#### Tricking callers with false sense of urgency  
The bank will never pressure you into sharing personal information or bank account details over the phone. Never add new beneficiaries to your mobile banking at the request of an unknown caller.
title: Fight Fraud - Stay Vigilant Against Scammers | Emirates NBD
section: To stay protected, it is crucial to be aware of the types of fraud occurring:

text:
Fight Fraud - Stay Vigilant Against Scammers | Emirates NBD > To stay protected, it is crucial to be aware of the types of fraud occurring:

![Prize](/-/media/enbd/images/promotions/2024/salary-transfer-account-offer/offer-terms-and-conditions-blue_icon.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=840A6D59C10AABB5F2C93F1A384FA5D8)  
#### Asking to reconfirm personal data to validate expired or suspended Emirates ID  
Always verify who is contacting you before sharing sensitive and personal information. The bank will never ask for such information over the phone.  
#### Fake calls claiming a blocked card prompting to login to ENBD X app and share Smart Pass authentication  
Banks or official authorities will never ask you to share passwords or authentication codes over the phone; fraudsters may send you one-time passwords (OTPs), notifications from UAEPASS, or messages from other genuine government departments to trick you into believing them.  
#### Read OTP message carefully  
Be extra careful and check the value, currency and the merchant name on the OTP messages that you receive from the bank.  
#### Do not add unknown beneficiaries  
Never add any online or mobile banking beneficiaries to your account at the request of an unknown caller.

# How to apply for a supplementary credit card  
Get up to 5 supplementary credit cards for dependents and set spending limits  
[Apply now](#topic-apply-for-a-supplementary-credit-card "Apply now
")  
[How long it will take](#topic-how-long-it-will-take "How long it will take
")  
[FAQs](#article-faq "Apply for a supplementary Credit Card")  
Share your credit card benefits with your dependents by giving them a supplementary credit card. Emirates NBD Supplementary Credit Cards enjoy all the features of the original credit card, and you'll have the advantage of [earning rewards](/en/help-and-support/understanding-your-rewards)on purchases made by the supplementary credit cardholder.  
You can apply for up to 5 supplementary credit cards for family and friends as well as house help and[set limits](/en/help-and-support/manage-your-credit-card-limits)on the cards.  
You can also[track](/en/help-and-support/manage-your-credit-card-limits)the spending on the supplementary credit cards via[Online Banking](https://online.emiratesnbd.com/)and [Mobile Banking](/en/ways-of-banking/enbd-x)and on your monthly credit card statements.

## How long it will take  
Your supplementary credit card application will be processed within 3 to 5 working days, subject to meeting all documentation requirements and bank’s norms. Once your application is accepted, your card will be [delivered to you](/en/help-and-support/receiving-your-card) in 3 to 5 working days.  
International deliveries may take up to 7 to 10 working days and a fee of 157.50 (inclusive of VAT) will apply.

## FAQs  
[What are the advantages of having a credit card?](#faqs-what-are-the-advantages-of-having-a-credit-card "What are the advantages of having a credit card")  
Credit cards are safer and are easier to carry than large amounts of cash. You can use your credit card to shop almost anywhere, even online. They afford you a month’s worth of credit and, provided you repay your dues on time, this is free of cost. You can also use your card to take a cash advance from an ATM any time you need it. Although you should know there is a fee and interest rate that applies.  
[How can I follow up on my card application?](#faqs-how-can-i-follow-up-on-my-card-application "How can I follow up on my card application")  
Please call [+971 600 54 0000](tel:00971600540000)and when prompted, say 'follow up on card application'.  
[If I don't have an Emirates NBD Account, can I apply for an Emirates NBD Credit Card and Supplementary Credit Card?](#faqs-if-i-dont-have-an-emirates-nbd-account-can-i-apply-for-an-supplementary-cards "If I dont have an Emirates NBD Account can I apply for an Emirates NBD Credit Card and Supplementary Credit Card")  
Yes, you can apply for an Emirates NBD Credit Card even if you don't have an account with us. You just need to meetthese[eligibility requirements](/en/help-and-support/eligibility-and-documents-for-supplementary-credit-cards). Once your card arrives, you can apply for up to 5 supplementary credit cards for dependents, friends and house help as well.

# Cookie Policy  
##  
Our Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use cookies, how third-parties we may partner with may use cookies on the EmiratesNBD.com, your choices regarding cookies and further information about cookies.  
**Emirates NBD ("us", "we", or "our") uses cookies on EmiratesNBD.com.
By using the EmiratesNBD.com, you consent to the use of cookies.**  
**What are Cookies?**  
Cookies are small pieces of encrypted text saved in your web browser by a website you visit. Encrypted text can on be read by the website it was saved by. A cookie file is stored in your web browser and allows the **EmiratesNBD.com** or a third party to recognize you and make your next visit easier and the **EmiratesNBD.com** more useful to you.
Cookies can be "persistent" or "session" cookies.  
**How EmiratesNBD.com uses cookies**  
* When you use and access the EmiratesNBD.com, we may place a number of cookies files in your web browser.
* We use cookies for the following purposes: to enable certain functions of the EmiratesNBD.com, to provide analytics, to store your preferences, to enable advertisements delivery, including behavioral advertising.
* Emirates NBD uses both session and persistent cookies on the EmiratesNBD.com and Emirates NBD uses different types of cookies to run the EmiratesNBD.com
* Essential cookies. Emirates NBD may use essential cookies to authenticate users and prevent fraudulent use of user accounts.

**Third-party cookies**  
In addition to our own cookies, we may also use various third-parties cookies to report usage statistics of the EmiratesNBD.com, deliver advertisements on and through the EmiratesNBD.com, and so on.  
**What are your choices regarding cookies**  
If you'd like to delete cookies or instruct your web browser to delete or refuse cookies, please visit the help pages of your web browser.
Please note, however, that if you delete cookies or refuse to accept them, you might not be able to use all of the features we offer, you may not be able to store your preferences, and some of our pages might not display properly.

text:
Auto Loan Clearance Letter Request | Support | Emirates NBD > What is a clearance letter?

## What is a clearance letter?  
A clearance letter is an acknowledgement by the bank that your auto loan has been paid in full and that all the terms of the loan have been satisfied. So if you’ve cleared your auto loan and your loan account is closed, you can ask the bank for a clearance letter and transfer the vehicle to your name.
title: Auto Loan Clearance Letter Request | Support | Emirates NBD

text:

## Request an auto loan clearance letter  
Choose one of the options below to proceed**:**  
**What’s next**  
Once your request is processed, you’ll receive an SMS with a reference number on your [registered mobile number](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number). You can then visit the Traffic Department of the emirate in which your vehicle is registered to have the registration transferred to your name.

## Quick Answers  
[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my card number?](#accordion-c14e16bd-40cc-461b-87a6-b5f8a7f4570b "Is it safe to share my card number")  
You should avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. It’s ok to share this information with the bank in a safe manner. Rest assured we do not share this information with anyone. Read more about how we keep you safe [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/security/?ref=beta).

text:
Apply for a personal loan top-up | Support | Emirates NBD > Need extra cash urgently?

## Need extra cash urgently?  
We understand that you may need extra cash urgently at times, so we've made it easy for you to top up your Emirates NBD personal loan quickly and conveniently. Just log in to Mobile or Online Banking to apply. You can also visit a branch near you or apply via our website.  
If you have a loan at another bank which does not offer a top-up loan, you can shift your loan to Emirates NBD by simply applying for a new loan with us and closing the other one.
title: Apply for a personal loan top-up | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a personal loan top-up | Support | Emirates NBD > Eligibility

## Eligibility  
You can apply for a loan top-up right away if:  
* You borrowed less than the full amount you are eligible for
* You borrowed the full amount you are eligible for, and you havepaid at least 12 EMIs
* You have never defaulted on payments
title: Apply for a personal loan top-up | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a personal loan top-up | Support | Emirates NBD > Fees

## Fees  
A processing fee of 1.05% of the incremental loan amount (a minimum of 525 and a maximum of 2,625) applies.
title: Apply for a personal loan top-up | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a personal loan top-up | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[If my salary has changed since I applied for the loan will I get a top-up?](#faqs-if-my-salary-has-changed-since-i-applied-for-the-loan-will-i-get-a-top-up "If my salary has changed since I applied for the loan will I get a topup")  
You can request for a top-up if your salary has increased, but it's always subject to the bank's approval.  
[If I have defaulted just once will the bank give me a top-up on my loan?](#faqs-if-i-have-defaulted-just-once-will-the-bank-give-me-a-top-up-on-my-loan "If I have defaulted just once will the bank give me a topup on my loan")  
This is subject to a credit review approval by the bank.  
[I’m close to retirement age, will the bank give me a top-up on my loan?](#faqs-i-am-close-to-retirement-age-will-the-bank-give-me-a-top-up-on-my-loan "Im close to retirement age will the bank give me a topup on my loan")  
You’ll get a top-up only if the loan maturity date is before your retirement age.  
[How long does it take for a loan top-up amount to reach my account?](#faqs-how-long-does-it-take-for-a-loan-top-up-amount-to-reach-my-account "How long does it take for a loan topup amount to reach my account")  
This normally happens in 3 to 5 working days.

## Before you start  
* You’ll be asked security questions, so we can make sure that it’s you. Be prepared with your **credit card number** and [**registered mobile number**](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number).
* Learn more about Loan on Card **[here](/en/help-and-support/loan-on-card)**.

* We’ll get in touch with you within 2 to 3 working days to tell you more about your interest rate.

text:
Loan on Card (LOC) Request | Emirates NBD > Quick Answers

## Quick Answers  
[Am I eligible for Loan on Card?](#accordion-7c5cac8d-461f-42b9-ace1-dbda85dcc092 "Am I eligible for Loan on Card")  
You need to have an account with any local bank, and you can apply for a minimum amount of 1,000.  
[Are there any processing fees for installment plans?](#accordion-cafcf315-ec4d-45d2-ba2d-55124577692b "Are there any processing fees for installment plans")  
Regular Installment Payment Plan, Balance Conversion, and Loan on Card don’t have a processing fee, but a nominal interest rate applies based on your credit card history and usage.
With the 0% interest Installment Payment Plan there could be a one-time processing fee of 51.45 (inclusive of VAT) per transaction. For more details, read more about our [**fees and charges**](/-/media/enbd/files/others/fees-and-charges/cards/emiratesnbd_credit_card_fees_charges.pdf).  
[Can I cancel my installment plan?](#accordion-3d65f651-7a3b-46ee-aa5d-bdb0008212d3 "Can I cancel my installment plan ")  
Yes, you can cancel your installment plan through Mobile Banking and Online Banking.
Before cancelling your plan, you will have to settle the remaining principal outstanding plus a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding and 5% VAT.  
[I want to follow up on a previous request.](#accordion-2f1ca41b-92bd-4a91-b918-73ec90afc301 "I want to follow up on a previous request.")

## Emirates NBD joins hands with AFIN as a founding industry partner for its global fintech registry  
* Global FinTech registry, ChekFIN to assist financial institutions in easy identification and evaluation of FinTechs for potential collaborations
* Bank is ChekFIN’s first founding industry partner from the Middle East  
**Dubai, UAE, 25 November 2021:** Emirates NBD, a leading banking group in the MENAT (Middle East, North Africa and Turkey) region, has announced its association with ASEAN Financial Innovation Network (AFIN), as a member and as an industry partner to support its global fintech registry, ChekFIN.
title: Emirates NBD Joins Hands with AFIN as a Founding Industry Partner
section: Emirates NBD joins hands with AFIN as a founding industry partner for its global fintech registry

text:
Emirates NBD Joins Hands with AFIN as a Founding Industry Partner > Emirates NBD joins hands with AFIN as a founding industry partner for its global fintech registry

Created in collaboration with Boston Consulting Group FinTech Control Tower (BCG FCT) and Temasek-founded Affinidi, ChekFIN was officially launched at the Singapore FinTech Festival 2021. Scheduled to go live on 01 December 2021, the registry will provide a decentralised, open standard, and trust-based solution enabling and empowering financial institutions to reduce the amount of time spent searching for and assessing a suitable partner firm. The platform includes unique features such as a comprehensive taxonomy and tagging system to facilitate easy search, easy access to aggregated and relevant information on firms in a single place. A key feature of the platform is the use of Verifiable Credentials (VCs), cryptographically secure digital certificates, to assess the digital reputation and credibility of various FinTechs. Emirates NBD is one of the ten global pioneer industry partners working with APIX to issue the first set of VCs.  
The presence of a global registry where consolidated information on vetted FinTechs is readily available, will benefit financial institutions by bringing greater connectivity in the Fintech ecosystem, thus enabling smoother and more reliable collaborations.
title: Emirates NBD Joins Hands with AFIN as a Founding Industry Partner
section: Emirates NBD joins hands with AFIN as a founding industry partner for its global fintech registry

text:
Emirates NBD Joins Hands with AFIN as a Founding Industry Partner > Emirates NBD joins hands with AFIN as a founding industry partner for its global fintech registry

Commenting on the announcement, **Miguel Rio Tinto, Group Chief Information Officer, Emirates NBD** said, “As a leading banking group in the region, Emirates NBD is always looking for opportunities for innovative collaboration in and outside the region. Exploring partnerships with FinTechs can have a big impact on enhancing the financial services industry through their innovative capabilities, business models and cutting-edge solutions that can help enhance customer experience. However, onboarding FinTech partners comes with its set of complex challenges including a long lead time and regulatory and compliance hurdles. We are delighted to support AFIN, for its ground-breaking new platform, which acts as a credible registry of FinTech firms.”  
He added, “As we continue to lead innovation in digital banking in the region, we see this as an important milestone in our long-term digital strategy. We will continue to contribute to the growth of the FinTech start-up ecosystem and pave the way for more collaborations between financial institutions and FinTechs across the globe.”  
**Sopnendu Mohanty, Chief FinTech Officer of the Monetary Authority of Singapore**, said, "Emirates NBD joining ChekFIN as a pioneer partner from the MENA region shows their transformational approach in engaging with FinTechs and innovation enablers. As a pioneer partner, it will contribute to the development of this new game-changing engagement mode, leading to accelerated and sustainable innovation."

## About Virtual Accounts  
Track your receivables by creating and maintaining virtual accounts through businessONLINE. Virtual Accounts allow you to identify payers without having to rely on additional information in the account credits, while actual funds are being received in the underlying physical account, all in real-time.  
[know more](/-/media/enbd/files/cib/2022/virtual_account_leaflet_cib.pdf "About Virtual Accounts")

## Before you start  
* You’ll be asked security questions, so we can make sure that it’s you. Be prepared with your **[account number](/en/help-and-support/view-your-account-details-and-transactions)** and [**registered mobile number**](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number).

[What is an MT-103? And when do I need it?](#accordion-ab7def71-743c-45cf-9567-780417d640bf "What is an MT103 And when do I need it")  
An MT103 is a standardized SWIFT payment message used specifically for cross border/international transfers and includes transfer details such as date, amount, currency, sender and recipient.  
You will need to submit an MT-103 form in case you need to identify the status of a processed international transfer you have been expecting. The sender will be able to request their bank to provide an MT103 for the transfer and share it with you.  
[You can refer to the below-mentioned MT103 Sample](#accordion-213b2b5f-cf1b-4dd1-b419-e6eb5b89e304 "You can refer to the belowmentioned MT103 Sample")  
(The sender will be able to request their bank to provide an MT103 for the transfer and share it with you): Make sure that the MT103 mentions Swift Code “EBILAEAD” as the receiver.

# Be ready for the unexpected with an Emergency Fund  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/logomark.svg)  
Curated by Emirates NBD  
2 min read  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/calendar.svg)  
24/06/2025  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/show.svg)  
49,129  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/share.svg)  
Share  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/deals/images/tiles/ReadyforUnexpected-1.jpg)  
Life is full of surprises, and unfortunately, not all surprises are good. You might unexpectedly lose a job, get injured, or have your car suddenly break down and need repairs. All these things cost money, and if you aren’t ready, you could be in a lot of trouble. This is exactly why you need an emergency fund.
.  
**What’s an emergency fund?**  
An emergency fund is exactly what it sounds like: money you set aside for emergencies. With an emergency fund, you’ll be able to pay for expenses that come up at any moment. It doesn’t matter what else is going on in your life, your emergency fund is meant to take care of you when you need it.  
**How do I start building an emergency fund?**  
All it takes is setting money aside each week or month for your fund. Try opening a new bank account just for your emergency fund, that way you can always see your balance.
title: Be ready for the unexpected with an Emergency Fund | Emirates NBD
section: Be ready for the unexpected with an Emergency Fund

text:
Be ready for the unexpected with an Emergency Fund | Emirates NBD > Be ready for the unexpected with an Emergency Fund

Make sure that you can easy access to your emergency fund, just in case anything comes up. Since you (hopefully) won’t be withdrawing money all that often, a savings account can be a good place to park your emergency funds, so that you’re earning some interest on your money as well.  
**Is it really an emergency?**  
The money you set aside for your emergency fund should only be used in case of an emergency. How you define an emergency might be different from someone else, but it’s safe to say that splurging on a new pair of shoes doesn’t count. Sit down and write a list of all the reasons you might use your emergency fund. That way, it’s clear why this money might be used, and you won’t be tempted to spend the savings on other things.  
**How much money should you put away?**  
There is no one set amount that is good for an emergency fund, but there are some rules that could help you to figure out how much to put away. Most financial experts agree that you should save between three and six months’ worth of your expenses. This is to protect you in case you lose your job and need a few months to get back on your feet.  
![](https://finwell.emiratesnbd.com/-/media/fw/images/articles/saving/artboard-662x100.jpg)  
For instance, if your total monthly costs are 3,000, you should be saving between 9,000 and 18,000 in your emergency fund. In the worst-case scenario, this should be enough money to pay for your living expenses and keep you protected until you get back on your feet.
title: Be ready for the unexpected with an Emergency Fund | Emirates NBD
section: Be ready for the unexpected with an Emergency Fund

text:
Be ready for the unexpected with an Emergency Fund | Emirates NBD > Be ready for the unexpected with an Emergency Fund

**It’s for your peace of mind**  
An emergency fund might not be the most exciting financial decision you can make, but it could be one of the most important. Knowing you have money for emergencies will provide you with that extra peace of mind in your financial life, and allow you to sleep better at night.

text:
Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Why take a personal loan?

## Why take a personal loan?  
A personal loan can be used for large purchases, emergency expenses and so much more.  
Some of the top reasons people take personal loans are for home upgrades or moving house, going on a holiday, purchasing expensive appliances or other equipment, wedding expenses and even college expenses.  
Emirates NBD personal loans can help you with anything you need extra cash for. Our application process is simple and quick with minimal documentation. You can get pre-qualified right away.
title: Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Eligibility

## Eligibility  
To apply for a personal loan, you should be:  
* a UAE national or a UAE resident
* between 21 and 60 years old
* earning a minimum salary of 5,000
* working for a company that falls under our approved list of employers  
If you’re self-employed, your business should be operational for at least 2 years, and you must have a minimum 6-month balance of at least 50,000.  
Learn more [here](/en/loans/personal-loans).  
If you’d like to talk to us, fill in this [form](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/apply-now-form/personal-loan/?product=pl&etm_action=pl-featured) and one of our personal loan experts will call you back.
title: Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Documents required

## Documents required  
The bank requires the following documents to process your personal loan. If you don’t have any of them, or if you have any questions, please visit a branch and we’ll be happy to help.  
* Your passport
* A valid UAE residency visa and Emirates ID with copies
* Staff ID, Labor Card or Work ID
* Your latest salary certificate
* Last 3-month bank statement
* A security cheque  
**Note:**If additional documents are required, we’ll inform you during the application process.
title: Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Fees and charges

## Fees and charges  
Here are the fees and charges for a personal loan:  
* Loan Processing Fee: 1.05% of the loan amount (inclusive of VAT), or a minimum of 500 and a maximum 2,500 + VAT.
* Credit Life Insurance Coverage: Free of charge  
Read more about our [fees and charges](/-/media/enbd/files/others/fees-and-charges/loans/personal/personal_loans_price_guide.pdf).
title: Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[What can I use a personal loan for?](#faqs-what-can-i-use-a-personal-loan-for "What can I use a personal loan for")  
A personal loan can be used for a variety of reasons. It can help finance big purchases or can be used for home renovation, holiday expenses, emergencies, wedding expenses, education fees, or even debt consolidation if the interest rate is attractive enough.  
[What is EMI, and how is it calculated?](#faqs-what-is-emi-and-how-is-it-calculated "What is EMI and how is it calculated")  
EMI stands for Equated Monthly Installments. It’s the amount you pay back to the bank every month until you pay off the total loan amount due. The EMI is calculated considering the loan amount, the tenure of the loan and the interest rate on the borrowed sum.  
[How will I receive the funds once my personal loan is approved?](#faqs-how-will-i-receive-the-funds-once-my-personal-loan-is-approved "How will I receive the funds once my personal loan is approved")  
The money will be credited to your Emirates NBD account after deducting fees and charges. In case you hold multiple accounts with us, we will credit your loan amount to the account which was specified in your loan application.  
If you do not hold an account with us, the loan amount will be issued as a manager’s cheque towards the account you hold at another local bank.
title: Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a Personal Loan | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

If you do not hold an account with us, the loan amount will be issued as a manager’s cheque towards the account you hold at another local bank.  
[What is the maximum amount and tenure for a personal loan?](#faqs-what-is-the-maximum-amount-and-tenure-for-a-personal-loan "What is the maximum amount and tenure for a personal loan")  
The maximum amount and tenure for a personal loan will vary based on your age, salary, employment tenure and length of relationship with the bank.  
The maximum tenure for a self-employed individual is 4 years.

[What is Sheikh Zayed Housing programme(SZHP)?](#accordion-c90ddc54-8552-4ea6-ab35-cee9bc57cdd6 "What is Sheikh Zayed Housing programmeSZHP")  
The Sheikh Zayed Housing Program is a government initiative aimed at providing affordable housing solutions to eligible customers.  
[Who is eligible for a home loan under this programme?](#accordion-5a0f0ba4-e51d-471c-b594-86ce6e76d454 "Who is eligible for a home loan under this programme")  
The programme is exclusive for UAE Nationals as per the list that SZHP provides to Emirates NBD.  
[What are the benefits of obtaining a home loan through Emirates NBD under this programme?](#accordion-b956a594-ee80-4fba-be14-1f628f2ca9a4 "What are the benefits of obtaining a home loan through Emirates NBD under this programme")  
Emirates NBD offers interest free for maximum finance amount of 800,000 and competitive interest rates flexible repayment options and personalized assistance throughout the loan process.  
[Do I have to transfer my salary to Emirates NBD to apply?](#accordion-a5b365c5-572b-4df0-907b-52d744fdfa56 "Do I have to transfer my salary to Emirates NBD to apply")  
No, a salary transfer is not mandatory. However, you are encouraged to transfer your salary to Emirates NBD if you intend to avail other benefits, we offer to the UAE national segment.  
[What loan finance is available?](#accordion-3738b252-dfa5-40a5-b54c-660879e8c299 "What loan finance is available")

text:
Sheikh Zayed Housing Program (SZHP) | Emirati Home Loan | Emirates NBD > Getting started

[What loan finance is available?](#accordion-3738b252-dfa5-40a5-b54c-660879e8c299 "What loan finance is available")  
The maximum home finance amount available is 800,000 (interest free - at an interest rate subsidized by SZHP). If you require an additional finance amount, subject to your eligibility, the financing will be provided based on a special competitive commercial rate.  
[What is the loan tenor available for home loan under this programme?](#accordion-1af14c91-b82d-41a3-9ee3-9b45eb6e6903 "What is the loan tenor available for home loan under this programme")  
The maximum finance tenor is 25 years.  
[At what rate is the financing provided?](#accordion-e34ecc33-574e-479c-bebd-ae3755cd38e4 "At what rate is the financing provided")  
The financing of the 800,000 amount is interest free for the customer. Any additional amount required will be given back on your eligibility and on a special competitive commercial rate.  
[What type of properties can be financed under this programme?](#accordion-9a7b43d7-e718-40cf-8dbf-d859fc655c61 "What type of properties can be financed under this programme")  
Financing is provided for both self-construction and ready property projects as follows:  
* Ready property finance – developed by SZHP
* Ready property finance – developer or secondary market in the UAE
* Self-construction finance – on own or gifted plot

**Maximum eligible spends**  
In a given statement cycle, Miles can be earned for eligible spends up to the credit limit, or 100,000 for Skywards Infinite Card / 50,000 for Skywards Signature Card, whichever is lower. Miles will be awarded for eligible transactions in chronological order up to the credit limit or above stated cap, whicheveris lower.  
**Retail spends**  
* Grocery and supermarkets, fast food restaurants, insurance, car dealership earn 25% of domestic spends\*
* Petroleum, transit, government services, utility payments, real estate, education & telecommunications payments earn 10% of the domestic spends\*  
**Duty free, online food delivery and car booking apps**  
* Domestic and international Duty free spends, domestic online food delivery and car booking apps spends earn 2 Miles per USD equivalent; spend on Skywards Infinite Card. 1.5 Miles per USD equivalent spend on Skywards Signature Card  
**International spends**  
Spends made abroad on groceries and supermarkets, insurance, car dealerships, fast food, real estate, education, petrol, government services and utility payments including telecom, earn Miles as per normal international spends.  
Retail spends on merchants in the EU earn 50% of the international spends.

## Adapting to Unpredictability
