text:
Privacy and Security | Security Banking | Safeguard your Information | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

In BankNet, customer information and account data is protected by two independent security protocols: data encryption and a verifiable Password. When customers use BankNet, they are first prompted to enter their Password . The EB computer will not send any account information to the customer's computer unless the Password associated with the User ID has been correctly entered. All information that passes between Emirates NBD and the customer's computer is put through data encryption.  
[How do I know if my banking session is encrypted?](#accordion-8faf38c2-5d17-4584-996c-5d5a504ff780 "How do I know if my banking session is encrypted")  
Your banking session data is encrypted when the key icon appears in the lower left corner of your screen in Netscape's Navigator, and when it appears in Microsoft's Explorer.  
If you're using a version of Netscape Navigator with domestic-grade encryption running, a key icon will appear in the lower left corner of your screen.  
When not in a secure session, Netscape's appears broken and Microsoft's is not shown.  
[What type of encryption do I need?](#accordion-ebc7ff6b-63ac-4f49-8b56-b8feddf8e695 "What type of encryption do I need")  
You need to use a browser with 128-bit encryption for using BankNet.  
[Why BankNet Requires 128-Bit Encryption?](#accordion-c6e5c2cd-f8d8-40a1-860b-ec96b8371d80 "Why BankNet Requires 128Bit Encryption")

text:

[Why BankNet Requires 128-Bit Encryption?](#accordion-c6e5c2cd-f8d8-40a1-860b-ec96b8371d80 "Why BankNet Requires 128Bit Encryption")  
Emirates NBD is concerned about the security of your transactions. Our success as a financial institution depends on our ability to manage these systems safely and to continue to earn your trust as our customer. By requiring 128-bit encryption, we are assuring the highest level of commercially available security for your financial transactions.  
[What is a browser and what does it do?](#accordion-7a2a9334-c3c1-4fc2-b740-68d9ac5aee02 "What is a browser and what does it do")  
A browser is a software used use to surf the Web. In the absence of a browser you cannot visit a Website and view its contents, graphics and other information.  
[What makes one browser more secure than another?](#accordion-9cf05229-37e9-47cd-bcb2-0904c84be41c "What makes one browser more secure than another")  
Browsers offer varying degrees of security, particularly in regard to encryption:  
* Some browsers allow you to encrypt information, so that the information is scrambled as it passes over the Internet.
* Some browsers offer more secure forms of encryption than other browsers do.
* Even the same version of a browser can come with different levels of encryption. Netscape Navigator 3.0, for example, comes with either 40-bit encryption or the more secure 128-bit encryption.

# Terms & Conditions  
## Emirates NBD Debit Card Campaign  
**Promotion Period:**  15 May – 15 August 2023  
**Applicable for:**  Selected Emirates NBD Visa Debit Cardholders  
**Qualifying Customer:**  
Solely determined by the bank.  
**Qualifying Spends:**  
* Only spends made during the campaign period.
* Supplementary Debit Cards attached to the qualifying Primary Debit Card will also be included towards determining the Qualifying spend.
* Transactions on the card in the form of reversals, refunds or disputed purchases during the Promotion Period will be deducted from the Qualifying Spends/ transactions.
* Domestic and International cash withdrawals are not eligible spends for the purpose of this promotion.
* In case of any other campaigns/promotion being run during the same period, the reward will be awarded for any one qualifying campaign only.
* To qualify for the reward, cardholders should spend the minimum amount during the campaign period on the Debit Card as communicated to them through direct communication.
* Cardholders should also register/opt in for this promotion. Customer can opt in through ATM/Email/Mobile and Online Banking or by sending SMS “RETEN” to 4456 from the mobile number registered with Emirates NBD. Regardless of the opt-in date, all spends made during the campaign period from the start date will qualify towards the campaign.

Home Loans for UAE Nationals | Emirati Mortgage | Emirates NBD > Borrow wisely – a few things you should know

### Borrow wisely – a few things you should know  
* If you don’t make the monthly payments towards your loan on time, you will incur a late payment fee
* Missing repayments can affect your credit score, limiting your ability to access loans or financing in the future
* If you refinance your loan or defer your payments, your loan will take longer to pay back, and you may pay more interest
* If you can’t meet a monthly payment, [apply in advance for a deferment](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/defer-your-loan-payments). You can do this up to twice a year  
It’s important to read the terms and conditions and know the fees and charges before you apply for a loan.

Know more about the DLD FTHBProgram

![purchasing1](/-/media/enbd/images/loan/home-loans/det/purchasing-process-off-plan.jpg?la=en&h=667&w=1000&hash=2F1BB6D8FA91117C163A9259BA4DB2CC)  
**Purchasing Process for an Off-Plan Properties**  
* Partnered developers can see list of customers who have shown interest into their projects.
* For any planned launches developers reach out to eligible customers to inform them about the project and dedicated units for FTH Program.
* If customers were to show interest in project, then they submit EOI and books their property.
* Following booking completion, developer completes “Oqood” registration in DLD system.
* Customers who become property owners, are removed from the system by DLD.  
![purchasing2](/-/media/enbd/images/loan/home-loans/det/purchasing-process-ready-prop.jpg?la=en&h=667&w=1000&hash=5D1A2E8FCB92F97AE6A5750CD72F707E)  
**Purchasing Process for Ready Properties**  
* Customers shortlist a ready property from secondary market.
* Customers wishes to finance their purchase, with Home Loan from Emirates NBD, reaches out to bank
* Bank representatives checks whether the customers are verified participants of the program
* If customers are verified through DLD portal, bank provides the special offer to applicant.

##  
It is open to all registered business entities operating in Trading, Manufacturing, Contracting, Transportation and Professional or any of the Service sectors in the UAE, wherein at least one signatory is a UAE resident.  
##  
There are many important banking services that financial institutions can provide, however, the top 6 to look out for are:  
* **Deposits:** Business banking will be able to help businesses with their day-to-day operations by allowing them to make and receive payments, manage their cash flow, and separate different types of transactions.
* **Lending:** Business banking can offer all kinds of credit options such as loans, asset-based loans, and other lines of credit to enable businesses to operate and grow.
* **Treasury and payments:** Businesses often have large sums of money moving in and out of their accounts, so many business bank account providers will provide treasury management services to help businesses manage their cash flow and liquidity.
* **Cash Management offerings:** Our efficient and effective cash management solutions cover your regular and routine payments, as well as collections and overall liquidity, empowering you to explore opportunities.
* **Forex Exchange Solutions:** Many banks now offer international banking services, such as foreign exchange services, or connections to payment systems for secure, fast, international payments.

##  
* You can register for businessONLINE upon account opening. We will send your login credentials with your Account Opening Welcome Pack.
* You can manage your business account seamlessly and cost effectively through **businessONLINE** or the [**businessONLINE X app**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/business-online/businessonline-mobile-app) anytime, from anywhere. Alternatively, you can visit any Emirates NBD branch or visit one of the many Business Banking Centers in the UAE.  
##  
To enable seamless account opening, we have listed the documents required at the beginning of your application. Please note that any delay in submitting these documents could lead to a delay in your application.  
Below are the mandatory documents required:  
* Valid Trade License/Commercial License
* Attested Memorandum of Association, Article of Association, Board of Resolution, General Partnership Contract & all its Amendments (if any)
* Identity documents of all shareholders, partners: Emirates ID and passport copies
* Tenancy contract as proof of address.

Manage your credit card limits | Support | Emirates NBD > Manage your credit card limits

## Manage your credit card limits  
Your credit card limit is assigned by the bank after taking several factors into consideration including the type of credit card, your income, the company you work for, your financial history and debt burden ratio.
title: Manage your credit card limits | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Manage your credit card limits | Support | Emirates NBD > Understanding your limits

## Understanding your limits  
**Credit card limit:** Thisis the maximum amount you can spend using your credit card.  
**Outstanding balance**or**utilised limit**: This isthe amount you spend and need to repay, at least in part before your payment due date.  
**A****vailable credit limit:** This is what's left after what you've spent or utilised from your credit card limit.  
If you hold one or more supplementary credit cards, these cards will utilise a percentage of your total credit card limit. For example, if your credit card has a total limit of 10,000, and you assign your supplementary credit card 10% of your limit, the supplementary card holder can use 1,000 of your primary credit card limit.
title: Manage your credit card limits | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Manage your credit card limits | Support | Emirates NBD > Increase your primary credit card limit

## Increase your primary credit card limit  
To apply for a credit limit increase on your credit card you must meet the following criteria:  
* Your card should be active
* You should be holding the card for at least 6 months
* If your salary has increased, the six-month wait does not apply, but you must update our records with your new salary details  
**Use one of the options below to apply for a limit increase on your card:**  
Keep **[these documents](#topic-documents-required-for-primary-credit-card-limit-increase)**ready to complete your request.  
**What’s next?**  
Your request will be reviewed and processed within 6 working days. You’ll receive an email and SMS once your request is processed.  
If you don’t hear from us, you can track the status of your request by calling [+971 600 54 0000](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say 'track service request'.
title: Manage your credit card limits | Support | Emirates NBD
section: Increase your primary credit card limit

text:
Manage your credit card limits | Support | Emirates NBD > Documents required for primary credit card limit increase

## Documents required for primary credit card limit increase  
The documents required to increase your primary credit card limit depend on your employment status and the bank to which you are currently transferring your salary. The following are the documents you should keep ready depending on your situation:  
**If your salary is being transferred to Emirates NBD**  
* Copies of your passport and Emirates ID
* Your salary certificate (not more than 1 month old)
* Pay slips for the last 3 months  
**If your salary is being transferred to another bank**  
* Copies of your passport and Emirates ID
* Your salary certificate (not more than 1 month old)
* Original bank statements for the last 3 months
* Pay slips for the last 3 months  
**If you’re self-employed**  
* Copies of your passport and Emirates ID
* Trade License
* Memorandum of Association (MOA)
* Company or personal account bank statement for the last 3 months
* Power of Attorney (if signatory is not available)

text:
Manage your credit card limits | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[Will I receive a new credit card once my limit is increased?](#faqs-will-i-receive-a-new-credit-card-once-my-limit-is-increased "Will I receive a new credit card once my limit is increased")  
No, your credit limit will be increased on your existing credit card.  
[How can I track my supplementary card holder’s credit limit utilisation?](#faqs-how-can-i-track-my-supplementary-card-holder-credit-limit-utilisation "How can I track my supplementary card holders credit limit utilisation")  
You can view your supplementary credit cardholder’s limit utilisation or transaction history via Online and Mobile Banking. Your supplementary card holder’s transactions will also be listed in your monthly credit card statements.  
[What is the maximum amount that I can increase my credit card limit by?](#faqs-whats-the-maximum-amount-that-i-can-increase-my-credit-card-limit-by "What is the maximum amount that I can increase my credit card limit by")  
Your credit limit is based on a number of factors including income, payment and spending history on your card, your credit score etc. The bank will always process your request for the maximum eligible amount.  
[What happens if I use my entire credit card limit?](#faqs-what-happens-if-i-use-my-entire-credit-card-limit "What happens if I use my entire credit card limit")

text:
Manage your credit card limits | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

Emirates NBD Credit Cards have a buffer limit which allows you to complete a purchase that is higher than your current available credit limit. Based on the type of credit card you hold, your buffer limit can range between 3% and 15% of your total credit limit.  
Spending more than your assigned credit limit will incur over-limit charges.  
Always keep track of your credit card transactions and available limit. It’s easy via Online and Mobile Banking.  
**Online Banking****:**Go to**My Finances > Cards**  
**Mobile Banking:**  
Click on![](/-/media/enbd/images/help-and-support/icons/hamburger-200x200.png) and then Credit Cards.  
[How much of my credit limit can be used for cash advances?](#faqs-how-much-of-my-credit-limit-can-be-used-for-cash-advances "How much of my credit limit can be used for cash advances")  
You can use up to 75% of your total credit limit for cash advances on business credit cards and 50% of your total credit limit for cash advances on any other credit card.  
[Is it possible to transfer some of my credit limit from one of my credit cards to another?](#faqs-is-it-possible-to-transfer-some-of-my-credit-limit-from-one-of-my-credit-cards-to-another "Is it possible to transfer some of my credit limit from one of my credit cards to another")  
You can only transfer a portion of your credit limit from a non-Web Shopper credit card to your Web Shopper card. You can’t transfer credit limit between non-Web Shopper credit cards.

## Safeguard your Smart Pass PIN  
Never share your [banking PIN](/en/help-and-support/change-your-card-pin)with anyone including your Smart Pass PIN. It's a good security practice to change these PINs every few months.  
If you've forgotten yourSmart Pass PIN, or just need to change it, you can do it in a few simple steps outlined below.

text:

## Should you change or reset your PIN?  
You should change your Smart Pass PIN if you have security concerns or if someone else has had access to it. To change your PIN, you need to know the old one. If you don’t know your old PIN, [reset the PIN](/en/help-and-support/reset-your-card-pin)instead.

## How to change your Smart Pass PIN

Change your PIN if you know your old PIN. Otherwise, reset it. You could also choose one of the options below:  
Through **Profile and Settings**

Through **Services**

text:
Reset or change your Smart Pass PIN | Support | Emirates NBD > How to reset your Smart Pass PIN

## How to reset your Smart Pass PIN  
If you’ve forgotten your Smart Pass PIN, here are the steps to reset it.  
There are two ways to reset your Smart Pass PIN:  
**ENBD X**  
Through **Profile and Settings**  
* Log in to**[Mobile Banking](/en/ways-of-banking/enbd-x)**
* Tap ![](/-/media/enbd/icons/Support-articles-for-ENBDX/Profile.svg) in the top left corner of the app
* Tap **Security** and under Smart Pass, tap **Set a new PIN**
* Tap **Forgot Smart Pass Pin >>**
* Verify your email by clicking on the link sent to your registered email address > **Next**
* Enter the authorization code sent to your registered mobile number > **Next**
* Enter and confirm your new Smart Pass PIN
* Follow the instructions and tap **Call Emirates NBD.** Make sure to have your card number available with you when prompted on the call  
You will receive a message that your Smart Pass PIN has been activated.  
Through **Services**  
* Log in to **[Mobile Banking](/en/ways-of-banking/enbd-x)**
* Tap![](/-/media/enbd/icons/Support-articles-for-ENBDX/Services-icon.svg)on the bottom of the app
* Tap **Apply for New Service** > **Profile** > **Change Smart Pass PIN** > **Set a new PIN**
* Tap **Forgot Smart Pass Pin >>**
* Verify your email by clicking on the link sent to your registered email address > **Next**
* Enter the authorization code sent to your registered mobile number > **Next**
* Enter and confirm your new Smart Pass PIN

## FAQs  
[Once I receive my authorisation code to reset my Smart Pass PIN, how long is it valid for?](#faqs-once-i-receive-my-authorisation-code-to-reset-my-smart-pass-pin-how-long-is-it-valid-for "Once I receive my authorisation code to reset my Smart Pass PIN how long is it valid for")  
Your authorisation codewill be valid for 15 minutes after which you'll need to reset it.  
[Can I install Smart Pass on two devices?](#faqs-can-i-install-smart-pass-on-two-devices "Can I install Smart Pass on two devices")  
Smart Pass can be activated only on one device. You can do transactions from other devices, but you have to authorise those transactions by [generating a Smart Pass token or push notification](/en/help-and-support/using-smart-pass) on the device which has Smart Pass on it.  
[What happens if I lose my phone with Smart Pass on it?](#faqs-what-happens-if-i-lose-my-phone-with-smart-pass-on-it "What happens if I lose my phone with Smart Pass on it")  
If your phone is lost or stolen, you should deactivate your Smart Pass immediately by activating it on another device, or call us on [+971 600 54 0000](tel:971600540000)and when prompted, say ‘deactivate Smart Pass’.

#### Fake emails? Check first. Click next.  
[Know more](/en/fraud-awareness/iban-fraud-awareness)  
Online fraud is on the rise, and fraudulent websites are becoming more sophisticated. So protect your business from online scams by staying vigilant. Fraudulent websites often look identical to the real ones, but a closer inspection of the URL can reveal their true nature. Keep an eye out for extra characters, misspellings or suspicious extensions and always verify before you transact.

Fraudsters often create fake websites with subtle spelling changes to deceive you

Never click on any links without verifying their authenticity  
**Stay vigilant against fraud**  
If you detect any fraudulent activity, please contact us immediately on **[600 54 0009](tel:600540009)** and when prompted, please say “Emergency”.

## It's instant and free  
[DirectRemit](/en/foreign-exchange/directremit)allows you to transfer money instantly and for free to banks in the countries listed below.  
DirectRemit is meant for personal transactions only, and you need to transfer a minimum of 100.  
- **Country**: India; **Upper limit per transfer**: INR 1,000,000
- **Country**: Philippines; **Upper limit per transfer**: PHP 500,000
- **Country**: Pakistan; **Upper limit per transfer**: PKR 1,000,000
- **Country**: Egypt; **Upper limit per transfer**: EGP 250,000
- **Country**: UK; **Upper limit per transfer**: GBP 25,000
- **Country**: Sri Lanka; **Upper limit per transfer**: LKR 999,999  
\*Philippines real time credit is only PHP 50,000.  
###### Can’t use DirectRemit?  
To transfer to countries or banks that are currently not available for DirectRemit transfers, you can use our regular [international transfers](/en/help-and-support/make-an-international-transfer).

## Processing time and charges  
Depending on when you initiate your DirectRemit transfer, it would take near real time transfer. Each of our DirectRemit countries have its own processing and crediting schedules. These vary depending on the country and bank to which you are transferring.  
DirectRemits are free of charge.  
Learn more about DirectRemit services[here](/en/foreign-exchange/directremit).

Use DirectRemit to make a transfer | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[Can I set up a standing order for DirectRemit transfers?](#faqs-can-i-set-up-a-standing-order-for-directremit-transfers "Can I set up a standing order for DirectRemit transfers")  
No, you can’t set up a standing instruction for DirectRemit transfers.  
[Can I reverse a DirectRemit transfer if I've provided incorrect details?](#faqs-can-i-reverse-a-directremit-transfer-if-i-provide-incorrect-details "Can I reverse a DirectRemit transfer if Ive provided incorrect details")  
No, you can’t reverse a DirectRemit transfer. If the details you have provided are inaccurate, then the transfer will be returned to your Emirates NBD account within 3 to 5 working days. You’ll be liable to bear the exchange loss, should there be any.  
[Why is there a delay in my DirectRemit transfer?](#faqs-why-is-there-a-delay-in-my-directremit-transfer "Why is there a delay in my DirectRemit transfer")  
Here are some of the reasons DirectRemit can be delayed:  
* The transfer was initiated after processing hours, or it’s a bank holiday in the recipient’s country. Your request will then be processed the next working day.
* Your beneficiary details are inaccurate, or your transfer was made for business and not personal purposes.
* The Bank may require more information for some transfers. If this is the case, your request will need to be processed using Emirates NBD’s regular international transfer service.

Group Compliance | Emirates NBD > Last week, Shayne Nelson, Group CEO, inaugurated the Group Compliance annual conference - Compliance University 2024.

# Group Compliance  
##  
### Last week, Shayne Nelson, Group CEO, inaugurated the Group Compliance annual conference - Compliance University 2024.  
In his speech, at the much awaited, in-person meet conducted from 30 April - 1 May at the Emirates NBD Group Head Office in Dubai, Shayne highlighted the Bank’s overall vision, priorities, growth trajectory and expectations from Compliance as a trusted partner of Business and a key support function of the Bank. Victor Matafonov, Group Chief Compliance Officer, covered in detail, Group Compliance’s specific objectives, milestones, and focus areas for 2024, aligned with the Bank’s strategy.  
Aptly termed Compliance University, aiming to engage, educate and inspire, the conference provided a platform for thought provoking discussions, exchange of ideas and solution seeking for challenges faced by local and international teams, as well as an open forum for the delegates to put burning questions to senior management, including the Group CEO. Through an exciting line-up of presentations, Q&A sessions, workshops, a gamified quiz, team building and networking activities, a broad spectrum of significant and topical Compliance issues were covered. Key themes centered around harnessing new technologies especially AI and GenAI, advanced data analytics, increasingly complex regulatory landscape, and developing the Compliance workforce of the future.

The offer is available across **all Emirates NBD credit cards**, with **exclusive 5% cashback** as noon credits for **noon One Visa Credit Cardholders**.

Joining fee: Free for life / No Annual fee  
[Required Documents](#accordion-f7541ed6-baae-4d7f-90d2-139d0fa51424 "Required Documents")  
* Duly filled Credit Card application
* Original Emirates ID and copy with passport copy
* Latest salary certificate for salaried individuals
* Trade license for non-individuals
* Latest 3-month original bank statements (or mini ATM statements)
* Security cheque  
[Credit card limit increase](#accordion-e86c17c9-c81b-4390-b537-9ce358ddc668 "Credit card limit increase")  
* Original passport and copy with visa page
* Emirates ID and copy
* Salaried individual banking with Emirates NBD:
+ Latest salary certificate (not more than 1 month old)
+ Pay slip in case the salary variance is over 10%

## What is Smart Pass?  
Smart Pass is Emirates NBD’s digital banking security feature that serves as a secure replacement for SMS authorisation codes.  
Once you activate Smart Pass, you can authorise all your Online and Mobile Banking transactions and requests instantly using a Smart Pass PIN.  
Key benefits include:  
* Secure approval using a PIN or biometrics
* Works even without mobile network coverage
* Faster transaction authorisation compared to SMS OTPs
title: How to Activate Smart Pass | Help and Support | Emirates NBD

text:
How to Activate Smart Pass | Help and Support | Emirates NBD > System requirements

## System requirements  
To successfully activate and use Smart Pass, please ensure that you’re using the latest version of the Emirates NBD mobile app and that your mobile device meets the following requirements:  
* Android version 11 and above, or IOS version 16.0 and above  
+ To check whichAndroid version you have on your phone, go to Settings > About Device/Phone > Software information
+ To check whichIOS version is running on your phone, go to Settings > General > About > Software Version  
* Set the Date and Time settings on your mobile device to Automatic
title: How to Activate Smart Pass | Help and Support | Emirates NBD

text:
How to Activate Smart Pass | Help and Support | Emirates NBD > Activate Smart Pass now

## Activate Smart Pass now  
****If you have migrated from the old app to ENBD X****  
* Log in with your username and password
* A banner will appear to activate Smart Pass. Tap **Activate Now**.
* Review the terms and conditions and **Slide to Confirm**
* Verify your registered email address and verify your identity using a selfie
* Enter and confirm your new Smart Pass PIN and tap **Next**  
Your Smart Pass will be activated instantly.  
Through **Profile and Settings**  
* Log in to ****[Mobile Banking](/en/ways-of-banking/enbd-x)****
* Tap the Profile iconon the top left corner of the app
* Tap **Security** and under Smart Pass, tap **Set a new PIN**
* Set and confirm your new Smart Pass PIN
* Verify your registered email address and verify your identity using a selfie  
Your Smart Pass will be activated instantly.  
Through **Services**  
* Log in to**[Mobile Banking](/en/ways-of-banking/enbd-x)**
* Tapthe Services iconon the bottom of the app
* Tap **Apply for New Service** > **Profile** > **Activate Smart Pass** or search ‘smart’ and select it from your search results
* Set and confirm your new Smart Pass PIN  
Your Smart Pass will be activated instantly.  
**If you are doing a transaction but don’t have Smart Pass**  
If you are not registered for Smart Pass and you are trying to complete any transaction that requires Smart Pass PIN, you will be prompted to activate your Smart Pass. Follow the steps below:  
* Tap **Activate Now** displayed on the banner

text:
How to Activate Smart Pass | Help and Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[Is it possible to activate my Smart Pass on multiple mobile devices?](#faqs-is-it-possible-to-activate-my-smart-pass-on-multiple-mobile-devices "Is it possible to activate my Smart Pass on multiple mobile devices")  
No, you can only activate Smart Pass on one mobile device at any given time. If you already have your Smart Pass configured to a mobile device, activating it on any other device will deactivate it on your first device.  
[How do I activate my Smart Pass on another mobile device?](#faqs-how-do-i-activate-my-smart-pass-on-a-different-mobile-device "How do I activate my Smart Pass on another mobile device")  
To activate Smart Pass on a new mobile device, you will first need to deactivate it from the previous one. To do so, download the ENBD X mobile app in your new device and log in with your username and password.If you have an Android device, you will need to activate/enable biometrics and then follow the steps to activate Smart Pass.  
[Can multiple users activate their Smart Pass on the same mobile device?](#faqs-can-multiple-users-activate-their-smart-pass-on-the-same-mobile-device "Can multiple users activate their Smart Pass on the same mobile device")  
No, a mobile device can be configured with only one user’s Smart Pass.
title: How to Activate Smart Pass | Help and Support | Emirates NBD

[Does my Smart Pass get deactivated if my Online and Mobile Banking profile is blocked?](#faqs-does-my-smart-pass-get-deactivated-if-my-onlinemobile-banking-profile-is-blocked "Does my Smart Pass get deactivated if my Online and Mobile Banking profile is blocked")  
No, it won’t. Once you [unblock your Online and Mobile Banking profile](/en/help-and-support/unlock-your-online-mobile-banking), you’ll be able to continue using Smart Pass.  
[Can I use Smart Pass if I have touch ID or face ID enabled on my mobile phone?](#faqs-can-i-use-smart-pass-if-i-have-touch-id-face-id-enabled-on-my-mobile-phone "Can I use Smart Pass if I have touch ID or face ID enabled on my mobile phone")  
Yes, you can. Once you enable this, you'll be authorising your transactions via touch ID or face ID.  
[I’m unable to active Smart Pass. What should I do?](#faqs-i-am-unable-to-active-smart-pass-what-should-i-do "Im unable to active Smart Pass. What should I do")  
Smart Pass activation may fail for the following reasons:  
* **Online or Mobile Banking profile is blocked** - Smart Pass can only be activated on an active profile.
* **Registered email or mobile number is outdated** - Activation requires verification codes sent to registered contact details

[I’m unable to authorise transactions with Smart Pass. What do I do?](#faqs-i-am-unable-to-authorise-transactions-with-smart-pass "Im unable to authorise transactions with Smart Pass. What do I do")  
Common reasons include:  
* **Incorrect PIN entered multiple times** - Entering the wrong PIN 3 times blocks Smart Pass.
* **Multiple screens or tabs open during the transaction** - This may cause the transaction to be cancelled.  
[How long is the Smart Pass PIN reset authorisation code valid?](#faqs-how-long-is-the-smart-pass-pin-reset-authorisation-code-valid "How long is the Smart Pass PIN reset authorisation code valid")  
The authorisation code is valid for 15 minutes.  
[What to do if the phone with Smart Pass is lost?](#faqs-what-to-do-if-the-phone-with-smart-pass-is-lost "What to do if the phone with Smart Pass is lost")  
Call us on **[600 54 0000](tel:600540000)** in the UAE or **[+971 600 54 0000](tel:+971600540000)** from abroad to block the profile.

## What are people asking?  
[What is a Balance Transfer?](#accordion-6258d31c-070d-4885-be37-5dd1156171ec "What is a Balance Transfer")  
A Balance Transfer (BT) allows you to transfer outstanding balances from another bank’s credit card to your Emirates NBD Credit Card, converting them into an easy instalment plan with lower interest rates.  
If you don’t have an Emirates NBD Credit Card, you can [**apply**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/campaigns/credit-card-apply) for one now and then transfer your balance from another bank to us.  
[Who can apply for a Balance Transfer?](#accordion-091fac79-6840-4955-91b0-7e3aa4b45dee "Who can apply for a Balance Transfer")  
All primary Emirates NBD Credit Cardholders can apply for Balance Transfers.  
Anyone who doesn’t have an Emirates NBD Credit Card, can [**apply**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/campaigns/credit-card-apply) for one and then ask for a Balance Transfer.  
[What is the maximum amount I can transfer to Emirates NBD under a Balance Transfer?](#accordion-60b7d980-894b-4e20-a267-91391f34ae73 "What is the maximum amount I can transfer to Emirates NBD under a Balance Transfer")  
You can transfer up to 90% of your available credit limit, subject to eligibility and the available balance on your card.  
[Can I cancel my Balance Transfer early?](#accordion-5a3bd3b2-d0f5-4f36-a2c7-0d959d3cb071 "Can I cancel my Balance Transfer early")
title: Balance Transfer - Consolidate Debt at Lower Rates | Emirates NBD

text:
Balance Transfer - Consolidate Debt at Lower Rates | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[Can I cancel my Balance Transfer early?](#accordion-5a3bd3b2-d0f5-4f36-a2c7-0d959d3cb071 "Can I cancel my Balance Transfer early")  
Yes, you can cancel or prepay your Balance Transfer by contacting [**600 54 0000**](tel:00971600540000) (UAE) or [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600 540000), internationally.  
An early settlement fee of 1% of the outstanding principal plus 5% VAT will apply.  
[Are there any early settlement charges?](#accordion-92cc1531-d147-4ed8-b31a-872b052fa548 "Are there any early settlement charges")  
Yes, if you settle your Balance Transfer early, a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding plus 5% VAT, will apply for each plan.

[What are the charges for a Balance Transfer?](#accordion-02b96a25-b267-4531-a9bf-e84dc07367b3 "What are the charges for a Balance Transfer")  
Fees are determined by Emirates NBD and can change from time to time. Read more [**here**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/terms-and-conditions).  
[What is the interest rate on a Balance Transfer?](#accordion-d6278102-0912-4d89-9c54-aff601a721ca "What is the interest rate on a Balance Transfer")  
Interest is charged on a reducing monthly basis and is determined by Emirates NBD based on card usage and overall performance. Rates are subject to change from time to time.  
[How do I apply for a Balance Transfer?](#accordion-99d180a4-8482-443f-bdcc-f5dcf4be24ad "How do I apply for a Balance Transfer")

text:
Balance Transfer - Consolidate Debt at Lower Rates | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[How long does it take to process a Balance Transfer?](#accordion-445dc230-5edf-4025-b881-df62826121a2 "How long does it take to process a Balance Transfer")  
Your request will be processed within 5-7 working days and will be reflected from your second credit card statement onwards.  
The principal amount and the accrued interest up to the second card statement date will be included in the subsequent instalments starting from the second card statement.  
[How long can I take to repay a Credit Card balance I have transferred to Emirates NBD?](#accordion-f23db617-a250-43a1-98c1-a0f87f2e0258 "How long can I take to repay a Credit Card balance I have transferred to Emirates NBD")  
You can choose to repay instalments over 3,6,12, 18, 24, 36 or 48 months.  
[Is there a minimum amount to apply for a Balance Transfer?](#accordion-fc20f9d7-c1fe-4334-8288-3bf0e1debfb1 "Is there a minimum amount to apply for a Balance Transfer")  
Yes, you need to transfer a minimum of 1,000 for a Balance Transfer.  
[What happens if I fail to make payments on my Balance Transfer?](#accordion-5cb03621-92e6-494b-a419-5db0378d73ed "What happens if I fail to make payments on my Balance Transfer")  
If you fail to make payments, your Balance Transfer plan will be foreclosed, and the entire outstanding balance including any foreclosure fees will be due immediately, along with regular finance charges.
title: Balance Transfer - Consolidate Debt at Lower Rates | Emirates NBD

text:
Balance Transfer - Consolidate Debt at Lower Rates | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[Can I change my existing Balance Transfer plan?](#accordion-346d9708-13b2-4a0a-bca9-7c562c5e5f85 "Can I change my existing Balance Transfer plan")  
No, but you can foreclose your plan by paying a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding plus 5% VAT, then rebook the remaining balance into a new plan you wish to select.  
[What happens if I prepay what I owe for my Balance Transfer?](#accordion-2cd91907-186d-4f13-8c2b-2095917f032c "What happens if I prepay what I owe for my Balance Transfer")  
If you prepay intending to cancel the plan, you will need to contact our call center at [**600 54 0000**](tel:00971600540000) (UAE) or [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600 540000), internationally.  
The prepayment will be adjusted towards your outstanding balance and a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding plus 5% VAT will apply.  
[What happens if I close my Credit Card while I have a Balance Transfer plan?](#accordion-0b878693-4d1a-4b70-9e31-6432880ab635 "What happens if I close my Credit Card while I have a Balance Transfer plan")  
Active Balance Transfer plans must be foreclosed first and then your credit card cancellation request can be processed. Foreclosure fees will apply.  
[When is my first instalment amount billed?](#accordion-8d0a658b-0b54-45c2-85d6-9e9bdcc7b99d "When is my first instalment amount billed")  
The first instalment will reflect on the second card statement post booking.

Grow Your Wealth with Expert Banking | Emirates NBD > Investments

## Investments  
Our investment team is ready to advise you on a curated selection of investment options to help you achieve optimum returns on your capital. These include:  
#### Mutual Funds  
Mutual funds are pools of funds collected from many investors for investment in stocks, bonds or other assets. As an investor in a mutual fund, you own units in the fund, which is operated by a professional fund manager who aims to deliver capital gains and income for all the fund’s investors.  
[Read More](javascript:ENBD.OpenDialog('mutual_fund') "Mutual Funds")  
#### Bonds  
Bonds are debt securities issued by governments, corporations or other institutions to raise funds. They can provide a steady flow of investment income, and potentially lower the overall portfolio risks. As an investor in bonds, you typically receive interest payments at specific intervals (“coupon” payouts) and receive your initial capital back on maturity of the bond.  
#### Sukuks  
Sukuk is an Islamic financial certificate that represents a portion of ownership in a portfolio of eligible existing or future assets. They represent an undivided ownership in an asset or a special investment activity. The Sukuk issuer sells the certificates that represent an undivided ownership in the Trust assets to you and other investors. You are then entitled to the returns on the relevant assets throughout the Sukuk tenor.  
#### Structured Products
title: Grow Your Wealth with Expert Banking | Emirates NBD

text:
Grow Your Wealth with Expert Banking | Emirates NBD > Investments

#### Structured Products  
Structured products are designed to achieve risk-return objectives that are not achievable with traditional investments. When investing in structured products, your return on capital invested may be linked to the performance of an index, a "basket" of selected stocks, or other underlying traditional assets. Structured products may also include an element of principal protection.  
#### Gold Savings Certificates  
Gold savings certificates are sold in multiples of 300 grams (999 finesse) and 500 grams (995 finesse), priced against the global spot market. Used for investment or as a gift, each certificate is valid for five years from the date of issue. It can be redeemed against physical gold or the equivalent amount in cash at any time until maturity.

text:
Your credit score | Support | Emirates NBD > How does it work?

## How does it work?  
A credit score is a three-digit score that plays an important role in deciding how eligible you are for a loan or a credit card. The higher your credit score, the easier it is for you to get a loan or credit card from a bank. And the more benefits you enjoy like faster processing, less paperwork, low interest rates, high loan amounts and credit limits.  
**The Al Etihad Credit Bureau**  
In the UAE, the Al Etihad Credit Bureau (AECB) generates credit reports which include your credit score. These reports are made by gathering credit information such as number of loans, number of credit cards, payment history, utilisation of credit limit, debit cards, bounced cheques etc., from various sources such as banks, finance and insurance companies, telecom operators and service providers.  
**What’s a good score?**  
A credit score can be anything between 300 and 900. Anything above 700 is a good score. Anything below 400 is not, and your applications for loans and credit cards will likely not be entertained by any bank. So before applying, make sure your credit score is good to avoid rejection. A low score can be improved.  
**Know your credit score**  
It’s important to know your credit score – being informed will help you better manage your finances.
title: Your credit score | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Your credit score | Support | Emirates NBD > How does it work?

**Know your credit score**  
It’s important to know your credit score – being informed will help you better manage your finances.  
Apply for your credit score online at<https://aecb.gov.ae/creditscore>. You can also get it on the AECB app. You can get your entire credit report or only your credit score. There is a cost for both, so get only your credit score which is good enough to keep tabs on your rating.
title: Your credit score | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Your credit score | Support | Emirates NBD > Improve your credit score

## Improve your credit score  
Checking your credit report can tell you what’s pulling your score down.  
Things you can do to improve your credit score:  
* Making payments on or before the due date.
* Avoiding cheque bounces.
* Don’t apply for too much new credit. Reducing the number of active credit cards and loans you hold will improve your score.
* Pay off debts and don’t utilise all your available [credit limit](/en/help-and-support/manage-your-credit-card-limits).
* Dispute inaccuracies. Inaccurate information on your report can drag your score down.
title: Your credit score | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Your credit score | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[Can I improve my credit score within a month?](#faqs-can-i-improve-my-credit-score-within-a-month "Can I improve my credit score within a month")  
For most people, this can’t happen. But paying your bills on time, paying off your debt and not using up all your credit limit will improve your credit score within a few months.  
[What hurts my credit score the most?](#faqs-what-hurts-my-credit-score-the-most "What hurts my credit score the most")  
Missed payments, bounced cheques, having too many credit cards and loans, using your entire credit limit are all factors that will hurt your score.  
[How can I fix incorrect information appearing in my Credit Report?](#faqs-how-can-i-fix-incorrect-information-appearing-in-my-credit-report "How can I fix incorrect information appearing in my Credit Report")  
The information in your Credit Report is provided to the AECB by banks, finance companies, telecom companies and other service providers. If you find any inaccuracies in your Credit Report, Al Etihad Credit Bureau can assist you to raise it with the respective information provider.

# 5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE  
14 January 2026  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![5smartwaystosaveforyourfirsthomeintheuae](/-/media/enbd/images/knowledge-hub/5smart_ways_to_save_new.jpg?la=en&h=600&w=800&hash=84672880D3733AA900261A048B44F7B3)  
##### Purchasing a first home in the UAE is a significant milestone, symbolising independence, stability and long-term security  
Purchasing a first home in the UAE is a significant milestone, symbolising independence, stability and long-term security. Although accumulating funds for that first deposit may be challenging given increasing living expenses, a systematic approach combine ed with effective banking solutions can make this considerably more manageable.  
Here are five practical strategies to confidently begin building your home deposit.
title: 5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE
section: 5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE

text:
5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE > **Pay Yourself First**

## **Pay Yourself First**  
A great way to build up your home deposit is to make saving a top priority before spending anything else. Think of your savings as a fixed monthly expense, much like paying a utility bill, so it becomes part of your financial routine. Each time you receive your salary, immediately transfer a set amount into your savings account.  
Arranging an automatic transfer from your Emirates NBD Current Account to a separate savings account can keep you on track. This method reduces the temptation to use money meant for your future home and helps you follow a steady plan toward reaching your saving goals.
title: 5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE

text:
5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE > **Choose the right savings account**

## **Choose the right savings account**  
The right savings product can make a meaningful difference over time.  
* The Plus Saver Account offers competitive interest rates and can be opened instantly through the ENBD X app
* If you are comfortable setting money aside for a fixed period, Fixed Deposits allow you to earn potentially higher returns while keeping your capital secure
* If you have multiple goals, Goal Recurring Deposit helps you prioritise your home deposit through fixed monthly contributions, while offering flexibility to support other goals over time  
Selecting a savings option that matches your time horizon and risk comfort helps your deposit grow more efficiently.
title: 5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE

text:
5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE > **Track and trim everyday expenses**

## **Track and trim everyday expenses**  
Small, recurring expenses often have the biggest impact on your ability to save. Reviewing your monthly spending can uncover opportunities such as unused subscriptions, frequent dining out or overlapping service plans.  
Reducing discretionary spending by even 500 a month could add up to 6,000 a year towards your deposit.  
With ENBD X, built-in spending insights and budgeting tools make it easier to understand where your money goes and take informed action.
title: 5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE

text:
5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE > **Make everyday spending work harder**

## **Make everyday spending work harder**  
Everyday purchases can support your savings goal when used wisely. Emirates NBD credit cards offer cashback on common spending categories such as groceries, fuel and dining.  
By directing cashback earned into your savings account, you can grow your deposit without changing your lifestyle. When balances are paid in full each month, credit cards can be a helpful tool rather than a financial burden.
title: 5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE

text:
5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE > **Set a clear goal and track progress**

## **Set a clear goal and track progress**  
Clear goals bring focus and motivation. Start by estimating the deposit you’ll need, typically around 20% of the property value. For example, a property worth 1 million would require a deposit of 200,000.  
Breaking this target into monthly milestones makes it easier to manage and track. ENBD X allows you to set savings goals and monitor progress in real time, helping you stay motivated as you move closer to home ownership.
title: 5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE
section: **Set a clear goal and track progress**

text:
5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE > **Plan for the unexpected**

## **Plan for the unexpected**  
Alongside your home deposit, it’s important to maintain an emergency fund. Setting aside three months’ worth of essential expenses can protect your savings plan from unexpected events and give you greater peace of mind.
title: 5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE

text:
5 smart ways to save for your first home in the UAE > **The bottom line**

## **The bottom line**  
Saving for your first home in the UAE is achievable with the right habits, products and support. By prioritising savings, choosing suitable accounts, managing spending and setting clear goals, you can take steady steps towards owning your home.  
With solutions such as the **[Plus Saver Account](/en/accounts/savings-accounts/plus-saver-account)**, **[Fixed Deposits](/en/accounts/savings-accounts/fixed-deposits-account)**, and the **[ENBD X app](/en/ways-of-banking/mobile-banking)**, Emirates NBD is here to help you save smarter and move closer to the milestones that matter most.

## Preparing to invest in your home  
The decision to buy a home of your own can be intimidating. If you’re a first-time buyer in the UAE, you’ll find endless choices and a whole array of finance and bank loan options.  
Read through the points below and give them some careful thought before you take this very important step. We’re here to help with your home loan when you’re ready. [Emirates NBD home loans](/en/loans/home-loans)are fast and hassle-free, so you can have the keys to your very own home in your hands within days.  
**A few things you should consider before you decide on your home:**  
**Does it fit your needs?** There are many different kinds of properties in the UAE. Check if the community fits your needs. Does it have a school, hospital, green areas, security and connectivity to the metro and road transport? Everything that’s important to you.  
**Flats vs villas:** Flats can be easier to manage, especially if you’re a frequent traveller. You’ll find some very good choices with great community facilities including gyms and pools. Villas can be way more expensive not just to buy, but also to maintain. Utility costs can be high too. Consider the pros and cons well.  
**Fees and charges:** Community fees can be quite high in some developments – be it a flat or villa. Find out what the fees entitles you - chiller charges, gyms, community halls, parking spaces?

text:
Buying your first home in the UAE | Support | Emirates NBD > Preparing to invest in your home

**Off-plan or ready-to-move-into?** Buying off-planinvolves a waiting period before you can move in, but then you pay much less and may even get an easy payment plan, avoiding the need for a home loan. With the latter, you can move into your home immediately and start saving on rent right away.  
**Real estate agent:** Finding yourself a trustworthy real estate agent is always a good idea. They can present you with the best options and do most of the leg and paper work for you.  
**Your home loan:** Lastly, but most importantly, consider your mortgage. What’s the best rate you can get? How much should you put as down payment? How long should you take the loan for? All good questions to which you should have the answers before taking this very important decision.

Which one should I opt for?](#faqs-some-banks-promise-faster-processing-while-others-talk-of-lower-interest-rates "Some banks promise faster processing while others talk of lower interest rates. Which one should I opt for")

text:
Buying your first home in the UAE | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

[How big should my down payment be?](#faqs-how-big-should-my-down-payment-be "How big should my down payment be")  
A higher down payment on your home means lower total payments on your home loan. It gives you the flexibility of either reducing the term of the loan or having smaller monthly installments. Loan-to-value (LTV) is a financial term that expresses the ratio of a loan against the value of the home. While it's tempting to apply for the highest LTV, it is advisable to pay a higher down payment and opt for a lower LTV. Lower monthly installments will keep the loan manageable and give you more disposable income at all times.  
[Can I apply for early settlement of my home loan?](#faqs-can-i-apply-for-early-settlement-of-my-home-loan "Can I apply for early settlement of my home loan")  
Yes, you can. You can close your loan at any time during the loan term. To know more, please visit any Emirates NBD branch or call us on +91 600 54 0000. To know more about early settlement of our loan, read [this article](/en/help-and-support/apply-for-early-loan-settlement).  
[Can I do a partial payment towards my home loan? Will there be any charges for this?](#faqs-can-i-do-a-partial-payment-towards-my-home-loan "Can I do a partial payment towards my home loan Will there be any charges for this")
title: Buying your first home in the UAE | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Buying your first home in the UAE | Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

Yes, you can partially settle your home loan if you have extra cash in hand. There is a charge for this, but you will save on interest payments. You can choose to either reduce the term of your loan or reduce the EMI amounts when you pay part of your loan back. Read more about partial settlement of home loans in [this article](/en/help-and-support/apply-for-a-partial-loan-settlement).  
[What is the difference between a clearance letter and a no-liability letter?](#faqs-what-is-the-difference-between-a-clearance-letter-and-a-no-liability-letter "What is the difference between a clearance letter and a noliability letter")  
The bank will issue you a [clearance letter](/en/help-and-support/request-a-clearance-letter)when a specific liability, such as a personal or car loan, has been cleared by you while a [no-liability letter](/en/help-and-support/request-a-liability-or-no-liability-letter)will be issued only if you have no existing liabilities with the bank.  
[What is a post-dated cheque (PDC)?](#faqs-what-is-a-post-dated-cheque-pdc "What is a postdated cheque PDC")  
A post-dated cheque is a cheque with a future date that can be used to collect a payment you owe after the date mentioned. This can be issued to a bank, business or person (known as the payee). You can use post-dated cheques when you don't want the payee to collect payment before a particular date.

[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my account number?](#accordion-6c7a3152-a05d-4ef2-92d9-932ef2572a52 "Is it safe to share my account number")  
It’s generally safe to share your account number with trusted people and with the bank. Always avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. Rest assured the bank does not share this information with anyone. Read more [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/security).

* Eligible Credit Cardholders, automatically enter the Promotion subject to achieving the AED spends value within the specified categories, as has been communicated by Emirates NBD.

text:
Foreign Exchange Services | Exchange Rates | Emirates NBD > How can we help?

* **FX rates are indicative**  
**Warning: This product/service may be affected by changes in foreign currency exchange rates.**  
Exchange rate displayed on transfer pages are indicative. Prevailing rates will be applied at the time of processing.  
* **Processing time**  
**Warning: The actual time to complete a transaction may differ from estimates due to increased scrutiny of transactions by the correspondent bank/financial institution or entity providing financial services to the beneficiary of remittances.**  
* **Penalties & Fees**  
**Warning: Penalties and Fees may be applied if there is a customer error or omission in providing correct or incomplete information for remittances.**  
Ensure accuracy of details provided prior to submitting the transfer request. In case if customer provides incorrect or incomplete details transactions will be rejected & refunded at prevailing exchange rates and loss if any will have to be borne by the remitter.  
* **Additional fees by correspondent bank**  
**Warning: Additional fees may be levied by the correspondent bank/financial institution or entity providing financial services to the beneficiary of remittances.**  
The beneficiary payout amount may be subject to additional costs. Correspondent bank charges may be applicable subject to currency, destination country/bank and amount basis selection of charge code.

* **Cooling-off waiver**  
Customer agrees to waive cooling-off period for the FX transaction as it requires immediate processing.  
* **Cancellation Process**  
Ensure accuracy of details provided prior to submitting the transfer request. To cancel or recall any transfer sent, contact the Emirates NBD call center/branch for submitting the request within 24 hours. The processing of such request is subject to refund/reversal confirmation from beneficiary or correspondent bank. Exchange loss amount, if any, shall be levied in such cases.

## Rewards Hub  
Redeem your Plus Points instantly through Rewards Hub on ENBD X across travel, shopping, gift cards and more, all in one place.  
Redemption options available on Rewards Hub include:  
**Travel**  
Use your Plus Points to book flights and hotel stays through the Rewards Hub at a conversion rate of 1 Plus Point = 1.  
**Experiences**  
Access dining, entertainment and exclusive experiences using your Plus Points at a conversion rate of 1 Plus Point = 1.  
**Gift Cards**  
Redeem your Plus Points instantly for digital gift cards across partner brands at a conversion rate of 1 Plus Point = 1.  
**Apple Shop**  
Redeem your Plus Points across a wide range of Apple products available on the Rewards Hub at a conversion rate of 1 Plus Point = 1.  
**Points Transfer**  
Transfer your Plus Points to selected airlines and loyalty partners directly through the Rewards Hub.  
- **Partner**: **Qatar Airways**; **Conversion rate**: 1 Plus Point = 14 Avios
- **Partner**: **Air India**; **Conversion rate**: 1 Plus Point = 20 Maharaja Points
- **Partner**: **Philippine Airlines**; **Conversion rate**: 1 Plus Point = 11 Mabuhay Miles
- **Partner**: **Air Arabia**; **Conversion rate**: 1 Plus Point = 14 Air Rewards
- **Partner**: **Shukran**; **Conversion rate**: 1 Plus Point = 13 Shukrans  
Your miles or points will be credited to your loyalty account within 7 working days from the request submission date.  
**Steps to redeem your Plus Points on Rewards Hub**

## Instant redemption  
Redeem your Plus Points directly against purchases you make at participating stores at a conversion rate of
1 Plus Point = 1 AED.  
**Steps to redeem your Plus Points against purchases:**  
* While making your purchase, inform the cashier that you would like to redeem your Plus Points
* Let the cashier know the number of points you would like to redeem  
The transaction slip will contain a summary of the points you redeemed.  
**For partial redemptions**: Upon swiping the card for transaction, the POS machine will prompt to debit from the card and redeem the points in single transaction.  
A few of the participating stores to redeem your Plus Points are:  
**![](/-/media/enbd/images/help-and-support/cards/participating_partners_instant_rewards_12june.jpg)**  
To see the full list of participating stores, [click here](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/enbd/files/pdf/plus_points_merchants.pdf).

## Nol top up  
Redeem your Plus Points for a Nol top up at a conversion rate of 1 Plus Point = 1 AED. To do this, your card must be active, and you must have at least 20 points.  
A maximum of 5,000 Plus Points can be redeemed at once towards Nol cards linked to a Go4it credit card. For other RTA Nol cards, a maximum of 1,000 Plus Points can be redeemed at once.

## Paying education fees  
Use your Plus Points to pay university or school fees at a conversion rate of 1 Plus Point = 1 AED. You must have a minimum of 100 points to do this.  
**Steps to redeem your Plus Points for education fees:**  
* Pay your education fees in full using your credit card
* Once the payment is processed, **[request Plus Points redemption](/en/campaigns/education-payments)** (you can also offset a partial amount of the fee)  
Once your request is processed, you'll be notified via SMS and your points will be credited as payment to your credit card within 7 working days. This will reflect on your next statement.

How to Redeem Plus Points | Help and Support | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[How long are Plus Points valid for?](#faqs-how-long-are-plus-points-valid-for "How long are Plus Points valid for")  
Plus Points don’t expire as long as you have an active Emirates NBD card. Once you redeem them for Frequent Flyer Miles, the terms and conditions of your frequent flyer programme apply.  
[Can a supplementary credit card holder redeem any points they have earned?](#faqs-can-a-supplementary-credit-card-holder-redeem-points-they-earn "Can a supplementary credit card holder redeem any points they have earned")  
Redemption requests can only be placed by the primary credit card holder using the primary credit card.  
[Is a cashback redemption considered as a payment towards my credit card?](#faqs-is-a-cashback-redemption-considered-as-a-payment-towards-my-credit-card "Is a cashback redemption considered as a payment towards my credit card")  
Yes, it is. If you have [auto debits](/en/help-and-support/auto-debits-for-credit-card-payments)active on your card, you'll need to redeem your points at least 24 hours before your due date, otherwise the full auto debit amount will be debited from your account. The cashback will then go towards your next payment.

# Simplify your payroll process  
Enjoy the convenience of this payroll card that lets employers pay employee's wages directly to the card.  
**About the card**  
The Emirates NBD Salary Prepay Card enables our corporate clients to deposit salaries for employees earning up to 5,000, providing them the convenience of withdrawing their salaries without having to open a bank account.  
This is an environmentally friendly card, and it comes with chip and pin technology for enhanced security. The card promotes financial inclusion and contributes to reduced cash circulation in the country.  
**Key features**  
* Re-loadable card, allowing companies to conveniently transfer salaries directly onto the card
* Complies with regulatory directives of salary payment via WPS (Wage Protection System)
* Can be used at all Point Of Sale machines (POS) and automated teller machines (ATM) where Visa is accepted at over 200 countries and territories around the world
* The card is environment friendly
* Chip & pin for enhanced security
* Dedicated 24x7 helpline for employees  
**How your company benefits**  
* Saves time, money and effort on the paycheck process
* Establishes an accounting trail for easy records reconciliation
* Eliminates risk of handling cash for payroll processing each month
* Instant transfer of salaries
* Unique wallet ID & IBAN assigned to each cardholder, making salary transfer more convenient
* Option to activate, cancel or replace cards in bulk

Manage your corporate card. Anytime. Anywhere. | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[Who can use this feature?](#faq-enbdxcorp-en-1-e27efae3 "Who can use this feature?")  
All eligible Emirates NBD corporate cardholders, **except:**  
* Shareholders and Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBO)
who are corporate cardholders but do not have an existing consumer banking relationship with Emirates NBD.
* Corporate Administrators/KCPs, who can continue using the existing businessONLINE platform to manage their corporate cards.  
Alternatively, all cardholders can view and manage their corporate card(s) through the Visa Spend Clarity or Smart Data Generation2.  
[Do I need to register again?](#faq-enbdxcorp-en-2-97f848ce "Do I need to register again?")  
Existing ENBD X users can access the features by selecting the Corporate tab after logging in. New users will have to register on ENBD X to access them.  
[What can I do on ENBD X?](#faq-enbdxcorp-en-3-6cbb2d68 "What can I do on ENBD X?")  
You can view your corporate card details, monitor balances and transactions, download statements and access card services.  
For more details, please email [**corporatecards@emiratesnbd.com**](mail:corporatecards@emiratesnbd.com) or contact your relationship manager.

## Before you start  
* You’ll be asked security questions so we can make sure that it’s you. Be prepared with your auto loan number and **[registered mobile number](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number)**.
* Your request will be processed within 3 working days. Once done, you will receive an SMS with the request details on your **[registered mobile number](/en/help-and-support/update-your-registered-mobile-number)**.
* If your car is registered in Dubai, you will receive an SMS directly from RTA about the auto loan release. If your car is registered in other Emirates, you will receive an SMS from Emirates NBD about the auto loan release.

text:
Auto Loan Release Request | Emirates NBD > Quick Answers

## Quick Answers  
[When can I request auto loan release?](#accordion-23f042f8-7bd2-4c88-88e3-1bd0ab10282c "When can I request auto loan release")  
You can request an auto loan release once you have entirely settled your loan outstanding. Please allow one working day after settling the loan to request for an auto loan release. This ensures your records are up to date.  
[What if the car is registered in my company’s name?](#accordion-258de659-8319-4720-bdb8-8b37e030bb55 "What if the car is registered in my companys name")  
If the car is registered in a company’s name, please provide Trade License copy along with the Mulkiya copy.  
[Are there any fees and charges for an auto loan release?](#accordion-3b003dbc-15a6-40e4-bd32-400c3a1ee9ae "Are there any fees and charges for an auto loan release")  
No, an auto loan release is free of charge.  
[I want to follow up on a previous query.](#accordion-00be67c7-b00c-40b3-8cea-14448df2f96a "I want to follow up on a previous query.")  
You can track your auto loan release request by calling us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘follow up on my request’.

Emirates NBD’s Priority Banking Deposit Accounts give you the security you want for your investments, as well as higher returns than from a savings account. Offering fixed, call or recurring account options, our deposit range enables you to retain the flexibility and accessibility you need for your money while it grows.

Priority Banking - Deposit Accounts | Emirates NBD > Enjoy 24/7 access while earning interest on your deposit

## Enjoy 24/7 access while earning interest on your deposit  
An Emirates NBD FlexiDeposit Account won't let you down when you need it most. With a minimum of 10,000 or equivalent in other currencies, you can keep your deposit intact even if you have to make a partial withdrawal. That's real flexibility, without losing the benefits of a deposit account. Features include:  
* Available in AED, USD, GBP and EUR
* Market-leading interest rates, subject to duration and currency
* Minimum deposit term of 3 months
* Early and partial withdrawals are permitted in units as low as 1 with unlimited frequency

You don’t have to wait until your fixed term deposit matures to reap the rewards. With competitive interest rates for minimum deposits of 10,000, or equivalent in other currencies, other features of this account include:  
* Monthly, quarterly or half-yearly interest payments
* Available in AED, USD, GBP and EUR
* Tenors ranging from 3 months to 3 years

text:
Priority Banking - Deposit Accounts | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

## What are people asking?  
[Am I eligible for a Priority Banking Deposit Account?](#accordion-a8a99138-3550-413d-9d19-b063f70a2401 "Am I eligible for a Priority Banking Deposit Account")  
Our Deposit Accounts are open to new and existing customers of all nationalities.  
To apply you must be:  
* 18 years or older (or a minor with your legal guardian’s signature)
* UAE residence visa holder
* Priority Banking customer or meet the Priority Banking threshold  
[What do I need to open a Priority Banking Current Account?](#accordion-9cb92cdc-577c-47a6-a958-6c1e3b4169e0 "What do I need to open a Priority Banking Current Account")  
* Copy of passport(s) and original passport(s) for validation
* Sponsor's letter of no objection
* Salary Certificate (in case of salary transfer accounts). In the absence of a Salary Certificate, any one of the following documents may be provided:
+ Appointment letter/Contract copy
+ Pay slip (<3 months old)
+ Consolidated letter from HR for bulk accounts
+ Most recent statement of account if your salary is being transferred

****ENBD X Mobile App** “Menu”**  
* Register and log in to Mobile Banking app
* Tap on ‘**Services**’ at the footer of the screen and select ‘**Apply for New Service**’
* Click on ‘**Credit Card**’ and select ‘**Activate Credit Card**’ and tap on the Card
* Enter the **Expiry Date** and set your Card **PIN**  
****ENBD X Mobile App** “Dashboard”**  
* Register and log in to Mobile Banking app
* Tap on ‘**Credit Card**’
* Select the Card you want to activate
* Enter the**Expiry Date**and set your Card**PIN**  
* Text ‘ACT’ to 4459 from your registered mobile number
* You will get a call from [+971 431 60 505](tel:+971 431 60 505) in few minutes. Keep the last 6 digits of your Card number handy and follow the instructions to activate your Card

## If we can't reach an agreement together  
We’re confident that our complaint resolution process is fair and robust, but if we’ve been unable to provide you with a satisfactory resolution, you have the right to refer your complaint to Sanadak.  
Sanadak is the first legally established independent ombudsman unit, with a focus on safeguarding consumers’ rights and resolving complaints that arise from dealings with financial institutions and licensed insurance companies. Sanadak will assume all consumer complaint-handling duties previously carried out by the Central Bank of the UAE’s Consumer Protection Department and Insurance Dispute Resolution Committee.  
Sanadak’s office is located on the ground floor of the Emirates Institute of Finance building in Abu Dhabi.  
**Office hours**
Monday to Thursday: 8:30 am to 3:30 pm
Friday: 8:30 am to 11:30 am  
**Email:**[Info@sanadak.gov.ae](mailto:Info@sanadak.gov.ae)

text:
Long-term Business Financing Solutions | Emirates NBD > Commercial property (Retail Space and office loan)

## Commercial property (Retail Space and office loan)  
Securing the right office or property for your business can provide a strong foundation for success and a key asset for your balance sheet. As one of the UAE’s premier business lenders, we can help you finance your real estate purchase or leverage your current real estate assets to inject cash into your business.  
* Emirates NBD offers market leading office, home and commercial mortgage loans for your business. Our expert team will help you set up a loan for up to 20 million towards the purchase of ready built commercial property, so you can set up in an ideal location and capitalize on ownership of real estate.  
* **Loans Against Property:** Emirates NBD’s Business Banking Property Power Loan is the perfect way to work the value of your property harder. Whether you are salaried, self-employed or you own a company, we can provide a loan of up to 20 million (maximum 70% of market value for UAE nationals or 60% for expatriates) over a maximum of 15 years against your commercial or residential property.  
[Know more](/en/campaigns/mortgage-loans)

section: Commercial property (Retail Space and office loan)

text:
Long-term Business Financing Solutions | Emirates NBD > Business Vehicle Loans

## Business Vehicle Loans  
You need the right equipment to do the job, and inevitably you have to update your commercial vehicles or machinery from time to time, or increase the size of your fleet. Our cost-effective financing and loan options allow you to act on your plans without delay to improve your efficiency and performance.  
#### Commercial Vehicle Loans  
Our Commercial Vehicle Loans make sure you have the vehicles you need to drive your business forward. They are perfect for trucks, heavy buses, multi-utility vehicles, pick-ups, light commercial vehicles, medium and heavy commercial vehicles, trailers or vans. We can finance 90% of the necessary costs at attractive interest rates for loans up to 7 million for new and used vehicles, as well as the cost of insurance premiums.  
[Click here for eligibility and documents required](javascript:ENBD.OpenDialog('cvl') "Commercial Vehicle Loans")  
#### Construction Equipment Loans  
If you are looking to expand your business or need more equipment to respond to a major new contract, our Construction Equipment Loans will provide you with customized financing options, for both new and used equipment. Loans of up to 5 million for 85% of equipment cost and insurance coverage are available for a maximum of 36 months.  
[Click here for eligibility and documents required](javascript:ENBD.OpenDialog('cel') "Construction Equipment Loans")  
#### Fleet Financing

# Fake emails? Check first. Click next.  
Do you open every email you receive in your inbox, without investigating? Do you check if this is from a verified source or a random email address? The name on any email address can be made to look alike. For example:  
- Email Account Name: ABC Limited; Email Account Address: abc.limited@abc.com
- Email Account Name: ABC Limited; Email Account Address: adc.limited@adc.com  
Fraudsters create fake profiles/email accounts using stolen information to impersonate as individuals or businesses for fraudulent purposes. These are some common types of tactics used by scammers:  
![Fake Accounts](/-/media/enbd/images/fraud/fake-account.jpg?la=en&h=1000&w=1000&hash=2600432D2C6949B08A5B477D69C1C804)  
#### **Fake Accounts**  
Use fake or stolen credentials to register accounts, for financial gain.  
![Fake Identity](/-/media/enbd/images/fraud/fake-identity.jpg?la=en&h=1000&w=1000&hash=46E7057DAAA77CE55F8BB750EF76A4BB)  
#### **Fake Identity**  
Create fake companies and their websites, that closely resemble legitimate businesses, to trick you into providing financial information and transfer funds.  
![Fake Emails](/-/media/enbd/images/fraud/fake-email.jpg?la=en&h=1000&w=1000&hash=B2EAD3E49538B1A02DE2E89F505C5992)  
#### **Fake Emails**  
Send emails or messages that appear to be from legitimate sources, urging recipients to click on links or provide personal information.

Fake emails | Check first | Click next |  Emirates NBD > Fake emails? Check first. Click next.

Send emails or messages that appear to be from legitimate sources, urging recipients to click on links or provide personal information.  
If you receive an email, a call or SMS, requesting you to transfer money to an alternative account with a new IBAN number, protect yourself as follows:  
![Look for inconsistencies](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/accservices_icon_b.png?la=en&h=200&w=200&hash=50C996E80E9DE503799194893437FC74)  
Look for inconsistencies in the profile information, change in email address, typos, grammatical errors, blurry logos, etc.  
![Monthly Grand Prize](/-/media/enbd/icons/accounts/icon_0001_track-the-balances-in-your-account.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=B554482BFBB8B35F71F9AE45E545FC30)  
Verify the authenticity of accounts and websites before providing any information.  
![Check with the approved](/-/media/enbd/icons/packages/blue-icons/eligibility_icon.png?la=en&h=50&w=50&hash=10A8E7ADB99A9275A9071202275A2311)  
Check with the approved company through their verified channels, if there has been a change.  
![Be cautious of requests](/-/media/enbd/images/ways-of-banking/e-transfer_icon.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=7B29F244F851C6D1BF84E1555CD5F263)  
Be cautious of requests for payment in unusual ways or any urgency in making payments.  
![Discount](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/cib_ds_apibanking_jwt_icon.png?la=en&h=250&w=250&hash=14676DBCD9EC1AAE81877F9314E8DBEB)

![Discount](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/api-banking/icons/cib_ds_apibanking_jwt_icon.png?la=en&h=250&w=250&hash=14676DBCD9EC1AAE81877F9314E8DBEB)  
If the email address doesn't match the company’s verified email or is from a free provider (such as Hotmail, Gmail or Outlook).  
![Discount](/-/media/enbd/icons/accounts/icon_0002_get-option-to-set-maximum-balance.png?la=en&h=500&w=500&hash=1B70C1644F11D42F0A64B9FA2D214176)  
Be careful if you’re being asked to take an action, such as click on a link, supply a code or download software.  
![PromoCardWithHighlights  Lets take a look](/-/media/enbd/images/others/security/pcidss-privacyandsecurity.jpg?la=en&h=1400&w=2800&hash=04667EA068BFABA6FE639BF1664E7CC6)  
#### Think before you act!  
If you suspect a scam, report it through the official channels. **Never transfer money to a New Account or IBAN number** before confirming through the listed company's verified channels and authorised personnel.  
**Stay vigilant against fraud**  
If you detect any fraudulent activity, please contact us immediately on **[600 54 0009](tel:600540009)** and when prompted, please say “Emergency”.

## Quick Answers  
[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my card number?](#accordion-c14e16bd-40cc-461b-87a6-b5f8a7f4570b "Is it safe to share my card number")  
You should avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. It’s ok to share this information with the bank in a safe manner. Rest assured we do not share this information with anyone. Read more about how we keep you safe [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/security/?ref=beta).

**Global Priority Banking Access**  
Priority Banking in Egypt and Saudi Arabia automatically receive Priority Banking status in the UAE, bringing exclusive international benefits to all three countries.  
You can enjoy preferential treatment across markets with your relationship managers managing your commitments in all countries. You can also access your global accounts from anywhere in the world, receiving seamless assistance as well as professional support that goes beyond banking. Managing your money across countries is quick and easy, with instant, no-fee transfers using Emirates NBD DirectRemit in online and mobile banking. You will enjoy preferential rates on Deposits and exclusive fee free Priority Banking Products in all three nations.
