# Busting four myths about real estate  
01 May 2021  
[Share](javascript:void(0); "Share")  
![Busting four myths about real estate](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/cio_corner_insights_thumb_apr2021.jpg)  
##### Busting four myths about real estate  
After equities and bonds, property is the third major class of wealth. But some investors still have their misconceptions.  
If you look out the window, how many construction cranes can you count? Probably more than a few, given that GCC countries have $1 trillion of investment planned for megaprojects such as Al Harir City in Kuwait, Lusail City in Qatar and the Riyadh City project in Abu Dhabi. With that sort of money at play, real estate is too big for experienced investors to ignore. At the same time, property markets are always subject to misapprehensions – here are four fables to disregard.  
**Myth 1: It's all about capital gains**  
No, real-estate investing is about income. Indeed, properties are valued as a multiple of income. Of course capital gains can be a nice icing on the cake, but the reason for those gains and the cause of long-term value is bottom-line profit from rentals and leases. Net income should always be the core consideration of a property investment. (The exception here is property bought for an investor’s own personal use. Owning a home or homes is partly about financial return, but equally or more about ‘return on family’ or friends or life in general.)
title: Busting four myths about real estate
section: Busting four myths about real estate

text:
Busting four myths about real estate > Busting four myths about real estate

![The Edge](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/insights_inner_image_1.jpg)  
**Myth 2: Prices go only one way**  
In boom times it’s easy to believe that prices will never fall, in bust times that they will never rise. Both are wrong: just like the economy in general, property is a cyclical market. Wise investors generally take a long view of at least 5-10 years, enough time for real value to outride shorter-term ups and downs. The other key factor here is relative return on competing assets. That is, especially in the highly levered world of property, interest rates will always be a key factor in prices  and values.  
![The Edge](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/insights_inner_image_2.jpg)  
**Myth 3: Land – they’re not making any more of it**  
Take a look at Dubai’s Palm Islands, and you’ll know this one is wrong. Yes, land can be ‘made’ from the sea. But the more important, related point is that major properties tend to be illiquid. Neither can they be moved nor can they be traded in short order, as most stocks and bonds can. Over time this is generally good – property is not a fad, not something that might disappear in a few years. Again, this suits investors with a longer view, who don’t need the principle back next week or even  next year.  
![The Edge](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/insights_inner_image_3.jpg)  
**Myth 4: COVID will kill retail and offices**
title: Busting four myths about real estate
section: Busting four myths about real estate

text:
Busting four myths about real estate > Busting four myths about real estate

![The Edge](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/insights_inner_image_3.jpg)  
**Myth 4: COVID will kill retail and offices**  
Bricks-and-mortar shops have been devasted during the pandemic, true, but this was and is an acceleration of a process already in motion. The real reason is e-commerce, which is locked with physical retail in a zero-sum game. Customers are not going to buy their gadgets, their gear or their groceries twice – they’ll do it either in person or online, so one channel will win while the other loses. For the foreseeable future, online retail seems to be steadily winning. As for offices, rumours of death are exaggerated. True, post-COVID demand will likely be different: for instance, offices might become more decentralised. But there is still a fundamental need. Many companies and government agencies have already begun calling home-working employees back to the mother ship. And even if conventional offices fail to reach their former popularity, this will invite a surge in alternative uses – such as hot-desks and work-hotels that are the new darling of freelance ‘gig’ workers. Humans’ fundamental need for space won’t go away anytime soon.  
![The Edge](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/insights_inner_image_4.jpg)  
**So why invest in real estate?**
title: Busting four myths about real estate
section: Busting four myths about real estate

text:
Busting four myths about real estate > Busting four myths about real estate

![The Edge](//cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/images/insights_inner_image_4.jpg)  
**So why invest in real estate?**  
Because it offers steady returns at reasonable risk over the long-term. People need property, and so they will pay for using it, before ultimately selling on to other people who will subsequently use it. Take 25 Cabot Square, a 17-storey office tower in the heart of London’s Canary Wharf financial district. Last Autumn it was snapped up for £380 million by an investment company from Hong Kong. The property is leased to Morgan Stanley, the global investment bank, for the next 11 years at an annual yield of 4.86%. That sure enough beats the going yield for bonds of only 1.40%. This is typical for real estate deals that, across all asset classes, stand out as solid, safe plays that are hard to beat.

Self-Construction Home Loans | Home Construction Loan | Emirates NBD > Getting started

## Getting started  
[What is a Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-c4f862e8-b4d4-4054-b416-d86c1850d849 "What is a Selfconstruction Loan")  
A Self-construction Loan is a specialized financial product designed to provide the necessary funding for individuals who wish to construct their own home from the ground up.  
[How does a Self-construction Loan differ from a traditional mortgage?](#accordion-f475dc61-64cd-4c3e-8506-1732df6899c9 "How does a Selfconstruction Loan differ from a traditional mortgage")  
Unlike traditional mortgages, which are primarily intended for the purchase of pre-existing properties, self-construction loans are meant for the construction of a new home on an existing piece of land.  
[Who is eligible for a Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-97d7339f-e0c8-4321-b45d-1dabc6f13221 "Who is eligible for a Selfconstruction Loan")  
UAE Nationals with available land or those who are granted land by the government are eligible to apply for a self-construction loan, subject to meeting the lender's specific criteria.  
[How do disbursements work with a Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-63d4939b-37e9-4441-9946-5292b56513e5 "How do disbursements work with a Selfconstruction Loan")
title: Self-Construction Home Loans | Home Construction Loan | Emirates NBD

text:
Self-Construction Home Loans | Home Construction Loan | Emirates NBD > Getting started

Disbursements for a Self-construction Loan are usually administered in stages, with funds released as the construction progresses. This staged approach ensures that the funds are disbursed in line with the completion of specific construction milestones, rather than as a single lump sum.  
[What documents are typically required for a Self-construction Loan application?](#accordion-5614e9df-f18c-4ae6-8812-a700f5b32870 "What documents are typically required for a Selfconstruction Loan application")  
Commonly required documents for a Self-construction Loan application include passport, Emirates ID, original affection plan/search certificate or original title deed of the property, the mortgage deed for the property, if applicable, technical evaluation report, workers insurance, registered mortgage deed and building permit, demarcation certificate and contractor's trade license.  
[What is a Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-c4f862e8-b4d4-4054-b416-d86c1850d849 "What is a Selfconstruction Loan")  
A Self-construction Loan is a specialized financial product designed to provide the necessary funding for individuals who wish to construct their own home from the ground up.  
[How does a Self-construction Loan differ from a traditional mortgage?](#accordion-f475dc61-64cd-4c3e-8506-1732df6899c9 "How does a Selfconstruction Loan differ from a traditional mortgage")
title: Self-Construction Home Loans | Home Construction Loan | Emirates NBD

text:
Self-Construction Home Loans | Home Construction Loan | Emirates NBD > Getting started

Unlike traditional mortgages, which are primarily intended for the purchase of pre-existing properties, self-construction loans are meant for the construction of a new home on an existing piece of land.  
[Who is eligible for a Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-97d7339f-e0c8-4321-b45d-1dabc6f13221 "Who is eligible for a Selfconstruction Loan")  
UAE Nationals with available land or those who are granted land by the government are eligible to apply for a self-construction loan, subject to meeting the lender's specific criteria.  
[How do disbursements work with a Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-63d4939b-37e9-4441-9946-5292b56513e5 "How do disbursements work with a Selfconstruction Loan")  
Disbursements for a Self-construction Loan are usually administered in stages, with funds released as the construction progresses. This staged approach ensures that the funds are disbursed in line with the completion of specific construction milestones, rather than as a single lump sum.  
[What documents are typically required for a Self-construction Loan application?](#accordion-5614e9df-f18c-4ae6-8812-a700f5b32870 "What documents are typically required for a Selfconstruction Loan application")
title: Self-Construction Home Loans | Home Construction Loan | Emirates NBD

text:
Self-Construction Home Loans | Home Construction Loan | Emirates NBD > Getting started

Commonly required documents for a Self-construction Loan application include passport, Emirates ID, original affection plan/search certificate or original title deed of the property, the mortgage deed for the property, if applicable, technical evaluation report, workers insurance, registered mortgage deed and building permit, demarcation certificate and contractor's trade license.  
[Does a Self-construction Loan cover the purchase of land as well?](#accordion-09fee0e2-3263-4209-82cc-67060be2ae60 "Does a Selfconstruction Loan cover the purchase of land as well")  
No, it is necessary for you to already have the land before you apply for a Self-construction Loan.  
[What is the difference between Mulhaq loan and a Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-5a60070a-e8f7-451e-baae-dc1e9c6079c4 "What is the difference between Mulhaq loan and a Selfconstruction Loan")  
The Mulhaq loan is intended for building an extension or making improvements to a ready property, whereas a Self-construction Loan is meant for the construction of a new property on an empty piece of land.  
[How much can I borrow with a Self-construction Loan from Emirates NBD?](#accordion-a6e0a595-1e77-49b0-aa88-ab8abdd0f6c6 "How much can I borrow with a Selfconstruction Loan from Emirates NBD ")
title: Self-Construction Home Loans | Home Construction Loan | Emirates NBD

text:
Self-Construction Home Loans | Home Construction Loan | Emirates NBD > Getting started

Loan amounts are determined based on your income, the value of the land, the estimated construction cost, and your overall creditworthiness. Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratios are subject to Emirates NBD’s lending policies which can be up to 85%.  
[What is the interest rate for a Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-29c574ee-1a10-4654-b884-4799350fd159 "What is the interest rate for a Selfconstruction Loan ")  
Interest rates are competitive and based on market conditions and your credit profile.  
[What is the maximum tenure for Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-39859c83-aa02-405c-b99f-2f084149b54d "What is the maximum tenure for Selfconstruction Loan ")  
Repayment periods can extend up to 25 years, depending on the loan amount, your age at maturity, and Emirates NBD’s policy.  
[Is early repayment allowed for Self-construction Loans?](#accordion-4f392075-e680-4cbb-98b1-ec23cc432c5f "Is early repayment allowed for Selfconstruction Loans ")  
Yes, early repayment is possible. Fees may apply as per Emirates NBD’s settlement policies.  
[What are the additional fees associated with a Self-construction Loan?](#accordion-21408c99-2a11-4d72-97c7-a00da76820b5 "What are the additional fees associated with a Selfconstruction Loan ")  
Additional fees may include processing fees and valuation fees. For a detailed fee structure, please refer to the loan agreement or contact Emirates NBD.

### Borrow wisely – a few things you should know  
* If you don’t make the monthly payments towards your loan on time, you will incur a late payment fee
* Missing repayments can affect your credit score, limiting your ability to access loans or financing in the future
* If you refinance your loan or defer your payments, your loan will take longer to pay back, and you may pay more interest
* If you can’t meet a monthly payment, [apply in advance for a deferment](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/defer-your-loan-payments). You can do this up to twice a year  
It’s important to read the terms and conditions and know the fees and charges before you apply for a loan.

Convert Balance to Installments - Affordable Payments | Emirates NBD > Turn your Credit Card Outstanding into easy instalments

## Turn your Credit Card Outstanding into easy instalments  
Balance conversion allows you to convert your Credit Card outstanding balance into easy and affordable instalments over tenures up to 48 months. Managing debt has never been easier.  
**Disclaimer:**  
* Monthly instalments are calculated using an illustrative instalment amount of 10,000, effective interest rate of 0.89% per month (reducing balance) and 0% processing fees for 12 months tenure.
* Actual interest rates vary by tenure and are subject to the bank's policy. Kindly log in to your Mobile App or Online Banking to check the eligible transactions, applicable interest rate and processing fees.
* First instalment will reflect on the second card statement post booking and will include the instalment principal amount and accrued interest billed from the booking date till the second statement date.
* Processing fees will be charged as part of your first card statement post booking if applicable.  
To know the effective rate, please [**click here**](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/en/assets/File/ENBD_CC_Applicable_Rate_Of_Interest.pdf).

## What are people asking?  
[What is Balance Conversion?](#accordion-feb0627a-38f4-476a-9355-d655bea31d29 "What is Balance Conversion")  
Balance Conversion is an Instalment Plan that allows you to convert your Credit Card retail balance into manageable monthly payments.  
[Who can apply for Balance Conversion?](#accordion-39a3ad60-7e1a-4bb9-9f2c-1a820ca9045c "Who can apply for Balance Conversion")  
Any Emirates NBD primary Credit Cardholder with a minimum retail outstanding balance of 1,000 can apply.  
[Are there any application charges for a Balance Conversion plan?](#accordion-c60ec058-b081-4fa1-95ed-acc18f2b7e0b "Are there any application charges for a Balance Conversion plan")  
Fees are charged on the plan and are subject to change on periodic basis. There’s more information [**here**](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/terms-and-conditions).  
[Can I cancel my Balance Conversion plan and will I be charged?](#accordion-f84a81c7-b9ef-4957-bf45-455c6d5fd5ef "Can I cancel my Balance Conversion plan and will I be charged")  
Yes, you can cancel at any time. A foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding and 5% VAT, will apply. To cancel, call us on [**600 54 0000**](tel:600540000) (UAE) or [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) internationally.  
[Are there any early settlement charges?](#accordion-c3401dac-4f1c-45b6-bc7b-d944fbe5ab04 "Are there any early settlement charges")

Your request will be processed instantly and will be reflected on your secondCredit Card statement post booking.  
[How long do I have to repay the amount I convert to a Balance Conversion plan?](#accordion-0812a73a-273a-43d5-8cfd-e35d04c750d9 "How long do I have to repay the amount I convert to a Balance Conversion plan")  
You can choose to pay back over 12, 18, 24, 36, or 48 months.  
[Is there a minimum transaction amount to apply for a Balance Conversion plan?](#accordion-a113cffe-6745-4abc-b471-b3145e386196 "Is there a minimum transaction amount to apply for a Balance Conversion plan")  
Yes, you need to have a minimum retail outstanding balance of 1,000 to apply for a Balance Conversion plan on your Credit Card.  
[What happens if I fail to repay an instalment on a Balance Conversion plan?](#accordion-332e1093-5b7d-489d-ad8d-be88876929a8 "What happens if I fail to repay an instalment on a Balance Conversion plan")  
If you fail to make payments, your Balance Conversion plan will automatically be foreclosed. The full outstanding balance will be due immediately, and regular finance charges will apply to the remaining amount.  
[Can I change the tenure on an existing Balance Conversion plan?](#accordion-efaf1395-8097-4599-8004-9483e641b41e "Can I change the tenure on an existing Balance Conversion plan")

text:
Convert Balance to Installments - Affordable Payments | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

No, but you can foreclose your plan by paying a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding plus 5% VAT, then rebook the remaining balance into a new plan you wish to select.  
[What are the benefits of Balance Conversion on my Credit Card?](#accordion-91e5e403-2f50-4149-b9d1-58a06cb610e7 "What are the benefits of Balance Conversion on my Credit Card")  
With a Balance Conversion plan, you can repay your credit card outstanding balance comfortably in equal monthly instalments at a reducing interest rate. You have the flexibility to repay over 12 to 48 months.  
[What is the interest rate for a Balance Conversion plan?](#accordion-be587aa0-f5d0-4ea0-b638-a4e9574b8d07 "What is the interest rate for a Balance Conversion plan")  
Balance Conversion interest is a reducing monthly interest rate determined by Emirates NBD and shall be charged on the converted amount. The interest rates are subject to changes on periodic basis and is also based on Card usage and overall performance.  
[Can supplementary cardholders apply for Balance Conversion?](#accordion-250bfb93-90ad-4fad-b1bf-19f19575778e "Can supplementary cardholders apply for Balance Conversion")  
This facility is available for transactions done on both Primary and Supplementary Cards. However, only Primary Cardholders can raise a balance conversion request.

[What happens to the Balance Conversion plan if I prepay what I owe?](#accordion-25187eb4-eaf3-4e6a-bb00-32513212076e "What happens to the Balance Conversion plan if I prepay what I owe")  
Even if you prepay the full amount, your plan will remain active until you request cancellation by calling us on [**600 54 0000**](tel:600540000) (UAE) or [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) internationally. Once you call and cancel, a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding and 5% VAT, will apply.  
[What happens if I close my Credit Card while I have a Balance Conversion plan?](#accordion-e1a7a2cf-ab3b-4815-b2b8-6f4db9c4e475 "What happens if I close my Credit Card while I have a Balance Conversion plan")  
Active Balance Conversion plans must be foreclosed first and then your credit card cancellation request can be processed. Foreclosure fees will apply.  
[Do I earn or lose reward points on my Card when converting transactions to Balance Conversion?](#accordion-3b9e0fa3-bce2-4170-85d0-969e3f86a2d9 "Do I earn or lose reward points on my Card when converting transactions to Balance Conversion")  
No, you won’t lose any reward points on transactions that are converted to a Balance Conversion plan.

text:
Support Services | Authentication Tools | Emirates NBD > Security features

## Security features  
* 256-bit SSL data encryption certified by NORTON
* Access is controlled by robust entitlements in the system
* Two-factor authentication through password and Soft Token (smartPASS)
* Shared Admin as well as client admin functionality for seamless control
* PGP/Proprietary encryption supported for payments and payroll upload on businessONLINE
* Payments are secured with a multi-user defined workflow on businessONLINE i.e. maker can only initiate a payment and approver can approve a payment
* Complete transaction and user audit trail
* Online user enablement and disablement in the event of emergency and possibility of fraud
* Supports account-wise and product-wise access to users
* Uploaded transactions on businessONLINE are locked for any editing or information change

text:
Apply for an auto loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Buy any car in the UAE

## Buy any car in the UAE  
You can apply for an Emirates NBD car loan to buy any vehicle of your choice in the UAE provided you meet the criteria for the loan.  
**Why you should get a car loan from us:**  
* Easy process and documentation
* Green loans for electric cars
* Preferred pricing for pre-owned vehicles and fleet
* You can ask for a Shari'a compliant loan
* It's even easier if you have a high AECB credit score - you can get a higher amount and a lower interest rate
* You get a free credit card and0% installment payment plan
title: Apply for an auto loan | Support | Emirates NBD
section: Buy any car in the UAE

text:
Apply for an auto loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Eligibility

## Eligibility  
To apply for an auto loan with us, you need to be:  
* A UAE national or a UAE resident.
* Between 21 and 60 years old.
* Earning a minimum salary of 7,000.  
If you’re self-employed, you need an average balance of 20,000 in your account.  
We have a [range of auto loans](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/personal-banking/loans/auto-loan/?ref=search&sq=auto%20loan)with different features and benefits, including a Green Auto Loan which you might like to consider.  
If you’d like to talk to us, fill in this [form](/en/campaigns/auto-loan-offers)and one of our auto loan experts will call you back.
title: Apply for an auto loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for an auto loan | Support | Emirates NBD > How to apply

## How to apply  
If you’re self-employed, you can apply for an auto loan only through our website or by visiting one of our [business banking centers](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/branches-and-atms/?ref=header-navigation).  
**What's next**  
Your application will be processed within 7 to 10 working days. Once it's approved, your loan amount will be transferred to the car dealership or seller immediately.
title: Apply for an auto loan | Support | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for an auto loan | Support | Emirates NBD > Documents required

## Documents required  
* Your passport
* UAE residency visa and Emirates ID with copies
* A copy of your Driver’s License
* Idbara page (for UAE Nationals)
* Labour Card or Work ID copy
* Three-month bank statement (if you’re not banking with Emirates NBD)
* If you're self-employed, you'll need your trade license copy, memorandum and article of association
* For used vehicles, you'll need the seller’s passport, Emirates ID copy and valuation certificate from the dealership
* For new vehicles, you'll just need a quotation from the dealership  
The bank may ask you for additional documents in some cases.
title: Apply for an auto loan | Support | Emirates NBD

Our finance charges for car loans are one of the best in the market:  
* **Processing fee (for new and used vehicles):**1.05% of the loan amount (min 525 and max 2,625 inclusive of VAT)
* **Change of registration:**free of cost

# Give your savings a boost  
At Emirates NBD, we’re committed to helping you grow your wealth.  
Simply open your **Plus Saver (AED**) Account through **ENBD X** and fund the account with **new money** to earn **5.5%**p.a.  
**Offer is valid from 1 October to 31 December 2026.**

text:
Apply for a cheque book | Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[How safe are cheques?](#faqs-how-safe-are-cheques "How safe are cheques")  
All Emirates NBD cheques have a QR code and an MICR code-line to prevent checks from being reproduced by fraudsters. If you don’t specify a recipient on the cheque, or if you write a cheque to ‘cash or bearer’, there’s always the risk of anyone getting a hold of it and cashing it.  
[Can I request a cheque book with more than 10 leaves?](#faqs-can-i-request-a-cheque-book-with-more-than-10-leaves "Can I request a cheque book with more than 10 leaves")  
If you have a new relationship with the Bank, your first cheque book will have 10 leaves. Every subsequent cheque book request will have 10 to 25 leaves, subject to your AECB score.  
[Can my cheque book be issued in any other currency?](#faqs-can-my-cheque-book-be-issued-in-any-other-currency "Can my cheque book be issued in any other currency")  
We only issue cheque books in AED. To issue a cheque in a different currency you can apply for a demand draft.  
[How soon after I deposit a cheque will the money be in my account?](#faqs-how-soon-after-a-deposit-a-cheque-will-the-money-be-in-my-account "How soon after I deposit a cheque will the money be in my account")  
The processing and clearing time for cheques depends on the type of cheque and the channel used. To know more click [here](/en/help-and-support/deposit-a-cheque).
title: Apply for a cheque book | Emirates NBD

text:
Apply for a cheque book | Emirates NBD > FAQs

[My cheque has been misused, how can I get help?](#faqs-my-cheque-has-been-misused-how-can-i-get-help "My cheque has been misused how can I get help")  
If you suspect a cheque has been lost or stolen, you first need to submit a police report for the lost or stolen cheque and then visit one of our branches with the police report to place a stop payment on a cheque which has not been presented yet. Additional documents may be required at the bank's discretion.  
[What are the services available through an Emirates NBD Cheque Deposit Machine?](#faqs-what-are-the-services-available-through-an-emirates-nbd-cheque-deposit-machine "What are the services available through an Emirates NBD Cheque Deposit Machine")  
The following are the services available through all our Cheque Deposit Machines:  
* Cheque deposit to Emirates NBD or Emirates Islamic accounts and credit cards
* Payment towards DEWA and Wasel, DREC (Dubai Real Estate Co) and DP World

##  
Eligibility depends on the offer. Pre-travel offers, including Avis, Budget, Booking.com, Visa’s Journey Collection, and travel insurance, are available to Visa Gold, Platinum, Signature and Infinite cardholders. Destination offers, including London, Paris and Thailand, are available to all Visa cardholders, with selected benefits reserved for Platinum, Signature and Infinite tiers. Please check each offer for the eligible card tier.  
##  
Select the offer on this page, follow the partner’s redemption process and pay with your eligible Emirates NBD Visa card. Some offers require a promo code or a Visa invitation document to be presented at the venue. You’ll find the requirements and other details on each offer page.  
##  
Most offers activate automatically when you pay with your eligible Emirates NBD Visa card. Some offers, such as Avis Preferred and Avis President’s Club, require one-time enrolment so your benefits are linked to your profile.  
##  
Pre-travel offers, including Avis, Budget, Booking.com, are valid globally. Destination offers are linked to the city or country featured in the offer. Validity periods vary by offer. Each offer shows its end date in the pop-up.  
##  
Yes. Visa offers are in addition to your card’s standard benefits, including welcome miles, lounge access, travel insurance and more. They do not replace them. Any restrictions on combining offers with other promotions are included in the individual offer terms.

### Highlights  
##### About the deal  
Enjoy 10% off all mechanical, electrical and bodyshop repairs (accident, paint and denting) at Excellence Premier Auto Repair.  
Complimentary services included with every visit:
• Free body wash
• Free 20-point check-up  
• Free repair estimate  
##### About Excellence Premier Auto Repair exclusive offer for Emirates NBD cardholders  
At Excellence Premier Auto Repair, we combine modern technology, expert technicians and a state-of-the-art facility to deliver quality repairs for all makes and models. With 30,000 sq. ft. of space and 33 working bays, we are equipped to handle mechanical and electrical repairs, accident repairs, body restoration, tyre services and detailing under one roof.  
##### Terms and conditions  
* Offer is not valid in conjunction with any other promotions or discounts.
* This offer is valid for Emirates NBD, Emirates Islamic and Liv cardholders during the promotional period.
* Offer is valid only when payment is made using an Emirates NBD, Emirates Islamic or Liv credit or debit card.
* Reservations must be made in advance, and the discount must be mentioned at the time of booking.
* The discount applies to all mechanical and electrical repairs, including body shop repairs (accident, paint and denting).
* The discount must be applied at the time of payment and cannot be added later.
* All services are subject to the workshop's standard terms and service policies.

Emirates NBD, like any other bank or financial institution, needs to ask customers for proof of identity before they engage with them. This is to comply with Know Your Customer (KYC) regulations and anti-money laundering regulations to limit fraud. It’s important that you keep your personal information on record with us up to date for the same reason.

* Copies of Title Deed and Mortgage Deed

## Frequently Asked Questions  
[What is a credit card?](#accordion-1edc9910-4f6a-4bf8-9ea4-18dbda914e20 "What is a credit card")  
A credit card is a financial tool issued by banks that allows you to borrow money up to a predetermined limit to make purchases or withdraw cash. The borrowed amount must be repaid by the due date, either in full or through instalments, with interest applicable on outstanding balances. Credit cards also offer various benefits such as rewards, cashback, and travel perks.  
[What is a cashback credit card?](#accordion-bdda41a8-21c2-4b80-a4e8-7900f6246989 "What is a cashback credit card")  
A cashback credit card rewards you with a percentage of your spending in the form of cash rebates. For example, if a card offers 5% cashback on groceries, you receive 5 back for every 100 spent. Cashback cards in the UAE often have specific categories like fuel, dining, or online shopping where higher cashback rates apply.  
[What is balance transfer in a credit card?](#accordion-068db1ac-b45a-4652-9a22-619ef9079f72 "What is balance transfer in a credit card")  
A balance transfer lets you move credit card debt to a lower-interest card for easier repayment. **[Click here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/help-and-support/balance-transfer)** for more information.  
[How can we get a credit card in the UAE?](#accordion-7ef76717-d8ff-4173-904d-54e3296854c9 "How can we get a credit card in the UAE")

text:
Visa International Offers | Pre-Travel, London, Paris & Thailand | Emirates NBD > Visa international offers

##  
Eligibility depends on the offer. Pre-travel offers (Avis, Budget, Booking.com, Journey Collection and Travel Insurance) are open to Visa Gold, Platinum, Signature and Infinite cardholders. Destination offers (London, Paris and Thailand) are open to all Visa cardholders, with selected benefits reserved for Platinum/Signature/Infinite tiers. Please check each offer for the exact tier.  
##  
Click through to the offer on this page, follow the partner's redemption flow, and pay with your eligible Emirates NBD Visa card. Some offers require a promo code or a Visa invitation document to be presented at the venue — the offer page tells you which.  
##  
Most offers activate automatically when you pay with your eligible Emirates NBD Visa card. Some — like Avis Preferred and Avis President's Club — require a one-time enrolment so your benefits are linked to your profile.  
##  
Pre-travel offers (Avis, Budget, Booking.com) are valid globally. Destination offers are tied to the specific city or country featured. Validity windows differ — every offer shows its end date in the modal pop-up.  
##  
Yes. Visa offers are layered on top of your card's standard benefits (welcome miles, lounge access, travel insurance etc.) and don't replace them. Restrictions on combining with other promotions are noted in the individual offer terms.

## What are people asking?  
[What are the different ways to bank with Emirates NBD?](#accordion-7521462c-e1b5-477a-9334-91435cdb7e39 "What are the different ways to bank with Emirates NBD")  
Emirates NBD offers multiple banking channels, including mobile banking, online banking, ATMs, branches, and phone banking. These options allow customers to manage their finances conveniently based on their preferences. Whether you prefer digital self-service or in-person assistance, the bank ensures seamless access to services across all channels.  
[How does Mobile Banking work with Emirates NBD?](#accordion-2d2155a7-8e9b-4d93-ad5d-59e1988b5a19 "How does Mobile Banking work with Emirates NBD")  
The Emirates NBD mobile banking app allows customers to perform transactions such as fund transfers, bill payments, and account monitoring directly from their smartphones. It provides a secure and user-friendly interface with features like real-time notifications and quick access to financial services, making it a preferred option for everyday banking.  
[What services are available through Online Banking?](#accordion-634f8111-10e6-4205-8837-a96c2dbbff19 "What services are available through Online Banking")  
Online banking with Emirates NBD enables customers to access their accounts, transfer funds, pay bills, and manage investments through a web platform. It is designed for convenience and accessibility, allowing users to perform most banking activities without visiting a branch.

Ways of Banking - Personal Banking | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[Can I still visit a branch for banking services?](#accordion-63424d7d-4158-4f67-a51d-e5aba85e4b2b "Can I still visit a branch for banking services")  
Yes, Emirates NBD continues to offer branch banking for customers who prefer face-to-face interactions. Branches provide services such as account opening, financial consultations, and complex transactions. This ensures that customers have access to personalized support when needed.  
[What transactions can I perform at Emirates NBD ATMs and CDMs?](#accordion-058215f7-5df3-4253-9d62-c82a7f7141e5 "What transactions can I perform at Emirates NBD ATMs and CDMs")  
ATMs and cash deposit machines (CDMs) allow customers to withdraw cash, deposit funds, check balances, and perform basic banking transactions. These self-service machines are widely available and provide quick access to essential banking services without visiting a branch.  
[What are the different ways to bank with Emirates NBD?](#accordion-7521462c-e1b5-477a-9334-91435cdb7e39 "What are the different ways to bank with Emirates NBD")  
Emirates NBD offers multiple banking channels, including mobile banking, online banking, ATMs, branches, and phone banking. These options allow customers to manage their finances conveniently based on their preferences. Whether you prefer digital self-service or in-person assistance, the bank ensures seamless access to services across all channels.
title: Ways of Banking - Personal Banking | Emirates NBD

text:
Ways of Banking - Personal Banking | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[How does Mobile Banking work with Emirates NBD?](#accordion-2d2155a7-8e9b-4d93-ad5d-59e1988b5a19 "How does Mobile Banking work with Emirates NBD")  
The Emirates NBD mobile banking app allows customers to perform transactions such as fund transfers, bill payments, and account monitoring directly from their smartphones. It provides a secure and user-friendly interface with features like real-time notifications and quick access to financial services, making it a preferred option for everyday banking.  
[What services are available through Online Banking?](#accordion-634f8111-10e6-4205-8837-a96c2dbbff19 "What services are available through Online Banking")  
Online banking with Emirates NBD enables customers to access their accounts, transfer funds, pay bills, and manage investments through a web platform. It is designed for convenience and accessibility, allowing users to perform most banking activities without visiting a branch.  
[Can I still visit a branch for banking services?](#accordion-63424d7d-4158-4f67-a51d-e5aba85e4b2b "Can I still visit a branch for banking services")  
Yes, Emirates NBD continues to offer branch banking for customers who prefer face-to-face interactions. Branches provide services such as account opening, financial consultations, and complex transactions. This ensures that customers have access to personalized support when needed.
title: Ways of Banking - Personal Banking | Emirates NBD

text:
Ways of Banking - Personal Banking | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[What transactions can I perform at Emirates NBD ATMs and CDMs?](#accordion-058215f7-5df3-4253-9d62-c82a7f7141e5 "What transactions can I perform at Emirates NBD ATMs and CDMs")  
ATMs and cash deposit machines (CDMs) allow customers to withdraw cash, deposit funds, check balances, and perform basic banking transactions. These self-service machines are widely available and provide quick access to essential banking services without visiting a branch.  
[How secure are Emirates NBD digital banking channels?](#accordion-135ffcf4-90d0-4282-b926-76a88e00b018 "How secure are Emirates NBD digital banking channels")  
Emirates NBD uses advanced security measures such as encryption, multi-factor authentication, and real-time monitoring to protect customer data and transactions. These features ensure that both mobile and online banking platforms remain safe and reliable for users.  
[What is phone banking and how can it help me?](#accordion-f6f6e67c-2416-4a5e-8ad6-8e27cabd1741 "What is phone banking and how can it help me")  
Phone banking allows customers to access banking services by calling Emirates NBD’s customer support on **800-10**0 (in the UAE) or on **+971 4 316 0333** (from outside the UAE). It is useful for resolving queries, performing certain transactions, and receiving assistance when digital or branch access is not convenient. This adds another layer of accessibility to banking services.
title: Ways of Banking - Personal Banking | Emirates NBD

text:
Ways of Banking - Personal Banking | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[Which banking channel is best for everyday transactions?](#accordion-e03999fa-56af-4e08-9f15-c64e2510873f "Which banking channel is best for everyday transactions")  
For most everyday transactions, mobile and online banking are the most convenient options. They offer quick, 24/7 access to essential services like transfers, payments, and account monitoring. Emirates NBD’s digital platforms are designed to reduce the need for branch visits while maintaining full functionality.  
[Can I switch between different banking channels easily?](#accordion-d4b5a0bf-5988-43aa-b54a-895ebbfc5017 "Can I switch between different banking channels easily")  
Yes, Emirates NBD allows seamless switching between channels such as mobile, online, ATM, and branch banking. Customer data and account information are integrated across platforms, ensuring a consistent experience regardless of how you choose to bank.  
[Why does Emirates NBD offer multiple ways of banking?](#accordion-eeeef2ea-256e-47fe-9204-af28410b5dec "Why does Emirates NBD offer multiple ways of banking")  
Emirates NBD provides multiple banking channels to meet diverse customer preferences and needs. While digital banking offers speed and convenience,[branches](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/branches-and-atms)and phone banking provide personalized support. This omnichannel approach ensures flexibility, accessibility, and a better overall banking experience.

## An investment approach **tailored** to you  
Our guiding principle is to provide you with knowledgeable and appropriate advice. We make no decisions for you. Our wealth advisors are selected and trained to ensure that you receive all the information and guidance you need to create an investment plan that is right for you.  
You will have an initial in-depth conversation with your dedicated wealth advisor to enable us to understand your current financial position, as well as your goals and needs. Only after that has been completed and agreed will we suggest a suitable investment portfolio designed specifically for you, and then support you with regular updates and advice throughout the investment lifecycle.

##### Business Vehicle and Equipment Loans  
#### Get the vehicles and equipment you need to drive your business forward.  
Whether you operate in transportation, car rentals, travel and tourism, logistics, manufacturing, construction, or the FMCG sector, we’ve got you covered.  
We understand your business needs and offer financing for a wide range of assets, including:  
* Trucks, trailers, and heavy buses
* Pick-ups and vans
* Light, medium, and heavy commercial vehicles
* Multi-utility vehicles
* Equipment and machinery  
![PromoCardWithLinks  Explore limitedperiod offers](/-/media/enbd/images/campaign-form/bg/bvel_img2_slider.jpg?la=en&h=1250&w=2500&hash=700F26A1664AF2CFDF4DAEB548A803FD)  
#### Explore limited-period offers to support your business growth  
We offer financing of up to 100%\* of the asset value, including insurance costs, at competitive interest rates. Loan amounts can go up to 10 million\*\*, with flexible repayment terms of up to 60 months.  
Our dedicated vehicle finance team, available across the UAE, ensures fast approvals, efficient document processing, and personalised support every step of the way.  
Plus, we’ve partnered with leading vehicle distributors nationwide to secure the best deals for your business.

text:
Credit Card Instalment Plans - Easy Monthly Payments | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

## What are people asking?  
[How long will it take to process my instalment request?](#accordion-91d43f25-7f4c-4205-bb52-932a889c2d09 "How long will it take to process my instalment request")  
Your request will be processed instantly and reflect from the second credit card statement onwards.  
The principal amount and the accrued interest until the second card statement date will be included in the subsequent instalments starting from the second card statement  
[How long do I have to repay the amount I convert to an instalment plan?](#accordion-8d2cc340-e106-4d75-b6d5-0fe2f502404c "How long do I have to repay the amount I convert to an instalment plan")  
You can choose to pay back over 12, 18, 24, 36 or 48 months.  
[What happens if I miss a monthly instalment?](#accordion-67bd0a96-32d3-4250-9274-7f4b64a273e2 "What happens if I miss a monthly instalment")  
If you miss a monthly payment, your instalment plan will automatically be foreclosed. The full outstanding balance will be due immediately including foreclosure fees, and regular finance charges will apply to the remaining amount.  
[Can I cancel my Instalment Plan, and will I be charged?](#accordion-e2f249e0-fd1c-4edd-a535-e5ed757a3c62 "Can I cancel my Instalment Plan and will I be charged")  
Yes, you can cancel at any time. A foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding and 5% VAT, will apply. To cancel, call us on [600 54 0000](tel:600540000) (UAE) or [+971 600 54 0000](tel:+971600540000) internationally.

text:
Credit Card Instalment Plans - Easy Monthly Payments | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[Can I cancel my Instalment Plan, and will I be charged?](#accordion-e2f249e0-fd1c-4edd-a535-e5ed757a3c62 "Can I cancel my Instalment Plan and will I be charged")  
Yes, you can cancel at any time. A foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding and 5% VAT, will apply. To cancel, call us on [600 54 0000](tel:600540000) (UAE) or [+971 600 54 0000](tel:+971600540000) internationally.  
[Are there any early settlement charges?](#accordion-7c46982b-9e70-4693-9f1f-64d90cf34a5d "Are there any early settlement charges")  
Yes, if you settle the Instalment Plan early, a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding plus 5% VAT, will apply.  
[Can I change the tenure on an existing instalment plan?](#accordion-1f9668bd-e62f-467e-86f6-39f40d0aa070 "Can I change the tenure on an existing instalment plan")  
No, but you can foreclose your plan by paying a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding plus 5% VAT, then rebook the remaining balance into a new plan.  
[What is the interest rate for an instalment plan?](#accordion-00fcfd59-36cc-4141-887f-a34a865acf92 "What is the interest rate for an instalment plan")  
A reducing monthly interest rate determined by Emirates NBD and charged on the principal amount, will apply. The interest rate is subject to change and is also based on Card usage and overall performance.
title: Credit Card Instalment Plans - Easy Monthly Payments | Emirates NBD

text:
Credit Card Instalment Plans - Easy Monthly Payments | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[What happens to the Instalment Plan if I prepay what I owe?](#accordion-2ae0e155-5d1c-4cc0-bd7a-e020d839c957 "What happens to the Instalment Plan if I prepay what I owe")  
Even if you prepay the full amount, your plan will remain active until you request cancellation by calling us on [600 54 0000](tel:600540000) (UAE) or [+971600540000](tel:+971600540000) internationally. Once you call and cancel, a foreclosure fee of 1% of the principal outstanding and 5% VAT, will apply.  
[What happens if I close my Credit Card while I have an instalment plan?](#accordion-11909661-48b1-4764-8807-25a34f3c1bf5 "What happens if I close my Credit Card while I have an instalment plan")  
All active instalment plans must be foreclosed before a Credit Card cancellation request can be processed. Foreclosure fees will apply.  
[When is my first instalment amount billed?](#accordion-a8173998-2625-4571-ae9a-853f6a2cc48d "When is my first instalment amount billed")  
The first instalment will reflect on the second card statement post booking.  
The principal amount and the accrued interest up to the second card statement date will be included in the subsequent instalments starting from the second card statement

The menu at Bijou Patisserie include as well breakfast, takeaway specials, and a variety of indulgences from delicate pastries and sweets such as classic croissants, éclairs, lemon tarts, and Chef Romain’s signature cannelés Bordelais in a variety of different flavors.

## Quick Answers  
[I’ve not received my OTP. What should I do?](#accordion-1fdbbdfb-f81a-443c-9711-d247d51d6222 "Ive not received my OTP. What should I do")  
Please ensure you’re using a mobile number registered with us. If you still don’t receive the OTP SMS and OTP Email, call us on [**+971 600 54 0000**](tel:+971600540000) and when prompted, say ‘Authentication Code not received’.  
[Is it safe to share my card number?](#accordion-c14e16bd-40cc-461b-87a6-b5f8a7f4570b "Is it safe to share my card number")  
You should avoid sharing any of your bank details with people you don’t know or can’t trust. It’s ok to share this information with the bank in a safe manner. Rest assured we do not share this information with anyone. Read more about how we keep you safe [here](https://www.emiratesnbd.com/en/security/?ref=beta).

## What are people asking?  
[What is the Signature Package in Emirates NBD Priority Banking?](#accordion-25b8f1e2-4bca-4612-8b58-c25649bb4f7b "What is the Signature Package in Emirates NBD Priority Banking")  
The Signature Package is a premium offering within Emirates NBD Priority Banking that combines personalized banking, wealth management, and lifestyle privileges. It is designed for affluent clients who want preferential rates, dedicated relationship support, and exclusive benefits. The package integrates financial solutions with lifestyle enhancements, making it a comprehensive banking experience tailored to high-value customers.  
[What are the main benefits of the Emirates NBD Signature Package?](#accordion-c967d305-9bf3-41e6-9f77-8e3345b55e22 "What are the main benefits of the Emirates NBD Signature Package")  
The Signature Package offers a range of benefits, including preferential pricing on loans and deposits, access to wealth management solutions, and dedicated relationship management. Customers also enjoy exclusive lifestyle privileges such as travel benefits, concierge services, and curated experiences. These benefits are designed to enhance both financial growth and everyday convenience.  
[Who is eligible for the Signature Package?](#accordion-5dde9f9a-be4f-4490-a8b8-73ef7e3db0f0 "Who is eligible for the Signature Package")
title: Signature by Priority Banking | Benefits | Emirates NBD

text:
Signature by Priority Banking | Benefits | Emirates NBD > What are people asking?

[Who is eligible for the Signature Package?](#accordion-5dde9f9a-be4f-4490-a8b8-73ef7e3db0f0 "Who is eligible for the Signature Package")

# How to save money on your utility bill  
![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/logomark.svg)  
Curated by Emirates NBD

![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/assets/images/calendar.svg)

![](https://cdn.emiratesnbd.com/deals/images/tiles/How-to-save-money-on-a-utility%20bill.jpg)  
Some things in life are necessities, having a roof over your head, food to eat, and energy to use in your home. As utility costs rise, you might want to look for ways to reduce your utility bill and save money. Try some of these tips to save money on your next utility bill.  
**Clean your appliances**  
Did you know that cleaning appliances in your home could save energy and reduce your utility bill? That’s because when some appliances are dirty, they need to use more energy to run.  
Take your refrigerator, for example. When your refrigerator’s coils are dirty, the appliance needs to use more energy to cool your food. If you clean your appliances regularly, they’ll run more efficiently, saving you money in the process.  
**Unplug your devices**  
When you power down your home computer or television, you might think that you’re done using energy, but this isn’t the case. Devices left plugged in continue to use energy. So, unplug large devices and appliances when they aren’t in use. Your wallet will thank you.

text:
How to save money on your utility bill | Emirates NBD > How to save money on your utility bill

**Switch off utilities**  
If you’re traveling or won’t be home for more than a day, try turning off your air conditioner, and other utilities. Why waste this energy when no one is there.  
**Manage your home temperature**  
For each degree of air conditioning or heat you’re using, you’re spending more money. The less you change the temperature in your home, the better when it comes to your wallet. Keeping your home around 24°C should still be comfortable while saving you money at the same time.  
**Seal gaps in windows or doors**  
You probably don’t realize it, but there may be small gaps in the cracks of your windows or doors. While these may not seem like a big deal, they could be causing outside air to come in. Why does that matter? Well, if you’re using your air conditioning or heat, the more air coming in from the outside, the more energy you will use to cool or heat your home. You can prevent this by sealing windows or doors throughout your house using caulk, putty, or anything else that will help seal the gaps.  
**Limit hot water usage**  
To get water hot it must be heated, which uses energy. The hotter your water, and the longer you leave it running, the higher your utility bill will be. So, try and limit your hot water usage to save money. If you’re up to it, take a cold shower! This won’t just save you money, but has amazing health benefits as well.

## Funded  
Funded lines support the short-term cash flow requirements of your business, so you can focus on growth opportunities and cash flow management. Our facilities include funding your supply chain, operational expenses and discounting future trade receivables.  
![Overdraft](/-/media/enbd/images/business-banking/working-capital/working_cap_overdraft.png?la=en&h=100&w=100&hash=7485B08D8127FDF030810B6F4DBA1DF6)  
#### Overdraft  
However, successful your business, your cashflow may not always match your financing needs. A short or longer-term overdraft is often the fastest and easiest way of bridging a temporary gap. We can negotiate attractive terms and competitive rates to meet your specific business context.  
![Cheque Discounting](/-/media/enbd/images/business-banking/working-capital/working_cap_cheqdiscounting.png?la=en&h=100&w=100&hash=5DFF4A2BF3A8BE00E6E6FE8AD7E11B64)  
#### Cheque Discounting  
We can help you meet your financing immediate needs by facilitating payment on post-dated cheques. Whether for batches or single larger payments, if you need your business income to be more manageable, a discount facility could be the right option for your business.  
![Loan Against Trust Receivables](/-/media/enbd/images/business-banking/working-capital/working_cap_loantrustreceivables.png?la=en&h=100&w=100&hash=A32F13657F56FC1CE45838D7734E7114)  
#### Loan Against Trust Receivables
title: Working Capital | Funded and Non-Funded Lines | Emirates NBD

text:
Working Capital | Funded and Non-Funded Lines | Emirates NBD > Funded

#### Loan Against Trust Receivables  
The relationship we have with you gives us a clear picture of your income flows, which may include sources outside your primary business. A loan using trust receivables as collateral can be easily and quickly arranged at highly preferable rates  
![Loan Against POS Receivables](/-/media/enbd/images/business-banking/working-capital/working_cap_loanposreceivables.png?la=en&h=100&w=100&hash=12CF6BB41B984DAFD91066FF229A778A)  
#### Loan Against POS Receivables  
We can help you use it to support your ongoing financial needs. If you are a merchant using credit card Point of Sale (POS) machines for your daily business transactions, that value is your POS receivables. It can be used to leverage a loan of up to 5 million for 48 months, offering low interest rates and a top-up facility after 12 months. It does not even have to be our POS machine.  
[Click here for eligibility and documents required](javascript:ENBD.OpenDialog('lapr') "Loan Against POS Receivables")

## Requirements and documents for opening an account  
[UAE Nationals](#accordion-ff0efc17-2606-4262-98db-57691546bddd "UAE Nationals")  
* **Identification**
+ Original Emirates ID and copy
+ Copy of passport
* **In case of a salary transfer account, we’ll need one of the following documents:**
+ Copy of Labor Card
+ Copy of Employee ID
+ Latest salary letter
+ Copy of employment visa page from passport  
[Expats](#accordion-1f6960bb-f1e7-49ab-940e-87ddecb96980 "Expats")  
* **Identification**
+ Original Emirates ID and copy
+ Copy of passport
* **In case of a salary transfer account, we’ll need one of the following documents:**
+ Salary transfer letter (not more than 30 days from date of issue for non-government companies. For government companies, validity as mentioned in the letter.)
+ Copy of appointment letter or contract
+ Copy of payslip (less than 3 months old)
+ Statement with previous month’s salary
+ **For bulk accounts:** consolidated letter from HR (with salary of each employee mentioned)  
[Non-residents](#accordion-c3957b4c-cd0f-4588-be30-315bae2c3dfe "Nonresidents")  
* **Passport and copy with visa page and one of the following documents**
+ Utility bill (not more than 3 months old)
+ Bank statements (not more than 3 months old, and you can print these off online banking too)

##### Terms and conditions  
* The offer is not valid in conjunction with any other promotions or discounts.

## Who We Are  
Emirates NBD Capital (EmCap) is the global investment bank for Emirates NBD Group. We are located at the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and are regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA) along with The Securities and Commodities Authority (SCA) for onshore UAE activities.  
We are also licensed by the regulatory authorities in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), India, the UK, Türkiye, Singapore and Egypt to provide a full suite
of Investment Banking services, through dedicated teams on the ground supported by Emirates NBD Capital UAE.

text:
Card stuck in ATM | Support | Emirates NBD > We'll replace your card for free

## We'll replace your card for free  
Your debit or credit card can be captured by the ATM for several reasons. When this happens, inform the bank immediately by calling [+971 600 54 0000](tel:+971600540000). We recommend that you have the bank block the card to prevent misuse.  
Possible reasons your card can get stuck in the ATM:  
* You enter the wrong PIN three times
* You take too long to retrieve your card from the ATM after your transaction
* The card is blocked
* The ATM may not be working  
**What happens next**  
The card will be retrieved by the vendor servicing the machine and sent back to the bank operating the ATM. If it’s not an Emirates NBD ATM, the operating bank will send the card to us. You can call us to have the card replaced free of cost. Your new card will have a new number, CVV and expiry date, and you can start using it after you [activate the card and set your new PIN](/en/help-and-support/activate-your-credit-or-debit-card).

## FAQs  
[What’s the quickest way to change my card PIN?](#faqs-whats-the-quickest-way-to-change-my-card-pin "Whats the quickest way to change my card PIN")  
Online Banking or Mobile Banking are the quickest ways to change your card PIN. Just follow [these instructions](/en/help-and-support/change-your-card-pin).  
[Can I restrict a supplementary debit card from cash withdrawals?](#faqs-can-i-restrict-a-supplementary-debit-card-from-cash-withdrawals "Can I restrict a supplementary debit card from cash withdrawals")  
Yes, you can do this by [setting the card’s daily and monthly cash withdrawal limit](/en/help-and-support/change-your-supplementary-debit-card-limits) to below AED100. This is the minimum amount for a cash withdrawal at ATMs in the UAE.

# United Against Fraud  
## In the battle of Real Vs Fake, you lose your money.  
Scammers are getting more creative and are making fake websites and social media accounts, that closely resemble Emirates NBD’s or any other company’s official pages. Tricking customers into entering their banking credentials is their motive.  
These fraudulent sites can steal your personal and financial information, putting your money and security at risk, and may appear as sponsored listing on the top of the search engines or social media apps.

text:
Private Banking Foreign Exchange Solutions | Emirates NBD > Manage your wealth using foreign exchange

## Manage your wealth using foreign exchange  
As a more sophisticated investor you may wish to use Forward Contracts or Currency Options on foreign exchange to benefit from currency movements.  
Forward Contracts are an agreement between you and the Bank to buy or sell a specified amount of foreign currency at a rate agreed today for delivery on a specified date in the future. The benefits of this are:  
* Fixed exchange rate at which you may buy or sell a certain amount of currency
* Plan for future currency needs
* Hedge against adverse foreign exchange movements
* Wide list of currencies available
* Certainty of cash flow  
#### FX Forwards and Options Features

text:
Private Banking Foreign Exchange Solutions | Emirates NBD > Locking in **your best rates**

## Locking in **your best rates**  
Currency Options provide the right to certain protection at a specified foreign exchange rate on a specific forward date, but with the flexibility of choosing to opt for a spot deal. It works exactly like an insurance policy, in that you pay a premium for the protection you want on an FX rate. Its features include  
**Available in any currency pair where there is a forward market**  
**No obligation to deal at your protected rate – you can withdraw from the deal at maturity or transact in the spot market if the rate moves in your favor**  
**Full protection against adverse currency movements**

Simplify your Payable Process by integrating your Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) with smartSCF. Other features include Host to Host and Manual Invoice upload.  
![Dynamic](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/common-icons/dynamic_discounting_icon_cib.png?la=en&h=250&w=250&hash=3B02C962FE53698634B16A4C047A3615)

text:
SmartSCF | Digital Supply Chain Financing Platform | Emirates NBD > Dynamic Discounting

### Dynamic Discounting  
An innovative solution introduced in this region for the first time. Buyers can use their surplus cash and earn higher risk-free return. By using their cash flows to fund early supplier payments through various discounting models, suppliers get early payments at preferential financing rate.  
![Mutual](/-/media/enbd/images/cib/common-icons/shakehands_cib_icons.png?la=en&h=160&w=250&hash=B3DD09FBC3272B69073AC4888D7931E1)
title: SmartSCF | Digital Supply Chain Financing Platform | Emirates NBD

text:
SmartSCF | Digital Supply Chain Financing Platform | Emirates NBD > Mutual Platform Access

### Mutual Platform Access  
Reduce inquiry traffic from suppliers with platform access to both corporate buyers and suppliers.  
**How it Works**  
smartSCF allows you to digitize your payable process, so you can benefit from improved cash flow and working capital efficiencies. In turn, your suppliers benefit from early payment of their invoices without the need for collaterals and at competitive rates.

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > We have you covered

## We have you covered  
We offer a host of insurance plans, so you can protect everything precious to you – your loved ones, your wellbeing, your home, cars and property. Read more about the plans we have on offer, choose what suits your needs best and be well-prepared for life’s unexpected events.
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

## FAQs  
[Can I get travel insurance for someone with a pre-existing medical condition?](#faqs-can-i-get-travel-insurance-for-someone-with-a-pre-existing-medical-condition "Can I get travel insurance for someone with a preexisting medical condition")  
Yes you can, but pre-existing conditions will not be covered by the policy.  
[What are the advantages of an annual travel insurance policy?](#faqs-what-are-the-advantages-of-an-annual-travel-insurance-policy "What are the advantages of an annual travel insurance policy")  
An annual policy is good for someone who is likely to travel more frequently as it is more cost-effective, and you don’t have to notify us every time you travel.  
[What is the difference between single trip and annual cover travel insurance?](#faqs-what-is-the-difference-between-single-trip-and-annual-cover-travel-insurance "What is the difference between single trip and annual cover travel insurance")  
A single trip policy covers you only for one specified trip, whereas an annual policy will cover you for multiple trips made during the year without having to notify us. The cover and the limits offered for our annual and single trip policies are identical.  
[What is the definition of a pre-existing condition?](#faqs-what-is-the-definition-of-a-pre-existing-condition "What is the definition of a preexisting condition")
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

A pre-existing condition is defined as any medical condition which existed prior to a journey affecting you and/or any close relative and/or travelling companion, including but not limited to (a) a condition for which the person is on a waiting list for hospital in-patient treatment, (b) a condition referred to a medical specialist, (c) a condition or the cause of in-patient treatment within 12 months prior to the journey, or (d) a condition for which a terminal prognosis has been provided by a medical practitioner.  
[Am I covered for pregnancy related claims?](#faqs-am-i-covered-for-pregnancy-related-claims "Am I covered for pregnancy related claims")  
Our travel insurance policy covers pregnancy related claims up until 10 weeks prior to the estimated date of delivery.  
[Are children covered free of charge for travel insurance?](#faqs-are-children-covered-free-of-charge-for-travel-insurance "Are children covered free of charge for travel insurance")  
No children are not covered free, but a reduced rate is charged and they still need to be added into the policy.  
[Is scuba diving covered under my travel insurance policy?](#faqs-is-scuba-diving-covered-under-my-travel-insurance-policy "Is scuba diving covered under my travel insurance policy")  
Yes it is, provided you are with an instructor and you are diving no deeper than 30 metres.
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

Yes it is, provided you are with an instructor and you are diving no deeper than 30 metres.  
[What is the age limit for a travel insurance policy?](#faqs-what-is-the-age-limit-for-a-travel-insurance-policy "What is the age limit for a travel insurance policy")  
Anyone less than 16 years old is considered a child. The maximum age up to which you can be insured is 75 years.  
[Why is there a 65-year age limit for some travel insurance claims?](#faqs-why-is-there-a-65-year-age-limit "Why is there a 65year age limit for some travel insurance claims")  
The reason we have a 65-year age limit on some travel insurance is because of the high probability of claims from this age group. If we covered these risks, the result would be a general raise in all premiums for everyone. However, we always try to be accommodating, so please speak to us and we’ll do the best we can to help.  
[Can I choose which garage I want to take my vehicle to?](#faqs-can-i-choose-which-garage-i-want-to-take-my-vehicle-to "Can I choose which garage I want to take my vehicle to")  
If you have opted for agency repairs, then your vehicle will be repaired at the main authorised dealership. Otherwise, the insurance company will select one of its authorised repairers depending on the vehicle type, nature of damage and availability.  
[Can I insure my home if it is used for business?](#faqs-can-i-insure-my-home-if-it-is-used-for-business "Can I insure my home if it is used for business")
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

Our home insurance policy is designed for items of personal use only. However, if your home-office is used for anything other than paperwork and telephone calls, like for e.g., if you receive visits from clients/customers, employ staff, or keep business related cash or stock at the property, please call us to discuss your requirements.  
[Do I need to list all of my contents?](#faqs-do-i-need-to-list-all-of-my-contents "Do I need to list all of my contents")  
No, you only need to specify items in the home that are worth more than 40,000 and 10,000 under personal possessions.  
[Do I need to provide valuation or proof of purchases for my items?](#faqs-do-i-need-to-provide-valuation-or-proof-of-purchases-for-my-items "Do I need to provide valuation or proof of purchases for my items")  
No, you don’t, although, we may ask at the time of claim for any proof of purchase like receipts or any operating manuals. However, for items those are specified in the policy under cover outside of the home should be supported by proof of purchase or a recent valuation certificate.  
[Do you offer travel cover for skiing holidays?](#faqs-do-you-offer-travel-cover-for-skiing-holidays "Do you offer travel cover for skiing holidays")
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

Yes, we do offer a skiing option that provides cover on a range of skiing benefits for customers who want to take part in normal winter sports activities. Please tick this box when requesting an online home insurance quotation. A premium charge will be made for this extension.  
[Do you provide GCC and Oman coverage for motor insurance?](#faqs-do-you-provide-gcc-and-oman-coverage-for-motor-insurance "Do you provide GCC and Oman coverage for motor insurance")  
Yes, GCC and Oman cover is provided at an additional cost.  
[Does Emirates NBD provide motor insurance for high-value cars and sports cars?](#faqs-does-emirates-nbd-provide-motor-insurance-for-high-value-cars-and-sports-cars "Does Emirates NBD provide motor insurance for highvalue cars and sports cars")  
Insurance for high-value cars or sports cars can be arranged on a referral basis only.  
[How are lost or damaged items replaced in the home insurance policy?](#faqs-how-are-lost-or-damaged-items-replaced-in-the-home-insurance-policy "How are lost or damaged items replaced in the home insurance policy")  
All lost or damaged items will all be replaced on a new for old basis (except for clothing, where a wear and tear deduction may be made).  
[How do you calculate my motor insurance premium?](#faqs-how-do-you-calculate-my-motor-insurance-premium "How do you calculate my motor insurance premium")
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

A number of factors are used to calculate your insurance premium. Amongst these factors are the age of the driver, length of driving experience, claims history, location, value of the vehicle and type.  
[How many days can I holiday for under the travel insurance policy?](#faqs-how-many-days-can-i-holiday-for-under-the-travel-insurance-policy "How many days can I holiday for under the travel insurance policy")  
This is set by you when applying. Single trips are covered for up to 62 days, which is also the limit for annual policies.  
[How much should I insure my home contents for?](#faqs-how-much-should-i-insure-my-home-contents-for "How much should I insure my home contents for")  
As a general guideline, contents are all of the items you would be likely to take when moving out including carpets, curtains, furniture, electrical appliances, valuables, clothing and personal effects. Your contents sum insured must represent the total current replacement cost of all such items in your home. Items that are to be insured outside of the home do not need to be included in this sum.  
[If I sell my car, is it possible to transfer the insurance to the buyer's name?](#faqs-if-i-sell-my-car-is-it-possible-to-transfer-the-insurance-to-the-buyers-name "If I sell my car is it possible to transfer the insurance to the buyers name")
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

As the insurance premium is affected by the profile of the driver, it is not possible to simply transfer insurance cover from one driver to another. The existing policy must be cancelled. The new owner will then be given a new insurance policy that is required for registration purposes.  
[In case the motor insurance policy is cancelled, do you return the premium for the unexpired period?](#faqs-in-case-the-motor-insurance-policy-is-cancelled-do-you-return-the-premium-for-the-unexpired-period "In case the motor insurance policy is cancelled do you return the premium for the unexpired period")  
The premium for the unexpired period is returned as long as no claims were made during the insurance period. The refund is calculated on pro rata basis.  
[Is it mandatory to have motor insurance in the UAE?](#faqs-is-it-mandatory-to-have-motor-insurance-in-the-uae "Is it mandatory to have motor insurance in the UAE")  
Yes, you are legally required to insure your vehicle in the UAE.  
[I've decided to cancel my holiday due to the risk of terrorism. Can I claim a refund?](#faqs-ive-decided-to-cancel-my-holiday-due-to-the-risk-of-terrorism-can-i-claim-a-refund "Ive decided to cancel my holiday due to the risk of terrorism. Can I claim a refund")  
Cancellation on the grounds of war or terrorism isn't covered by your policy.

[What happens if I have a medical emergency or other travel related problems abroad?](#faqs-what-happens-if-i-have-a-medical-emergency-or-other-travel-related-problems-abroad "What happens if I have a medical emergency or other travel related problems abroad")  
We have a dedicated 24-hour Assistance Centre that you can contact from anywhere in the world. Call [+971 4 601 8777](tel:046018777) for help. Repatriation to the UAE will be arranged if it is deemed medically necessary.  
[What happens if I'm the victim of a terrorist attack while I’m abroad?](#faqs-what-happens-if-im-the-victim-of-a-terrorist-attack-while-im-abroad "What happens if Im the victim of a terrorist attack while Im abroad")  
War and terrorism are standard exclusions under the terms and conditions of this and most other travel insurance policies.  
[What is a motor insurance policy?](#faqs-what-is-a-motor-insurance-policy "What is a motor insurance policy")  
A motor insurance policy is a mandatory policy issued by an insurance company as part of prevention of public liability to protect the general public from any accident that might take place on the road. UAE law mandates that every owner of a motor vehicle must have a motor insurance policy.
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

[What is considered outside of the home cover (personal belongings)?](#faqs-what-is-considered-outside-of-the-home-cover-personal-belongings "What is considered outside of the home cover personal belongings")  
This cover is for objects that are literally "taken outside of the home", for e.g., cameras, watches, sunglasses and jewellery. This cover can be arranged on both a specified and an unspecified basis. You need to specify items that are over 5,000, if you require these to be insured outside of the home. For objects below this amount, a general sum insured can be provided, for e.g., up to 3,000.  
[What is off-road coverage?](#faqs-what-is-off-road-coverage "What is offroad coverage")  
The coverage under the policy is extended to include loss or damage to your insured vehicle and/or third-party liability while being driven off the road.  
[What is the compulsory excess indicated on my motor policy?](#faqs-what-is-the-compulsory-excess-indicated-on-my-motor-policy "What is the compulsory excess indicated on my motor policy")  
The excess or deductible is the customer contribution made at the time of non-recoverable claim(s) due to an accident. Non-recoverable motor claims usually occur when an accident is caused by the insurance policy holder. Our standard excess is as per UAE law.
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

[What is the difference between a full cover insurance and third-party insurance?](#faqs-what-is-the-difference-between-a-full-cover-insurance-and-third-party-insurance "What is the difference between a full cover insurance and thirdparty insurance")  
Full car insurance policy covers you against loss, damage and third-party liability. You are also protected against damage to your motor vehicle due to accidental collision, overturning, fire, external explosion, self-ignition, theft, or a malicious act unless specifically excluded. Accrued legal liability and agreed costs and expenses against third party bodily injury/property damage arising out of use of motor vehicles unless specifically excluded. Third-party liability covers you against death or bodily injury to any third party/person. Damages to third party property arising out of the use of your motor vehicle. More importantly, this policy does not cover any damage or loss to your own vehicle.  
[What is the excess (deductible) if I claim?](#faqs-what-is-the-excess-deductible-if-i-claim "What is the excess deductible if I claim")  
The excess or deductible is the customer contribution made at the time of non-recoverable claim(s) due to an accident. Non-recoverable motor claims usually occur when an accident is caused by the insurance policy holder. Our standard excess is as per UAE law.  
[What is the excess if I claim?](#faqs-what-is-the-excess-if-i-claim "What is the excess if I claim")
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

[What is the excess if I claim?](#faqs-what-is-the-excess-if-i-claim "What is the excess if I claim")  
This depends on what section you are claiming under. The standard excess for buildings is 1,000, contents is 250, and cover outside the home is 250.  
[What is the ‘No Claim Discount’?](#faqs-what-is-the-no-claim-discount "What is the No Claim Discount")  
A No Claims Discount (NCD) is the discount given on your premium based on the experience (i.e. number of years without claims) of the driver.  
[What is the procedure to cancel my motor insurance policy?](#faqs-what-is-the-procedure-to-cancel-my-motor-insurance-policy "What is the procedure to cancel my motor insurance policy")  
To cancel the policy, please call the direct line of our sales agents [+971 4 3160171](tel:+971 4 3160171), [+971 4 3160094](tel:+971 4 3160094), [+971 4 3160097](tel:+971 4 3160097), [+971 4 3160944](tel:+971 4 3160944).  
[Why can't the insurance and registration be in two different names?](#faqs-why-cant-the-insurance-and-registration-be-in-two-different-names "Why cant the insurance and registration be in two different names")  
The policy holder must have a financial interest in the vehicle. The Traffic Department will only register a vehicle in the name stated on the certificate of motor insurance.  
[Why do I need 13 months of insurance and not 12 months?](#faqs-why-do-i-need-13-months-of-insurance-and-not-12-months "Why do I need 13 months of insurance and not 12 months")
title: Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD

text:
Our  insurance plans| Emirates NBD > FAQs

A 13-month insurance period is required to cover the one-month registration grace period.  
[Will my home insurance policy be affected if I go away on holiday?](#faqs-will-my-home-insurance-policy-be-affected-if-i-go-away-on-holiday "Will my home insurance policy be affected if I go away on holiday")  
Your home is covered for a maximum of 60 days while you are away on holiday. If you're planning to be away for longer than 60 days, please contact us to arrange for your home insurance cover to be extended.  
[Will my home insurance policy be affected if I make multiple claims?](#faqs-will-my-home-insurance-policy-be-affected-if-i-make-multiple-claims "Will my home insurance policy be affected if I make multiple claims")  
In most cases, it shouldn't make a big difference. However, for the small number of cases where the number of claims are well above the average, we may alter the terms of cover and/or increase the premium when it's time to renew the policy. If you have a break-in, we'll offer suggestions on home security and may ask you to carry out security improvements at your next renewal.
